name: AP Tours Malaysia
reviews: We had an excellent experience with AP tours during our time in Malaysia. Our guide, Amarjit, took us to many places of interest over several days. He was patient, very helpful, and always polite, making sure we were comfortable and well looked after throughout the trip. His local knowledge and good manners really added to the experience and made our journey smooth and enjoyable. We truly appreciated his service and would highly recommend him to anyone visiting Malaysia.

Our trip to Malaysia in nov was amazing. Entire 4 days, we had our guide/driver/friend/everything for us , and he made our tour memorable. Amarjeet, is very kind , helpful, never said no attitude, humble person. We really enjoyed the journey

It's was the best experience by ap tours Malaysia it's very friendly and safe to travel on a tour even ur a ladies like me always traveling alone I highly recommend to book this travel agency so that u can explore the beauty of Malaysia

name: Georgetown ~ Walk the Legacy, Live the Culture, Taste the Story :)
street: The entrance of the courtyard, 23, Lebuh Pantai
reviews: We had a beautiful morning on the tour; we saw many things we wouldn't have been able to see on our own. She is a very kind and fun person. We are very grateful for everything we were able to appreciate in beautiful Penang. We highly recommend it.

Strolling through Georgetown with Joo felt like unlocking Penang’s secret heartbeat. Honestly, I got more than my money’s worth .… Thank you, Joo, for being so generous with your wisdom, your warmth, and your friendship.

I was looking for a guide who could not only show me historical sites but actual history behind them and Joo didn't disappoint at all, she went above and beyond my expectations.
Sharp as a tack and hilariously entertaining, her grandmother’s tales had me in stitches—definitely not the kind of history you’ll find in any textbook

name: Darul ilmi Campsite
reviews: Area suitable for camping activities, chalet rentals for school programs, universities, corporations, and family activities. Also suitable for campervan gangs.. Has electricity source, spacious parking, located in a fenced area..Having a very large private swimming pool. The area is surrounded by beautiful hill views. 2 minutes from a clean river.

Very friendly guy, speaking English:)

Nice place with electric power, pool and toilets.

In middle of jungle

reviews: 4月1日にオープンしたコースで天ぷらやお刺身などが食べられるお店です。カウンター席11席で明るく綺麗で落ち着く店内です。5月4日に妻と伺いました。料理もコース料理のみで13品ほどいただきました。出来立て揚げたてで､とても満足できました。お酒の種類も豊富です。予約して行かれることをお勧めします。

商店街の中にひっそりとあるコース料理の天ぷら屋さん。

日本酒もあり、楽しく食事が出来たのでまた行きたいと思います。

name: K Fry Urban Korean KL East
street: Lot G3-13, KL East Mall, Jln Lingkaran Tengah 2
reviews: We had such a lovely lunch here while celebrating my husband’s birthday (13/01/26). The service was excellent, and Miss Mimi really stood out.She is cheerful, friendly, and truly made us feel special. She definitely deserves a Best Staff award! Thank you to the entire KFry team for making our celebration memorable. We will surely be back.

Tried a variety of items. The K’Fry Original Chicken was average, with the chicken breast slightly dry. The Honey Butter Chicken stood out, nicely balanced and pleasantly sweet. The Snow Cheese Original Chicken was disappointing due to very minimal cheese powder and a lack of cheese flavour.

The Chicken Slice & Cheese Riceballs were prepared tableside, which was a nice touch, with an overall decent taste. The Shin Volcanic Corn Cheese Bokkeummyeon was enjoyable, a comforting mix of noodles, fried egg, cheese, and corn. The Watermelon Fruit Tea was refreshing and not overly sweet, a good palate cleanser after fried food.

Overall, the food was generally satisfactory. Service was a highlight, with professional, well-trained, and friendly staff.

This is my 1st time eating Kfry Lunch Set. . The set includes 1 fried chicken and you can choose 3 side dishes . The price is only RM19.90 (not including tax). The cold plain water served FOC.
Totally worth your penny.
Additionally, the service was very good. Even though they are well known korean franchise restaurant, the staff still asked me how was the food, was everything alright..made me feels comfortable and worth as customer.

Surely will repeat at this shop insyaAllah.

name: Gyukatsu Motomura Namba Sub-branch
street: Namba, 3 Chome−6−17 なんばチップスビル B1F
reviews: Amazing food experience! We had to wait for around thirty minutes before getting a place but were not mad about it as the service personnel provided us with a kendama to pass the time and as our orders were taken during the wait so when we got our place the food arrived immediately. We ordered the large size gyukatsu which is a good portion, but not too big. The experience of grilling the pieces to your desired doneness. The meat was buttery on the inside and crispy on the outside. The provided sauces you could dip in the meat before grilling were also very tasty. The service personnel was very attentive, explained how to eat the meal correctly and provided more rice and sauces when needed and replaced the burning paste whenever needed. The only critique I have is concerning the side dishes which are probably not to taste for everyone (cod roe and yams paste) so if there was an option to choose other ones that would be great. All in all would go and eat there again gladly.

The place was clean. Service is superb. Everyone is attentive. It didnt matter if you dont know how to speak Japanese.

Food is delicious. S (small) is enough because of the variety unless you prefer more meat.

Quality is great! Will come back again soon!

We joined the queue and was told after approx 10 mins that they had another area nearby. In total we waited around 20 mins before we ordered and were seated.

The food came almost immediately and the beef was tender but crispy. It was slightly salty and oily for my liking, but definitely must try for the texture. Service was amazing as well

name: GYUKATSU Kyoto Katsugyu Namba-Walk 1st Avenue
street: Namba, 2 Chome−3 虹のまち1-5 なんばウォーク 1番街北通り
reviews:
I visited Gyukaysu Kyoto Kaysugyu Namba and had a wonderful experience. The restaurant exudes a warm and inviting atmosphere, with elegant wooden interiors that create a cosy and authentic feel. Each bite was full of rich flavour, and the accompanying sauces complemented the dish beautifully.

The service was attentive and efficient, with staff happy to explain the menu and offer recommendations. I also appreciated how quickly the food was served. The portion sizes were satisfying, and the presentation was meticulous, reflecting the care that goes into each dish.

Overall, Gyukaysu Kyoto Kaysugyu Namba is a must-visit for anyone craving high-quality beef katsu in a comfortable setting.

Honestly an awesome dining experience. Staff very attentive, great service. Beef katsu was amazing. Such an oishi meal. Would definitely come back and deserved 5 star. Quality of food was superb. Id recommend the sirloin around 3700 yen

If you love beef this place is a must-visit. Gyukatsu Kyoto Katsugyu serves perfectly breaded and lightly fried beef cutlets that are crispy on the outside and tender, juicy, and pink on the inside. You cook the beef to your preferred doneness on the small hot stone grill, which makes the experience fun and interactive.

The meat quality was excellent, super flavourful and soft. The set meal comes with rice, cabbage, miso soup, and dipping sauces that really elevate the taste. I especially loved trying it with wasabi and soy sauce.

Service was efficient and organised, foreign friendly. Great spot for a satisfying and uniquely Japanese dining experience.

name: K Fry Urban Korean Suria KLCC
street: Persiaran KLCC LCC02, Level Concourse Kuala Lumpur City Centre 邮政编码:
reviews: This is the best place I have ever visited in terms of attention to customers, very organized,  very kind , very humble and very attentive staff. We paid in total 120 - 150 ringgit for 3 bowls on hot wings , 1 strawberry sorbet, 1 peach bingsoo and 1 coke. Overall it's affordable and great Korean food.

We were visiting the Mall inside the Twin Towers and decided to try the Famous K Fry restaurant.
The service is amazing: all staff members are polite, sophisticated, delicate and make You feel like they are family.
We have ordered nice Apple fruit tea (refreshing after a long walk) + Bulgogi Chicken Fries + Japchae noodles with chicken+ Chicken Jjajang Udon (Yes, we like chicken so much😋).
Every plate was nicely done, makes You feel the boom of taste, makes You feel full and satisfied.
Definitely earned its reputation as a must-visit restaurant.

While in Kuala Lumpur, we went to @kfrymy inside the @suriaklccmall mall. now this was an experience, we were recommeneded to try the K'razy Spicy Cheesy Fried Chicken Bambuk, which is fried boneless chicken dipped in their yangnyeom sauce, and then cover with mozzarella cheese. It was amazing, tender chicken, crispy exterior, spicy and full of flavor, and wrapped with cheese. you will need to run a few extra laps after this meal, but its worth it lol 😆. we also tried the Bulgogi Beef Fries, which was another item we enjoyed. there were many other items on the menu that looked great, definitely will be back the next time I'm in KL.

#foodphotography #foodstagram #foodblogger #foodblog #foodlovers foodpic

name: Hut Dining Buffet （Lalaport BBCC)
reviews:
We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience here. This Japanese buffet is truly outstanding — every dish was fresh, beautifully prepared, and incredibly delicious. At around RM290 per person, it was absolutely worth it for the quality and variety offered.

What impressed us just as much as the food was the service. The staff were extremely polite, attentive, and professional throughout the entire meal, making us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of.

As a lovely surprise, we were even treated to Häagen-Dazs ice cream for each of us at the end, which was the perfect finishing touch.
Highly recommended — we will definitely be coming back!

Fresh and flavourful. Its good that the portions of the sushi and dons are small, I don't get stuffed too fast and get to try out literally everything on the menu. But to remind anyone coming here to try, the food came out mini size, which is too cute to eat, so just order your favourites x(n) if you like.

Engawa, chutoro, A5 wagyu, uni, caviar, foie gras & oysters are all available.

We came here on Valentine's Day, they gave everyone of us a rose, thank you 🫶🏻

Food was way beyond my expectations. Everything was fresh, properly served. Sashimi was way too nice and fresh. My first time eating the top grade tuna that looks like wagyu.. Ordered more for that as well. Cleaned environment and the waiter and waitress were well groomed and friendly. Will come again and recommend my colleagues or friends for this.. 👍🏽👍🏽👍🏽

name: Maidcafe Maidreamin Osu Manekineko Store
reviews:
This was my first time going to a maid cafe and it was overall a satisfactory experience. It isn’t awkward or embarrassing unless you think of it that way.

The maids were nice and willing to explain in English if you don’t understand Japanese.

The food was good like any other restaurant.

BUT I do have a complaint. I paid to take a polaroid picture with a maid but when I received, it was so overexposed. It didn’t get any better. The faces are so white that you can barely make out who it is. Please choose the digital picture instead.

1 week ago i come in this Coffee with my mom and the experience on this cafe is very awesome thank a lot of all person on this Coffee for this moment and big big thanks to Hirari for the photo and everthing she made. I will comeback one Day i promise :3

Cuuuute :)
No one spoke English but they made alot of effort.

name: Opera Cafe & Lounge
street: G29(A) & G29(B), Ground Floor, Starhill Gallery, 181, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews:
We visited Opera Cafe & Lounge at KL (Bukit Bintang) on Valentine’s Eve, and although this review comes a little late, the experience truly deserves to be shared..

We made a very last-minute request for a reservation with light decorations, and Miss June was incredibly helpful in arranging everything for us. She handled it so smoothly and professionally despite the short notice, and we truly appreciated her effort..

Our dining experience was absolutely wonderful. The service was top-notch, the staffs especially Khunkhon and Hassan were very kind, attentive, and kept checking on us to ensure everything was perfect throughout the evening. It made us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of.

The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and worth every bite. Overall, it was a memorable and romantic experience for us.

We will definitely be coming back again ❤️

First visit to Opera Café located at Starhill Gallery KL. The café is nicely decorated in pink and it gives a very fusion vibes. In this café there are different types of very attractive cakes including afternoon tea sets. The staff are friendly and welcoming.

The menu from this café consists of a mixture of western, Italian and pastry. The chicken cordon bleu was just averagely done but the Opera pasta was quite good. Price wise is steep and do expect to pay a lot more than the regular café. However, the service was extremely slow and waited near to an hour for the food to be served when the café was not even at a busy state.

Would probably return to try some of the cakes and afternoon tea set.

We are thrilled with our order :) Started with thinking the menu is a bit pricy with funny and dreamy decorations but seriously it is much more than what you see. The delivery of the dessert gave us a real surprise and also an unforgettable experience. Highly recommend it for people for something more than yummy food!

name: Kobe Beef KOJYU
reviews: As a self named foodie trying kobe beef in kobe was definitly on my bucketlist! I followed the reviews and got to Kobe Beef Kojyu. I needed a second to find the certain elevator to the restaurant. I wanted to arrive early since I couldnt book any table on the same day, I was basicly the first at 1pm. The staff greeted me nicely and I got seated. I chosed menu B with 110gr of meat. Not gonna lie it is expensive but worth every penny for my experience. The meat was incredible, and all the predishes were well made. I was served by Geetu and Bishal, who were super professional and explained everything. Couldnt imagine a better kobe beef in kobe!

This was an authentic and wonderful experience. We arrived without reservations and they seated us immediately. Our teppanyaki chef Takada was awesome!  He was an artist with his food preparation and presentation, and he and all of the staff were very kind, humble, polite, and respectful. The food was delicious and Takada prepared and served the meat and vegetables in small portions to keep it hot and gave us specific suggestions for how to use the seasonings and sauces to flavor the bite-sized Kobe beef pieces he had prepared. The service was amazing throughout the meal and the staff thanked us with a bow when we were leaving.

Outstanding service from Geetu! The way she sliced the meat and placed it on my plate was meticulous. We came to Kobe on a day trip from Osaka and opted to start our visit with a Kobe beef lunch. This restaurant only serves A5 grade, so the prices are size and cut dependent. The two of us shared the 220g sirloin under Set A (rice, soup, and salad), and the portion was perfect as we weren’t even hungry by dinner time. The Kobe beef definitely lived up to the hype. Don’t forget to snap a picture with the award! During peak seasons, it’s advisable to book online as the restaurant only has three teppanyaki tables.

name: GIOIA CHINATOWN
reviews:
Our first time exploring this ice cream shop. The interior is cosy and inviting, making it a lovely spot to chill. The ice cream itself was rather mediocre, especially the flavours with liquor. However, the waffle cones deserve a highlight — very thin and tasteful. Service was excellent, especially Jake.

Worth trying if you’re in the area.

A unique ice cream experience 🍦✨

This is not your average scoop shop. The texture is chewy and gooey in the best way — rich, dense and full of flavour. With my simple palate I went with chocolate and vanilla, and even the classics were excellent.

But head upstairs… that’s where the real surprise is. Chocolate and tequila, chocolate and whisky, Kahlua and vanilla — bold, creative combinations you don’t see every day.

Great atmosphere, stylish space, and the perfect spot to sit by the window and enjoy a rainy afternoon

You call this a gelato? Premium?
I tasted the worst gelato today, so sorry to be honest. Agreed that inside scoop is way better. Venchi is good although is more expensive but amount is more and it doesn’t melt.

Environment, is ok. Probably because of corner shop with glass.

Service, is so so, without excitement from the staffs.

Tried all 4 flavours available:- Green tea, coconut, houjicha and hazelnut.

Green tea is sweet, rough like bits of sugar/tea leaf blended in vanilla ice cream. Melt immediately after putting in the cup

Coconut + espresso + caramel tasted like coconut frozen milkshake

Houjicha and hazelnut is the best in the shop but still the worst I have tasted.

name: Wagyu Sukiyaki Kyoto Chikarayama Osaka Namba No.1 Store
reviews:
I know some of the people came for handsome staff lol…
but I came for the food:) I ordered Fuji wagyu it was really nice and amazing. There’s one young lady served me all the way, she was friendly and warm even she wearing mask. I came in very earlier just only one customer and that’s me, but l didn’t feel any uncomfortable. The atmosphere was nice.

Thank you Yurina, the staff who served us throughout the whole dining, you gave us a wonderful dining experience!
We had Hokkaido Wagyu set for both of us.
They cook the beef in front of you, the beef literally melt in your mouth, taste absolutely superb.
All the staffs are very friendly, attentive and sporting!
You'll feel it's an immerging dining experience rather than just a meal.
The place is clean and quiet with soft music, very cozy!
We did make a reservation prior coming, but there wasn't a queue.
We'll gladly come again if we happen to be in Osaka again!
Japan food never disappoint!

Had a great sukiyaki experience at Chikarayama. The quality of the wagyu was excellent — beautifully marbled, tender, and full of flavour. The beef simply melts in your mouth once cooked in the sukiyaki broth.

Service was attentive and the staff took time to explain the cooking process, which made the experience feel more personal. The setting was also calm and cosy, perfect for enjoying a proper Japanese meal.

Definitely a place worth visiting if you appreciate high quality wagyu and a well-done sukiyaki experience.

name: Kobe Beef WANOMIYA Kuromon Sennichimae Store
reviews:
We came across this Kobe beef teppanyaki restaurant by chance in the morning while we were out exploring. In the evening, we decided to come back and try our luck — even without a reservation, we were pleasantly surprised that we could walk in.

We ordered two cuts of Kobe beef: one sirloin and one rare cut. Personally, I preferred the sirloin much more. It was very juicy, with a perfect balance of lean meat and fat, and the texture was exactly what I enjoy in a good steak. The rare cut was interesting to try, but the sirloin clearly stood out in terms of flavour and overall satisfaction.

What I really like about this place is that they offer a wide variety of Kobe beef cuts, so it’s a great spot if you’d like to explore and compare different parts.

The chef who served us was Yuburaj.

Overall, a very nice and easy-going Kobe beef teppanyaki experience.
Highly recommend trying the sirloin — it’s a safe and delicious choice. 🥩

We had an exceptional experience at this Wagyu-certified restaurant. The chef’s (HIRAICHI) presentation was absolutely flawless, every detail was thoughtful and precise. The Wagyu was perfectly prepared, incredibly tender, and full of rich flavor. You can truly taste the quality.

From start to finish, the service and atmosphere made the meal unforgettable. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a premium dining experience.

A wonderful lunch with delicious Kobe beef! There were 2 of us and we shared the silver menu which was more than enough for both of us. Kitano-san was our chef and was friendly and cooked the beef to perfection. We also appreciated his recommendations on how to best enjoy the beef with the condiments provided. Not a cheap meal but thoroughly recommended nonetheless!

name: Penang History Gallery
reviews: Perfect place to learn something about Penang's fascinating history. Exhibit sections are well done with very well researched info. Guests are given an overview of Penang's colourful past, from its earliest days as a British trading outpost to the bustling Malaysian city that it is today in the 21st century. If you love Penang or just history in general, drop by and enjoy the museum in cool air conditioned comfort. Optional guides are available to assist, or alternatively just do a self walking discovery tour. A 5-star experience highly recommended for foreign tourists and Penang/Malaysian locals alike. ❤️❤️👍👍🤣😉⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️.

We're delighted with this little museum.  It is a must-see experience!
Usually I don't like to be guided round a Museum as the displays should not need explaining to a visitor, whatever their age or nationality, but here, a knowledgeable local guide added so much more for us than a self-guided tour would have done. She took cues and pace from us, and we shared so many ideas and a wealth of information. Thank you.
Having said that, the museum layout, the models, display panels and interpretation were all good, and we learned a lot and will remember the visit.

Simply brilliant. Heartily recommend! A must see whlist in Georgetown. Really comprehensive history of Penang, which makes sense of it's rich fusions of cultures. Staff are really helpful too. I didn't have time to book a private guide, but I heard them on the way round, and would recommend. Although reading the Penang Times on a self guided tour was also informative.

name: Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M Hanare Branch
reviews:
An Unforgettable Celebration with World-Class Service.
We visited for my mother’s birthday, and while the Matsusaka Wagyu was spectacular, it was the hospitality that made the night truly special.
The Star of the Night: Nayla
Our server, Nayla (who is from Argentina), was beyond amazing. Her attention to detail was flawless, and she was incredibly attentive without being intrusive. What we appreciated most was how engaging she was—she ansked many random questions with a smile and genuine warmth, and we finally figured out why. She truly elevated the entire dining experience.
The Food
* The Meats: A perfect 10/10. The quality of the Matsusaka beef is undeniable—it melts in your mouth and lives up to every bit of the hype.
* The Sukiyaki: While the beef quality in the dish was excellent, the sauce was a bit too sweet for our personal preference. However, the Yakiniku cuts were seasoned to perfection.
The Birthday Surprise
The highlight of the evening was the birthday celebration for my mom. The staff brought out a beautiful plate of sweets, but the "wow" factor was the Labubu character they included on the plate. We had only mentioned in passing that it was her favorite character, and the fact that they remembered and executed that detail was so touching. It made my mom’s day!
Bottom line: If you want incredible Wagyu and service that makes you feel like family, ask for Nayla. We will definitely be back!

Fantastic experience here, and one of the best meals we had in Japan. It is on the pricey side, but the quality of meat and food was well worth the money. The sirloin and short rib was great, and the garlic rice was fabulous! I am dreaming of the flavour right now!

They were very attentive with the service and everyone was friendly too. Kevin was lovely in taking us through the menu, and all the staff members were very friendly and easy to interact with. Yoshi (the manager) even stopped by at the end to say hi, and drew that lovely and accurate labubu!

First of all, kudos to Nayla, our server tonight. She explained the menu and the dishes very well, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable!!

As for the food and the overall experience ..this has to be the best beef I’ve ever tasted. The Matsusaka beef was incredibly tender, rich, and literally melts in your mouth. Every bite was flavorful without being overwhelming, and you can really tell the quality of the beef.

Definitely one of those meals that you remember long after the dinner is over. A truly memorable experience!!!

name: Kobe Beef TAKAKURA
reviews: A friend and I were fortunate enough to be able to walk in last September in a post-lunch rush lull and have what was *the best* culinary experience hands down that I had in Japan. For tourists wanting to make this a tentpole experience, there was also a fun photo opportunity the chef provided for us. The staff were very knowledgeable in making recommendations, but respected our food choices when we selected a mid-tier cut due to budget, and advised us on the best ways to consume and best enjoy our experience. I've had Kobe beef before, but it was not prepared by experts, and I didn't know how much of a difference that makes in how it can be enjoyed. Chef Emi was wonderful and we were very fortunate to have been able to find a seat at her table. ごちそうさまでした!

It was a bit late for lunch and we were hungry. We were lucky to stumbled at this place.

Even though it was small, chef Sena was excellent at her job. Took her time to explain everything and was nice.

Kobe beef was soft and flavorful. Her recommendation to have the meat with wasabi and shoyu was the best and now I'm going to eat all my beef like that.

Thanks for a wonderful experience and a good meal. :D

This is the right place if your are looking for an unique, personalized, and delicious experience eating Kobe beef, in Kobe.
The food is perfect. All of the kobe beef cuts has a delicious texture and taste, and are cooked exactly right.
The service is amazing, Connie was our Chef and she made everything to perfection. She was incredibly kind, explained it all, took pictures of us and made our experience memorable.
The restaurant is a small, and cozy teppanyaki grill.

name: Spice & Spicy Nasi Lemak - Georgetown Penang
reviews:
Chanced upon this place and decided to give it a try. Ordered the fried chicken nasi lemak to share. The boss was very friendly and let us know there’s free flow soup and sauces available for self-service.

The rice was just nice, not too dry or mushy and nicely separated grain by grain. The fried chicken was pretty good too. It’s juicy and didn’t taste like it was frozen. No blood like you sometimes see at other places.

On top of that, the boss even brought out a free dessert for us, a bowl of red bean soup.

Definitely give them a try if you’re new to the area.

This is honestly the best nasi lemak I’ve ever eaten.

I seldom write long captions, but this is one nasi lemak that’s a must-try.

Rice – Basmati rice, well cooked, light and fluffy, with a really nice coconut fragrance.

Chicken – Crispy on the outside, juicy and moist on the inside.

Fried egg – Looks normal at first, but don’t underestimate it. The egg is fried over high heat and then placed on a banana leaf. The heat lightly chars the leaf underneath, and that interaction gives the egg a subtle pandan fragrance. Simple detail, but damn shiok.

Anchovies – Nicely fried, not oily, but still very tasty.

Soup – They’re currently offering free-flow soup. The ingredients taste fresh and the soup is genuinely good. Pro tip from their menu: add a bit of sambal belacan — it brings out a sweet, slightly sour, and spicy kick.

Service – Friendly bunch of people, very welcoming.

Highly recommended 👍

Although it's Chinese style, the fried chicken nasi lemak is great, crispy skin, juicy chicken, sweet savoury sambal
Free flow carrot cucumber salad has an amazing sambal homemade dressing, this is what makes this place unique
Two things I was disappointed in was the absence of coffee(kopi) in the menu and I've been here since 10.33am, it is 11:04 now, it's very warm inside. But the furniture and atmosphere and vibe and music is gooood.
Carpark directly next to this restaurant is very convenient.
Will come again if I'm wandering around komtar
Also, not many customers, very nice vibe
Got a free dessert, thank you guys :)

name: C.STAND Nagoya Sakae
reviews: The staff are really friendly. It was easy to order too.

It's an interesting location, but the service is one of the worst so far.  It takes almost 30 minutes for the hookah to arrive.  The reason is that there is only one employee working here, who doesn't even have much knowledge about flavors and brands.
Very cozy place and we can spend a stunning moment. The quality is also good.

name: Corks Out Bukit Bintang
street: Lot B2, B3, B4, 1st Floor, Fahrenheit 88 Block B, 179, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews:
My experience at Corks Out is excellent. Highly recommend this restaurant.

We had two soups, beef tartare, a Waygu Rump and seafood pasta. Every item was PERFECTLY prepared. We wasn’t expecting such a high level of sophistication, each dish is so meticulous, and well thought out.

The steak was cooked to perfection. The charcoal grill made it even better, perfect rare.

The staff Jefferson was extremely helpful, his kind hospitality and service is greatly appreciated. We will be returning very soon.

Corks Out heart in Bukit Bintang, before heading to the place need to plan your timing and route as is it tourist spot and heart of KL City Center.

The ambience is nice and food selection is just decent. A place practise fine dine. The food for me personally can be better, but what I love most is the atmosphere of service from the place. Wish it have jazz live performer which can boost the mood. As they currently played Taylor Swift the pop styles which i think not so much match the ambience.

I most prefered their house wine, and bought half dozen bottles to cheer myself and festive gifts since it's Chinese New Year next week.

Overall will come again definetly and hope the food i will try something i prefer more to my tastebuds.

I spent the night at Corks Out for my birthday , and I could say it was a wonderful experience! The staff were all kind and the food was served fast. It was super clean in here and the food was spot on. I recommend starting off with the beef tartare as an appetizer , the wagyu is very flavourful and soft perfect for me since I lost a tooth, beef is great too not much flavour than wagyu so just sprinkle a little truffle salt to enhance its flavour. The duck isn't as good as beef but juicy and thick, tougher than the beef.Bisque was creamy and smooth so was the sauce of multiple dishes! Drinks are fine and good for cleansing your palette or a quick cool drink to top off the food. Their waiters were kind and fast,so was the chef! They prepare meals in a fast pace and make all the dishes look so appealing with the presentation.  I highly recommend to go for a celebration or a date night, meat lovers will love it here!

name: Bombay Grand Indian Cuisine - KLCC Branch
street: SR-05-02 ,Block 5, Star Boulevard KLCC, Jalan Yap Kwan Seng
reviews:
Just landed in Kuala Lumpur and headed straight for a late lunch at Bombay Grand. What a fantastic start to the trip. The entire team was warm, attentive, and genuinely polite. The food tasted truly authentic, not toned down or overdone. The garlic naan was perfectly soft with just the right crisp edges, and the methi mutter malai was rich, balanced, and full of flavor.

I’ll definitely be visiting again before I leave and would happily recommend this place to anyone craving proper Indian food in KL.

Bombay Grand KLCC is an excellent spot for Indian food lovers. The Triple Rice is absolutely delicious perfectly cooked with amazing flavors, and the Garlic Chicken is a must try, packed with rich aroma and taste. Portion sizes are generous, quality is top-notch, and the food feels freshly prepared. Great ambiance and friendly service add to the experience. Definitely one of the best Indian restaurants around KLCC. Will visit again! 😋🍽️

Easily and I mean easily the BEST Indian food my wife and I have ever had. We grew up in LA thinking we ate good Indian food and have had great Indian food living in Tokyo. But none of that even compares to this place. The service is amazing but above all the food is absolutely incredible. The spices and flavor are out of this world. And we tried so many dishes here. I would recommend this to anyone staying in this area if they are looking for the best Indian food of their life.

name: Marina Seafood
reviews:
Seafood is fresh! Unique Chinese yet Halal dishes for me. I like the garlic sauce seafood platter.
The chicken meat bun is steam on the spot. Nice and small.

And the staff service is very good too. They will pay attention to my table and assisted to get new plates & utensils; and also top up my teapot w/o me requesting.

Visited this branch and had a really pleasant experience. We ordered a plate of eggplant, some fragrant dishes with corn, and a bowl of porridge — the porridge was especially good, very comforting and full of flavor.

The food was fresh, well-prepared, and served nicely. The environment was comfortable and the staff were friendly. Overall, a great place for a satisfying meal. Would definitely come back again.

The food was impeccable, tasting unique and fresh, and I especially enjoyed the chicken dumplings. It was well plated, and the appearance was appealing and impressive, with the food being gone in under a minute 😂! They even steam the food right in front of you, allowing you to enjoy the moments leading up to the moment you get to eat 😁! Not only that, the staff were also very friendly and they did th it best to serve us and accommodate our requests 😁. *Shout out to Karen and Yin for introducing us to th specials and making us feel welcomed!

If anyone is looking for a vercitile and delicious steamed seafood to quell your appetite, I recommend marina seafood 😊!  好吃👍

name: Kobe Beef MIYABI Kitanosaka Store
reviews: Beautiful, quaint nine seater restaurant.  the atmosphere is really great! The chef, Hiroshi Hinokami,  is very kind and accommodating. The meat was so tender and really delicious. The included sides: carrot lotus root sweet potato , large green onion. Highly recommend if coming to Kobe!

visited Kobe for a day and stopped here for dinner, and it ended up being the most memorable meal of our entire Japan trip. The food was outstanding, the chef was incredibly passionate, and it was the perfect place to truly enjoy authentic Kobe beef 🐮🍖🥩 With so many wagyu restaurants in Kobe, we’re soooo glad we chose this one — highly recommended 👍🏻

My husband and I took a day trip and Kobe and stopped in here for the tapanyaki experience and it was even better than we imagined! Chef Haruna was kind and entertaining and prepared the best meal! One of my favorites that we’ve had in the two weeks we’ve been in Japan! We had the lunch special which included a salad, soup, oolong tea, grilled veggies, rice, and 3 varieties of the best Kobe beef. It was amazing! 10/10 recommend!!!

name: Kuromon Sushi & Tempura
reviews: Delicious tempura that was pretty massive. We shared 4 between 2 people; 2 prawn, 1 squid and 1 crab. The crab was easily our favorite.

We really enjoyed this tempura! Everything was freshly fried and super crispy without being greasy.
The prawn had a sweet, delicate flavor and the vegetables (especially the shiso leaf and sweet potato) were perfectly cooked-light and airy batter, not heavy at all. The eel tempura was also a surprise favorite: rich, flavorful, and a great contrast in texture. Definitely a great example of how good tempura should be!
the owner is friendly, and the tempura is really nice. he even reminds us (as muslims) that the soy sauce contains mirin, so he offered salt to us.

name: Urban Republic @ Pavilion Bukit Bintang
street: Lot No. 5.24.07, 5th Floor, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, 168, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews: Excellent service at Urban Republic by Switch, Pavilion. Ramadan assisted me with setting up my Google Pixel 10 and was very patient, knowledgeable, and helpful throughout the process. The staff here are genuinely friendly and professional, and the overall store experience was great. I was very satisfied with the service and would definitely come back.

I had a frustrating experience with the Pavilion KL branch. HQ informed me that only two outlets had last stock for the Samsung ultra model colour I wanted, and Pavilion KL confirmed RM4,199 via WhatsApp. After traveling all the way there, I was suddenly told the price became RM4,799, which felt misleading and unprofessional.
To make things worse, the staff said no nearby outlets had stock, even though Pavilion Damansara Heights actually did.
I then went to Pavilion Damansara Heights and was served by Haiqal, who provided excellent service, clear explanations, and a smooth, honest buying experience. I ended up purchasing the phone from him.
Pavilion KL seriously needs to improve transparency and pricing consistency.

Bought my phone here and being served by Dorothy. Highly recommended to look for her as her service is excellent. She tried to answer all my questions in order for me to get what I need and not what I want

name: Halal Sushi Osaka TEMAKISUSHI YOSAKURA Namba Osaka hand roll
reviews: Quiet place when we got there, but became busy later, amazing atmosphere and modern. The food was so amazing, watching them put our meals together was pure art. Everything was so fresh and tasty. Try the Tea, it was really good. ?🧡.

Very delightful to see the chef preparing the food and the taste of the food is also amazing 🤩
Must try if you are around❣️

Perfect for a quick & high quality lunch for solo travelers or couples. These hand rolls were well balanced in flavor could not recommend more 10/10. I got the spicy tuna and unagi hand rolls. The unagi roll was outstanding with the flame broiled eel, sweet tamago, and bursting umami salmon roe. Very well executed and very kind service.

name: Firewood KLCC
street: SR-05-05, Star Boulevard KLCC, Jalan Yap Kwan Seng
reviews: The experience was simply perfect. Impeccable service from our server, Lyn, she was incredibly attentive, accommodating our special requests and always prompt to our needs. The food was top-notch; everything we ordered was delicious, especially the steaks. The Stone Axe was beautifully marbled and full of flavour and the Australian Angus Ribeye was so good we ended up ordering another portion. Lyn and the team also surprised me with a birthday cake and dessert, which was such a thoughtful touch. We will definitely be back!

Perfect Sunday lunch at Firewood before we flew back to Singapore.

Chef Qaia is amazing—so friendly, talented, and passionate about her dishes. She really made our dining experience special with her warm attitude and attention to detail. Every dish we tried was beautifully executed and full of flavor.

Captain Usman gave us a warm welcome, explaining the dishes and introducing the beef—it really made the experience special.

Starters we ordered:
•	Charred Cauliflower Florets – The cauliflower was beautifully charred and crispy, paired with a flavorful sauce. It was surprisingly delicious and impressive. Even those who usually don’t like cauliflower would fall in love with this dish.

•	Firewood Chitose Tomato Soup – The tomatoes were naturally sweet and very appetizing, a perfect way to start the meal.
•	Pan-seared Fresh Hokkaido Scallop – Fresh, tender, and well-seared.
•	Pan-seared French Foie Gras – Rich and satisfying, cooked perfectly.

Main courses:
•	Burnt Spring Onion Miso Cod Fish – Well-balanced flavors with a lovely smoky touch.

•	Korean Hanwoo Sirloin – Juicy, flavorful, and cooked just right. It was served with three accompaniments: grilled garlic, salt, and a house special sauce. The combination really elevated the dish and made it even more outstanding.

Dessert:
•	Lemon Posset Brûlée – Absolutely delicious. The sweetness was perfectly balanced, light and refreshing, not overly sweet at all. A perfect ending to the meal.

We were very satisfied with our dining experience. The food was gorgeous, the service was excellent, and everything was perfect.
Huge thanks to Chef Qaia and the team for an unforgettable meal!
We will definitely be back to try more dishes. Highly recommended!

Excellent service, meat texture is tender, but I feel it's too dry. The sweet potato fries I think it's fried using air fryer. Almost no oil, yet crunchy. I like it, the healthier way.

What can be improved is perhaps they can consider serving a free basket of bread with butter/olive oil for customers while waiting for the main course, coz the waiting time is quite long (more than 30 mins). With the expensive food price that customers paid, the bread really costs nothing much, but it will indeed improve customer experience.

Overall, I've tasted better steak elsewhere with the price half of it. But if you're looking for nice ambience and service for special occasion it's quite a good choice. At least better than Wolfgang and Smith & Wollensky.

name: Fluffed Cafe @ Petaling Street
reviews:
We really loved Fluffed Cafe and Dessert Bar on Petaling Street.
We came as a family of three, and honestly, one big sweet waffle would have been enough for all of us — the portion is very generous. But we also ordered an original waffle… and ended up completely full 😄

The waffles are super crispy and absolutely delicious. Everything we tried was very tasty and well made.

We liked it so much that we came back another day specially for the savory waffles to have a late breakfast here — and they were amazing too! The savory waffle was just as good, not sweet at all, and very satisfying.

Great food, great portions, and a lovely place to eat. Highly recommended — both sweet and savory waffles are excellent!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely heavenly! Fluffed Cafe & Dessert Bar is now my go-to spot for a dreamy escape. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is so cozy and chic—perfect for a sweet date or a treat-yourself moment.

We tried the famous soufflé pancakes and they were worth every second of the wait. Like eating a cloud! The texture was flawless, and the fresh berries and cream paired perfectly. Also sampled the Matchamisu—a brilliant twist on a classic, with the most beautiful layered presentation.

Service was wonderful; the staff was genuinely friendly and happy to explain the menu. Even the drinks were standout—their signature Sea Salt Cream Coffee was the best I’ve had.

Every detail feels thoughtful, from the aesthetic decor to the exquisite plating. A little slice of dessert paradise. Can’t wait to come back and try everything else!

Highly, highly recommend. Your sweet tooth will thank you! 🍰☕

one of best places for desserts especially their sweet waffles & speciality drinks & now they even introduced the savory version of their waffles. the most common pairing has to be the fried chicken & waffles drenched with honey which I personally enjoyed it so much which comes with fries & a scoop of ice cream. the waffles were perfectly fluffy, the fried chicken were spot on, cooked to perfection & really tasty. even their drinks were really good too & not too mentioned, the fries were crunchy, perfectly seasoned. love their simple ambience, a nice place to relax & worth another visit.

name: 焼肉 松もと | Yakiniku Matsumoto – Japanese Wagyu BBQ, Namba Osaka
reviews:
The Wagyu here is truly amazing!

I love Japanese yakiniku and have visited many restaurants over the years, and I can confidently say the Wagyu here is outstanding.
The quality is far superior to the “Wagyu” served at many other places, and for this level, it would usually cost much more.

In Dotonbori, some restaurants charge around ¥20,000 even for lunch.
Here, they serve A5-ranked Miyazaki beef, the same top grade as Kobe beef.

For Wagyu of this quality, the price here is very reasonable.

We visited this yakiniku restaurant three weeks ago. As other reviewers mentioned, the quality of the meat was quite good. However, the atmosphere wasn’t as lively as some of the other reviews suggested — perhaps because we were the first group of customers that day.
We arrived according to the hours listed on Google, but the owner said the restaurant would open half an hour later. I noticed they updated their hours a week ago, so hopefully the current hours are accurate.
Best experience for eating wagyu! Rina was so kind and nice, the best service! The meat was really good!! Great for interacting with people from all over Asia!

name: MST Golf Arena - The Gardens Mall
reviews: I hosted my team lunch here. Very fast service. I ordered roasted chicken rice and banana split as dessert. The food is amazing .The overall ambience was great too. Lots of bays for.golf.The staff is extremely helpful too. Special thanks to Thilaa, Raj Hafiz and Fara to making our dining experience great.

Took 3 stars off due to rude and unprofessional individual manning the front desk (later we were informed his name was Benny).

We were the first guests to arrive for a birthday party (the host arrived later as it was a surprise) and the worker asked us whether he should begin the session’s time. It was our first time at an establishment like this so we didn’t know how it worked.

We hesitated and he said rudely and in a condescending manner, ‘Your session was booked for 4:30pm right? That’s why I’m asking you. I don’t know what you want.’ We replied that we were guests and we didn’t know the official plan. And he said, ‘I don’t know either’ in an unwelcoming tone.

Good food. Good facilities. Two stars. But customer service — especially at first point of contact, imagine that — is abysmal. Would not recommend if you’re looking to start off your session with warmth, you simply won’t get it!

MST Golf Arena at The Gardens Mall offers a convenient indoor golfing experience, but there are some definite pros and cons.

Pros:
✅ The simulator runs on Foresight, which is a solid system with accurate tracking and a good variety of courses.
✅ The chicken karaage was surprisingly very good—crispy, flavorful, and well-seasoned.
✅ The venue itself has a nice ambiance for a casual golf session or a hangout spot.

Cons:
❌ The clubs provided are terrible—they feel cheap, worn out, and don’t give a great experience. If you’re serious about your game, bring your own set.
❌ The balls are all worn down, which affects performance and feel. A place charging premium prices should have better-quality range balls.
❌ The chocolate banana smoothie was just okay—not bad, but nothing special.

Verdict:
If you're bringing your own clubs and just want to enjoy a session with Foresight simulators, it’s worth a visit. The food is decent, but the provided equipment could use a serious upgrade.

name: Yakiniku GREAT @ 3rd Floor • WOLO Kuala Lumpur
street: W.P, WOLO Kuala Lumpur 3rd Floor Corner of Jalan Bukit Bintang, &, Jln Sultan Ismail
reviews:
Thank you so much for the warm and thoughtful service. We really enjoyed ourselves and felt very welcomed throughout our visit.

We visited the restaurant on 5 February 2026 for birthday celebration, and it was such a nice break from our busy schedule. The whole experience was relaxing and enjoyable. The food, service, and overall environment were great, and my boyfriend was pleasantly surprised as well.

Special thanks to Ms Dee for taking such good care of us. She was very friendly and patient in explaining everything, which we truly appreciated 😊

Thank you for the lovely surprise and the celebration. It really meant a lot to us and made the experience even more memorable.

We’ll definitely be back again. Highly recommended

We had omakase wagyu in KL yesterday and the service was very attentive. Our server Rana was very polite, professional, and patient. He explained the dishes well and took good care of us throughout the meal.

There were three of us dining, and Rana was serving all three alone. Since each dish is cooked one by one, the waiting time was quite long and one of us felt very hungry by the end. We could tell he was working very hard, so this felt more like a manpower issue rather than his fault.

Overall, Rana did a great job. With more staff to assist in cooking, the dining experience would be much better.

Rana is a very kind and hardworking person. He was friendly, patient, and always attentive to our needs. Even though he was serving all three of us alone, he remained professional and positive throughout the meal, which we truly appreciated.

The food was amazing — we were already impressed by the appetizers! We couldn’t stop thinking about it the next day. Among all the meats, the one that left the deepest impression on me was the Shakushi — the texture and flavor were both outstanding.

Most importantly, Dee’s service was excellent — warm, friendly, and always with a big smile. Dee explained every dish to us, letting us know which part of the meat we were enjoying. Thank you, Dee, for giving us such a comfortable and delicious dining experience!

name: Moo Point Steaks
reviews:
Moo Point Steaks in Penang is a true gem. From the moment we arrived, the customer service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming without being overbearing. The staff were knowledgeable about the menu and made excellent recommendations.

The food was outstanding — every bite was absolutely delicious. The steak was cooked perfectly, tender, and full of flavour. You can really tell they pay attention to quality ingredients and proper technique. The presentation was also impressive, with each dish plated beautifully and thoughtfully.

The overall dining experience felt polished yet comfortable, making it a great spot for both special occasions and relaxed dinners. If you’re in Penang and craving a proper steak, Moo Point Steaks is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!

A truly satisfying steak night at Moo Steakhouse! 😍

We ordered the Moo House Steak, Tiger Prawn, House Fries, and Tomato Soup, and every dish delivered beyond expectations.

The Moo House Steak was the star of the table — beautifully cooked, tender, juicy, and packed with rich beef flavor. Every bite was indulgent and satisfying. The tiger prawns were fresh, succulent, and perfectly grilled, complementing the steak wonderfully.

The house fries were crispy on the outside and fluffy inside — simple but addictive. And the tomato soup was surprisingly memorable: warm, rich, and comforting with a deep tomato flavor that felt homemade.

Beyond the food, the service was excellent. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made the dining experience smooth and enjoyable.

Great food, great service, and definitely value for money. A spot I’d happily return to whenever the steak craving hits.

🔥 Highly recommended for anyone who loves a good steak experience.

Just Google search for a good steak house brought me to Moo Point steaks at Hutton lane.  The steakhouse just opened not too long  about 7 months ago and already had great reviews. Hence, we decided to check it out.

Indeed, it was a good find if you are a steak lover. The menu is not complicated but clear, simple way that also piques the diner's interest. The ambience of the restaurant is simple and casual. The service staff are super friendly making your dining experience enjoyable.

The steaks we had were cooked to perfection as what we requested. The steak juiciness made  each mouthful a mix of tenderness and taste, making your meal special and satisfying. The side dish of corn rib steak had an interesting flavour, it had soft  texture with a savoury, roasted, and slightly nutty flavour;. It was flavourful indeed. The French fries were excellent and the tomato soup was delicious. The okra tempura was great and salad with citrus dressing was refreshing .

Definitely a steak restaurant worth visiting and the portion size was pretty decent and  value for money.

name: Halal Beef bone ramen Ushibon Osaka Namba/牛骨ラーメン うしぼーん 大阪なんば
reviews:
We were here on the evening of their grand opening day on the 8th of Feb. It is a new halal certified restaurant, typical quaint Japanese eatery but the environment was very pleasant.

Their specialty is Ushi bone ramen. They also have wagyu gyukatsu, rice bowls, okonomiyaki and takoyaki. Orders are to be made and paid at a vending machine on the right side of the restaurant when you enter. After you are done, tickets will be printed out accordingly to your order and please pass it to the staff so they can prepare your hearty meal for you. Feel free to clarify anything you need, they have a staff who speaks quite decent English to help you out. We also had the complimentary dessert of a fried mochi in dashi broth. The chewiness of the fried mochi and its combination with the dashi broth was surprisingly delicious but slightly salty for my palate.

We tried their ramune soda which tasted like a refreshing bubble gum soda. Due to its grand opening, not many people know of this gem. We manage to enjoy our dinner with only another patron. No wait. We kinda like had the restaurant to ourselves, ahaha.

For muslim travellers they have a small prayer room with en suite ablution area which can fit one person at a time.

We were very happy with the food, the staff and chef was also very accommodating, friendly as well as helpful. Looking forward to revisit during our next Osaka trip.

I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The ramen soup was incredibly delicious, perfect for warming up on a cold day. I couldn't help but savor every drop of the flavorful broth. If you're in the mood for something delightful, try their signature beef bone ramen in Namba.

The fact that this place offers halal options made it a reassuring choice for me. The staff was exceptionally kind and friendly, adding to the pleasant experience.

I highly recommend this restaurant to Muslim tourists visiting Japan. It's an ideal spot to break your fast and enjoy a comforting meal. You'll be glad you stopped by!

Had an amazing experience at Halal Beef Bone Ramen Ushibon! 🍜🔥

The beef bone broth was incredibly rich, creamy, and full of deep umami flavour — you can really taste the long hours of simmering. The ramen texture was perfectly cooked, springy and satisfying in every bite. The beef slices were tender and generous, making the bowl feel premium and comforting at the same time.

As a halal ramen spot, this place truly delivers both authenticity and quality without compromise. The ambiance was cozy, clean, and welcoming, and the staff were friendly and attentive throughout.

If you’re looking for a hearty, flavour-packed halal ramen experience, Ushibon is definitely a must-visit. Will absolutely come back again! 🤍🍜

name: QingHeGu | 청학골 | Korean BBQ Restaurant | Bukit Bintang
street: R-001, Low Yat Park, 55, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews:
Came across by chance along our way to hotel and decided to stop by for dinner and omg what a treat. We sat upstairs and was served the most amazing pork belly, pork ribs and beef bulgogi set platter with a ton of banchan, veggies and a pot of steamed eggs. Our meats were cooked to perfection by friendly and professional Apon. We really had a great time. Ultimate shiok.

Back again for light supper. The galbitang has a generous serving of beef brisket in light broth. The sundubu serving is kinda small but side dishes made up for it. Decent. We preferred the bbq beef dishes.

Back for dinner with Apon cooking for us 3 kinds of pork. Lovely dinner we had. Shiok.

I was visiting Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and I found a Korean restaurant in the city center on a second-floor unit. I had dinner there and the food was absolutely fantastic and reasonably priced. I was able to dine alone, and the staff grilled the meats for me, making it easy and enjoyable. Everything on the menu was delicious. I think we need to go back again before leaving Kuala Lumpur. The taste was superb and the staff provided excellent service.

Absolutely outstanding Korean BBQ experience. From start to finish, everything exceeded our expectations.

A special mention goes to Apon, our server, who truly made the evening exceptional. His service was not just friendly and attentive, but genuinely expert-level. He clearly knew the art of Korean BBQ inside out and prepared everything exactly to our preference. Thanks to him, the meal was not only very enjoyable, but also exceptionally tasty.

The quality of the food was top-notch — excellent cuts, fresh ingredients, and great flavors across the board. You can tell this place takes pride in both its cuisine and its service.

Overall, an amazing restaurant that we can wholeheartedly recommend. We will most definitely come back the next time we are in Kuala Lumpur.

name: Food Tour Malaysia
reviews: My husband and I did the Off the Eaten Food Tour with Junie in George Town and what a fantastic evening it was! We loved learning all about Penang’s incredible food culture while exploring hidden gems and local street food spots around town. Junie was so knowledgeable and passionate about sharing her culture, and she gave us some great recommendations for other  places to try a during our stay. Such a memorable experience — highly recommend!
Our tour with Karlson was great. He was very knowledgeable and it was like going out with an old friend. Would highly recommend the tour.

Incredible tour! This is a must for anyone visiting KL. My wife and I loved the “Off the Rail Food Tour”. Our guide was funny, informative, thoughtful, and knew incredible places to eat. We learned so much about KL history nd ate a variety of fantastic foods.

name: Kobe Beef Amami
reviews:
We came here and didn’t expect this. Definitely on the higher end of food wise but worth the experience. Having an experienced chef cook you kobe beef and doing it amazingly is a must do experience. We came here during lunch hours and we were extremely satisfied. We also ordered the Italian soda which we didn’t like as much as it is very strong in alcohol taste, but it was also our very first meal/drink of the day but still a 10/10 experience.

Food is amazing and wouldn’t change anything. I would highly recommend opting for the garlic wagyu rice and definitely walk off the calories gained because the fat of the wagyu will have you sleppy!!😂

Absolutely overpriced, food is OK, service is borderline scammy.

There were only 2 staff members in the store when we visited. They were both very friendly and polite despite 1 not being fluent in English.

However, they failed to mention to us that the 2 cheapest beef options (which we wanted to pick) and the set option with desserts were sold out, and instead offered us free drinks because they "will be keep us waiting for a while" as they prepared desserts for another 2 guests. We were only informed of the menu change after we started consuming the free drinks, so it would be difficult and impolite for us to leave. The staff were polite and professional throughout the whole service, but the practice of keeping customers in the dark until it's too late felt scammy and insincere.

All 3 of us ended up choosing the "special rare cuts" option (~¥10230, 110g) plus set A (¥900, with rice, salad, and soup). The meat was tender and not overly greasy, with mild umami flavor. There were also some vegetables as sides (onions, peppers, etc), they were well cooked but the portion was a bit small. The meat portion was on point and we were about 80% full after the meal. Service was quick because the we were the only group in the restaurant. Food was good but not worth the price. You will mostly be paying for service and the furnishing/environment.

The shop is small with less than 10 seats. Chef will be cooking on the hot plate in front of you. It was very quiet when we visited as we were the only group.

Overall, you will get a comfortable experience in a nice, quiet environment. The food will be satisfactory albeit overpriced. You should ask whether your desired menu option is available before you enter to avoid having a similar experience as we did. (You can find the menu on tabelog)

Additional information:
- Set A (rice, salad, soup) is included if you order before 15:00.
- A 5% service charge will be applied if you visit after 17:00 (in additon to VAT).
- This resuatrant is owned by the chain "Kisshokichi".

Originally, we wanted to try a different Kobe restaurant, but at the last minute we decided to check out Kobe Beef Amami because of the reviews—and we’re so delighted with our decision and experience. Luckily, my husband and I were the only customers, so we were able to enjoy a full teppanyaki-style dining experience.

The Kobe beef was excellent, and even the sides and sauces were impressive. We highly recommend this restaurant because you truly get what you pay for. We’ll definitely be back again. Kudos to Sanil and the rest of the staff for being so accommodating. Thank you!

name: Kuromon Burger Makotoya
reviews: Ordered the double kuromon burger and it was absolutely delicious! The fries were seasoned perfectly as well. Would highly recommend to anyone with a craving for a burger. The atmosphere was nice as well. A lot of throwback American songs in the background.

We visited Kuromon market and got hungry, and decided to try this place.
My wife did order the Kuromon burger and double Kuromon burger, which tasted really good.
They only got beef burgers no chicken (the mest is halal, one burger got bacon but he makes that separetly).
The owners is a nice couple which gives best service. While waiting we saw the pictures with more informations on the burgers than the menu, and saw there is wine in the sauce on the burger we choose. After telling the owner we dont want it, even if it is simmer. He did make it again without wine, since almost done.

We will definetly recommend this place, if you want a burger and are nearby.
Loved it. Thanks so much for great fresh food quality burgers and wedges. Kids loved it and staff were very friendly and accommodating. Recommended for quality burgers at the heart of Kuromon market.

name: Discova Malaysia
street: Level 12-1, Mercu UEM, Jalan Stesen Sentral 5
reviews:
We had a brilliant day visiting Malacca from KL! Kugan was a great guide - friendly and we enjoyed his sense of humour :) We learned facts and history about Malaysia and the local area, but were not overloaded with information which most people would likely appreciate. The tour was relaxing!
There were 14 of us in the minibus, which was comfortable and with strong air con.

It would have been nice to visit the coast as part of the tour. But I appreciate that only a certain number of visits/attractions can be covered in each day tour, and we did enjoy the boat trip from Morten Village and back, and all of the sights included in the tour!

Highly recommend!!

Had a great half day tour of Kek Lok Si temple and Penang Hill.  G-Shen did a great job guiding me around amd getting me where I needed to be, both for views and great photos.

He also had lots of historic amd current info on Penang and George Town, which made the tour very interesting.

Since it was just me and I tend to move quickly, we had some extra time at the end. So he drove me through different parts of George Town explaining sites and history. It was great.

Highly recommend.

Great tour to Melaka and great guide, Suren Naidu.
Pick-up on time with nice greetings. His car was very clean. Water was available to all of us (we were 2 couples)
The tour was nice although it was very hot that day.
Suren explained us everything in advance.
He told us all about Melaka and the history.
The conversation was very good with Suren, his English was perfect to understand.

We recommend Suren Naidu to all travellers.

name: Carousel & Co. Kuala Lumpur
street: L4-2 & L4-6, ABOVE, Level 4 @, 156, Jln Ampang
reviews: Best dating place and chill. Environment was nice. I feel like oversea vibes. They got bar and popcorn area. Some machine a bit delay and malfunction. Hopefully they will improve the system. Overall I really recommend for those looking for place to have fun and enjoy your weekend. Have fun guys.

Stumbled upon this place during their soft opening and have since been back once more! The games are a good level of challenging and you get to go for two rounds per game, so you play a total of 18 rounds (9 games)—if you’re the type to go all out be prepared to work up a bit of a sweat! A highlight would be the staff as they’re all really friendly and helpful. Perfect activity if you’re into some friendly competition with friends/partner/coworkers/family (adults only though). There’s also a bar and restaurant within the same space and you can order food and drinks to have while playing. Great concept overall and will definitely be back!

Game play was really fun.

Took us around 1 hour to play all games... maybe slightly longer as we took a break for a drink in the middle as for us Adults, it's a full workout!

SO MUCH FUN! They need more of these venues

name: Wagyu Musashi kuromon
reviews:
Ordered the A5 sushi and rump wagyu skewer. They were surprisingly close to flavorless, and the rice was a joke. You can get a much better meal at Yoshinoya for 1/5th of the price.

I'm upset I spent legal tender and stomach space here. I wish someone had warned me, as it has been a bit of a downer on what has otherwise been a nice vacation.

Got the uni sushi tofu pocket because I didn't want to buy a whole box of uni in case I wouldn't like it. It had a very strong seafood/ocean taste but honestly not that amazing. Also had to wait quite a bit because they were working on cooking the wagyu skewers first.

It’s not even 15 minutes ago that I left this place, but I felt the need to leave a stellar review. While not necessarily cheap, the price was totally worth it. First, the staff is very friendly and accommodating, and the food was so so good. We wagyu in different forms and it was all delicious. A truly nice and charming place.

name: kobe beef steak kiku神戸牛ステーキ菊
street: Kitanagasadori, 1 Chome−21−5 コペンビル壱 番館202
reviews: The chef grilled the premium Kobe beef right in front of us — perfect sear, melt-in-your-mouth texture, and a buttery aroma that filled the air. Every bite was rich yet delicate. The presentation was beautiful, paired with seasonal vegetables and crispy garlic chips. I also loved how the chef explained each step and cooking style in detail. You can really taste the quality of award-winning Kobe beef. Truly one of the best teppanyaki experiences in Japan — elegant, flavorful, and unforgettable.

Awesome Kobe Beef in short. We were the only guests in the restaurant despite dinner time, which meant the attention from the staff were all on us. We were well-serviced and taken care of. The selection of beef were great and the chef skillfully cooked the beef to perfection in front of us. Best meal of my trip!

A great place to eat kobe beef at affordable prices. The staff were very accommodating despite us not having a reservation.
The chef was very kind and made sure we savor every bite and take pictures.
The food itself was very nice and portion size was reasonable for its price. Highly recommend kobe beef steak kiku!

name: The Perfume Factory Bukit Bintang (Retail & Wholesale)
street: Retail 4 & 5, B-1-1, Block B Bintang Fairlane.23 Jalan Padang, Lorong Walter Grenier
reviews: Staff yang nama Darius sangat friendly and helpful in recommending the right present to gift to someone. The price is affordable and reasonable. All kind of perfume can be found here. Semua perfume Muslim-Friendly. Boleh datang lagi next time untuk shopping perfume!

The store was full of perfume products outside of the well-known brands. The staff was also very helpful in assisting me with sniffing different tester scents. I spent more than an hour here just exploring lesser known and niche perfumes. I would come again and perhaps update this review in the future.

For those interested, there is also a membership.

Went there yesterday with the intention of buying, however left disappointed due to service wise.
- wanting to buy the alchemist perfume but was told no more tester available. The lady quite petite and pretty continue doing her make up. No intention at all to serve us at all. No tester how u expect us to buy in the first place? You can't open another tester? Plus black face maybe i disturb her doing her make up? I'm not sure.
Just hope at least do greet any customer who came in, instead of showing black face to us.

name: Home Snack 南洋特产 Jalan Alor
reviews:
5 stars for 5 reasons

1. The workers are super nice and welcoming.

2. Good products and seem to be quality.

3. We tried a lot of the stuff out before buying so it was nice

4. Wide variety of durian products, coffee durian, snacks and a lot more to explore.

5. They were nice for us to leave our bags there and come back to pick it up.

BEST LOCAL SPECIALTY SHOP IN JALAN ALOR!!!!
There is so much variety here. Things are cheap. Especially their durian goods. THEY ARE SO GOOD OMG. Their staff is also really friendly. Good service 🤩👍
Very nice and excellent service. Many good products and cheap prices 👍❤️

name: Kopi Saigon Taman Melawati
reviews: Fast and efficient staff, a comfortable environment, and a really relaxing vibe. Service was smooth and quick, and it’s a great place to sit back and enjoy a drink. Definitely a spot I’d come back to. Tried their new drink (TWIN BERRY) and it was really good. The flavour well-balanced and not too sweet, clearly meet with quality ingredients. definitely worth trying if you're looking for something new. And also they have waffle and croffle 🫶🏼😇

Has been coming over since years ago, so glad to see they renovated the space to be more comfortable and air-conditioned inside!

Kopi saigon has been consistently good dari dulu! On-repeat!
Love the new look! Really cozy and aesthetic. I also really recommend their Kopi Buttercream if you prefer sweet and creamy.

name: Magic Restaurant & Bar – Illusion Land Nandeya!?
reviews:
What a magical experience at "Illusion Land Nan De Ya!?".

We did a quick Google Maps search of the area, and came across dinner and a show as an option.

We made no reservation and walked in from the street, we were immediately greeted and surprised with the first magic trick right on entry (no spoilers on that!)

The drinks menu is impressive, the gentlemen as well as being skilled illusionists are also skilled bar tenders.

They have an A La Carte menu, so it's easy not to waste part of a meal set and thus not feel guilty.

After a few small meals, we were shown a few magic tricks at our table before the main event started.

We were well fed! Please don't let my marked price point intimidate you, we were very happy to keep the meals and drinks coming, but each are all well priced.

What was truly special about the experience was that though our Japanese was limited, as was their English, we all communicated well and shared an atmosphere of awe and appreciation.

To my western friends, don't let the trasitional American diner decor throw you off - this is hand on heart a truly humble Japanese experience. You will not regret coming here.

I couldn't reccommend "Illusionland Nan De Ya!?" enough. I was very pleasantly impressed by their hospitality and kindness.

All the best gentlemen, I hope you enjoyed our company as much as we did enjoy yours.

Many blessings.
We walked past this place looking for dinner. So glad we stopped. An unforgettable night. Very friendly service and amazing magic show!

We stopped in on a Sunday evening and the service was impeccable. The food 🍝 was delicious. Kirin 🍺 was frosty. And even though it was just my wife and I the guys pit on an incredible magic 🪄 show! Highly recommend visiting!

name: Kuala Lumpur City Tour
reviews:
Excellent Service.  Highly Recommended

I had a great experience with “ Discovery tours and travel management” 👍👍 during my visit to Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya. Everything was perfectly organized and smooth.

Special thanks to their boss, Eunus Eusuf, who is extremely knowledgeable and knows every detail of the city. His professionalism and insight made the visit truly enjoyable.

Highly recommended. 👏👏👏

Super service! I asked for a last minute private tour for 6 person and they gave me an offer super quickly. Everything went so smooth, and we were in the car only in 1h 15 minutes after i contacted them. The driver was easy and friendly, he talked exactly as much as needed. The car was very clean. Highly reccomend this company.
It was amazing experience at malaysia. I really liked the way they maintain the traffic rules.

name: 吉隆坡师爷庙拓荒博物馆 Sin Sze Si Ya Temple Pioneers of Kuala Lumpur Museum
reviews:
Really interesting museum. I was lucky to stumble upon it. There was masses of information about the origins of the temple and the Chinese community in KL. There were also fascinating panorami of KL over four different periods and you could see the differences quite clearly. In the 1880s the centre of the city where the temple stands was just wooden huts. Merdeka Square was fields! It's large and well designed with two galleries, one being historic the other being artistic and comprised of artefacts. Excellent way to spend a couple of hours. The young woman on the desk is very pleasant.😍😍😍

You can visit the temple after!

A small but fascinating museum located next to the temple. The temple is free to enter with a charge of RM10 for the museum.

I would highly recommend visiting if in the area. The museum is very well laid out and gives a good overview of the history of the temple

Entrance fee for adult at RM10, senior citizen at RM5.

Very interesting, informative and there were stories of Yap Ah Loy and some other Chinese Kapitans too.

name: Ci Manchi Coffee Gusto
street: G.02, Ground Floor, Menara Haw Par, 12, Jln Sultan Ismail
reviews: If you are fussy about coffee that is the right place to go. I've tried also their local toasted bread with some kind of coconut jam, it was very good with very delicate sweetness and flavour. Espresso was top notch, served with a glass of water. Excellent
Went here for quick coffee. Turns out it's a nice place to do WFC. The coffee is also nice.

Cute place, friendly staff & good drinks!
Really enjoyed the iced biscoff specialty drink. Good music to relax to and wait out the rain. Barely 5 min walk from monorail station.
Cozy seats available inside and outside.

name: お料理 いしはら
reviews:
日曜日のランチを予約をしてお邪魔しました。
和風の落ち着いた雰囲気の、オシャレで綺麗な店内のお店です。
ランチコースのお品書きは無く、皆さん共通の1択コースです。
盛り付けは美しく、味は京風？薄味で美味しかったです。
月替りでメニューの内容が少し変わりますとの事でした。
お昼のランチや夜のコースのお値段は少々お高めかな？と感じられました。
ハイボールも山崎・白州・竹鶴等と嬉しい品揃えでした。
直ぐに満席となっていましたので、確かではありませんが予約必須の人気のお店だと思います。
近鉄桑名駅東口から徒歩５分くらいの所にお店があります。
お店の駐車場は無いと思います。
近くにコインパーキングがたくさんありました。

Googleの評価を見て訪問しました。
八寸からご飯まで、バランスよくさまざまな美味しい食材を楽しめました。
丁寧に取られた出汁が効いており、どのお料理もとても上品に調理されています。

蒸籠蒸しのご飯はツヤツヤでもちもち。上にのった縮緬雑魚もふわふわで印象的でした。
大将と女将さんの接客は丁寧でありながらテキパキしていて、とても居心地が良かったです。

ランチは一人3,000円ですが、価格以上の価値があります。
量も女性にちょうど良いボリュームでした。

また次回お邪魔するのを楽しみにしております。

土曜昼、ランチ。ランチだが、7人の貸し切りで夜のコースをお願いしました。

桑名でこんなに美味しい和食料理屋がオープンするとは...しかも訪問しやすい価格設定で!!!　素材を活かした調理、丁寧に仕込みしているのがわかります。料理はもちろんですがドリンクも和酒、洋酒、ソフドリまできちんとセレクトされており◎

※駅近のため、駐車場はありません。車の場合は近隣のコインパーキングを利用してくださいとのこと。

name: Gyukatsu Motomura Namba Branch
street: Namba, 3 Chome−3−1 スガタビル B1F
reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Absolutely worth the hype! Gyukatsu Motomura Namba Branch delivers an unforgettable dining experience. The beef cutlet was perfectly tender and juicy, with a crisp coating that wasn’t oily at all. I loved grilling the gyukatsu on the stone to my preferred doneness — such a fun and interactive touch.

The set meal was well-balanced, from the fluffy rice and miso soup to the variety of sauces that really elevated the flavor. Service was efficient and polite despite the crowd, and the overall atmosphere felt authentic and welcoming.

If you’re in Osaka and love high-quality beef, this place is a must-try. I’d gladly line up again! 🇯🇵🥩✨

This was a very nice restaurant to dine in!

The food and service were amazing! Yuna was our server. She was very helpful and really really friendly. All of the staff are friendly and helpful. We'll come back here if we get the chance.

Thank you so much! Mabuhay ka, Yuna!

Very delicious! As soon as we sat down our food was already prepared for us. The staff gave clear instructions on how to enjoy our meal and were so kind. The food was high quality! I would love to come back here again. Thank you for making our dining experience so wonderful, Choru!

name: Canopy Lounge Rooftop Bar KL
reviews:
had such a good night at Canopy Lounge Rooftop Bar & Lounge 🤍✨

the vibe is sooo nice, perfect rooftop ambiance with city views 🌃💫 we had some shisha which was smooth and really good 💨 and my cosmopolitan was perfectly balanced, not too sweet, just right 🍸💋

what impressed me the most? i randomly asked for a fruit platter even though it wasn’t on the menu… and they actually made it for me 🥹🍓🍍 that’s such thoughtful service!!

special shoutout to Miraj for being super friendly and helpful the whole time 🙌🏻 made the experience even better.

definitely coming back for the vibes, drinks, and amazing service 🤍✨

Canobi Lounge offers a truly mixed experience. Let me start with the undeniable positives: the hospitality is top-tier. The staff are attentive, friendly, and provide service that makes you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. The ambiance is beautifully designed, creating a sophisticated and comfortable setting for an evening out.

Furthermore, the food and non-alcoholic beverages are excellent. The menu is creative, well-presented, and delicious, showcasing a great deal of culinary skill. We thoroughly enjoyed every dish we ordered, and the mocktails were flavorful and expertly crafted.

However, for the Muslim community, there is a significant and unavoidable issue: the prominent offering and service of alcohol throughout the lounge. While the establishment itself is stylish and the halal food is superb, the pervasive presence of alcoholic beverages creates an environment that may not align with the comfort and principles of many Muslim patrons. The close proximity of these drinks on tables and at the bar can be off-putting and detracts from what would otherwise be a fantastic, fully inclusive venue.

In summary, a great place in terms of service, food, and ambiance, but the alcohol service is a major drawback for those seeking a completely Islam-friendly environment. I hope the management might consider creating dedicated nights or a separate section to cater to this large segment of their potential clientele.
The place is very nice and the pizza was wonderful…staff is very friendly and active…we enjoy our time here …must suggest this place …we will came back again

name: PINWHEEL RESTO CAFE
reviews: Pine Wheel Resto is a great place to enjoy tasty food in a comfortable and pleasant atmosphere. The food quality is good, portions are satisfying, and the presentation is nice. The staff is friendly and service is smooth, making the overall experience enjoyable. A nice spot for casual dining with friends or family. Definitely worth visiting.

Halal Cafe for Muslim patrons 😃
