Great restaurant with great food! Tried their seafood tomyum and black pepper salmon pasta! Highly recommend these 2 mains! Their mushroom soup with garlic bread taste sooooo good! Got myself a Matcha Latte, it taste perfect!

Last night got myself Fish and Chips from Grabfood app, it was nicely packed and the portion of the fish was satisfying for the price.

The garlic bread was fragrant and delicious, however I ordered Tomyam Carbonara Pasta and Garlic Butter Chicken Chop, both was a miss in my opinion, not as flavourful as I thought.

You will need to add either more salt and pepper according to your tasting. Overall, based on other reviews, looks like breakfast will be better instead of lunch/dinner. Will try other dishes instead the next time.

name: Wagyu(Halal) Japanese food Steak-Burger&Ramen Dotonbori Restaurant Namba-Tei
reviews:
We had a great meal here. Ordered Combo 1 (Wagyu Truffle Cheese Burger + Steak Rice Bowl Combo). A waitress greeted us and brought us into a private room. I forgot her name but she spoke good English, which is helpful for customers who do not speak Japanese.

Location is very near Ebisu Bridge, where the Glico sign is. Another waiter, Atsuki, also served us and ensured we had great service throughout the meal (he spoke good English too).

Highly recommend this place, especially if you’re looking for a halal option in Osaka.

Best service by the sweet lady server. She introduce to us for a good 5minutes about the restaurant and Osaka. She explain to us about the menu and the halal concept of the restaurant. There was no rush unlike other restaurant. Here, they want to enjoy the experience of dining. We finished off with matcha ice cream mochi. Nice!

The overall taste was better here than the other Halal Wagyu place a block away but to be fair, that is a DIY BBQ  and this is not.

So if you want ambience, food and comfort, this is the place.

Maybe need to change one thing on google map opens at 11am, not 10am.

I had a wonderful experience at this place. The atmosphere was welcoming and comfortable from the moment I walked in. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made me feel truly valued as a customer.

The food was beautifully presented and tasted amazing. You can really tell that they care about quality and details. Everything was fresh and well-prepared.

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. I’m already looking forward to coming back again!

name: Reggae Cafe Penang
reviews:
Would not recommend to anyone looking for a good dining experience. Used to enjoy this place for good cakes and drinks but now is seems like they just don't care anymore. Quality is just terrible.

Ordered 2 slices of cakes, one tiramisu and one chocolate cake. The chocolate was mediocre, very dry and almost as hard as a rock. The tiramisu had zero coffee taste in the cake, the cake wasnt even chilled properly and the cream in the center had already gone rancid. I immediately feedback to the indian male server named ‘Mali’ that the cake had gone bad and tasted sour. He even had the audacity to bring back the cake and told us it was fine and insisted we continue eating that piece of spoilt cake. He kept insisting that their cakes are very fresh and even told me off in a very rude manner. Clearly the cake have been left for days for it to turn that dry and for the cream to turn rancid.

DO NOT DINE IN THIS CAFE:
- If you don’t want to be served by rude waiters (As if you owe them money).
- If you don’t want dry and bland cakes that have been kept for days.
- If you don't want to feel ripped off. (Mind you that each slice of cake is charged at about RM25-30)
-If you

There are way better options at that price point, with better quality and without risk of food poisoning.

Came here for Valentines dinner with our children and parents. The drinks were nice. We are vegetarians and noticed that there were a lot of vegan options hence we decided to come here. Unfortunately they served us a wrong chicken pizza at first. Followed by a mushroom burger that tasted very bland. The stuffed bell pepper also tasted extremely bland. Couldn’t eat. Will not recommend this place to vegans. The carrot cake we ordered also didn’t taste good.

Absolutely loved this cafe! The food was fantastic (Creamy Lemon Pasta and Mushroom Soup were highlights!), and the presentation was lovely. The cake selection is legendary—so many treats to choose from! Perfect place to relax and satisfy your sweet cravings. Must-try dishes: Hearthside Lamb Pleasure and the classic Caffe Latte!

name: Indian Empire
reviews:
I had a wonderful Iftar experience at Indian Empire. The food was absolutely delicious! I ordered the butter chicken and briyani, and both dishes were full of flavor. The butter chicken was creamy and rich, perfectly balanced with spices, and the briyani was fragrant, well-cooked, and very satisfying.

The service was also excellent. Mr. Krishnamurthy was very friendly, attentive, and polite throughout our meal. He made sure we were comfortable and checked on us regularly, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, it was a great Iftar dinner with good food and warm hospitality. I would definitely recommend this place and will come back again!

We had a wonderful dining experience at here! The Butter Chicken was incredibly creamy and flavorful—definitely a must-try. The Crab Soup was also delicious and really hit the spot.

However, what truly made our visit special was the service. A male staff whose name starts with T (I am sorry can’t confirm is Th or sth, who has a big smile), went above and beyond for us. He was very attentive and patiently explained the differences between the dishes on the menu. Thanks to his recommendations, we felt right at home and got a genuine taste of Indian culture through the food. We left feeling completely satisfied. Very delicious!"

This is food paradise! The most delicious Indian food I had so far. From the starters to the main courses - everything was so flavourful! I highly recommend the Dahi Poori and the Badami Gosht. The curry was incredibly good. Also, our waiter Mr. Selva did a fantastic job in explaininig the menu, giving great recommendations and making us feel comfortable. It was a perfect dinner out and I for sure was in food heaven. We'll come back!

name: Specialty Cow Restaurant Itamae Yakiniku Ichigyu Kobe Sannomiya Branch
street: Nakayamatedori, 1 Chome−4−7 ユーベルビル 1F 東門
reviews:
Loved this experience of Wagyu Yakiniku.  It is amongst one of the best ones we have had.  The Kobe beef were great of course, but what impressed me is that all the other types of Wagyu beef are equally enjoyable.  Thanks for a wonderful experience.

Our favorite beef part is the Special Filet Mignon.

I had slightly higher expectations going in — I tried Kobe beef at the market earlier and was absolutely amazed, maybe that was a very high premium cut. At this restaurant, the first four cuts on the platter were amazing, but the last four were a bit underwhelming, so I’d probably recommend ordering individual plates rather than the premium 8 set.

The overall experience was great — good service and a nice atmosphere — but I wouldn’t rate it a five stars. Also worth noting: they offer ice cream or a drink in exchange for leaving a review, so keep that in mind when reading others.

The meats and cuts here were excellent. Our first experience of eating Kobe beef here. Highly recommend the liver, sirloin, and chateaubriand. We had the staircase selection as well which lets you taste a variation of cuts.

The staff are super lovely and helpful. Tho a small team so be patient and kind!

The restaurant has a small seating — some individual, two people, and group tables. We came at 1pm and did not have to wait but the restaurant soon filled up.

Overall would come back and we had a very good and full meal here.

name: DUAN @ George Town
reviews:
I had a great experience at Duan Cafe. The laksa was really good—flavorful and satisfying. I also loved the crispy bread with kaya and peanut; it was nicely toasted and paired perfectly with the spread.
The portion size was bigger than expected, which really impressed me and made the meal even more worth it.
The environment can be slightly noisy and the walking space inside is a bit small, but it’s still comfortable enough to enjoy the food. Overall, a nice spot for a tasty local meal.

🌿 Nasi Lemak
I was pleasantly surprised by their nasi lemak! The chicken was juicy, and the rice had a subtle coconut aroma. Paired with the sambal, it was absolutely appetizing.

🥩 Beef Satay
The beef skewers were generously portioned, with plenty of meat on each stick. The dipping sauce was unique—not the usual sweet style, but more fragrant and layered in flavor.

🔥 Salted Egg Char Kuey Teow
This is exactly the kind of char kuey teow I love—full of that perfect wok hei! The moment the aroma hit, I knew it would be good. The noodles were fragrant and wonderfully smooth.

🍜 Mee Jawa
My first time trying it! The tangy broth was rich and flavorful, and the toppings were plentiful. It’s one of those dishes that gets better with every bite.
I also have to praise the prawn crackers—they were super crispy with the perfect thickness. Soaking them in the rich broth made them even more amazing.

Absolutely superb food at Duan! The fried mantis is to die for: crispy and perfect. I also loved the Duck Egg Seafood and the Prawn Char Koay Kak, which were both incredibly tasty. And bonus points: the staff are amazing and fast. A must-visit for anyone craving authentic flavors in the area.

name: Serai • Pavilion Kuala Lumpur
street: Lot 7 . 01 . 04, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, 168, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews: We took a chance and ate here without reading any reviews. Food was so good especially the satays and char kuey teow. They also offer some interesting drinks and staff were super friendly.

The food was delicious, especially the Massaman Lamb Shank Curry — the meat was incredibly tender. The Serai Platter is also a great choice. However, the Hot Lemongrass Tea was a bit of a letdown as it tasted quite watered down; I wouldn't order it again. Service was a 4/5. Overall, worth visiting for the great flavors!

Food was generally okay, kids meal was adequate but the fish and chips came with ketchup instead of tartar sauce which is peculiar. Burger came with a good sized patty. Salads were good but again the mushroom soup was on the salty side. Restaurant is always crowded but there's a good spread of items on the menu.

name: Sakananohachibe Sakae
reviews:
Food was really good and staff were very friendly! They have english menu. Do note that you have to make a reservation before visiting. Otherwise, you might not get to dine there.

Favourite is the fried prawn! It's very fresh and has that natural sweetness!

Food was very fresh and service was very friendly. However there are a few items that we ordered, but it didn’t came. So we had to re-order multiple times. Not sure if the bills were duplicate as well since we didn’t translate it to English.

But overall, I will recommend this place!

The Sashimi was decent for the price, but the Sesame Hamachi was overpowered by an overly strong sesame sauce, and while the servers were kind, service was slow when taking orders and settling the bill

name: TGI Fridays Suria KLCC
reviews: the food was so good and they had alot of different drinks options but i dont reccomend the blue raspberry, it kinda tasted like swimming pool water.. other than that everything else was SO good , me and my family spent 700RM for 9 people and we ordered apitizers and meals. food came pretty fast and the workers were kind and helpful , atmopshere was good and had TVs around . seats were really comfortable . i reccomend coming at dinner time and on a empty stomach because the portions are quite big . the texas ribs is so tender and just wants to fall off the bone when i lift it up. it came with a side of big onion rings freshly made and it came out to be around 90++ RM !  overall i totally reccomend people to come visit this place . many food options ! 🫶🏻

The Limited Time Christmas/New Year Steak in this place is fantastic, and the drinks (especially the Grinch Milkshake) is great too.
However, I would not have had this experience if it were not for our waiter Fadzil.
He was very friendly and helpful with our order, and the food was his recommendation.
Many thanks to TGI Friday's in KLCC Suria and to our waiter Fadzil for this excellent meal.
Food is nice and big in portion. 3 person can just order two main if you are small eater 👌😊 Price a bit high but in this mall can't complaint 😊. Steak and Salmon are nicely prepared.

name: Nando’s - Suria KLCC
street: Lot C07, Concourse Floor, Petronas Twin Tower, Jln Ampang
reviews:
Had a great lunch with my bestie
Didn’t know they offered new menu for sides, Mac&cheese. It was good but I think the cheese just to much haha
& it’s a bit hot 🥲
But we had a great food & time.

Ain was great in assisting us! Thank you for your lovely service! 🤩🥳

If you are coming from LRT station, walking over to klcc mall. This will be the first few shops that will welcome you.

The layout can feels pretty noisy and crowded when it is full house. The mushroom soup seems to be alittle bit more less sticky than the ones I had in one utama.

As for the chicken, it has always been consistent. I tried the chicken butterfly with BBQ sauce. The BBQ sauce was alittle be too little despite they asked for additional RM1+ for it. The chicken was really moist and nice to eat.

The chicken is just fine but the peri peri sauce is a bit strange as it is not like what I usually taste. One of the waiter needed to be well trained to serve the customer not to pass the communication to other waiter. Additionally I was not so convinience as the girl next to me is coughing all the time which annoyes me a lot. Overal is just okay. You can do better to check the quality of the food including the sauce. Keep it up.

name: Shawarma City - KLCC
street: 148, Jalan Ampang Affin Bank Bangunan Getah Asli
reviews: I was excited to try this restaurant given that there were so many high reviews, but boy was I disappointed. The chicken meat was extremely dry and devoid of flavor, barely juicy, and tender unlike so many other reviews here say. I usually enjoy the garlic sauce, the most, but here the garlic sauce was barely flavorful. You could barely taste any hint of garlic in it, and it tasted more like a lemon sauce. Completely disappointed by my visit.

The food was good. I would recommend you to get the additional 2 RM fries. It is well worth it. Portion is more than enough and it also tastes great. Hummus comes with one free pita bread
The server also was super helpful and respectful. We did not wait at all for a table. People come and go but there are always atleast 2 tables open at a time (at least when we visited).

We honestly just came in for a quick snack, but the chicken shawarma platter was sooo good. There were 6 of us and it was perfect to share, filling but not too heavy. And for RM33? Totally worth it. Will definitely visit again!

name: Hookie Dookie @ LaLaport Bukit Bintang
street: GF84 & 85, Ground Level, Mitsui Shopping Park LaLaport, 2, Jln Hang Tuah
reviews:
We’d been eager to visit this spot after hearing so many good things, and it definitely has its bright spots! The avocado shrimp salad was fresh and delicious—just as delightful as we’d hoped. We also tried the Kam heong seafood pizza, which had such a creative and flavorful topping. If we could offer one friendly suggestion: the very thin crust couldn’t quite hold up to those tasty ingredients, so it turned out a bit softer than we expected. With just a little tweak to the base, this pizza could be absolutely stellar!

Beyond the food, the ambience was lovely—both indoor and outdoor seating offered a nice vibe—and the service was prompt and friendly. Prices felt fair for the portions, too. We’re looking forward to returning and seeing what’s next on the menu!

First time visited this lounge and bar. The service of Zaid and other staffs were excellent. They welcomed us with a warm smile and approached us friendly. The food and environment here were nice. Chicken aglio Akio we even ordered 2. Taste good! Birthday people also can redeem their cute larva cake! Definitely will come here again!

Read the good reviews and decided to give this restaurant a try.

We ordered one set dinner, which was the Pull Beef Rendang Pizza. That came with a soup, dessert and a soft drink. I spent Rm15 to upgrade that to a Tiger beer. We also ordered a Roast Beef Salad.

Verdict:
1. Set dinner soup: Awful. I honestly could not tell what soup it was. 👎🏼
2. Pull Beef Rendang Pizza: Excellent! Such an interesting flavour! 👍🏼
3. Roast Beef Salad: A bit too much salad dressing. But on the whole, really good! The mint leaves in the salad made a big difference. 👍🏼
4. Dessert: Some puddy that waitress casually dropped off on the table without explaining what it was. Artificial taste and way too sweet. Awful. 👎🏼
5. The beer: It's just Tiger. But the thing that made all the difference was that it was served in an ice cold beer mug. Really nice. 👍🏼

Atmosphere: Music was good. But there was a table of about 8 people joking and laughing at the top of their voice. Not exactly conducive for conversation; so we ate, paid and left.

All in all, we did enjoy out meal, so we will come again.

name: Al - Sultan Restaurant - Bukit Bintang
reviews:
Al Sultan Restaurant in Bukit is a great spot to enjoy authentic Middle Eastern cuisine in a comfortable and welcoming setting. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels warm and relaxed, making it suitable for family meals, casual dining with friends, or even small group gatherings.

The food was genuinely good and satisfying. The flavors were rich, well-balanced, and clearly prepared with quality ingredients. The grilled dishes were especially impressive—tender, juicy, and well-seasoned without being overpowering. The rice dishes were fragrant and fluffy, pairing perfectly with the meats. Portions were generous, making the meals filling and good value for money. The bread was fresh and soft, and the sauces added an extra layer of authenticity to the overall dining experience.

Service was friendly and attentive. The staff were polite, responsive, and quick to assist with ordering or recommendations. Despite the restaurant being busy at times, the waiting time for food was reasonable.

The ambience is clean and pleasant, with a Middle Eastern touch that enhances the dining experience. Seating is comfortable, and the restaurant is suitable for both quick meals and longer, relaxed dining.

Overall, Al Sultan Restaurant in Bukit delivers good food, decent service, and a comfortable dining environment. It’s a solid choice for anyone craving Middle Eastern cuisine in Kuala Lumpur, and definitely a place worth revisiting

I had my birthday celebration in mid October last month. I met the manager named Mr Mido only a night before the actual celebration. He attentively listened to our request about food and table placemenr and all. He was also helpful recommending the food and everthing. Even throughout the event, he kept checking if eveyrthing is ok or not.

Not to mention, staff there also super helpful. Whatever we requested they served quickly and kindly. Their staff even willingly went all the way out to nearby street just to pick my birthday cake bcos Lalamove driver couldnt find the way. I didnt have to request even 😭✊🏻 Im so thankful for them for making things super smooth on that day.

We had lots of delicious food such as side dishes Turkish and Fattoudh Salad as well Mixed Grills. I love the Mixed Grills. It taste like satay but maybe better? With softer meat and more herbs. 2 jugs are enough for 7 people. Another significant dishes I would like to mention are Fahsah its sooo goood 😭 minced chicken with idk what but i love it and not too strong flavour i believe kid would like it too. Arabic Bread got 3 different type of bread especially the cheesy one is my favourite. We also had Turkish Mixed Mua’ Ganat, Mandy and Madghout. How ever those who may dont prefer too much herbs/spices in rice may avoid madghout. I put 4 stars for environment because of shisha and some unsettled business premises behind that abit unflattering.

Food presentation also lovely and well-presented. Thankyou everyone at Al Sultan for your service on my big day 💓

Me and my wife came here to eat dinner for our 2nd year wedding anniversary. Nice restaurant with delicious food. Ample space, service was good, we had a great time. Definitely can come again soon. 👌✨

name: Yaki Soul, KL
reviews: It was an incredible experience. The décor and atmosphere make you feel deeply connected to Japan. Everything was perfect. I highly recommend this place. The staff are wonderful, and the food is delicious. Thank you again for this authentic Japanese culinary experience. An authentic place with a sincere heart!

Visited during a weekend dinner — the restaurant was very crowded and reservations are definitely recommended. We ordered three plates of sashimi and a variety kind of yakitori. I wouldn’t say this is strictly an authentic Japanese yakitori spot; it feels more like a lively Japanese izakaya. That said, the food is easily among the best in town. Everything was well-prepared and flavorful. Highly recommended.

Our experience at Yaki Soul was fantastic. The restaurant’s design is stylish and inviting, setting the perfect atmosphere for a great meal.

The food was truly on another level. The Bluefin tuna literally melts in your mouth, and everything we ordered was of exceptional quality. Every dish was thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor. we only didnt like the clams, maybe necause of the sake taste inside.

Service was excellent as well. Our waiter gave remarkable attention and care throughout the meal—I just wish I remembered his name to personally commend him.

Overall, Yaki Soul is a must-visit for anyone looking for exquisite food, great service, and a wonderful dining experience.

name: Kuromon Kobe Beef & Beef Cutlet
reviews: Ordered the seafood fried rice and it was really tasty—prawns were fresh, nicely seasoned, and the overall flavour was satisfying. Presentation was great too. The portion is on the smaller side and the price feels a bit premium for the amount, but overall it was a pleasant meal and I’d still come back to try other dishes.

The menu was easy to navigate; English-friendly. The service was great! There is seating and a restroom for customers as well as vending machines for drinks. Our okonomiyaki was delicious and made quickly, too.

We tried the cup of three giant strawberries. Very tender and sweet with no sourness. You get a place to sit inside to enjoy to take a break from the crowd. Also they gave me a free bottle of water for writing a review. 😆

name: Kobe beef Daichi
reviews: The best meal of our life. The service, the atmosphere and of course the incredible food. Sugai, our chef, was exceptional. Do not miss out on this once in a lifetime experience if you are visiting Osaka/Kobe. We hope to be able to return again. Thank you to the entire team.

I've eaten A5 Kobe a lot in Japan, but this was my first time indulging in it from its hometown, and there is just something extra special about the experience. The lunch set automatically gets upgraded to include rice and salad and is thus a better deal than dinner service. We chose 110g Premium Rare Cut and 220g of lean A5, along with garlic rice (which was the best that I've ever had). The overall service is wonderful, and the chef is skillful and entertaining! Your trip in Japan is incomplete without a wagyu teppanyaki experience. By the way, Kobe Daichi has a very high rating on Tabelog, so it's local Japanese approved.

I recently had the pleasure of dining at Kobe Beef Daichi in Motomachidōri, Kobe, and it was truly an unforgettable culinary experience! From start to finish, everything was exceptional—the ambiance blended authentic Japanese elegance with warm, welcoming hospitality.

But what really elevated the evening was our chef, Oji. Chef Oji’s skill, attention to detail, and passion for her craft made all the difference. She gracefully prepared our meal—each step felt like an art performance as much as a dinner service. The way she seared the Kobe beef, brought out the flavors, and guided us through each course was both mesmerizing and deeply personal.

Each bite was a revelation—rich, melt-in-your-mouth beef with perfectly balanced seasoning, paired with thoughtfully selected sides and accompaniments. Chef Oji even took the time to explain the origin of the beef, her cooking techniques, and how to best appreciate the textures and flavors. Her warmth, enthusiasm, and artistry made us feel more than just guests—she treated us like honored friends.

If you’re looking for a standout dining experience in Kobe, I wholeheartedly recommend visiting this restaurant—and specifically asking for Chef Oji’s table. It’s rare to find such a combination of top-tier cuisine and genuine, heartfelt service. We’ll remember this night for a long time to come. Thank you, Chef Oji, and the entire team, for an amazing evening!

name: Umakabai Nagoya Station
reviews: GOOD👍️
I liked it! Very tasty
very good

name: Shabuwara Namba Grand Kagetsu
street: Nanbasennichimae, 11−番6号 なんばグランド花月１F
reviews: What a great find! We took the train to Namba without an agenda or nowhere specific to go to besides the Kuromon market. We wanted udon and did a search but the highly rated one wasn’t open yet. So we ducked into a food mall and found this place. Wow, impressed! The atmosphere is calm with dimmed lights and the food of course was marvelous. Plus one of the employees who is from Myanmar spoke really good English which made things easier for us. One of the best places we’ve eaten so far on our Osaka trip!

I had an amazing dining experience at Shabuwara. The restaurant specializes in sukiyaki and shabu-shabu, and everything—from the ingredients to the service—was truly impressive.

The highlight of the meal was definitely the premium Wagyu beef. The marbling was beautiful, and once it touched the hot sukiyaki broth, it cooked perfectly while staying tender and flavorful. The staff helped cook the first slice for me, which made the experience feel even more special.

The sukiyaki broth was rich, slightly sweet, and extremely comforting. Dipping the freshly cooked beef into the raw egg made it even smoother and more delicious, just like traditional Japanese style.

The vegetable set was also fresh and generous—mushrooms, tofu, greens, and more—perfect for balancing out the richness of the beef.

The atmosphere was cozy, and the staff were friendly and attentive. Even though the restaurant was busy, everything felt organized and welcoming.

Overall, Shabuwara is a great place for anyone who loves sukiyaki or wants to try high-quality Wagyu beef in Japan. I highly recommend it!

This place is a true paradise for shabu-shabu lovers!
Just look at that marbling on the beef 🥩 — absolutely stunning.
The visual? A solid 10/10.
Perfect marble texture, rich, premium, and totally mouthwatering.
One look and you already know… this is going to be so good

name: The Alley, 5 Stewart Lane
reviews: If you’re looking to have good coffee and good, tasty dessert away from the main street come here. The service is fast and friendly. The drinks and the burnt cheesecake were delicious. A good stop in the middle of the day.

I recently visited The Alley and had a very pleasant experience. The atmosphere is cozy and the staff are notably patient; they took the time to explain the different coffee beans in detail when we asked.

💁🏼‍♀️ Ordered:
🔅 Signature Churros:
These were excellent—crispy on the outside with a  chewy texture inside, and not greasy at all. Since I prefer less sweet desserts, I appreciated the staff's recommendation of the Dark Chocolate dip (rich and balanced) and the Salted Caramel. A unique highlight is the option to choose Kong Tng (traditional Penang peanut candy) as a side, which adds a great local touch.

🔅 Iced Americano (Ethiopia beans):
Very clean and refreshing with a bright, floral acidity typical of the region.

🔅 Dirty Latte (Indonesia beans):
The espresso was very bold and rich, featuring a nutty profile with a slight acidic finish. The milk was silky, though I personally found it could have used a bit more "body" or thickness to balance the heavy ristretto.

Value & Service:
The service is excellent without the added pressure of service charge or government tax. It’s a great spot for those who appreciate technical coffee knowledge and high-quality snacks.

We came to this café coz the key lime pie was meant to be an absolute dream, but my hopes were rather dashed. It was not as marvelous as I'd expected. We also had the signature churros, and they were decent but nothing to shout about. The coffee, though was fantastic. The latte was wonderfully fruity and aromatic with a lovely acidity. Reminds me of the ones I had in One Half. The service was slow. We had finished our dessert before the coffee even arrived. And the seating is quite limited. The toilet is tucked away in the back, and the roof above the basin is exposed, so things could get rather messy if it rains.

name: Kobe Beef Steak Ishida.Main-Shop
reviews: When you come to a place like this, you’re looking for more than food. You want a complete culinary experience, and Ishida lived up to the hype. Yes, the online reservation system is rigid, but the restaurant itself was flexible and reasonable once we arrived in person. The excellent experience starting at the reception where our coats were whisked away. Chef Shiiba not only prepared our meal with skill and flair, but his warmth and humour made us feel right at home. The Kobe beef was of course the star of the show and was top notch - rich, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with flavour. We ordered not just A5, but A4 and regular cuts, and could really tell the difference though even the regular cut was delicious. I felt the sake was more compellingly priced than the wine and would therefore recommend sake if you’re having alcohol (Dassai 45 paired well). Our young teenage sons were seamlessly accommodated in both drinks and food, and we’ll remember this family-friendly feast for a long time.

It was our first time visiting Kobe, and we came with high expectations for Kobe beef, so we made a reservation at Kobe Beef Steak Ishida Main Store, the most famous restaurant.
We had already expected a great experience from the reviews, but enjoying truly delicious food along with such kind and attentive service made it feel absolutely worth the price.
Ryuichi-san, thank you so much for all your hard work for us. Thanks to you, we had a wonderful dining experience and even learned a lot of Japanese.
If you ever get the chance, please come visit Korea as well.
Thank you very much!

My very first Kobe beef experience, and I feel so blessed that my first try was at Ishida. The juiciness is truly unimaginable until you actually taste it yourself! Although it’s a bit pricey, it is definitely worth every yen.

Huge thanks to the lovely chef for preparing the perfect Kobe beef for us in Japan. He was incredibly friendly and funny, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable. Wishing him all the best!

Just visit this restaurant—I’m pretty sure you’ll never regret it!

name: Auction Rooms Georgetown
reviews:
Stopped by Auction Rooms Georgetown for lunch and really enjoyed the visit.The place has a modern café vibe but still fits nicely with the historic Georgetown surroundings. It was quite lively around lunchtime but still comfortable.

The food was fresh and nicely presented. I had a light lunch with coffee and everything tasted well balanced without being too heavy.Portions were reasonable and good for a relaxed midday break.
Service was friendly and the staff checked in a couple of times which was nice. Overall a great spot in Georgetown if you’re looking for a casual lunch and good coffee. Would happily stop by again.
Food is satisfying. Service was great. Is under staff and serving a bit slow. But good service by Jamal although he is alone serving and preparing for drinks same time.

I ate a free breakfast here included in my stay in the hotel. The place is beautiful. The food is tasty. The options of choice are little bit limited, but the general atmosphere is nice. The coffee was good but fresh milk was not available, only creamer on the tables. That's an only issue for me, I prefer fresh milk. Otherwise it's all fine.

name: Tono Izakaya Changkat KL
street: 17G, Jalan Angsoka, Off, Changkat Bukit Bintang
reviews:
Price is on the high side considering the location it is in. Portion is also quite small but the ingredient used is of good quality unlikd regular izakaya.

Ordered the Engawa don (big) but the bowl looks smaller than a regular don bowl. However it is very delicious to the extend that it is a must-have menu item, (RM128 though).

Also ordered the wagyu don, the sauce is worth mention because it amplifies the flavour of the meat and rice.

Yakitori were slow but it was worth the wait! Ordered the chicken thigh, gizzard, wings and mala lamb, all of them taste so good, the skin on chicken wings were so crispy.

All the servers are friendly and attentive, they make you feel comfortable to give orders or make requests.

Definitely worth going back if I have the luxury to do so.

Tono Izakaya, located along the lively streets of Changkat Bukit Bintang, offers a vibrant and energetic dining atmosphere that suits both casual outings and group dining. We opted for their à la carte buffet, which provided a broad selection and good variety.
The highlights were notably strong. The unagi sando stood out—crispy on the outside, savoury and rich within, and well-executed in both texture and flavour. The fried oysters were fresh, clean-tasting, and not overly greasy. Sashimi portions were generous, cut thick, and impressively fresh for a buffet-style offering. Desserts were also a hit, particularly the matcha ice cream served with a crispy wafer, which was well-balanced and enjoyable enough that my wife reordered it multiple times.
Service, while friendly and approachable, can be inconsistent during peak hours. With high order volumes, dishes may be delayed, and reminders are sometimes necessary. That said, the staff remained polite and accommodating throughout, which helped mitigate the slower pace.

Great quality food. Excellent, fresh ingredients and skilled execution.

We came in late afternoon just before they close between shifts, but they didn’t seem to miss a beat at all even though we went past the closing time.

Well done.

name: Utoo Boho Cafe & Patisserie
reviews:
A must-visit in Penang!

If you visit Penang, you absolutely have to come here. Utoo Boho Café has a beautiful interior — no matter where you sit, you’ll get stunning photos. It’s the perfect spot if you love aesthetic places.

Not only is the interior amazing, but the food and desserts are absolutely delicious. Everything is perfectly balanced — not too sweet, not too salty — just right.

And the coffee? So good!

I’ve been here twice. On my second visit, we were only planning to stop by for coffee and dessert, but we ended up ordering so many dishes because everything looked and tasted amazing.

Most of all, the staff are genuinely kind and welcoming, always greeting you with warm smiles.

I will definitely come back when I visit Penang again. I hope you get a chance to come and experience it too!

Had breakfast at Utoo Boho and really enjoyed the experience. I went for the big breakfast generous spread and a nice touch with the fresh-squeezed orange juice. My wife had the shakshuka and absolutely loved it, full of flavour and very satisfying.

Total bill came to RM117 for 3 pax, which felt very reasonable for the quality, portion sizes, and overall experience. The atmosphere is relaxed with great vibes, making it a comfortable spot.

Will definitely return.

We came here for breakfast and really enjoyed the overall experience. The interior and ambiance are beautiful, calm, and thoughtfully designed — not too loud, with soft background music that makes it easy to relax and have a conversation. The space is air-conditioned, very clean, easy to find, and offers both traditional floor seating (Japanese-style) as well as regular tables and chairs. Our server, Rafiq, was very kind, attentive, and spoke English, which made the visit smooth and comfortable.

We ordered the two breakfast dishes shown in the photos, along with a matcha latte and a cappuccino. The main dishes were excellent and full of flavor. The matcha was very concentrated and quite overpowering for our taste, while the cappuccino and pastries were fantastic. The menu accommodates various dietary preferences (including vegetarian and halal), and for the price, it’s absolutely worth it. Minor points aside, it’s a great spot for breakfast, remote work, or a relaxed start to the day — we’d gladly return.

name: Maria's Signature Suria KLCC
street: Lot 157, First Floor, Petronas Twin Tower, Shopping Center, Jln Ampang
reviews:
Dropped by on 03/03/2026 around 5pm for a table of 1 with no reservations.

Was guided into the restaurant and was showed to a table leaning against the wall.
Restaurant had 0 diners inside, and I asked if any of the window tables were available and was told all tables are being reserved.

Subsequently, I was given a table that one had 1 chair. I requested for another chair or bag basket but was told there was no additional chair available. (At this point, I’m still the only diner in the entire restaurant) I had to hang my bag on the chair.

Throughout my dinner from 5-5:50pm, only a family of 3 came in and the rest of the tables are still empty.

Not too sure how staff were being trained or how do they manage their table turnover, but it was a pretty bad dinning experience. Staff were giving off vibes that they are just there to get by the day.

It could had been better managed with staff informing that if I wanted a window table, I will need to finish dinning by X amount of time because the reserved guest is coming (unless your restaurant’s reservations is all between 5-6pm which I doubted so) rather than just leaving it empty for close to an hour when it could be used to enhance guest experience.

This visit’s experience is pale compared to my initial visit with friends. Undeniably, the food is still good though, just room for improvement for service.

We dined at Maria’s Signature in Suria KLCC on October 27, 2025, as we were looking for a nice steak restaurant. Upon arrival, the restaurant looked elegant and peaceful. We were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food we ordered, especially the steak—it was absolutely worth the price! This place is truly recommended. The staff were nice and friendly.

We enjoyed our experience so much that we returned the following day and ordered the same dishes again because we loved them. The steak and pasta were superb!

A special mention goes to Rogelio, one of the staff, who was very lively and accommodating. He made our dining experience even more memorable by giving us a complimentary birthday cake for my partner and singing the birthday song for us.

We will definitely go back once we returned in KL!

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the steak served by Maria's Signature Suria KLCC.
Upon seeing multiple 5 star reviews of this restaurants, we immediately headed over.

I normally do not enjoy eating steak, so I ordered the Grilled Chicken Black Pepper for 28 ringgit. The chicken was nice and tender with little bones, with flavourful black pepper sauce. This was accompanied with Steak fries ( hand cut fries) that were perfectly salted.

The beef steak was the best I have ever had. The A5 wagyu was cooked to a perfect medium rare. The knife sliced through it like butter, and the meat just melted in my mouth. For a person who has never ever liked beef, I really enjoyed this.

Service was alright. We were left waiting outside when there were clearly available seats.

Best steak restaurant in Kuala Lumpur, no wait I mean whole of Malaysia.
Definitely do pay a visit!

name: Kobe Beef Steak Restaurant Royal Mouriya
reviews: Incredible place! We were lucky to be able to just walk into this place without a reservation.  We got a full course meal and chose to get the A5 highest quality as our big meal for our trip! It was the best meat I’ve heard had and the chef was excellent! The staff is very attentive too. Anything like this in the states would’ve been quadruple the price and probably half the quality and flavor. Definitely would come back in my next trip to Kobe!

Absolutely amazing lunch experience! We came here for lunch and it exceeded every expectation. The Kobe beef was incredibly tender, rich, and truly melts in your mouth 🤤 easily some of the best beef I’ve ever had!!! The chefs were highly skilled and attentive, and very friendly.

Service was impeccable from start to finish, and the atmosphere felt elegant yet comfortable. Portions were generous, beautifully presented, and worth every yen. If you’re in Kobe and want an authentic, unforgettable Kobe beef experience, this place is a must. We would 100% come back! 🫶🏼 ありがとうございます。

This is one of the better place to experience Kobe beef teppanyaki style cooked infront of you. The performance by the chef were enjoyable to watch. Each dishes is carefully prepared infront of you & the pacing of each dishes is very good so the time spend at restaurant was enjoyable. I recommend to try or experience both Kobe & premium selected wagyu. To me, i think due to the carefully selected ingredient & the chef skill, the premium selected wagyu was already delicious enough.

name: Rehan Restaurant
reviews:
This place is highly reviewed across over 1,300 reviews for a reason.  Clean, new aesthetic.  Owner / Operator energy from the Russian gent working as the face man and in some cases the Server.  Pretty decent Hookah / Shisha.  Had the Rehan level Shisha along with my Morracan Tea and the Spicy Hummus.  The Shisha was well maintained throughout about 2 hours of an afternoon chill.  The Hummus was filling (for my appetite) and well worth the knowledge I would be dealing with some spice and oil induced heartburn later.  Although not as spicy as I would have imagined, so just the oil factor.

Seems like a good place for a date.  Definitely a good place to kill a late afternoon with an authentic experience.

The Menu is HUGE!  Needed to split the video into 4 parts just to upload it all.

This is a real delightful find near our airbnb. Our family loves the food so much that we have been here for meals/takeaways 3 out of our 4 days here. The service staff are always so pleasant and attentive. They are also happy to make recommendations whenever we are unsure what to try. Their recommendations have always been great!

I am so disappointed with this restaurant. Don’t understand how their 4.8 stars comes from. Please don’t come to spoil your day.
1. Absurdly slow service. Almost 45 minutes wait for the main dish.
2. Too many mistakes. Wrong dishes. Lack of sides.
3. Rude manager(or maybe a waiter) and wrong check. We ordered a lamb couscous which is more expensive but was served with a chicken one. The manager insisted we ordered chicken when we argued. And the check turned out we are correct but the manager was not willing to correct the price. It wasted us long wait to finally get the check right. And the manager gave us a poker face and no apology.
4. The manager required cash when we paid the check. But we found out there are a variety of payment methods showed on the counter window. So the manager is reluctant to take the credit card in the end.

name: Tarbush Starhill
street: Lot No. LG06, Lower Ground Floor, Starhill Gallery, 181, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews:
Had a wonderful dining experience at Tarbush Starhill. The restaurant offers authentic Middle Eastern cuisine in a beautiful and lively setting right in the heart of Bukit Bintang.

The food was absolutely delicious. The grilled meats were perfectly cooked, tender, and full of flavor, and the mezze selection was fresh and very satisfying. The portions are generous and great for sharing, making it a perfect place to dine with family or friends.

The ambiance is warm and inviting with a traditional Middle Eastern touch, and the service was friendly and attentive throughout the meal. Everything arrived quickly and the staff made sure we were well taken care of.

If you’re in Kuala Lumpur and craving authentic Middle Eastern food, Tarbush Starhill is definitely a place worth visiting. Great food, great atmosphere, and a very enjoyable dining experience. 🥙

Tarbush at Starhill Gallery offers a truly beautiful ambience that sets the perfect stage for an authentic Middle Eastern dining experience. We visited for the Ramadan buffet and found it to be exceptional value for money, boasting a nice selection of dishes that cater to every palate. Every bite was a delight as the tastes are great across the board, but what really elevated our evening was the friendly and helpful staff who ensured everything ran smoothly. It’s a fantastic spot for anyone looking for high-quality food and top-tier service in a stunning setting!

I came accross the restaurant while looking for a quiet Arab restaurant around my hotel.
Food was good and portions are generous. The hummus was particularly tasty!
The staff was nice.
I gave a 4 stars for the ambiance because the tables for non smokers are next to the hallway and you hear the music from different restaurants from it.

Definitely expensive for KL but we are at the JW Marriott after all!

name: Stand-up Sushi Izakaya UOTSUBAKI Nagoya Station west exit Store
reviews: Absolutely amazing sushi here. Love the raw ebi sushi which is sweet. Tuna sushi is a must! Love the warm and fun atmosphere! 🍣 Staff are very friendly! Great service here. Will definitely come back again for moreeee 😍😍

Wanted a sushi omakase but stumbled on this instead and enjoyed it so much. Staff were so friendly and atmosphere was great.
Food was great, fish fresh at a reasonable price: Recommend to have a meal here.

Normally you would only max out the rating in one area, however the food, the atmosphere and the service where outstanding and showed up with 8 people and they didn't hesitate to take us.

It wasn't just great food but a fantastic experience that you need to come and try. 7 stars would be more accurate.

name: Wagyu Ramen & Hamburger (Halal Vegan Gluten Free) Dotonbori
reviews:
When you combine : Dontonbori + Wagyu + Halal you get the perfect recipe for a spicy tab, and that’s something you only notice after you sit down and you are handed the menu.

The prices here are not wallet friendly, as a matter of fact, during my lunch, I’ve seen two tables sit down, get the menu, then stand up and leave.

I believe this is to be blamed on the heavy marketing campaign used by this restaurant chain and the lack of transparency regarding its menu.

Now that is clarified, if you consider this as a fine dining experience where you won’t mind spending +20k per person you will have a fantastic meal.

The staff was very friendly and they did their best to communicate in a quite good English , after I finished ordering the chef came out of the kitchen and brought me a pamphlet explaining the « story » of the restaurant chain.

Despite looking young she cooked the steak perfectly and the presentation of each dish was picture perfect.

The waiter was also very professional, explaining the meals, the origin of the meat and even checking out if everything was right.

The restaurant has these grill holes inside each table that are just gathering dust, I saw nowhere on the menu to order cuts of meat to cook yourself and judging by the amount of dust on the one on my table I’d say these are not used, so if you’re looking for Yakiniku or BBQ … you’re at the wrong place.

I haven’t tried the burger so I can’t comment on it (I did get the potato wedges and they are pretty good) but I would recommend skipping the rice bowl (not worth it) and getting the waguy steak, just don’t come in here hungry ready to fill your stomach, rather come to treat yourself.

My pallet isn’t trained enough to get the difference between a top 10% Wagyu beef steak and the cheapest cut found at the supermarket but what I had here was excellent.

I am giving this a generous 4* for the staff implication and the steak, the restaurant itself and the aggressive opaque marketing campaign wouldn’t be worth 1* but thanks to the people working there I had a good time.
Had the steak and burger set. Food was great, service was superb. The waitress was super friendly. A little on the pricier side but the food and service was worth it.
the food is very nice and tasty, ordered the triple cheese burger very oishi and the staff is very nice and friendly to check on us and also give us free mochi arigatoooo

name: Orinea Restaurant
reviews:
Celebrating my beautiful wife’s birthday 🥂 at Orinea. Between the spectacular night scenery of Gurney & the 8-course degustation menu, it was an evening to remember.
The King Prawn with mangosteen soup was a refreshing revelation, & the Aged Duck Breast with charcoal jus was the perfect savory highlight. We loved how the creative sauces added layers of flavor without losing the essence of the dish.
Exceptional service and an even better view. Worth every bit for a special milestone!

Amazing food, amazing view, amazing service.

Every dish was flavorful and well-presented. The sea view and overall atmosphere were beautiful and perfect for a special night out.

The staff were very professional and attentive, which added so much to the overall experience. Definitely a place worth revisiting.

Everything was amazing. From the moment I walked in all the way till my last meal. I had come alone to celebrate my dinner as it was my first time eating at a fine dining restaurant and was really nervous but the staff treated me very nicely and gave me a very thorough rundown of everything i experienced from choosing my meal to recommending ways to eat the food as it enhances the experience. They even gave me a nice birthday dessert for me birthday which I am very grateful for. Every staff at the restaurant was extremely nice. And the food was really amazing. Really worth to try it out

name: Kobe Beef Steak Sakura
street: Shimoyamatedori, 2 Chome−17−10 2F 三ノ宮 神戸牛ステーキ 神戸牛専門 ランチ ディナー 鉄板焼き 接待 高級 コース
reviews:
The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made our special lunch such a fun and memorable experience. Huge shoutout to Chef James and Paulo! They kept the experience lively with great conversation and shared lots of interesting insights throughout the meal.

And the food… wow. Absolutely mouth-watering. The A5 Premium Kobe Beef was perfectly prepared and easily one of the best things we’ve ever eaten. Truly top class.

If you’re visiting Kobe and want the full Kobe beef experience, this place is a must.

Had an absolutely amazing experience at this restaurant. We were a little worried about getting caught in a tourist trap type of environment with Kobe beef given how popular it is, but we really felt well taken care of here.

We ordered Course B of the Selected Kobe Beef Round Steak, as well as course B for the Marbled Kobe Beef Round Steak (both 160g). The difference between Courses A and B are the appetizer platter and the dessert, but I would recommend getting those as they were delicious.  Not pictured here was miso soup as well as some toppings for our rice that tasted great.

Our chef was so personable and easy to speak with, and he was so much fun to watch with his grill/knife skills. English is spoken by most of the staff here which makes it more foreigner friendly.

The food itself was delicious. We loved the Kobe beef that was prepared for us, and appreciated all of the different pairing ingredients that were provided to help change the flavours with each bite. Both steaks were cooked to perfection with a good melt in your mouth feel.

I also want to express my sincere gratitude for the cute little extra dessert plate that they prepared for my wife and I. We mentioned that we were in Japan for our honeymoon and they gave us a beautiful plate with small extra cake cuts and a candle. It's little things like this that go a long way with customers.

Note that there is a 10% service fee applied to the bill, but I do genuinely think all of the staff deserve it for the level of care and attention they provided.
Thank you all again so much for the great meal!!!

Our experience here from the beginning till the end was very delightful and pleasant. We were greeted by Paulo and attended to by Chef James who were both very professional and attentive to all of our questions and needs.

The halal option comes with a pretty limited menu but is worth it. We took one kobe prime course (¥17k) and one kobe standard course (¥15k) that comes with starters (wagyu slice), main course - salad, rice, miso coup and desserts (matcha and matcha cake).

The starter was a mixture of spinach and mushroom that tasted fresh and floral, paired with smoked mackerel. Such amazing taste when paired together. The wagyu slice was so juicy and fatty, and topped with the sukiyaki dipping sauce - BOMB. The salad was also refreshing and sweet.

Onto the main course - the kobe beef melted in our mouth and i have nothing to complain about!! I will admit that it is on the pricey side but it is Kobe beef afterall. We had the steak in between medium and medium rare which i’ve never tried before but works amazingly well with Kobe beef.

Overall, pleasant experience here in SAKURA. Kudos to the chef and staff.

name: Okonomiyaki Mitsuki Kuromon Ichiba
reviews: The noodles taste so good.. Just the right sweetness. You can choose a generous slice of kobe or osaka beef and they will prepare and serve it in a beautiful fashion. The ladies cooking behind the tepan grill are nimble, focused and organized. Staff are friendly. Great atmosphere. Higly recommended visit when you are in the Kuromon market area.

First day dinner with my family~ very interesting way to eat. The beef is sooooo great! Super soft I love it~do not cook  noodles  too long. Will go hard super easy. It’s good place to visit with big groups ~

If you're looking for a hidden gem in the heart of Osaka, look no further. Went here on a Sunday evening to enjoy some Okonomiyaki and what I got in return went beyond expectations.

Not was the serving size also massive but the quality of what you're receiving was unbelievable.

Definitely try their signature Okonomiyaki with some omelettes and noodles.

name: Donna Bistro @ Com-Tar
street: Lot No. 5, Ground Floor, Komtar Walk, Jalan Dr Lim Chwee Leong
reviews: Nice atmosphere for people to hang out at night. There’s variety of food to try and plenty of seats. I bought their lok lok and char kuetiau. Lok lok is good with 3 different type of sauces and how to cook the lok lok. However for the ckt, its nice you could taste the char but it’s a lil bit oily for me. Ordering process was smooth, you could just order from your table.

Donna Bistro never disappoints! The food is absolutely delicious, the Nasi Lemak and Buttermilk Chicken are the best in town! And don’t miss their Char Koay Teow, packed with wok hei and full of flavour. Definitely a must-visit spot in Penang!

Tried the local bistro and the char kuey teow (Chinese style) was top tier, flavourful, though slightly salty. The tiramisu was superb, finished in less than 5 minutes. The buttermilk dish was tasty too, but can get muak after a while. Price-wise, not exactly cheap, but acceptable for the quality. Environment was okay, comfortable enough to dine in.

name: Tarbush Gourmet Restaurant JW Marriott
street: Upper Ground (UG) Floor, JW Marriott Hotel, 181, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews: It is located in the heart of the most crowded tourist spot in KL, in a quiet, cosy, and absolutely authentic environment. They have a jaw dropping number of staff to customer ratio among many restaurants that I have visited. Food-wise, awesome food, beautiful decoration, fresh products, and of course authentic taste. Family loved it.

Brought my friend here as it’s always one of my go-to places, and it didn’t disappoint as usual. Ashraf were very attentive and thoughtful, and manager were kind enough to offer us a complimentary dessert, which was a lovely touch. My friend was visiting for the first time and had a great time. A consistently great experience.

We found an amazing restaurant while out with friends, craving a different kind of meal, and it was a true gem. The entrance alone exuded an air of leisure and luxury. The staff were all incredibly kind, meticulously explaining the menu and genuinely asking for our food recommendations and taste preferences. The service was truly outstanding. The manager's constant smile and considerate demeanor really stood out. This was hands down the best meal of our trip.

name: akar
reviews: We had an outstanding dining experience at akar when we visited Kuala Lumpur for the first time, and were celebrating my brother's birthday! The food, service, and environment were exceptional! All of the dishes were so tasty and unique, with unique Malaysian flavors and foods, and presented perfectly with detailed explanations. The staff were always so friendly and willing to help make our dinner unforgettable! The environment is also very laid back, and you can feel comfortable with a group and speaking to staff, and they took time to learn about us as well. Highly recommend this restaurant, and hope to return again!

I’ll leave this review on two fronts: the 1) Food, and 2) the Service

1) Whilst the food was immaculately beautiful, I felt like most of them didn’t stand out taste-wise. The cucumber sorbet was probably the best dish of the night, and the rest felt….unspectacular.

Whenever I go to a restaurant the question I ask myself is would I come here again? Or is there a dish that I would absolutely love to have again? Unfortunately the answer is no.

2) I felt the service and our maître d could have had a little more finesse, especially in explaining the food. I could sense the server was probably a little bit nervous, and that is fine, but for the price we pay, we did expect a much more refined service.

Overall, it was normal. Nothing bad, but nothing great either. (E.g., even though Bol Asia doesn’t have a star (yet), I’ve been there twice because their rojak tart is absolutely delicious!)

Been to Akar three times since it opened in 2020. On my first visit, the flavours felt a little incoherent, with more misses than hits. A second visit two years ago showed clear improvement, though it didn’t leave a strong impression.

My most recent visit, just after they received their first Michelin star, was a completely different story. The tasting menu has been totally revamped and the experience was excellent. Most dishes were spot on, and the service was prompt and smooth. They also have a short but reasonably good wine list, with some well-priced bottles. The Michelin star is well deserved.

name: Kobe Beef Specialty Restaurant Kishō Kichi Teppanyaki Sannomiya Chuo
reviews: Booked this place mainly because it was the closest Kobe Beef place to my hotel, but i HIGHLY recommend coming here even if you’re hotel isn’t close. Everything was good but if i had to recommend any cut of the meats, go for the sirloin and chateaubriand!! Mouth watering softness. Definitely taking my parents here if I were you ever come back!! Be sure to say hi and ask for Kiyoshi!! The best chef here!

Mitsuda gave an amazing experience. Detailed information about Kobe beef and preparation was outstanding. The taste was the best beef and the best meal I ever had in Japan! His recommendation is affordable. Explaining why he recommended each cut. I would gladly come back to see him again!

I thought I had good speak in the past but the way this melted in you month was truly wonderful! The service was great and our cook Tani was amazing! Everything in the set meal we got tested so good and was well worth the trip and money! Would highly recommend!

name: Kuromon Gyoraku
reviews:
We visited Kuromon Gyoraku based on its high Google ratings. Upon arrival, we were informed that everyone is required to order a drink for 200 yen, even if you order other items.

The ordering process was simple and convenient via a tablet, and they accept most major credit cards, which we appreciated.

However, similar to many restaurants in Kuromon Market, the prices felt quite high. For example, we had the same eel over rice at a restaurant near Osaka Tenmangu (天滿宮) for about half the price, and the. The eel at Kuromon Gyoraku had too many soft bones, which made it difficult to enjoy. The king crab leg was also far too salty.

Overall, I would only recommend dining here if you are short on cash or have limited options. Otherwise, there are better-value and better-tasting alternatives nearby.

"Absolutely exquisite! The sushi rolls were perfectly crafted, each bite a delightful medley of fresh ingredients and a satisfying umami kick from the torched toppings and nori. The baked crab shell, rich with creamy sauce and sweet crab meat, was pure indulgence. And those oysters! Plump, briny, and beautifully presented – a true taste of the ocean. Every dish was a testament to quality and culinary skill. A truly memorable dining experience!"

1 drink per person is needed or else table charge

Absolutely loved the eel here—perfectly grilled, tender, and full of flavor! The sushi was fresh and well-prepared, and the service was top-notch. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even better. A must-visit for sushi lovers! Will definitely come back again.

name: Hwa Ting Restaurant
reviews:
Amazing experience! We came for lunch and everything exceeded expectations. The restaurant is very welcoming and well kept, with a friendly atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable right away. The staff is extremely kind and happy to help you choose the dishes.

Both the food and the drinks were outstanding, among the best I’ve had. You can really feel that every dish is prepared with love, and you taste it in every bite. The mango dessert was delicious and perfectly balanced in flavors, and even the coffee didn’t disappoint — which is not always a given.

This place definitely makes it into my top 5 restaurants, and I would gladly come back. I highly recommend it to everyone — it certainly won’t disappoint! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had tried dry and soup wan tan mee, both are tasted good. The addition of crispy lard bits is a huge plus—that’s where the real flavor and texture live.
The soup version looks light and clean. The wontons appear plump with thin, silky skins, and the broth looks clear, which is a good sign of a traditional crustacean or pork-based stock.
Tofu pudding tastes extremely white and delicate, like silk.The moment the brown sugar (Gula Melaka) is poured over is incredibly comforting. Compared to regular ginger syrup, brown sugar adds a rich caramel aroma to the delicate tofu pudding.

Everything was just tasty! The taste of duck egg char kwee tiaw was almost the same with the one in New Lane, delicious, and you can smell the aroma of char a little bit. The porridge smells nice as well. I also want to highlight their Chendol desert, really fresh and sweet, to my likings.

name: Tien Non-Pork by Putien
reviews: A Chinese restaurant by Putien with no pork ... located at the highest floor of KLCC ... variety of dishes available in the menu ... The Sweet n Sour Chicken Lychee is nice n tasty ... The meat is crunchy... The Sambal Kangkong is nice too ... Slightly spicy n salty ... The Deep Fried Chicken with Garlic is nice ... The skin is crispy but the meat is not sufficient taste ... The welcome drink is a lemonade n it's nice ... The Anxi Tie Guan Yin is nice n it's refillable ... The environment is big n cozy ... The pricing is at mid high ...
Halal and yet still delicious. I took my Moslem friends to this place and we had an enjoyable lunch during our visit. The service was excellent and quick. The price was fair and the quality is good.

This is our 1st visit & the food /service just blew us away! The manager was ever helpful & assist us wif the Yusheng😊 the taste of the dishes ordered is rich & flavourful,authentic Chinese cuisine indeed!

name: Sushi Dokoro Kuromon Suehiro
reviews:
If you're exploring Kuromon Fish Market and want an authentic sushi experience, this is a must-try! I stopped by for lunch and it was easily the best meal of my time in Osaka.

The shop is incredibly cozy and has such a warm, local vibe. Even though the chef doesn’t speak English, he was absolutely wonderful. We used Google Translate to communicate, and he was so friendly and attentive to everything we asked for. It made the whole experience feel very personal and welcoming.

The sushi was remarkably fresh, you can really taste the quality coming straight from the market. If you want top-tier food served by someone who clearly cares about their craft and their guests, don't pass this place up.

Highly recommend ☺️

Best otoro tuna I've had in Japan. This place is so underrated and the staff is friendly. 4 days in Osaka and we spent 3 of them eating dinner here. And when we came back the chefs recognized us! Super friendly atmosphere, you order what you want on your phone and it sends it to them, and they make it. Their wagyu nigiri and sashimi comes in hot as it's freshly cooked, it's amazing as well and melts in your mouth. Priced well and would come here again. 💗💗
Chanced about this stall. It was just brilliant. Service was lovely as well. The chawamushi just melted in our mouths. Would come again definitely

name: Kyrin Izakaya
reviews:
I was a little sceptical when I first sat down, especially after seeing the ‘free ice cream for a Google review’ sign. That said, the food is what really matters — and it didn’t disappoint. The sashimi cuts were generous and impressively fresh. While the sashimi platter was on the pricier side, it was well worth it considering the quality and selection, with two of the seven varieties being tuna toro cuts.

The chicken karaage batter wasn’t the most authentic, but it was still enjoyable. The kids loved the yakitori skewers. The chicken wasabi dish was decent, though I think it would have been even better using chicken thigh and a piece of seaweed to round out the flavours.

One piece of feedback I’d add is that the experience would have been even better if the background music suited the izakaya vibe — something other than Chinese New Year songs.

Overall, a solid izakaya experience in Penang, with some standout dishes that made the visit worthwhile.

We found this Japanese Restaurant on our way back from Hin Bus. We ordered Chicken Teriyaki Bento and Sakana Katsu Bento. The chicken and Sakana taste good. I like the dumplings come together in Bento, as it is juicy on the first bite. Ingredients are fresh. Food price Is reasonable. A comfort dining place. Garlic fried rice impressed me. (But i didnt take the photo.)You may try .
Overall, i recommend this Restaurant.

I ordered a sushi roll and absolutely loved it! The flavors were fresh and perfectly balanced. I also tried the sashimi and grilled avocado — both were delicious and beautifully presented. Highly recommend this Japanese restaurant for anyone who enjoys authentic, quality sushi! 🍣💛

name: The North Cafe
reviews:
This cafe strikes a beautiful balance between culinary execution and spatial design. The interior is a thoughtful adaptive reuse of space, featuring a stunning glass-enclosed internal courtyard that funnels natural daylight into the deep floor plan. The contrast between the clean, modern seating and the beautifully preserved heritage floor tiles creates a serene atmosphere, perfectly complemented by a beautiful, understated background music playlist.

​The menu matches the quality of the space. I had the Salted Vienna Coffee—a brilliant study in contrasts. The robust black Indonesian Mandheling coffee is blanketed by a dense, velvety layer of salted cream, finished with dusted cocoa powder and a pinch of salt. It’s an incredibly well-balanced cup.

For food, the Healthy Combo was a pleasant surprise. The grilled chicken breast was generously portioned, stacked high on toasted bread with fresh, crisp salad greens. The homemade honey mustard dressing tied it all together with a bright, tangy finish. Highly recommended for a quiet morning of reflection or a casual brunch.

The Big Breakfast was fairly standard and not particularly distinctive; however, the sausage stood out and was quite enjoyable.

The pistachio cocoa was slightly bland for my taste and could benefit from a richer flavor. That said, the service was attentive and the overall environment was pleasant and comfortable.

I would consider returning in the future to try some of the other main dishes and beverages.

I really, really loved this amazing café! First off, it was super easy to place an order, seeing that everything can be done via a QR code from your table. I really enjoyed having that luxury. Second, the atmosphere at the cafe is a great mirror of Georgetown itself, in that it is super chill and hospitable. Third,, the staff were all super friendly and very welcoming, and I really felt very comfortable from the moment I walked in! And, last but not definitely not least, my oat milk flat white with an extra shot was made to absolute perfection! I love my really strong coffee, and this was exactly what I was looking for, this is the truth 😊 💯🙏🏼

All in all, I would definitely recommend this amazing café and look forward to getting back there soon enough 😊🙏🏼

With all my Mettā,
Noah

name: Pitari Namba
street: Nanbanaka, 1 Chome−6−25 ナンバ ハイビル
reviews: Everything was delicious, with typical homemade Osaka-style cuisine. The staff was incredibly kind and helpful in guiding us through understanding and choosing the dishes.

I was looking for a dinner spot near the hotel and came across this restaurant with great reviews, so I decided to give it a try. I started by ordering two plates of gyoza, one plate of fried chicken, one plate of beef tongue, and a bowl of rice topped with mentaiko and fish. While I was trying to communicate in Japanese saying 'No negi' (no green onions) because I don’t eat them, my request was ignored. The staff also mentioned that we had to order one drink per person, which I had already planned to do after this. (I’m only with one other person, and with all this food, it’s obvious we won’t be sharing just one drink, right?)
After ordering our drinks, my partner started looking at the menu to decide on their drink, but we felt a sense of pressure from the staff, and I had to say, 'She’s still choosing a drink, please wait a moment.' Finally, the rice dish came, and it was served with green onions. I don’t think I’ll be coming back here again.
PS. From the picture,  I’ve already removed the green onions from the rice topped with mentaiko and fish. You’ll notice the empty spot where the green onions used to be. That spot was originally filled with green onions!
Absolutely loved our meal. Comfortably fed our family of six who enjoyed several small plates and some shared mains. Can highly recommend the broccoli entree and the chicken skin chips!

name: Restaurant au Jardin
reviews:
Mind-blowing French fusion in Penang: A must-visit!

We dined at Restaurant au Jardin in Penang today and had a truly mind-blowing fine dining experience. We went in without specific expectations, hoping for good value compared to bigger cities, but we were completely blown away. The concept is brilliant—French fusion deeply rooted in local ingredients and flavors.
The attention to detail was impeccable. Some highlights were the house bread inspired by Indian Dosa and the pre-meal watercress and cuttlefish broth, which was presented beautifully like a matcha tea ceremony. The main course, a 90-day aged duck, was beyond expectations—incredibly flavorful, even for someone like me who isn't usually a duck lover!
The creativity continued to the end with a dessert inspired by doujiang and youtiao (soy milk ice cream with celery and churros)—such a clever twist. They even surprised us with a 'blind tasting' of four local delights to finish, which made the meal so fun. We even left with a 'Hock Dog' takeaway gift!
Service was top-notch and made the lunch very wholesome. Our waiter patiently explained every dish in English for my husband and me, and then again in Mandarin for my mom, which we really appreciated. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a unique, fun, and high-value fine dining experience in Penang!

We had a wonderful dinner here. As someone who doesn’t often have fine-dining experiences, I was truly impressed from start to finish.

From the moment we arrived, we were warmly greeted by well-trained staff and guided to our reserved table. Every dish was exquisite—beautifully prepared and absolutely delicious. From our counter seating, we had the pleasure of watching the chef delicately craft each dish with great attention to detail. The waiters thoughtfully explained how each dish was made and the best way to enjoy it, which really elevated the experience.

The presentation of every course was spot-on, and the flavors were outstanding. Kudos to the chef and the entire team for such an exceptional dining experience. We were also treated to a few complimentary dishes, all of which were equally amazing.

Overall, it was a truly memorable evening. We didn’t even realize how quickly time passed—we ended up spending nearly three hours there because the experience was just that enjoyable.

Au Jardin delivers a refined and thoughtful dining experience in a uniquely creative setting. Located within the former Hin Bus Depot, now transformed into a vibrant art space, the restaurant feels quietly elegant while remaining grounded in its surroundings. Service throughout the evening was warm, attentive, and polished, with staff explaining each course clearly and confidently.

The food was consistently strong. Most dishes showcased excellent technique and a clear sense of purpose. The interpreting cabbage course felt more like an acquired taste and was the only dish that did not fully resonate. However, this was quickly redeemed by the following river shrimp course, which was full of umami, beautifully presented, and deeply satisfying.

The main dish of cognac and hay aged duck was a standout, pairing exceptionally well with the blackened banana ketchup and banana blossoms. A thoughtful final touch was the transformation of leftover duck into Hock’s Dog, allowing guests to bring home a delicious reminder of the meal. A memorable and highly commendable dining experience in Penang.

name: Wagyu (Halal) Ramen Noodle Dotonbori Namba Restaurant 和牛 道顿堀 拉面 餐厅
street: Dotonbori, 2 Chome−1−3 フルーツタワービル 1F
reviews: BESTT RAMEN IVE TRIED AROUND NAMBA! They torched the wagyu in front of us. It’s just around Dotonbori area so it’s a very accessible place. You have to look for signs outside and walk along sa very very short kind of alley to get here. Staff are so nice too. Must try! It’s halal btw.

I tried halal ramen at this restaurant and it was really delicious. The broth was rich and flavorful, and the noodles were soft but still chewy. I was happy that the restaurant clearly serves halal food, so I could eat comfortably without worrying. The chicken topping was tender and well-seasoned, and the portion size was quite satisfying. The staff were friendly and the place was clean. Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely come back again.

Had lunch here. Service was amazing the staff are so friendly. If you’re in Japan and want to experience the top 5% of Japanese Wagyu this is the spot! It’s in Namba.

We tried the Ramen and Malatang both of which were phenomenal dishes. They even lit them in front of us.

The staff were great and very attentive. Had good chats with them about where we were from. Their English is pretty good!

name: Beach St Bistrot
reviews:
Returned last night for my friend’s birthday and everything was just as good as I remembered. The fish pie was a favorite from my last visit, so I ordered it again and the seafood paella was a new favorite. Service was warm and super helpful, especially with my friend’s baby. Overall, another great dining experience at Beach St Bistrot.

Other menu items we tried:
- Wild Mushroom Soup
- Cold Capellini
- Mussels
- Fish Pie
- Mixed Seafood Paella
- Hamachi

Celebrating a birthday is always special, and choosing the right restaurant to mark the occasion is crucial. We, having heard much about this particular establishment and its proprietors, decided to give it a try – and thankfully, we were not disappointed.

The meal began promisingly. The lobster bisque and escargot pairing proved to be a winning combination. We specifically love the "buttery and creamy flavour" of the escargot, enhanced by the textural contrast of "crispy toasted bread crumps." This attention to detail, highlighting both flavour and texture, suggests a kitchen that understands the importance of a well-rounded culinary experience. The bisque, rich and flavourful, complemented the escargot perfectly, setting a high bar for the dishes to follow.

The paella was another standout. It was "lovely," emphasizing the delightful balance between the "saltiness and sweetness of the seafood." The rice, a critical component of any good paella, was tasty, with a subtle "burnt end" adding a touch of character and complexity, allowing the rice to develop a caramelized crust.

The richness continued with the foie gras, creamy and yet not too heavy. We love that there was a great bite to it, a pleasant texture and a well-executed sear. Finally, the truffle pasta completed the savory journey. "Yummy, sweet, springy and fragrant"; this pasta dish clearly left a lasting impression. The combination of "sweet" and "fragrant" suggests a delicate balance of flavors and aromas, while "springy" indicates perfectly cooked pasta with a satisfying texture.

Celebrated my friend’s birthday here and had a great time. Loved the food, everything was delicious. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the cozy ambience at the brasserie made it even nicer. Thanks for the lovely experience, will definitely come back!

name: Smith & Wollensky Kuala Lumpur
street: Lot LC G02-G05, & Lot LC 102-104, Petronas Twin Tower
reviews:
we had lunch here because we passed it and thought the place looked very nice from the outside. we ordered the tenderloin and the new york cheesecake. the tenderloin had the perfect tenderness and the chef cooked it nicely. the outside part of the steak was kinda ‘crispy’, and even without their signature sauce the steak itself is already nice. but with the sauce, it makes it nicer.

i had to mention the excellent service as well, since JD and rayana were super attentive to us and super friendly.

overall nice experience and totally would come back again :)

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
An unforgettable birthday celebration

We celebrated a birthday at Smith & Wollensky Kuala Lumpur last night, and it was truly an amazing experience from start to finish.
