I made the reservation two weeks in advance, with a RM100 deposit per person, which was smoothly deducted from the final bill, very clear and hassle-free.

The staff were exceptionally friendly, attentive, and genuinely warm. They made us feel welcomed the moment we arrived, and their service throughout the night was impeccable. As a lovely surprise, they even gave us a complimentary birthday cake. Such a thoughtful and classy gesture that really made the celebration extra special.

We ordered a steak and a burger, and both were absolutely delicious, cooked perfectly, full of flavour, and worth every bite. The complimentary bread appetizer was also outstanding: soft, smooth, and surprisingly good (dare I say… even better than Gordon Ramsay’s restaurant 👀🤫).

Also, they have all day dining but since we already booked for the steak house so we just go there instead. Will comback to try the all day dining, the coffee smell very nice🥰

Overall, it was a wonderful night to remember. Great food, excellent service, and a very memorable birthday experience. Highly recommended for special occasions or anyone looking for a top-tier dining experience in Kuala Lumpur. We’ll definitely be back.

Paid my maiden visit to celebrate wifey’s birthday. The service was very pleasant from the tele-reservation, the warm greetings, the frequent check ins, the complimentary cake and the pleasant goodbye. Deco and atmosphere was top notch, living to its S&W name. Food was great but felt there is still room for improvement.

The evening was made even special by the personalised touch of Ms Rayana; even orchestrated the sequence of meal from Buka Puasa right until the final meal. The house complimentary cake together with the sing along by the hostess was just the icing on the cake.

Thank you for the wonderful experience to both S&W Kuala Lumpur and Ms Rayana

name: Kobe Beef TANRYU Sannomiya Store
street: Kitanagasadori, 1 Chome−10−9 生田新道ビル 1階
reviews:
Everything here is absolutely delicious. The restaurant has such a friendly atmosphere, and the people are incredibly kind and caring. The food is outstanding, and you can truly feel the love they put into every dish. It’s a wonderful experience — I would happily come back again.
Hans and Amy amazing person . ❤️🥳🤘🏼

Happy holiday in JP! on 22/Feb, Sunday, crown of ppl. We back from Kyoto after Onsen, and didn't schedule the dinner at night. search n pass by KOBE TANRYU SANNOMIYA, by lift, to 1 of 9 restaurant in town. Expected, as didn't made a reservation, they don't have a seat. Their staffs and manager help us to contact the other branches and finally, there is a vacant in other branch, I am really appreciate their help as I go with my wife n little boy, can feel the warm in Cold weather.
Their Staff, Hana came to bring us to their branch in Sannomiya, n Chef Haruna well served with excellent KOBE A5 Teppanyaki for us. KOBE Beef under Haruna skill, melt in month with light taste of oil, me & my family really enjoy the time there.
For the price, most ppl concern, I can tell, it is worth for me:)
Again, Thank you Haruna & Hana excellent serve us and gave us a great time, also Kobe Tanryu provide highest quality food n service for us, Thank You:))))

Found this place randomly as we were looking for some Kobe beef teppanyaki and they didn’t disappoint :)  The service, cooking and flavor were delicious.  Emi was very good at explaining and teaching us how to properly eat the different types of steak.  A must place to visit and try out.  Well worth it.

name: Smiling Buffalo - Georgetown
reviews:
This is a nice boutique cafe established in a small two-storey house in George Town.  It has both indoor (with Air Con) and outdoor seating.  The decor is simple but cozy.  A very comfortable place to hang out for breakfast or coffee.  They serve All-Day Breakfast.  Manager/Owner Jeff recommended us for the Salted-Beef sandwich which is one of the well-known sandwiches in the UK.  The beef is tendered and tasted good.  However, a little salty.  Staff are extremely friendly and polite.

It seems that the staff are also very talented in art as some of the wall paintings and art works are created by the staff.  👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Came for breakfast, staff were v friendly & efficient. Food was good. Most of us ordered the Pick & Mix, and the food was all great. I liked the iced long black too. Ambience is good and inside was cooling.

Would recommend!

A fantastic little spot we returned to 4 out of the 5 mornings we spent in Georgetown for breakfast. The food was amazing but it was the service and friendly staff that made us return. They took the time to offer local suggestions that took our trip to the next level. Highly recommend this groovy spot!

name: PAAN KL
reviews: Sorry to say I was underwhelmed and unimpressed.  Stopped by for a light bite, drink and water in the middle of the afternoon and was the only person in the place.  The waitress was polite and warm and took my order.  The first to arrive was the water and then she disappeared.  Only to finally reappear with the papadum tacos.  They were not hot and absolutely tasteless. The meat looked like some sort of gelatinous mess: brown and uninviting!!  I ate one and wanted to ask for fresh chilies to provide some flavor and was unable to get her attention.  Finally she arrived with my cosmo.  It was then that I was able to request fresh chilies.  I finished my cocktail,  paid my bill and left.  Perhaps I ordered the wrong item on the menu: however, the service was less-than-acceptable for being the only patron in this establishment.

The service at this restaurant was warm and attentive, which made the overall experience very enjoyable. The owner took the time to introduce the dishes in detail and was happy to explain anything we did not understand. The atmosphere was pleasant and comfortable, and the food was served quickly. Overall, I had a great dining experience.

The way the waitress handle the customer is excellent, he recommend us the best food that suit us while engage with us.
We ordered Xo Fried Rice with Beed, Salted Egg Fish, and Daging Bali. Taste of the ordered food are more than we expected.
The drink is amazing as well, we ordered Iced Tea with Passionfruit.

Afterall PAAN just made our day. Thanks for the great experience :)

name: Choux Choux
reviews:
Pet-friendly restaurant with clear guidelines — please keep your furkid in a stroller and ensure they’re well-behaved. Nobody enjoys barking or pets roaming around, so we kept ours comfortably in the stroller and were seated near the main entrance.

Service was excellent, especially from Kelvin, who made our experience even better.

We ordered the onion soup, escargot, lasagna, Iberico pork, pasta, and dessert. Every dish was amazing — rich flavors, perfectly cooked, and everything lingered beautifully on my palate even after I’m back in KL. Truly memorable.

Highly recommended for great food, warm service, and a pet-friendly environment done right!

A quiet out of the main traffic venue. As you enter the space offers welcome relief from the heat and the decor is clean, modern, and tasteful. Upscale but comfortable. You're met by welcoming polite staff who are knowledgeable about the menu and attentive without being annoying. We had breakfast. The presentation is spectacular and it's delicious. We have been in Vietnam so it seems *very* expensive but really, the prices are fair, even by Malaysia standards.

The bar looks great and we will return for a wine and a cocktail.

I recommend this place if you're looking for something special.

Best meal in this Singapore-Malaysia trip.

We order a Tapas Share and a Spaghetti with Aglio Olio.

Spanish meatballs, chili garlic shrimp, ham croquettes, millefeuille potatoes in bravas sauce. Garlic bread. Every tapa was very tasty. The shrimps were springy & crunchy. Ham croquettes were excellent.

So was the Fiery Sausage Aglio Olio. Pasta was just al dente. No need to smother it with a sauce.

Dinner with two dark ales came to ~Can$90.

name: Georgetown Mansion
reviews:
Visited George Town Mansion today and it was such an unexpectedly wonderful experience.  The restored heritage home is rich with cultural stories, beautiful architectural details, and well-curated exhibits that bring Penang’s history to life.  You can really feel the care put into preserving the Peranakan and Malay heritage of the place.

A special shout-out to Alvin, who greeted us with so much enthusiasm the moment we stepped in. His introduction to the mansion made the visit even more meaningful, and he patiently helped us take photos at the best spots.  His warm hospitality truly added to the charm of the experience.

Highly recommend stopping by—both for the history and the heartfelt service!

very lovely building with beautiful and delicate collections, manager is knowledgeable and welcome. This mansion (museum) is a real worth-visit, as it holding lot’s of historical artifacts. BTW everything there have in formation, for person who really want to know Penang culture and tangible cultural heritage

Excellent mansion with great tour guide!
The tour guide is nice, inside the mansion is awesome! We had a good time here. It is free if you already brought ticket in Pinang Peranakan Mansion.

(The banner outside said it closed on Friday but it wasn’t true, this mansion open everyday according to the tour guide)

name: Wagyu Beef and Tuna Namba
reviews: A restaurant we found by chance, very calm and excellent. A very attentive waitress kindly explained how everything worked. The meat was of great quality and truly delicious. We highly recommend it!
Good food and service 🤩
Perfect

name: Space House Café
reviews:
Loved the food! I ordered lemon chicken and vegetable omellette - The serving is quite a lot. I thought I could not finish all my food, but eventually finished eating all because it was so yummy! Good music that sets the ambiance. The service was also good and the place was not crowded 👌

Maybe next time they can serve water in a glass and not in a disposable cup. 😊

The 1st place i went to after I arrived George Town is cafe hunting, n i found this hidden gem accidentally.  I had chicken chop, latte & pumpkin cekodok with coconut gravy. Total bill was Rm64.90. guess what! the chicken chop is juicy n crispy, their carrot pickle are damn good! the pumpkin cekodok? u must try!!! highly recommend

Good well-cooked meals, friendly staff, food quality is true to taste, chill atmosphere with cozy wooden furniture. (may have long food preparation time because is cooked with much thoughtfulness and love)

name: Yorimichi Cafeよりみち
street: 131, Mezzanine Floor, Jalan Tun H S Lee
reviews:
Had a late lunch at Yorimichi the other day where we got their Mentaiko pasta and the special of the day - Cold Noodles.

Food was pretty average - no complaints but not life changing. But their miso soup was really tasty! Got our appetites going!

Drinks were also quite yummy. My friend got their genmaicha latte which was creamy but had a nice roasted taste to it.

Really like the vibes though - we sat at the outdoors overhanging area and we could see the street. Really nice place for people watching.

This was such a cute lunch / tea spot to duck into after a busy hot day at the Park and Market. Was a much needed reprieve with a cute, air conditioned ambience! It’s also right above a cute flower shop and smells like flowers :)

We ordered the chicken karaage, mentaiko pasta, the honey tea, and the genmaicha — all for around 60 MYR. The karaage don was FANTASTIC. Drinks were solid too and service was fast / professional. I personally didn’t like the pasta (tasted like Mayo pasta), but I’ll chalk that up to my American taste and not quality haha

A step away from Chinatown, this wonderful place is discreetly hidden in one of the back alleys. Soft music and minimalist decor, you will surely cool off and take a long and deserved pause here. We tried the hot dishes and the short lattes. An absolute delight!

name: SamaSama Café & Workshop
reviews:
If you want to enjoy great coffee and wonderful workshop items, Sama Sama Cafe is definitely a place you shouldn’t miss.

The café is located in the same area as the famous street art Children on Bicycle mural by Ernest Zacharevic, which already makes the visit special before you even step inside.

The space itself is lovely, featuring a strong vintage vibe. From the decor to the overall setup, everything feels inspired by old-time cafés. If you love vintage aesthetics, this place will make you feel right at home.

The coffee is also worth experiencing, especially their traditional drip filter coffee. Watching the coffee slowly drip is both interesting and relaxing, and the taste makes the wait worthwhile. All the staff here are so much friendly and cute 🥰

Outside the café area, there are also food stalls where you can grab something to eat. Plus, you can walk around the surrounding streets to explore and shop for souvenirs or unique art pieces.

There are upstairs sections as well, so make sure to explore every corner when you visit. It’s truly a place where coffee, art, and culture come together beautifully.

Gem hidden inside what like like a warehouse, right beside the swing mural. We didn't stop for food so no comments. But walking past, we were attracted by the postcards n old times artifacts. Retro vibes within the cafe. Feels like time stopped then. We love stamp chops and were pleasantly surprised to find some outside the shop too!

What a lovely little cafe, about an 8min walk from Royal Chulan Hotel.

Situated inside a heritage building, this unassuming little joint has a lot of charm. It's cosy enough to spend a few hours chatting or just chilling by yourself.

The food and drink are prepared meticulously and it's was delicious.

The menu isn't extensive but what we as a group had we enjoyed it.

name: Arabian.B KLCC Restaurant
reviews: Definitely worth trying! Food was delicious and service was excellent 👍 Enjoyed the Arabic atmosphere too. Tried Lamb Kebab, Falafel and Cheese Kunafa. All were really good.

The food here is absolutely delicious! On top of that, the service was outstanding, friendly and attentive. They even treated us to complimentary tea and appetizer, which was such a thoughtful touch. The interior and surroundings are beautifully done, highly recommend this place for a great dining experience!

I travel. It is what I do, I even made it my living as an airline pilot, and this is why: stumbling into places like this. It is simply outstanding. Whoever is in charge here: you certainly know what you are doing. You have hand picked an incredible team.

And to those wondering if this place is worth a visit: yes, it is. I will remember this meal for years, not weeks or months. Jan H Maaso.

name: Straits Cafe 海峡咖啡馆@Georgetown
reviews: I saw in instagram this cafe is new. The location building was good theres many space inside and outside area. But they just sell pastries and drinks. The taste so good
Very friendly staff, and good environment. Their price range very affordable. Their Americano very delicious make me has good energy before work. 💪🏼 keep on going ya. Thank you

A three-story cafe next to the Straits Oriental Museum (an interesting little museum!). In fact, an entrance ticket of the museum grants one discount for item purchase in the cafe. Although the cafe is almost entirely indoor, the two upper floors are usually empty and everyone gathers on the first floor. The upper floor feels like a living room and as cozy as it gets. Didn't order coffee (just had one elsewhere), so I settled with the cempedak cake, which was bursting with the fragrant cempedak aroma and just right amount of sweetness.

name: unagibiyori nagoya
street: Tsubakicho, 17−21 ナゴヤグランドホテル 1階
reviews:
We originally planned to try Atsuta Houraiken (Matsuzakaya branch), but with an early flight the next morning, we decided to stay close to our hotel and have an earlier dinner instead. うなぎ日和 名古屋駅店 turned out to be just a 2-minute walk away — and honestly, we have zero regrets.

All four of us ordered the standard hitsumabushi (1 whole eel). Following the restaurant’s clear instructions on the three traditional ways of eating hitsumabushi, we enjoyed every stage of the meal thoroughly. Each variation brought out a different dimension of the eel, and it was a joy to experience how the flavours evolved from bowl to bowl.

What stood out most was the texture of the eel — a beautifully crispy, smoky exterior paired with an incredibly soft, fluffy interior. The balance was spot on, and the eel was neither greasy nor heavy. Even my wife, who is usually a small eater, managed to finish the entire 1-eel portion on her own (hence the empty bowl picture above to show her accomplishment :)), which says a lot.

This was genuinely one of the most delicious Japanese meals we’ve had.

The service was warm and friendly. Although we didn’t make a reservation, the staff kindly accommodated us after confirming that we were comfortable finishing our meal before 7:30pm. We arrived early at around 5:40pm, so it wasn’t an issue at all.

The restaurant itself is small, contemporary, warm, and cosy, seating around 20 people. Because of its limited capacity, I would definitely recommend making a reservation to avoid disappointment — unless you’re able to go early like we did.

If you’re looking for an excellent hitsumabushi experience right next to Nagoya Station, this place is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!

P.S. The entrance to the restaurant is quite easy to miss — it’s a small, discreet door located right next to Nagoya Grand Hotel (as shown in the photos). We almost walked past it ourselves, so do keep an eye out when you’re looking for it! 😊

The food was excellent and the manager and waiter were very polite and friendly despite that we didn’t make any reservation. They were kind enough to accommodate us.  The unagi was cooked to perfection. Hope to visit this restaurant again and will definitely make a reservation before going. Thanks so much for the great service and food.

Excellent unagi restaurant conveniently located near Nagoya Station. The food was outstanding, and the service was exceptional - we were immediately served green tea and water upon being seated. During our meal, my son dropped his chopsticks, and before we even asked, a fresh pair (along with spoons) was brought to our table.

Our server spoke English very well, which made ordering easy and comfortable. The restaurant’s décor was tasteful, spacious, and relaxing.

Overall, a wonderful dining experience. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area.

name: Unagi Ōyama
reviews: Amazing meal and surprisingly without a long queue for such a quality meal. I’m so full and satisfied. Chef is attentive and expertised at unagi grilling by charcoal right in front of the counter table. Fish was freshly handled. Even the rice and soup are amazingly served! The local crafted beer (long fermented) is such a great combo. Best start of the day in the cold weather and I’ll definitely come back next time in Arima Onsen!

Excellent quality of eel and price is very reasonable. The grilled eel is freshly prepared. The eel liver soup and pickles are tasty. The service is really good. The best eel I ever had. Definitely will come back for it 👍

A hidden gem. A restaurant that solely serves eel rice and only has a few sits. It was such a beautiful experience to see the chef (the person serving too) craft our food from cutting the fish to grilling in the charcoal to our bowl. One of the best eel rices I ever had.

name: Sakura
street: Arimacho, １０２１番地ー１ 有馬スプリングテラスC 1F
reviews: Really good food. Oishi! The pumpkin was extraordinary. Don't fret if you have allergies as you will just have to tell them, and they'll take care of your food selections. The chef is very accommodating too. Definitely worth visiting.

Such an extraordinary little kushiage (deep fried skewers) bar - a truly hidden gem in Arima Onsen! Each item is served up one-by-one, omakase-style, and every dish is incredibly delicious, unique and exquisitely executed. Use of lots of seasonal ingredients too. Credit cards accepted. English menu available. I took the 10 piece set that was full of yummy surprises - my favorites were the pumpkin and sweet potato skewers, so wonderfully executed. Beautiful bar counter with lots of natural light streaming in during the day. Highly recommended!!
The food was absolutely incredible. I had eight fried skewers, each a unique creation by the chef. The staff was attentive and genuinely kind. Highly recommended - 10/10🤩

name: Lazy Eye Coffee
reviews:
An absolutely lovely hidden gem. Once you reach the black door and go upstairs, you’re pleasantly surprised by a cozy café with a beautiful atmosphere. The decor is artsy and hip, and you can relax on floor cushions, which adds to the charm.

There’s even a smoking area at the back, and the overall vibe is quiet and laid-back—perfect for getting some work done or reading a book.

Important note: Payment is cash or QR code only; credit cards are not accepted.

Entering Lazy Eye was as if I was entering a mysterious garden of large antique trinkets. I’ve never felt such reality shift entering this store. It was full of nostalgia, and definitely a great place for asian film enthusiasts to hang around to grab drinks in a hot day at pasar seni. The whole place felt cozy and so dreamy. The staffs there were a bunch of passionate beings, full of hospitality and extremely helpful as they’d would suggest you good curated drinks if you’re ever looking for something different than an iced latte. Would definitely visit here again.

The place is quite hidden but once you're in there, it's a whole different vibe. It was full of vintage items and definitely quite unique to see. Ordered Black Cold Brew and it was good and the staff also was very friendly 👍🏼

name: SAKURA YAKINIKU (حلال) さくら焼肉
reviews: It's rare to find a halal restaurant that serves yakiniku in the Nagoya area. The 20-minute walk from the nearest station is worth it for the juicy and affordable meat. Don't forget to try the fried rice. It's delicious. And the fried beef is also delicious and plentiful! Recommended place. I'll come back and try other dishes. There is a comfortable and proper place for pray. Love it

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We were so happy to discover this halal restaurant near Nagoya Port Aquarium! Every dish was delicious and clearly made with care, the atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the owner went out of their way to make us feel welcome. It’s the perfect place to relax and enjoy a wonderful meal after a day at the aquarium. Highly recommended — this will definitely be a regular stop whenever we’re in the area!

Glad to have a halal yakiniku place jn Nagoya so I can fix my wagyu cravings. The place is abit further from central Nagoya but so worth it to come all the way~ The meat was so juicy and melts in your mouth! Left the place feeling very satisfied and happy~

name: F.R Asian Restaurant
reviews: No words just superb.if u are a sri lankan u should to try this restaurant.this just one pic i had try.but i tried uludu wade,shoties,those,juice also.all of foods were really good tatsty.and also they are really friendly.come and enjoy.💗

One of the best halal restaurant in Nagoya area. The food is so tasty that you cannot compare anywhere else in nagoya. Specially the price of menu including buffet and the items they serve is totally value for money. I strongly recommend everyone to visit there at least for first time. You will not be disappointed. I often go there with family and friends. The key point is that they have a small place for party or meeting, where you can enjoy or do your important activities and you dont need to think about the servings. We did birthday party as well as get together party and enjoyed a lot. Thanks to JST halal, no other halal shop will offer you these types of diversified facility. Even you can buy some halal food like frozen meat, fish, chapati, lentils etc from here. Long review but if you are a Halal seeker and live in Nagoya, you must need to try it once.

Our first time to come here to have biryani’s rice. We ordered mutton biryani & Mongol Gyoza. We didn’t expected was so good! So I have to take out more biryani. And he was so nice to give us compliment drinks!
From now, this restaurant will be my favorite for biryani rice

name: Mega mendung resto
reviews: It's quite small but the place has a good atmosphere, mostly halal Indonesian cuisine. Also has a joint halal shop next to it
Very good
Okay

name: Spice N Ice Bukit Bintang
reviews:
We are staying at the Ramada just across from this amazing Indian Restaurant.
The meals are absolutely beautiful ( I have spent a lot of time in India) and meals are so good.
The staff are amazing and really go above and beyond to make your evening special.
Service 5 stars
Don't walk past this restaurant
Enjoy
Erin & Jordy
Great staff. Super friendly and kind. Nice restaurant which offers truly good spicy food. They also make good drinks :)
Best Indian food in Malaysia 🇲🇾 love it - great service by Deep & Preet

name: すき焼き ひょうたん
reviews:
このすき焼きセットは肉が2枚しかありませんが、1枚あたりの価格は少なくとも7,000円以上です。味は美味しいとは言えませんが、全くお得とは言えません。
この食事は、価格が高すぎるため、とても不快にいただきましたが、牛肉が少なすぎます。食べないことをお勧めします。

有馬温泉1泊2日旅行の2日目のお昼ご飯で訪れました。元々12時からの予約でしたが、予定が早く進み11時からの予約に変更出来ないか問い合わせたら快く承諾して頂けました。
店の雰囲気はとても高級感があり、店員さんの対応も、とても品があり気配りに大満足です

頼んだ料理は『黒毛和牛ひつまぶしランチ』
こういう所のご飯の量は少ないものと思いこんでいましたが、いざ届くと大の大人でも満足いくちょうどいい量でした。
10種ほどの薬味が小皿で出てくるので
好きなように乗せて食べるのも美味しかった
何よりひつまぶしにお出汁をかけ、わさびをちょっとのせたセットは半端なくおいしかったです
아리마 온천에 묶으면서 오게 되었습니다. 스키야키 세트를 먹었는데 직접 다 구워주셨어요. 직원분들 정말 친절하시고 맛도 최고입니다!! 너무나 만족스러운 저녁 식사였습니다! 정말 강추입니다!!

name: George Town
reviews: Beautiful town Explorer on foot. Just walk around and you'll name unique sites. Take about 2 day more less. And make sure you stuff your face. Great food from many origins. Nice mix of culture and cuisine.

Welcome to old beautiful town, that so amazing old building still strong stand here and some of it like will delivery to us about past story, all this building are history witness, this about building in town now lets us talking about food, wow food here most delicious, remember Penang laksa and nasi lemak this place are heaven for that food so welcome to paradise guys

name: Lebuh Pantai Beach Street Heritage Site
reviews:
Lebuh Pantai / Beach Street kept the history of central business district at Georgetown. Nowadays, it is a busy street lined with historical buildings have been converted into banks and financial institutions, as well as other businesses. There are some eateries, souvenir shops, murals, street arts,  museum along this street. The entrance of Penang Little India is located at Beach Street.

City Area Transit (CAT) bus starts from Jetty  Bus Terminal and make stops at Bank OCBC and Police Station along Beach Street. Visitors may drive and park their car at road side parking and carpark building of Penang City Council is available here. E-hailing services is also available here.

This is the quieter business district of Georgetown with its wider streets and lots of classical buildings. There are mainly Colonial buildings, some neo classical and some with an Arabic touch. Well worth venturing here if you like architecture.
Best of colonial architecture along Beach St

name: Harmony Street Heritage Hindu Temple
street: Kompleks Lebuh Pitt, 14, Jln Masjid Kapitan Keling
reviews: Okayish place. Mostly indian sellers. You can buy all indian good from here. But would have been better if they stopped blaring music at full volume.
Nice place 🙏
好像没看见进去的地方

name: うなぎ舟鮨
reviews:
お昼は鰻屋さん。夜はお寿司屋さんの店舗みたいで、熱田神宮の近くで営業されてるのもあり、入ってみました。
パリしっとりの美味しいひつまぶしでした！！
お茶も席ごとにポットがあって、回転寿司みたいに自分で準備する方式。とっても便利。

熱田神宮の近くにある老舗のうなぎ屋さんへ行きました！
GW中だったので30〜40分程度並びました😂

並んでよかったな〜と思うくらいとても美味しくてまた行きたいです！
抹茶粉末のお茶を飲んで待ってました！

外はパリッと香ばしく、中はふっくらしたうなぎがとても美味しかったです！
美味しい食べ方通りにたべました笑
甘すぎないタレで最後まで食べやすく、ひつまぶしも楽しめました◎

落ち着いた昔ながらの雰囲気で、ゆっくり食事できるのも良かったです。

熱田神宮は何店舗も鰻屋さんあります。
ここは職場の会食で利用しました。2階席でゆっくり食事ができました。
ポットとお茶も飲めます。ウナギは3切れ1900円。焼き具合も美味しく、満足できました。
ほかのメニューもあります。

name: COCTEAU
street: Shinkocho, 7−2 神戸ポートミュージアム 1F
reviews: Some of the best karage I've ever eaten. The salad and sauce went very well together with the rice and karage.

接待でお客様を連れて昼食へ、
フードコートですが非常に神戸らしい雰囲気で、
会社が近くなので２度目ですがお客様は非常に喜んでいました。
お味はまあまあ、店員のお兄さんは非常に気さくで好印象でした。
オイスターも時期もありますがまあまあでした。
土日はいっぱいの様ですが普通の日ならお昼も夜も楽に入れそうです。
フードコートの中の店舗です。唐揚げ丼がメイン。汁物は大根のすまし汁で、味噌汁じゃないところがすごく良いです。めっちゃおいしかったです。

name: Burger & Lobster KLCC
street: Lot G46, Ground Floor, Lot G46, Ground Floor
reviews: We had a satisfying meal. The spicy dragon lobster was fresh and the spicy and sweet chili sauce goes really well with the fried mantous. The classic lobster roll was delicious too. Service was attentive and staff was friendly and helpful. The price point of this restaurant is on a higher side but good quality food. Definitely recommended!

Had a great experience at B&L! The food was really nice and full of flavour, and the service was excellent. The staff (Mr. Ali & Mr. Sun) were very friendly , efficient and professional — everything was fast, smooth, and well organized. Definitely a place I’d come back to and recommend to others. Keep up the good work! 😊

If you are a bit like me, you’ll love the burger and the cold milkshake!
What a tast, and so perfectly cooked :-)
That’s it. Just very very good.  Even Gorden would approve I bet.
Service was good and the environment with just right volume on the music and good seats.
Price is high, but you know what: Worth it!

name: Fuego at Troika Sky Dining
street: Level 23A Tower B, The Troika, 19, Persiaran KLCC
reviews:
We chose this restaurant to celebrate our anniversary after hearing great things about both the view and the food. The view truly lived up to expectations, and we were seated at a very nice table, which set a lovely tone for the evening.

We ordered the fuego guacamole, fuego ceviche, beef tongue, and the seafood moqueca, which was advertised as a sharing dish for 2–3 people. The guacamole was genuinely delicious, although the portion of chips was quite small and we had to order extra. Unfortunately, the ceviche was very underwhelming — despite being attractively served in a coconut shell, the portion was tiny and the flavor was rather bland and unremarkable.

The biggest disappointment was the seafood moqueca. For a dish promoted as a generous sharing plate, the portions were extremely small, with very little fish in a bland red sauce and only one small plate of rice provided. The quantity was barely enough for one person, let alone two or three, which felt misleading given how it was described on the menu.

While we understand that this is positioned as a fine-dining restaurant, the combination of small portions, lack of flavor, and the way the sharing dish was advertised was disappointing. Additionally, the service felt rushed — the staff were very quick to clear plates, which made it hard to relax and enjoy our evening. Ironically, the cocktails were the highlight of the night.

Overall summary (4/5): Stunning KL skyline views, great for special occasions.

The food (4/5): The food is South American tapas style and meant for sharing.
* The Fuego Ceviche (RM36) was a blast of flavors and a nice refreshing start, my only complaint is the portion was too little!
* The Corned Beef Croquettas (RM38) had really tender beef.
* Lamb Empanadas (RM24 per piece)—basically the South American version of a "karipap". It tasted ok, nothing exceptional, but I bit into what I believe was a jalapeño. It was super spicy, kinda overpowering.
* Barramundi Taco (RM25) - It was ok, nothing stands out and the best Tacos we had.
* Tres Leche (RM35) - The absolute dish of the day. The cake was delicious but too small. The almond florentine was crunchy and the coconut ice cream was so refreshing.

The value (4/5): It is on the pricey side, especially since some portions like the ceviche and cake are a bit small for the price. However, the quality of the food and the whole vibe make it worth it for a special occasion.

The service (4/5):  The staff are attentive, friendly, and happy to help you take photos with the skyline view. Just keep in mind they are quite strict with the dining time limit.

The environment (5/5): The outdoor seating gives you a beautiful sweep of the city skyline. It is very photogenic, especially if you manage to book the 6:30 PM slot for the sunset. You'll find plenty of insta-worthy photo opportunities. The atmosphere is vibrant but relaxed. Just remember to follow their smart casual dress code!

A quick tip: Advance booking is absolutely a must.

We had our first fine-dining experience in Malaysia at Fuego, and it was truly unforgettable. The ambiance was beautiful, and the skyline view added a special touch to our evening.

A special mention to Andy, who served us throughout the night. He was incredibly polite, friendly, and attentive, making sure we were comfortable and enjoying every moment. His service genuinely elevated our dining experience.

The food was excellent, the atmosphere was great, and the entire experience felt well curated. Just a note — you do need to make a reservation in advance, as the place is quite popular.

Overall, a wonderful sky-dining experience and definitely recommended.

name: Halab Beremi Arabic Restaurant
reviews:
Very good Arabic restaurant.
Unlikely the outside street, this restaurant is very clean and well organized. There are two stories and patio as well. So there are plenty of seats!
I tried the sandwich which was really nice, and juice. I do know what it is, but taste, flavors, smoothness, everything’s are perfect.
It is very close to the center on Bukit Bintang, so I recommend you to visit.

Honestly the whole restaurant is absolute average. I feel like the reviews are bought… The food was okay at best but not the best arab food I have ever had. The meat was rather dry and didn’t have any special flavour. The service was slow and the waiters were so unnotivated. They seemed like they all hate their jobs and spend more time watching loudly some random tiktoks than anything else. Considering the prive you pay, this is absolutely a tourist trap. I saw in some reviews that people are even allowed to smoke Shishas inside. If this would have happened, I had given the restaurant 1 star.

Our family dinner here was a great experience. We enjoyed amazing Arabic food and top-notch service. We started with the shawarma sandwich and hummus, and both were excellent. For our mains, the mandi rice was a bit bland, especially when compared to the richly flavorful kapsa rice. We originally planned on dessert, but the portions were so generous that we had no space left

name: Nikutarashi Sakae
reviews:
Even though we had a reservation, we were not seated at the reserved time.
We were asked to wait, which we did. However, when it was time to order, we were informed that because the restaurant was close to closing, the two-hour all-you-can-eat course could not be accommodated, and another restaurant was recommended instead.

It was difficult to understand why reservations were being accepted with only one staff member working. This lack of staffing clearly affected the service and overall management.

Accepting a reservation and then being unable to accommodate the reserved course due to closing time is very frustrating and unprofessional. There was no proper explanation or sincere apology, and the staff’s handling of the situation felt inexperienced.

Because of this experience, I do not understand why this restaurant has such a high Google rating.
I will not be returning.

Terrible, better off with other choices

To sum it up,
- Slow service
- Terrible ordering system and model

I made a reservation for four for an all-you-can-eat meal, after fast and confusing explanation of ordering system
We tried to enjoy the all-you-can-eat buffet, but we weren’t satisfied with the ordering method, which seemed to intentionally limit the amount of food we could eat.
You can order drinks from your smartphone, but you have to call a waiter and order food verbally.
It said 150 items that can be ordered, but most of them were drinks with slight variations.
The process of ordering took about 15 minutes for the food to arrive. Furthermore, you could only order the amount of number of customers at a time like 4 things for 4 people, so after eating 12 skewers of chicken (four serving), we had to wait another 15 minutes.
The food itself are not terrible, the system is.
Waiting order 45min-1hour

name: GYUKATSU KYOTO KATSUGYU Kobe Sannomiya Center Plaza Store
street: Sannomiyacho, 1 Chome−9−1 センタープラザ東館 １Ｆ
reviews: 10/10 enjoyable meal that was absolutely worth the wait! The beef cutlet was so tender and flavourful! Despite language barriers, the staff made a lot of effort to make sure I was able to order and understand how to eat the meal the right way! Honestly recommend it! Will be back again!!

I ordered the ageing striploin with onsen egg set, which proved to be both flavorful and generous in portion size. The crust was well-prepared, and the beef itself was tender, making for a satisfying main dish.

A notable highlight was the variety of methods offered to enhance the flavor of each gyukatsu. Among these, I particularly enjoyed the pairing with wasabi and dashi soy sauce, which added a refreshing balance to the richness of the beef.

The accompanying miso soup leaned slightly toward the salty side. Additionally, it is worth mentioning that the shop carried a faint oil aroma, likely due to the frying process involved in preparing the beef.

Overall, the experience was distinctive and memorable.

I visited Kyoto Katsugyu in Sannomiya and really enjoyed the meal. Their beef cutlet is tender, flavorful, and cooked perfectly with a crisp, golden crust and a juicy, pink center. The quality of the meat is excellent, and the seasoning is just right without being too heavy.

The service is quick, the prices are very reasonable, and it’s a great spot if you’re craving a satisfying beef cutlet. I’d definitely come back again.

name: GYUKATSU Kyoto Katsugyu Universal Citywalk Osaka
street: Shimaya, 6 Chome−2−61 ユニバーサル・シティウォーク大阪 ３Ｆ
reviews: We had the Wagyu Katsu x 2. We splurged. 10,000 Yen for 2. I have to say, I expected more. The steaks were maybe 150g each. They were perfectly cooked. The Katsu by itself was very plain, with no real flavour. I’d asked a waitress to explain the different dipping sauces etc - there was an English card translation, but it wasn’t clear to me which was which - she didn’t know herself….. I asked her to point out which were which, she told me some weren’t there - we discovered along the way that they were all there. My partner in crime gave the Katsu 4/5, I give it 3/5. Too expensive for what we got sorry. It’s very small and cozy in here and feels authentic.

I wanna give it a 4.5 because it was soooo delicious. The medium rare meat was more medium but the rare cuts were perfectly rare. I highly recommend it though! The portions were perfect and after a long day at Universal Studios it really hit the spot. Everything was just absolutely delicious^^

This restaurant is conveniently located near Universal Studios, making it easy to find and access. The staff welcomed us warmly, and I really liked that we could place our order while waiting — it saved a lot of time.

The atmosphere had a traditional Japanese feel and was lively. One of the staff members spoke Korean and kindly explained in detail how to best enjoy the dishes, which made the meal even better.

The meat was very tender, and the tempura was perfectly crispy. Personally, I’m not a fan of food that’s too juicy, and since they didn’t ask about the doneness, the meat felt a bit rare for my taste.

Still, it was a wonderful dining experience overall — especially because they offered a special matcha drink that you can only find here. Highly recommend visiting if you’re near Universal!

name: ParaThai @ Suria KLCC
reviews:
I had such a wonderful experience at this Thai restaurant! The pad Thai was absolutely delicious, flavourful and perfectly cooked. The crispy prawns came out hot and fresh, and the beef was tender and full of taste. The sour plum lemonade was a nice drink, it was light and refreshing, which balanced the meal nicely. Servers were also quick and attentive. Portions and prices are perfect too!

Hands down, this is the best Thai restaurant I’ve visited. I’m on vacation, so I won’t be able to come back soon, but I’ll definitely miss it!
Delicious and authentic! The green curry was rich and flavorful, and the stir-fried greens were perfectly cooked. Great food and a comfortable place will definitely return!

Had a wonderful dining experience at Para Thai KLCC. We ordered the sizzling Thai-style barbecue, steamed seabass with lime and chilli, and papaya salad, everything was flavourful, fresh and authentic. Great service and cosy ambience too. Highly recommended! 🌶️🍽️✨

name: Kraffmen Cafe
reviews:
Visited Kraffmen Cafe for a birthday celebration and had a great experience! The Butterflied Pork Loin with homemade red wine sauce was juicy and flavourful, and the Coconut Water Tomyam Seafood Pasta was a unique twist — tangy, slightly spicy, and refreshing.
The Double Smoked Brandy Infused Chicken had a nice smoky aroma and was well balanced with salad and fries. We also enjoyed the Chella Kombucha Ginger Lemon — light, fizzy, and perfect to cleanse the palate.
Bonus: They offer a free birthday platter for 3 pax during your birthday month, which made the celebration extra special.
Would definitely come back for gatherings!

Kraffmen Café is one of our treasured finds this round in Penang!

I initially came just for the tiramisu in a cup after spotting it on Instagram. I honestly thought it was purely a dessert café. To our surprise, they serve food too… and not just decent food, but really good food. After noticing the strong reviews, we decided to stay for dinner and we were genuinely wowed.

We ordered the red wine chicken chop, basil-infused grilled chicken with salted egg tofu purée, mushroom soup, and the coconut juice tom yum seafood pasta. Every dish had depth and character. The flavours were well thought through, with a satisfying umami punch across the board. The tofu purée was a standout for me…unique, comforting, and something refreshingly new. The mushroom soup was thick, rich, and delicious.

Their kombucha was refreshing as. it’s an in-house brew, which made it even more enjoyable.

And of course, the tiramisu cup was the perfect ending to the meal. Not overly sweet, moist, beautifully balanced, with a lovely layer of dark chocolate. A truly satisfying finish.

We thoroughly enjoyed everything here. Highly recommended and definitely a place we’ll return to on our next Penang trip.

Quality of food was good. The pork loin was very soft and full of flavour. Service crew were friendly and responsive. There’s quite a crowd it being a Saturday. Atmosphere not as cosy as expected as there was a group celebrating a birthday.
Seating is also available upstairs.

name: Kobe Beef MIYABI Sankita Store
street: Kitanagasadori, 1 Chome−2−7 プラチナビル
reviews: We went to the first restaurant without reservation, and it was fully booked. However the reception was kind enough to check other branches. In 3 minutes, we were fetched and taken to the other branch. And here we got a superb and amazing experience. The staff, Prajal, was exceptionally great. He was very attentive and took care of the whole gastronomic experience. And of course, the Kobe Beef was carefully cooked to perfection. For sure, we will come back again. Thank you and more Power.

I had an amazing dining experience here! The Kobe sirloin was absolutely delicious — beautifully cooked and full of flavor. Though the price is on the higher side, the quality of the food and the exceptional service made it well worth it. I would especially like to compliment Prajal for his outstanding service — attentive, warm, and professional throughout. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to experience authentic Kobe beef at its finest!

An amazing experience. We were keen to try real Kobe steak as we've only had whatever has cleared into the US. We tried a few of their cuts, including their limited special. All of the meats were amazing and the accompaniments even better. Our chef made the experience enjoyable by explaining the cuts, how to best savor the flavors, etc. The location, just outside the station, could not be more convenient. Great experience!

name: Lazeez Arabic Restaurant and Grill
reviews:
Their service is always incredible — everyone there is super kind, helpful, and very attentive. You can really feel that they care about their guests. Even the manager comes by sometimes to ask if everything is alright and if the food is tasty! The ambience and decorations are beautiful, creating such a warm and inviting atmosphere. The food is really delicious, full of flavour, and always freshly made. Every visit has been such a lovely experience and we came here often.. Its one of our favorite restaurants in KL/Bukit Bintang..

Highly recommend it to anyone looking for delicious food, a wide variety of dishes, and outstanding service in Bukit Bintang!

We ordered Haneed Lamb and Lamb Shawarma as pax of 2.
Haneed Lamb was so tender and juicy. The rice is quite smoky in a good way which we very much enjoy.
Lamb shawarma was also juicy and good. The wrap is thin and much enjoyable texture together with the lamb when chewed. That could be our personal preference.

We’re seated inside as the outside atmosphere is very busy with traffic and enjoy the interior.

Overall, the experience is good and will consider to come back and try another dishes.

I was so hungry and this place was very near my hotel. The service was fast and so the food.
I had a delicious lentil and chicken soup, to be fair the best I ever had in an Arabic restaurant.
The chicken couscous was absolutely perfect and it was a huge portion too.
My husband loved his falafel.
I loved the atmosphere, the place is beautifully decorated.
Great prices too.
I am doing a review while at the restaurant and got 5% discount 😍

name: Boleh Seafood Pot
reviews:
Just had an amazing dinner at Boleh Seafood Pot in Jalan Alor Food Street, KL! I ordered the seafood hot pot and it was so good! The staff were super friendly and the place was really clean. Plus, the prices were super affordable. The seafood was super fresh too!

Just a heads up, be careful with the hot pot and stove, especially if you're with kids. Other than that, it's a great spot for a delicious meal! Highly recommend!

Visiting Jalan Alor for the first time is an experience in itself, and I decided to stop by the infamous Boleh Seafood due to its reputation and the sheer variety of seafood choices on their menu. The options are extensive, making it a seafood lover's paradise at first glance. The atmosphere was buzzing with the typical energy of a Kuala Lumpur weekend, which added to the excitement of trying a local favorite.

However, the dining experience was a bit of a rollercoaster. While the food itself was absolutely delicious and lived up to the hype in terms of flavor, my craving to eat was dampened by the significant wait times. Being a Saturday, the place was packed, but it took over an hour just for someone to take our order, and another hour for the food to actually reach our table. It was disheartening to wait two hours in total when you are hungry and eager to enjoy your meal.

Boleh Seafood serves high-quality dishes that I truly loved, but the slow service and order-taking were major drawbacks during this visit. I understand that weekend crowds can be overwhelming, but the wait felt excessive. I will likely return to Jalan Alor soon because the food culture is so vibrant, but I think I will explore other seafood options next time to see if I can find a better balance between great taste and efficient service.

So delicious! consider the location in the area of bukit bintang, the food prices a lil bit pricy but not that pricey. it is muslim friendly all the staff here looks like real malay local no chinese worker (maybe some but not a lot), theres alot of seating area you can choose. for the waiting time, even tho its alot of customer but the food arrived so fast around 10-15 mins still okay for me, recommended 😆

name: Kuromonsakae Sushi
reviews:
Stopped in on a Tuesday night with 2 adults - was able to get seated right away, but the restaurant did fill up quickly.

Staff was very friendly and attentive / was very patient with our minimal Japanese as we asked questions about the menu.

Write down the item number(s) & hand it to your waiter to order.

-Vegetable Tempura Bowl
-Cucumber (Kappa) Roll
-Pickled Raddish Roll
-Spring Onion Roll
-Medium Fatty Tuna Sashimi
-Tuna Bowl
-Salmon Sashimi
-Sake x1 & Beers x4

Bill was about $67.

Would recommend for a nice, casual meal.

The prices are quite decent and the staffs are very friendly. As a foreigner I'm glad that there are tables on the side for me instead of having to sit at the counter which is more space constraint. The prices are decent for a tourist spot and the staffs try their best to interact with us using our languages.

I randomly walk in the market and reach this quiet far end of the market. The lady greets us with a welcoming smile and inviting us to try her restaurant. So we try! And we love it!! Its a hidden gem. Good quality sushi , sashimi and more, if you don’t eat raw food, they have other warm, cooked food tempura, udon, don-buri, miso soup, etc as well. Good portion and its not expensive, very reasonable price! The restaurant is clean. Staffs are polite and friendly. Menu has English descriptions. Staffs can speak English a little bit.
Plus There is a clean restroom too!
It is quiet, not many people pass by so
Please come support their business.
I highly recommended!

name: Spice Guys BLR - Suria KLCC
reviews:
While strolling through Suria KLCC one day—particularly the ever-buzzing food court—I happened to chance upon **Spice Guys Banana Leaf**, quietly inviting yet unmistakably confident in its presence. Curiosity lingered, and today’s dinner felt like the right moment to finally give it a try.

I began modestly with a selection of vegetarian tiffin items, a decision I’m genuinely glad I made. The idly, while not revelatory, was competently prepared—soft, light, and comforting. What truly elevated the experience, however, were the accompaniments: the chutneys and sambar were excellent, brimming with depth, balance, and that unmistakable homestyle warmth that signals care in the kitchen.

The onion dosa followed, and it did not disappoint. Crisp, well-fermented, and generously filled, it paired beautifully with the same stellar accompaniments, reaffirming that this establishment’s real strength lies in its condiments and supporting elements. Even the teh tarik stood out—smooth, aromatic, and well-pulled, rounding off the meal on a satisfying note.

Service throughout was attentive and pleasant, adding to the overall ease of the dining experience. I couldn’t help but notice many diners opting for the banana leaf meal, which looked both vibrant and enticing—clearly popular for good reason. That will undoubtedly be on my list for the next visit.

All things considered, Spice Guys Banana Leaf has scored highly where it matters most: in flavour, balance, and accompaniments. It’s a place I would readily recommend, and one I look forward to revisiting with a heartier appetite next time.

A very decent banana leaf place in a mall with warm service and delicious food.

There is a current promotion “tag us & get a drink”. We did it immediately and got 1 ice lemon tea in the house. Their ice lemon tea was so good and very sourish.

We ordered the banana leaf set meal consisting of unlimited rice, veggies, papadom and curries. Their curries was a bit on the thick side and heavy but definitely a flavour bomb. We added the beancurd Sambal and chicken 65. Both were very tasty and served hot.

We finished off with a flavourful bright orange kesari that is sweet and comforting to cleanse our palate. We close our meal with a hot chai also very good and hot.

Their service is top notch, we were served by a guy named “Haji”. He is warm and very hospitable.

Highly recommended if you want experience banana leaf rice with aircond and calm ambiance.

Was def a good choice for our first time experiencing the banana meals!
Staff were really sweet and helpful. The food was delicious and tasteful.
Will come back here for sure next time I’m in KL

name: Taishu Sukiyaki Hokuto GEMS Namba Branch
reviews:
This shabu-shabu restaurant was super delicious and authentic! I really loved the quality of the meat and all the side dishes that came along. The place was clean and nicely decorated — sitting by the window gave a lovely view while enjoying the meal. The staff were well-trained and attentive throughout.

Since the restaurant is filled with the warm aroma of soup, they even provide a fabric spray before you leave to help freshen up your clothes — such a thoughtful touch! Overall, a wonderful and satisfying experience.

Awa Black Beef Sirloin, Carefully Selected Wagyu Beef and Awa Black Beef
.
Wonderful sukiyaki place with a great view of Namba! Comes with a nice soothing miso soup and selected raw egg for the dipping.
Cook yourself and seasoned it yourself to your like. Not too worry as they give you a hint on how to cook both in pamflet and passing your dish.
Beef are all tender and juicy, given sauce and sugar pouring as per instructions really elevated them.
.
#jpfood #jpfoodies #sukiyaki #wagyubeef #awablackbeef #egg

This is the best sukiyaki restaurant experience in my life both the taste of the food and the service of all staffs 🥰. Our osaka trip this time today was our 2nd time and the staff remembered us and gave us some little gift and it was so cute and very impressive for us thank you so much. 🙏🏻🫶🏻 really recommend

name: Two Frenchies Cafe Bistro
reviews: If you’re looking for an adorable quaint French restaurant this place fits that description. The interior has a old world French charm. When you step inside from the heat it feels very cool and relaxing. The service is friendly and efficient. Everything we ordered was delicious. You can tell the food is made fresh with high-quality ingredients. The prices on their higher side for Penang is well worth it. Will definitely be coming back.

Whenever we’re craving French food, this is our go-to spot. Highly recommended dishes include the boeuf bourguignon, agneau 5-hour, French onion soup, and the profiteroles.

The French onion soup is the perfect, comforting way to start the meal. The boeuf bourguignon is flawless—the rich red wine sauce, tender beef, and creamy mashed potatoes come together beautifully. The only downside is the lack of vegetables. The agneau 5-hour is for two to share, but I wouldn’t recommend it for anyone who isn’t fond of the strong lamb flavour.

Save room for dessert—the profiteroles are absolutely divine and the highlight of the meal for me every time. The chocolate sauce isn’t overly sweet, which pairs perfectly with the whipped cream and ice cream.

This time, I also tried the halibut with hollandaise. The fish was nicely crispy without being oily at all. It’s a great option for those on keto—no carbs, yet still filling thanks to the broccoli on the side.

I've heard about Two Frenchies for years and am so glad I finally tried it. The ambiance is wonderful warm, cozy, and inviting making it perfect for a date night. The service was also very friendly and welcoming.
The food had some major highlights. The Escargot was fantastic; the garlic olive oil paired perfectly with the bread for dipping. We also loved the Sharing Cheese Platter and the Beef dish both were executed perfectly.

However, we had to deduct a star for the Roast Duck with Peach Sauce. It was the only letdown of the night. The meat was a bit tough and lacked flavor, and unfortunately, the peach sauce didn't complement the duck at all.
Overall, a great experience, but I’d recommend skipping the duck.

name: MinNature Malaysia
street: Level 1, Green Zone above Cold Storage Supermarket, Sungei Wang Plaza, Jln Sultan Ismail
reviews:
Oooh this place is good. I wish that more people would visit this place. I can see that the founders of this place is very passionate about this and his/her country. It’s like visiting a museum, but smaller.

Exhibits are interactive and I see that they are continuously improving the exhibits. There are also light shows at 20-minute intervals which is a cute thing to experience.

If you’re bringing kids, just be alert of their hands which might be itchy to touch the exhibits! Respect the work put in here. Will visit again.

I am a huge fan of miniature stuff. This museum is the Malaysian response to the world famous Miniature wonderland.

The museum is very inspirational and educational. There are miniature pieces of many perspectives on Malaysian society, which provide an interesting insight to observe the history and development of Malaysia.

Some miniature pieces also reflected some less touristy places in Malaysia, which inspired the future plans of traveling in Malaysia.

The ticket was 30 RM, a reasonable price. The staffs were very friendly and helpful.

This is a nice little place with miniatures, mainly of places in Malaysia. They also have regular lightshows at the displays.
The place is inside Sungei Wang shopping centre - you can walk directly from the Monorail station through the shopping centre to the venue. There’s a Cold Storage store on the ground floor where Google Maps shows this is - you can get to this via three ip escalators near it.

name: Pokok KLCC Lot 91
street: LOT C-08, LEVEL CONCOURSE, PERMATA SAPURA
reviews: I’m very satisfied with the food portions. It was a bit pricey, but everything was fine. The environment was very chill and not too noisy. Thanks to the staff as well. Good service and very helpful.

Nice place for brunch and lunch. We ordered the Pokok Beef Burger. To be honest, I liked the patty — it still had a nice fatty taste. The burger also came with beef streaky and a runny fried egg, which was great. However, halfway through, I started to feel a bit fed up and could barely finish it.

My friend ordered the Crab and Cherry Tomato Pasta. It was spicy, but the flavour was nice. We hope the management can consider adding a spice level indicator on the menu because not everyone can tolerate spicy food. My friend also struggled to finish the pasta because of the spiciness.

The serving time needs improvement. My burger came out earlier than the drinks, and the pasta took around 15 minutes to be served. We couldn’t take food photos together because my burger would have gone cold.

We ordered the Pokok Pink Latte and the Peach Iced Tea. The drinks were nice, but the portion was quite small for the price.

The staff were friendly, and the environment is nice, but the chairs are uncomfortable to sit on.

The service at this restaurant was excellent. Our server, Nahid, was very attentive and considerate, regularly checking in to make sure the food and drinks matched our preferences. The pasta was generously portioned with quality ingredients, and the kitchen was happy to adjust the seasoning to our taste. Overall, we felt well cared for and truly enjoyed the dining experience.

name: WaaronKuus Cafe
reviews:
Visited WaaronKuus Cafe on 3/03/26 at 12:30pm. It’s a very nice place tucked away in an alleyway while you’re walking around the markets. It looks beautiful and inviting from the outside.

As soon as you walk through the doors, you’re welcomed by a lovely cool breeze from the air conditioning. It’s very clean and such a nice break from the heat after walking around the market. The workers are very polite, which makes the experience even better.

The toilets are also very nice and clean. Overall, I had a very good experience. If you’re looking for a place to relax and cool down while exploring the markets, I would definitely recommend stopping in here.

Throwback to this amazing café in Malaysia! If you’re around Petaling Street or nearby and can’t decide what to eat, this place is perfect — especially if you want both local and Indian-style food.

I tried roti canai here for the first time (never had it back in India), and it was really good. We also ordered Mee Mamak Goreng and Mee Siam, and both dishes were tasty.

The service was good, and the ambience was nice and comfortable. Overall, a great spot to enjoy a mix of flavours without any confusion.

Overall Rating: 4/5
Food: 4.5 /5
Ambience: 4.5/5
Service: 4/5

#malaysia #roticanai #malaysiancuisine #explore

Out of the 30 different dishes we tried in our trip to Malaysia, one that is surely highlighted as probably the best one is WaaronKuus Curry Mee. Absolutely delicious, balanced, perfectly cooked and difficult to replicate. I came to this place driven by some blog I found and the reviews here and it didn’t disappoint. WaaronKuus is a real “hidden gem”.

name: WIP On The Park
reviews: Sensational. Great service, great experience and great food. Perfect location. Came here with work crew. The food kept coming and so did the tiger beers.  The only thing I didn't like was there was no table water which unacceptable, you had to buy a plastic bottle.  Huge video screens and great atmosphere.

Had the risotto, mantou and the katsu burger — both were tasty and nicely presented. Nothing mind blowing but pretty good standard.

The ambience at WIP On The Park is relaxing and the service is friendly. A solid spot for a good meal in KL.

Awesome place to chill and enjoy good beer. The vibe is really nice and relaxed. Perfect spot for unwinding and hanging out. I highly recommend it for a laid-back evening!
Note: From Wednesday till Saturday DJ night start from 7 pm

name: Dining In The Dark KL
reviews:
My second dining in the dark experience after Paris. This isn't the blind folded style, but the real dining in the dark. A visually impaired escort will guide us to the seat and serve us in the dark, we can't even see our own hands. The menu is a surprise, the goal is to awaken our senses while heightened taste, texture and aroma. It's a unique experience and luckily their food is always superb.

KL outlet beats Paris as they served us a mystery welcome drink first and I can only guess one ingredient out of 3. Then we can play a jigsaw puzzle while blind folded before stepping into the world without sight. The menu was too many to remember all of the ingredients by heart. In Paris they asked us to guess each dishes and its ingredients which was fun. Pity they didn't really do it here, but the lounges to wait also the outdoor balcony made it up. We were standing in the crowd in Paris, because it was raining outside and they didn't have the patio there.

Hopefully I'll have the chance to come back to KL again and I'll definitely dine here again and hopefully they'll have different menu then.

An absolutely amazing and unforgettable experience! We celebrated our 17th anniversary dinner with family through a total dark dining experience guided by visually impaired hosts — and it was truly eye-opening and humbling. Dining in complete darkness heightened all our other senses — every bite of the 4-course mystery menu was a surprise and a delight!

A heartfelt appreciation to Marcus, who attended to us with such warmth, patience, and professionalism. He made us feel so comfortable and well cared for throughout the evening — truly commendable!

It’s not just about food, but about perspective — learning to appreciate every sound, scent, and texture. We only got to see the menu after the dinner, which made it even more exciting! A truly unique, inspiring, and heartfelt experience — highly recommended! 💫

What an amazing experience. Truly left us speechless. Couldn’t recommend it enough to anyone coming to KL. Jonathan and the blind John were both amazing and treated us very well. The food was delicious, surprising and out of the ordinary. It left us feeling inspired and refreshed. Thank you!

name: Torico Meat
reviews: Delicious. There are three options for all you can eat with different prices, and I wish i could've eaten more 😂 all you can drink is available too. You basically order via a website/QR code link, and anything with ¥0 is part of your "all you can eat" options. You can also make your own soda with frozen fruits 🥝🍉 I didn't have enough stomachs to eat it all u_u I believe you only get one dessert per person with all you can eat, but honestly i couldn't even make it to dessert before I was totally full 😭🤣.
Nice
A lot of meat :D

name: NADODI
street: Level 7A, Four Seasons Hotel, Jln Ampang
reviews:
Back here again, my second time in 2 years for our anniversary. Food was impecable and I have absolute no regrets once again.
Special mentions to;
1) The Chef for having such a great thought through the entire menu. There was absolutely nothing to fault on.
2) Somellier Jack who walked us through every single dish and drinks that came out. He was rather clear in his explanation and i loved his passion when he explained the food anatomy. I hope to see him again when I am back.
3) Mixologist Nazzim for his amazing cocktails. That curry leaf amrudham was chef’s kiss!! Amazingggg creation!

Nadodi has truly spoilt us!

I went here with my husband a while back to celebrate our anniversary and truly loved everything about this place!

Their service was TOP NOTCH. I've been to a few fine dining restaurants but the service provided at Nadodi was definitely the best I've had. It was the little things that they did that made us feel so welcome for example:
1. We couldn't finish our food because we are both small eaters and they apologized for the food portions.
2. My husband was a little too tipsy from all the drinks at the end and they kept apologising and felt worried if we could drive back.
3. When one of our cocktails came before our food, we finished it without realising, they apologized and brought us a new drink because the drinks were supposed to go with the food.
4. The would provide a small personalised menu with your name on it.
4. Their explanation of the food and drinks were very good!

And the food... I guess we dont need to explain how incredibly delicious everything was! Everything tasted so unique and flavourful! Each course looked different and tasted different. Probably the best food I've ever had.

We also was to do a shout out to the young chinese sommelier who was extra attentive and genuinely nice (I'm sorry, we forgot to take down his name 🥲).

10/10 we loved this place so much and are so glad we decided to celebrate our special day here. Thank you Nadodi for everything (:

The spices blended really well and create a new taste to my tongue. Almost all of them have some sort of hot spiciness, but they do not cover the main indegient taste but rather enhance it.

I just booked it this afternoon since my train delay and rain evening, and don’t wanna go near my hotel.

This is a gem 😋

name: cocopocha
reviews: I loved the local vibe here, it feels real and unpretentious. The simple setup, plastic chairs, open-front space, and the buzz of Bukit Bintang right outside make it part of the experience. Nothing fancy, just honest food done really well. The flavours were excellent, and the whole place has that easy, authentic energy that makes you want to stay longer.

Basically RM39.90 is not too much for this kind of meat buffet. Even that is not the nett price as they do add 10% of their service. Is super full to eat those food even just the original given potions. Jus that the place is kind of small and u won't feel so comfortable there. But still consider a good one.

Had dinner at Cocopocha and really enjoyed it. The place has a nice, lively atmosphere and the staff were friendly and attentive throughout. The BBQ buffet was great: fresh meats, tasty marinades, and a good variety of side dishes.

Everything felt well-organised and the service was smooth. Prices are fair for the quality and the location along Jalan Alor makes it easy to get to.

Would definitely come back or recommend to anyone looking for good Korean BBQ in KL.

name: Zalqa Penang - Arabic Restaurant
street: 77-G-20-22 & 61 -65, penang time square, Jalan Dato Keramat
reviews:
I came here with my family. From the beginning Sam (I guess he is the supervisor) took a good care of us, he recommended the good dishes and almost everything was excellent.
We tried Hummus, falafel, mixed grilled and shawarma. They were tasty and delicious except the Tabouleh which could be much better, and the kofta had some local spices however I prefer the traditional one.
Overall it was a pleasant experience and the kids enjoyed it. Would come again.

Warm, friendly staff, excellent food and good value for money. This is a healthy option for whenever you want to steer away from the otherwise delicious woks and fried foods - Zalqa delivers quality cuisine with lots of fruits and veggies that will replenish your vitamin indicators.

Really recommended, and they have so many options for meat eaters, for vegetarians and even for vegans!

Just wow, we had a mixed grill, a salad and a Lebanese lamb claypot, desserts to finish, one of the best meals I have ever had, absolutely fantastic!  The breads, make sure you have some.  Definitely recommend and will be visiting again whilst in Penang

name: Junk Cafe
reviews:
Junk Cafe delivers a distinctive, character-driven dining experience that blends bold visuals with satisfying comfort food. The café’s interior is densely layered with tribal carvings, masks, vintage memorabilia, and warm ambient lighting, creating an atmosphere that feels eclectic, slightly raw, and unmistakably Penang. It is a space that invites you to slow down, observe, and soak in the details.

The burger is solid and indulgent—juicy patty, melted cheese, and fresh lettuce stacked within a well-toasted sesame bun. Paired with crispy fries, it does exactly what it should: straightforward, hearty, and comforting. Presentation is clean without being pretentious, fitting the café’s laid-back personality.

Drinks complement the experience well. Whether it’s a cold beer or a simple mixed drink, they suit the bar-style setup and the casual night-out vibe. This is a place that feels more like a long conversation over food and drinks than a quick café stop.
Overall, Junk Cafe stands out not for refinement, but for character. A good spot in Penang for those who appreciate a strong atmosphere, relaxed energy, and honest comfort food in a visually memorable setting.

If you are in George Town, you have to check out Junk Cafe. It’s a retro treasure chest packed with antique collections that create a perfectly cozy, eclectic environment. The reggae, soul, and funk music is absolutely contagious and sets the best mood in town.
The food is the real deal—their burgers feature house-made patties that are juicy and full of flavor, paired with delicious, hand-cut fries. Don't miss out on their excellent cocktails and beer selection; the bartenders really know their craft. A must-visit spot!

If you’re in Pengnan and don’t stop by Junk Café, you’re seriously missing out. The place has this super authentic vibe — kind of vintage and cozy — that makes you want to hang out longer than you planned. The food is delicious, with creative options and that homemade touch you don’t always find. But the best part? The staff. They’re friendly, welcoming, and just genuinely cool. It’s such a nice feeling when someone serves you with a real smile and makes you feel at home. I’m definitely coming back.

name: Penang Famous Samosa
reviews:
The best samosa I’ve tried so far.

Accidentally found this place while I strolled around Little India. I saw people queueing and I saw the Michelin star here, so I stop by.
And oh my god, their samosa is sooo good. it’s really really well seasoned. I tried it while it’s still warm, it’s crispy on the outside and the filling is pretty generous. the price is reasonable too.

they also have some Indian dessert, but my favorite is definitely their samosa, especially the chicken samosa.

I tried those Famous Samosa's on my last day in Penang.... The Mutton and the chicken were amazing, but they have many variety including vegetarian options. The masala they use inside is so flavorful. I saw it on a recommended food tour guide. But I did all the places on my own. I had 5 for less than 10 ringgit and could have gone back for 15 more 😋😋. Must try if you're in Georgetown.

Dont miss this stop ! I tried my luck after I noticed a food tour stopping past so thought its safe enough to try myself. The service was efficient he quickly told me what was what, most were 1R. Ive popped in for a snack ever day and the chicken samosa  is flavours ive never had before very tasty and enjoyable. The fish samosa also great. The Dahl ball was fine as was the banan ball (no actual banana in it, banana flavoured fried donut ball if i had to describe it ) for food I dont normally indulge in it was absolutely worth the visit every day. Its cash only take away in a bag quick in and out service and delicious food !
Dont miss it !

name: Bukit Bintang Crossing
reviews: The heart of Kuala Lumpur! Bukit Bintang has everything from the glitzy Pavilion Mall to the legendary street food on Jalan Alor. I spent my afternoon shopping for international brands and then headed to Lot 10 Hutong for some heritage Chinese food. Pro-tip: Visit the intersection near the MRT station at night. the giant LED screens and crowds make it feel like the "Shibuya of Malaysia." It’s the best place to soak in the city's energy.
This crossing is a sight! The buildings, the lights, the train, the people around. A must visit and walk along. Your visit in KL wont be complete if you wont go here.

Bukit Bintang is the place to be in Kuala Lumpur for shopping lovers, window shoppers, night owls, and anyone wanting to soak in the city’s nightlife. From sprawling malls to branded standalone stores and buzzing street markets, this area covers it all. The energy here is contagious — bright lights, music, and the steady rhythm of people moving from one attraction to another.

It’s incredibly well connected through the metro and monorail, making it easy to reach from any part of the city. Whether you’re out for a shopping spree, a late-night stroll, or simply people-watching, Bukit Bintang gives you a taste of Kuala Lumpur’s vibrant, modern spirit.

name: Dilrubar KL Bukit Bintang Restaurant Bar & Lounge
reviews:
I booked  Dilrubar for my husband’s birthday celebration and we had an amazing experience here!

From the moment we arrived, the service was warm, friendly, and very attentive. The staff made sure we were comfortable and checked in regularly without being intrusive, which made the whole dining experience feel very welcoming.

The food was excellent — every dish was well prepared, flavorful, and beautifully presented. You can really tell that care goes into the quality of the ingredients and the cooking. Everything we tried was delicious and satisfying.

What really made the night special was the live band performance (special shoutout to Thilipan) . The music was fantastic and created such a great atmosphere. The singer & band was talented, engaging, and played a great mix of songs that kept the crowd entertained throughout the night. It added so much energy and made the place feel lively and fun.

Overall, it was a perfect night out with great food, outstanding service, and amazing live music. Definitely a place I would recommend to anyone looking for a great dining and entertainment experience. Looking forward to coming back again! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 🎶

We celebrated my husband’s belated birthday at Dilrubar KL Bukit Bintang, and it was such a beautiful experience! The ambience was calm, cozy, and perfect for a special occasion.
The live band was amazing and created such a lovely vibe for the night. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was flavorful and well presented. We even got to dedicate his favourite song, which made the celebration extra special and memorable.
The highlight of the night was surprising him with a cute cake-cutting. Everything went smoothly, and we truly felt happy and relaxed throughout the evening.
Highly recommended for birthday celebrations or any special moments. Thank you for making our night so wonderful! 💕✨

Had an amazing dining experience for a special Valentine’s Day at Dilruba Cafe!
From the moment we walked in, the customer service was absolutely top-notch! A special shoutout to staff Hazel and Dippah for their warm hospitality, attentiveness, and beautiful smiles. They truly made us feel so welcomed 💯👏The food presentation was stunning every dish looked like a masterpiece. And taste wise simply outstanding 😍🔥The highlight of the night was definitely the grilled lamb rack briyani 🐑🍚Perfectly cooked, tender, juicy, and bursting with flavour. Every bite was pure satisfaction!
Fantastic food, fantastic service, fantastic vibes!
Highly recommended👌

name: New Kamura Sakae Princessdori
reviews: Very good restaurant if you're looking for snacks and drinks, very delicious and drinks go well together. First time trying pork tongue, I'd recommend if you haven't tried it, delicious! Good music, friendly to foreigners and great service.
all food are super yummy and all the staff are super nice and friendly. rmb to book earlier before entering.
Very good place to eat! Good environment and lots to do around!

name: Hacco restaurant enn by Wellbe
reviews: Place little hard to find, keep going up the  hill past midori and you'll find a house with a sliding door. Food itself was amazing almost like jewellery. I cannot believe this attention to detail goes into food in Japan. Very impressed super amazed and so much fun to navigate all the different things on the table. I also added the 3 local sake taster. What a day!

We went at lunchtime and they serve set food. The main were fish, chicken and pork, nothing fancy, but very tasty. Same with very fresh salad.  You have to take off shoes but the table is regular height.

A hidden gem tucked away in Arima, this spot was the perfect lunch spot on a chilly day. The lunch set (¥2530) was a comfortable amount of food with a satisfying variety of dishes. This spot sources locally-made miso and it shows. We added sake tastings and a beer and had a great time in this cozy spot.

name: EMP KL
street: 1st Floor, The Westin Kuala Lumpur, 199, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews: Usually pork-free establishments would raise some eyebrows and I'd normally avoid, but EMP had a high rating so decided to see what its about. At the 1st floor inside Westin KL, its now run by another company and not part of the hotel, just like Ferria downstairs. We ordered an assortment of dim sum, and most of it had some kind of truffle element to it, and I have to say it works quite well. Truffle itself lends an umami flavor that makes you forget that everything here is pork free. Food and presentation is very good, and everything is cooked to perfection. There is enough variety to keep things interesting and yet enough staples like siu mai that satisfies the traditionally inclined. The rice noodle rolls were the highlight as they were beautifully presented and very tasty. Truffle fried rice also was very good and very notable.
