When you finish your meal there wasn't a queasy feeling I would usually get after dim sum, then I realized that it must be because of the lack of pork lard. So, this might be the reason why this place is highly rated, and I tend to agree. Reservations are highly recommended and try to get a table near the windows where you can also watch the main street below while you dine.

Comfortable atmosphere and genuinely good quality for its price. The siew mai was very delicious, top 10 in my list 🤩. The fish looking dim sum with prawn in it was very cute, liked that one too 😂. The staff was very kind, always reply kindly and also warn us to be careful p of the step 😇. I loved the experience and would 100% come back, if I could afford a second time 🤐.

Fired rice shrimp with black truffle was good balanced flavor. personally would prefer Japanese rice style rather than long thin rice.   The roasted duck was sooo good, crispy skin and juicy meat would recommend to order this.

name: Inari Sakae
reviews: Came here for my birthday and every single dish is excellent
Everything is so good! I’ll get there one more time 👍🏻
service was really friendly and food was tasty

name: Ní.KIZOKU Modern Japanese Dining Bar 霓貴族
reviews:
Wonderful place! Lovely ambience, and the staff is very helpful.
Very instagrammable place..make you feel like you’re in Tokyo but actually you’re in Petaling Street lol.
There is a back portion which is private and romantic but bit dark for reading menu.
The menu is different from your typical Japanese place, it’s very interesting and lots of things to try. Presentation is beautiful and  food itself is very tasty
Recommended.

Everything we ordered was amazing!
The botan shrimp sashimi was incredibly sweet and fresh, and the mini truffle chawanmushi was rich, fragrant, and silky smooth. The soft-shell crab tofu salad was refreshing with great texture.

Spinach with mushrooms was simple but full of flavour, the gyoza was crispy and juicy, and the Japanese-style grilled chicken nori spaghetti was savoury and satisfying.

The eggplant katsu was crispy outside and soft inside, and the crème fraîche made it even more delicious.

Desserts were great too — the yuzu sorbet was refreshing and tangy, while the matcha sorbet had the perfect balance of bitterness and sweetness.
For drinks, the cucumber soda was super refreshing, and the Sakura Pink Lady looked beautiful and tasted great.

Overall, a really pleasant dining experience — definitely a place I want to revisit!

We came here to celebrate a friend's very belated birthday. The food was nicely presented and done with a bit flair! The portion wasn't as big as we thought but that's ok as we went for more variety instead. Some of the dishes were really good. We also ordered some of their cocktails and I must say these are a tad disappointing. The drinks were visually appealing but tastes bland and the alcohol content was so low I may as well be ordering mocktails.

name: Ocean Twe12ve
street: Lot C3.04.00, Connection Level 3 Pavilion KL, 168, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews: Love the foods. Tasted so good. Waiter’s is very friendly. And price is affordable. Would love to back soon with families and friends more after this.

13/Dec/2025
Had dinner here with 2 friends, good was quite good. Love my Guinness stout. Love the vibes. Friendly service. Air-con & alfresco dining available.

When pasta is served perfectly al dente, the experience is already off to a great start — and Ocean Twe12ve delivered. I had the creamy crab sauce pasta topped with deep-fried soft-shell crab, and it was rich, flavorful, and satisfying.

The service crew was friendly and attentive, and the food arrived quickly. A well-executed dish and a smooth dining experience

name: Halal Ramen Japan
reviews: Really great Halal ramen. The miso ramen broth was really creamy and the spicy ramen was really flavorful. Would definitely come here again.
The Halal chicken ramen was really good!! The services on top 👍🏻👏🏻
Taste is really good, i chose spicy ramen the spice level was really hot for me 🥵 nice service and kind staff! Although it’s expensive.

name: Anjum KLCC
reviews:
This is our second visit to restaurant.
The meals is superb. Amazing views of klcc/kl skyline.
Suitable for family or dinner outing.
Iftar package come with reasonable price which is great.  Will definately repeat coming again

Great view with both indoor and outdoor seating options. The ambience is beautiful and relaxing, especially the outdoor area which offers a really nice KLCC view.

The staff were superb — special thanks and shoutout to the hospitality and service team especially KURAM. he was very attentive and showed thoughtful gestures throughout our lunch time.

The manager, Hakim, was especially impressive. He was friendly, welcoming, and excellent at giving suggestions and recommendations — from choosing the best dishes to selecting seating with the nicest view. He also willing to assist with booking and handled upcoming and group reservations very professionally.

The food was absolutely delicious. I’ve been to a few Arab restaurants around KL area, and I would confidently say this is one of the best. They’re currently having a lunch promotion and it’s truly worth it — the portions are huge and perfect for sharing.

Definitely will be coming back again, especially to sit at the outdoor area next time!
I like the food & service the view there was super nice  it's recommend place

name: Kuromon Konamon Sakaba
reviews: The food was so good we both went for 2nd and 3rd rounds!!  We ordered Tempura shrimp and crab..  was super delicious and his sauce was so good!  Wish he sold his special Japanese sauce.
I loved this place and opens early morning. plenty of space for sitting and very kind attention.

We ordered 3 bowls of udon, and they came within 7 minutes. Also ordered the shrimp tempura and scallops all done super fast and hot. 5/5 presentation and delicious taste. Fast and friendly service and staff 😄

name: Roteigi Nagoya Osu
reviews: Authentic mala taste. We patronised the restaurant at 12pm on a weekday and it was quite empty.

Probably the most authentic Sichuanese restaurant in Nagoya to bring me back to Sichuanese restaurant in Singapore. Serves wagyu and many other typical Sichuan hotpot ingredients. I am looking forward to the next time here!
Very authentic Chinese Hotpot. Friendly staff, and super tasty food.

name: Come On Tigers Restaurant Kuala Lumpur
reviews: Delicious food and very friendly service. The prices are absolutely reasonable for such great food. Highly recommended! The restaurant is a bit hidden. Coming from the main road, you have to walk past the building on the right and down a small alley.

we tried the musakhan- really juicy tender chicken and the sauces with everything is just perfect. great value for the big portion! the owner was really friendly and even explained the whole menu to us! the owner has his own shop that sells perfume and other stuff too can ask him to show you around xD

Delicious authentic Palestinian cuisine for a great price! Very quick and friendly service. In the alleys next to Wisma. I had the chicken mushroom steak and rice at the recommendation of the worker and it was fabulous.

name: Wong Mee Coffee Stall
reviews:
This is the best spot for breakfast and brunch in Chinatown in Kuala Lumpur.
They open so early. The boa are so good.
The coffee is good as well.  Its a local shop with it looks like the grandkids are helping grandfather.

But its awesome and super cheap. You can pay more for less quality or you can pay less and get more.

This is a easy decision for me. You can watch all the elders come out and have their coffee.

Love this feel. I'll be back.

Located at a back alley right infront of a building carpark. It resembles a makeshift stall from afar but it reveals a long history as you approaches. The friendly uncle is so welcoming.

The kopi is super fragrant and the bun is delicious.

It is definitely worth the trip.

Gem of a breakfast joint hidden down an alley. A local favourite and worth the trip. Basic, but flavoursome and full of character. The Kopi hits the spot, and food was the perfect start to the day. Super cheap. Cash or local payment app only, no cards.

name: Zeteo Cafe
reviews: The staff are very friendly and speak English, great for foreigners that speak English like me! The food is some of the best I've had in Malaysia so far. The butter chicken was so flavorful, and their nasi lemak with fried chicken was incredible. This is the second time I've come, ordering different food, and it was still really great. Highly recommend!

Make sure you listen to Nahar! She knows her stuff and explains each dish well so you'll know what to expect. Still, nothing could've prepared us for the explosion of flavor we got from their butter chicken, pineapple fried rice, and Thai beef bone soup. 10/10 recommend this place!!!
One of the best cafes in the area. The food service and atmosphere were excellent! We had to return the following day for some more of their food. My partner loved their Thai beef bone soup!

name: Tateyama Ropeway
reviews: Very pretty view with a light dusting of snow in mid November. Very easy to navigate as part of the Tatayama Kurobe route.

One of the longest Ropeway systems without any middle support system in Japan!

It takes about seven minutes to across 1.7 Kilometers of distance.

The view from the gondola is magnificent. Do make sure line up early for your time slot of the ride to get you a window spot to you can have a good view and taking beautiful pictures.

The ride can be very full in the certain time of the day, specially in the summer months or when the mountain just opens after the winter close!

A very long continous Ropeway with no supports between the stations. Quite a view as it lifted us over 500 meters up the mountain.

quite a great sight and very fun to transit.

name: Restaurant Blanc Penang
reviews:
We celebrated a pre-Valentine’s Day dinner here and were treated to an exceptional fine-dining experience. Every detail was thoughtfully curated, from the exquisite dishes to the impeccable service. The food was refined and beautifully presented, and the staff were attentive, professional, and genuinely warm throughout the evening.

After dinner, we moved to the bar where a bespoke cocktail was crafted perfectly to my liking—an indulgent and personal touch that elevated the experience even further.

The experience left such an impression that we returned the following day for high tea, which was equally elegant and delightful. A truly luxurious destination that excels in both cuisine and hospitality.

Fine dining is sometimes a polarizing theme. Indulged on occasions to me is a fun thing to do. And here is the same concept to my mind. The decor and environment is elegant and not over the top. Table seating is comfortable and the staffs are polite and engaging.

We started with the bread. Lovely. Airy and chewy. Worked perfectly with the flavoured butter. Hokkaido scallop? Light and easy on the palate I felt. Loved the foie Gras. Beautifully seared with creamy melt in your mouth consistency, it's an excellent way to start dinner.

Mains were chicken, fish and lamb. The fish to me was the best. Nicely cooked, delicious soup, nice consistency of flesh. Lamb had a simple presentation but the juicy meat was perfectly paired with the accompanying condiments. I did find it a tad tough but generally deliciously chewy. Out of the three mains, the chicken I somehow found it quite average. Even with the sauce, the taste and flavor didn't really jump out at me.

As for dessert, quite a nice story with pieces representing the forest. I found it deliciously light and not overwhelmed by sugar. All in all a good meal indeed.

We visit BLANC at the Macalister Mansion Penang again after 2 years.
The ambiance is cozy and charming as it is.
Services are good, attentive, polite, and responsive to customer needs.
The food is good and elegant, characterized by fresh and high quality ingredients, meticulous preparation, and exceptionally beautiful presentation.
We have had an amazing and enjoyable evening.

name: Viet Nam Quan
reviews: Good
Ok

本格的なベトナム料理店です
フォーと春雨に野菜や肉をのせて食べるやつとあげ春巻を食べました。どれも美味しかったです。店主もフレンドリーでした。駐車場が一階で店は2階、少しわかりにくいです。

name: Durbar Sakae
reviews: Based on the high review we decided to give it a try. We ordered the mutton curry with Nan bread, chicken lollipops and chicken karaage. The curry and Nan bread are both quite sweet. Sweet curry on sweet Nan bread is a bit too much. The chicken lollipops is the better dish out of the three. The chicken karaage has quite a bit of batter. The staff is very friendly. A later guest came in and smoke next to us and we were able to move to a different table on the other side of the restaurant. Tight space. The dishes do not taste like Indian food so we assume they are more of Nepalese food. Overall an interesting dining experience.
This place is damn crazy go and check it out food is so delicious
I love this this place this is my favorite place whenever I want to visit Nepali restaurant I just use to visit  this restaurant ❤️

name: Khatulistiwa Skyline Dining
street: Level 10 & Rooftop, Bintang Collectionz Hotel, 68, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews: The place has a great view that you will love! It's a nice place to chill and relax. The food, however, is just okay. If you want a pretty spot to hang out, this is a good choice. Just to add up, the staff here are really friendly and welcoming, which makes the visit even nicer!

Khatulistiwa Skyline Dining is such a lovely place with a beautiful view. The staff are very friendly and approachable, which made the experience even better. It’s an Asian fusion restaurant that serves a mix of Western, Malaysian, Indonesian, and Filipino dishes. The food was enjoyable, the price is reasonable, and the atmosphere is relaxing. Definitely a nice spot to dine and unwind.

P.S: No photos of our food because we were too busy eating, lol 🫣

We came here for dad's birthday. Unfortunately it was raining so we kinda missed out on the main USP of this outlet. Service was good, staff was attentive but Food was below average. Since we didnt really get to enjoy the skyline view, it wasnt worth the trip. Parking was hard, we parked at a neigbouring hotel and walked another 10mins. For muslims, there were no surau in d whole building apparently so u gotta walk to neigbour hotel for his facility. Not gonna repeat this tbh.
we went to ground flr there are other better food options.

name: KUROMON KOZOU
reviews:
美味しかった！
Solid food i wasn’t expecting much before entering this restaurant but wanted to eat tendon for last day in Japan. So delicious wagyu steak bowl and tendon special! And the locals eat here too🙏🏼🥹 Hidden Gem 🔥 foreigner friendly restaurant 🫶🏻
Fast and friendly service, affordable prices. I highly recommend the roast beef rice bowl. The beef was so flavorful and melted in my mouth. The Wagyu sukiyaki rice bowl is also highly recommended!

The gentlemen running the shop were very friendly and energetic. We were actually too full from grazing at the market but wanted to try some tempura. What we liked about this stall is that they cook it to order not like some places on the market where it looked like everything was mass fried before hand and put on display and exposed to the environment where people walk by.
They were ok that we ordered just one each and even had space for us to sit in the stall.
It’s off the main thoroughfare where the crowds are which in my opinion is a plus so you are not squished with the other tourist.
Highly recommend.

name: YuYan Café & Hotel
reviews:
An excellent Tea Shop run by excellent staff. We did two tea tastings here. One was complimentary, and then for the other we tried a favorite tea of one of the staff. We’re not the biggest tea connoisseurs, but the tea was never bitter.

We got to enjoy learning how Chinese tea is brewed, where it is grown, the history of the tea shop owners, and how the flavor of the tea changes with each steep (or even with different teacups!)

This was one of our favorite experiences on our trip. Even if you don’t consider yourself a “tea person,” I would definitely recommend spending some time here.

I was first fascinated with the huge variety of tea ware offered. So many beautiful pieces but alas I could not carry any home. I was interested in the brand and since no other visitor was around, I was given a solo tea ritual ceremony when I expressed my desire to taste some fragrant tea. Li Sheng was not only knowledgeable but quite the tea connoisseur. I was offered 2 grades of oolong tea, both very pleasant in taste. He also offered a third cup of fruit tea for me to try.  I ended buying RM 200 worth of tea when I initially wanted only a chrysanthemum tea. Tea tasting is quite an experience and one should try it if in Chinatown!
Very good Chinese tea with very warm hospitality.

name: Tourist Information and Interaction Centre (TiiC)
street: Lot 02-03 Mezzanine Floor, Central Market Annexe, Jalan Hang Kasturi
reviews:
Eat.. Pray.. Walk and Love. ❤️
Fantastic tour... Kristin our tour guide was lovely. Very informative and took us to some local hotspots. A tasty selection of food mixed with insights into the local culture. Mutabak was my favourite 😋 highly recommend

We took part in a heritage walk in Kuala Lumpur.
There we learned a lot about local history, culture and habits and saw places that we would never have visited on our own account or in a common sightseeing tour. We could ask all questions that occurred to us, not only concerning the tour but also concerning different aspects, e.g. politics or religion and how things work in KL or in Malaysia.The atmosphere was very pleasant and familiar.

What a fun morning with Louis! We had a hugely enjoyable walk around Kuala Lumpur, learning about the history, culture and stories of its cosmopolitan heritage. Louis's enthusiasm and extensive knowledge illuminated the experience significantly. The tour was accompanied by regular stops for delicious tastings of Indian, Chinese and Malay food, as well as temple visits and ceremonies which really brought the city to life. A highly recommended tour and thanks for a terrific morning Louis! Good luck with the KL Half Marathon this weekend! 🤞👍

name: Foo Hwa Kopitiam
reviews: this very old school laneway cafe is part of KL's chinatown heritage. breakfast was great coffee, half boiled eggs and their home made steamed buns with margarine and kaya. it's probably part of a dying breed as the area around especially the laneways gentrify so i'd recommend coming here and taking it in before the only kopitiams left are air conditioned franchises.

Very cute place for breakfast. The owners were extremely friendly - they not only can speak multiple languages, but also customise the flavours for foreigners.

The owner 老闆娘 even chased us to return the 1 dollar as we didn’t eat the half cooked egg. So sweet!

We will definitely come back to visit the next time when we visit KL 💛
Good coffee to start the day exploring KL. The coffee is thick and nice. The service is fantastic, warm and friendly. One coffee costs RM3. Next time will try to enjoy their traditional breakfast.

name: La Pascana
reviews:
What a wonderful restaurant. I’d never had Bolivian food before and enjoyed it a ton. Pictured is the broasted chicken with “cheese rice”. Really good and just ¥1200.

La Pascana has a simple, easygoing atmosphere. It feels like a place where families get together. You WILL hear a lot of Spanish inside, but don’t worry - the woman working there speaks very fluent Japanese. The entire staff is SUPER friendly. The man who brought our food has one of those contagious smiles where you can’t help but smile too.

It’s really great to have a restaurant like this on the border of Yokkaichi and Suzuka!

2025年5月18日（日）20時30分
ステーキアラチョレジャナはステーキと目玉焼きに野菜、ポテト、ご飯はチーズで煮込んであるようで美味しかった。（今回の写真にありませんが、これはよく出ているようです）
モコチンチはほのかに甘いスモモのジュースで始めての味。

（2025年1月の投稿）
ボリビア料理は美味しく、店員さんも良い方です。「ピカンテ・デ・ポチョ」は鶏のピリ辛とフライドライスで美味しく、豚のハンバーガーもボリュームあって満足。前回行ったときは「サルテーニャ」を食べましたが、中に挽肉などが入った料理で1個から注文できます。

20席程の小規模な店ですが、店員さんも親切で1人でも気軽に入れます。
また行きたいと思います。

・エンパナーダ
サクサク甘めのパイ生地の中にチキンオリーブじゃがいもなどがバツバツに詰まっている、辛くないけどスパイス系でしっかり味ある。あまりクセはないながらも「何味か」と言われると難しい、カレーケバブポトフの中間。衝撃的に美味かった。
大きさは男握りこぶし位、重い。3〜4個くらいで満足。1個単位で注文できるみたいな感じあり。

・ケペリ
柔らかく煮た肉とチーズリゾット。味付けはシンプル。リゾットは塩味少なめなので、見た目のボリュームに対しては思いのほか腹に入る。美味い。
リゾット、ノーマル米は選べるっぽい。

自分が行ったときは、日本語完璧な人が2人居て、どっちもいい接客。よく喋る気前のいい女性が居て、食い方の説明してくれた。
食いきれない分は持ち帰りのタッパくれた。

name: 雪の大谷
reviews:
非常壯觀的雪牆
人潮也是很多
哭哭，一片白牆，然後雪之大谷限制參觀（好近…

雪牆行人路段9:30才開放，大家可以自行調節一下時間。
我訂購的是早上八時立山的纜車。上到來只需等候一段時間便可以了。晚一點就給旅遊團淹沒了。

name: Jing
reviews: Loved the vibes of this place. Food was decent.
One of the best burgers I've ever had with a cozy atmosphere

Amazing burgers!

Amazing music!

Amazing owner!

Best in town!

name: Mee Tarik Muslim • Little Bing
reviews: Truly amazing food, with exceptional service. We ordered a lot for three of us, including our toddler. But every single item was worth it. The service provided by Jeffry was top notch. 100/100.

Perfect place to have halal street food at Alor street and rate is also very reasonable. Their skewers are perfectly spiced so that you feel each and every ingredient in it. Noodle bowl was a combo and came with a fried egg, lamb skewers and a coke.
Rate is also very reasonable… Must visit for halal food.

We visited despite the place not having many reviews yet, and overall the food was good.

We ordered beef dumplings (served with a garlic sauce), a set/packaged dish with beef soup + three beef skewers and a can of cola, and a dragon fruit juice. The dumplings were good, and the beef skewers in the soup tasted good as well.

The soup itself was quite mild at first, and it seemed like you’re expected to season it yourself. There were condiments available (a soy-like liquid and a chili paste), and after adding those the soup tasted fine.

One small issue: I asked for the beef skewers not to be spicy, but they still came spicy. It was still edible and okay

name: Putu Piring Jalan Alor • Traditional Food Malaysia
reviews: We stumbled across this cake by accident while walking through the night market, and it turned out to be very good! Soft, fresh, and full of flavor. The price was great too- only 6 RM for 3 pieces. Definitely worth it and a nice surprise during our walk!

Got served soggy putu piring that was sitting in the boxed packaging for a good while. Look at the condensation in the box… My only advice to people is to not bother buying if there’s no queue or insist on a fresh one.
you watch them make it fresh in front of you, very tasty, vegan friendly.

name: Curio L5 Rooftop Cafe @ Chinatown
reviews:
Stumbled upon this cozy rooftop coffee space while wandering around the city. It’s a quiet spot filled with greenery, open skies, and a stunning view of the iconic Merdeka 118 and KL Tower.

They serve delicious curated coffee and non-coffee cocktails.

Perfect for a chill catch-up with friends or some quiet me-time with a book.

The barista and owner are both friendly — happy to chat about coffee if you’re interested.
Coffee with special view and decor, but the menu is quite boring. I wanted to order matcha latte/ coffee latte but they even did not have dairy milk for it!!! 🥹🥹

Awesome cafe in China Town! We’ve been to many cafes in KL and this was by far the best coffee we’ve had so far. The barista, Hazel, adjusted the grind with a few test shots to make sure that the coffee she served was perfect.

The patio is gorgeous, peaceful and has amazing views! Umbrellas are available to provide shade or cover from the rain, which was a really nice touch.

name: Roku Gin
reviews:
Our visit to the Suntory Distillery on January 30 was a standout highlight of our trip. For anyone who appreciates the art of spirits, seeing where Roku Gin is brought to life is a must.

The Experience: The distillery perfectly captures the Japanese concept of 'Shun'—harvesting botanicals at their seasonal peak. The attention to detail is evident everywhere, from the meticulous distillation process to the stunning hexagonal bottles etched with the six signature Japanese botanicals.

The Tasting: Sampling Roku at the source is a revelation. You can truly taste the harmony between the Sakura flower and leaf (Spring), Sencha and Gyokuro teas (Summer), Sansho pepper (Autumn), and Yuzu peel (Winter). It’s a beautifully balanced spirit—silky, floral, and finishing with a gentle, peppery spark.

The Atmosphere: The facility is spotless and staffed by incredibly knowledgeable guides who make the history of the House of Suntory feel alive. Even in the quiet of late January, the grounds were serene and the tasting room offered a warm, welcoming environment to explore their craft.
Nice place to view some murals depicting life in old time Chinatown in KL

It is a historic place situated along the cobbled streets of an old city. It was the perfect place to take a leisurely stroll, taking in the sights and sounds of the bustling street.

The alley was lined with old, stately buildings that had been standing for generations. The buildings had weathered the changes in the climate and time, but still retained their old-world charm. Many of the buildings were ornately decorated and some even had statues or busts of important people along their walls.

name: Pasaraya Bukit Bintang
reviews: Fresh fruit, vegetables,fish are here with reasonable price. Best mini market in Bukit Bintang
Good Food

name: Georgetown Heritage site
reviews: Best way to explore and soak in all the heritage site of Georgetown is by walking. Time stands still at many alleyways and streets. Nevertheless visitors will be surprised to find many cozy cafes and bistro in the vicinity.

Best to visit the Heritage Site in a trishaw as some of the paths are difficult to walk and visiting in the early morning will be less tedious than afternoon which the afternoon heat can affect your emotions and interests to continue the site walk. It’s quite an enriching tour.

아래와 같다고 합니다. 다들 참 열심히 사셨어.

The Swee Hock Chan(서복잔) Godown was a warehouse that once occupied 25 Acheen Street. It belonged to local merchant Goh Say Eng, one of the fervent supporters of Dr Sun Yat Sen and his revolutionary cause. Goh Say Eng was one of the founders of the Chinese Revolutionary Alliance, or Tong Meng Hui as well as the Chinese reading club, the Penang Philomatic Union.

Under the ownership of the Goh family, the Swee Hock Chan Godown was used for various purposes, including as the temporary premises of the Penang Philomatic Union, when it relocated from the Li Teik Seah Building, as well as the office of the Chung Ling High School Alumni.

When the Sun Yat Sen Heritage Trail was created, the Swee Hock Chan Godown as listed as along the sights on the trail.

name: Nicholas Choong Chinatown Wall Art Mural MRT Pasar Seni
reviews: Best place for shopping

name: Suria KLCC
street: Lot No. 241, Level 2Menara, Petronas Twin Tower
reviews:
Suria KLCC is a great place to shop and hang out in Kuala Lumpur. It’s located right next to the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, which already makes the visit special.
The mall is very large and has a really good mix of shops, from luxury brands like Dior to more affordable ones like Uniqlo, so there’s something for everyone. You can easily spend a few hours here without getting bored.
The food options are also solid. The Signature Food Court has plenty of choices, and there are many cafés and coffee shops around the mall if you just want a coffee or a short break.
Overall, it’s a pleasant, well-organized mall with great shopping and dining in an amazing location. Definitely worth a visit.

We visit SURIA KLCC often because our apartment is close to KLCC.  We mostly use the Signature food court as there are a lot of choices of food to eat m, it’s clean and the restrooms are clean.  We enjoy walking out to KLCC park as well.  This is a lovely facility with a lot of benches.  Concierge is excellent and we also shop at Guardian and Isetan for groceries.

🌟 A Premier Experience at the Heart of Kuala Lumpur! 🌟

Date of Visit: 1 February 2026

If you are looking for the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and breathtaking views, Suria KLCC is the place to be. We spent a wonderful day here and were thoroughly impressed by the impeccable cleanliness and the sophisticated atmosphere of the mall.

📱 Tech & Shopping Paradise
Whether you’re a fashionista or a tech enthusiast, this mall has it all. We managed to pick up a few electronic gadgets during our visit—the variety of high-end brands and the latest tech available is truly world-class.

🗼 Iconic Views
One of the highlights of Suria KLCC is its location. Stepping just outside (or looking through the grand windows), the Petronas Twin Towers are visible in all their silver glory. Standing at the foot of these giants makes for an unforgettable photo opportunity!

📜 A Quick Glimpse into History
For those who don't know, Suria KLCC is more than just a mall:

The Vision: It opened its doors in 1998 as part of the Kuala Lumpur City Centre project.

The Design: It was designed to reflect the geometric patterns found in Islamic architecture, mirroring the "Rub el Hizb" star shape of the Twin Towers themselves.

The Name: "Suria" translates to "Sunshine" in Malay, and it certainly lives up to the name by bringing a bright, vibrant energy to the city's skyline.

Verdict: Highly recommended for anyone visiting KL. It’s neat, organized, and offers a premium experience right at the base of the world's tallest twin towers.

name: Pavilion Kuala Lumpur
reviews:
I had an amazing experience at Pavilion Kuala Lumpur in Bukit Bintang. To me, it is truly a first-class shopping mall in every sense. The mall offers an impressive selection of branded boutiques and luxury stores, making it a perfect destination for fashion lovers and anyone who enjoys premium shopping.
The atmosphere is elegant and vibrant, with beautifully designed interiors that make walking through the mall a pleasure. One of the highlights is the stunning fountain at the façade, which creates a grand and welcoming entrance. It’s a wonderful spot for photos, especially in the evening when the lights enhance the beauty of the surroundings.
Beyond shopping, the mall also offers a great variety of dining options and entertainment, making it an ideal place to spend the whole day. Whether you are a tourist or a local, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur delivers a top-tier shopping and lifestyle experience. Highly recommended!

Pavilion Kuala Lumpur is the most luxurious and vibrant shopping destination in the city. My favorite highlights are the spectacular decorations during festive seasons and the stunning Crystal Fountain at the main entrance. It houses world-class luxury brands, diverse dining options, and the charming Tokyo Street. It is an unmissable spot for premium shopping and high-end photography.

This is a vibrant and stylish mall right in the heart of Bukit Bintang. It offers a great mix of luxury brands, trendy shops, and everyday stores, so there’s something for everyone. Food choices are a big highlight — from cafes and desserts to full restaurants and food courts. The atmosphere is lively and modern, with the Crystal Fountain making it a popular photo spot. It can be quite busy on weekends, but overall it’s highly recommended for shopping, dining, and spending a relaxed day in the city.

name: KLCC Park
reviews: One of the best park, I have visited in my life. It had synthetic track, which was surprising to me, nice small fountain every 400 mts to drink cold water. Plus the Petronas twin towers view is astonishing along with other beautiful buildings. You can also visit the mall and the mosque which is all nearby. I liked the overall vibe, the people, the park, hygiene and basically everything. I visited twice for my 10km run over there and I had a nice experience. So, It's a must if you want to chill and enjoy the scenery.

The absolute best spot for photos in KL! Pro-tip: Don't just stay in front of the mall; walk deep into KLCC Park near the whale sculptures for the best unobstructed view of the Twin Towers. Arrive around 6:45 PM to catch the "Blue Hour" when the towers start to glow against the darkening sky. The Lake Symphony fountain show (starts at 8 PM) is a beautiful way to end the night. It’s free, family-friendly, and has the best vibes in the city! 📸

The views of the Petronas Towers from inside the park are just fantastic. If you’re lucky enough to catch it in a good weather day it’s just stunning. I stayed at the same spot for ages as this building is just a marvel to look at. Very iconic you cannot miss this place

name: Kurobe Dam
reviews: An impressive feat of engineering. They give you around 16 min to transfer from the Kanden electric bus to the cable car. Walking from the bus across the dam takes around 10 min at a brisk pace. However you might want to slow down and look around, it's beautiful. We however opted to slow down for the return journey to maximise up in Murodo. On the way back, there is a 40 min gap between the cable car and bus transfer back in the afternoon so time to enjoy the dam then.

Absolutely magnificent! 🍂 Visiting Kurobe Dam in October was unforgettable, the earthy autumn colors, the rainbow terrace, and the scenic views all along the route were stunning. Also as always, Japan is so thoughtful in accommodating tourists, combining the nature and how they made it easy for all people to hike, even though it’s a short uphill hike from the station to the top, the views make it more than worth it. Every step of the trip was memorable, with breathtaking scenery everywhere ✨✨✨

It is a beautiful and magnificent as it can be!

It was built at 61 years ago according to our. Tours guide. And 171 people were lost during the construction!

The lights rain on the day of our visit did not affect its beauty. The dam and the lake  really made this place magical!

All four seasons will give this place a different and unique face, so it is worth of coming back sometime!

We also saw a performance in front of gift shot even is raining! What a fantastic performance!

name: Halab Penang Arabic Restaurant
reviews:
I recently visited Halab Restaurant, and it was a wonderful dining experience from start to finish. The moment I stepped inside, I was welcomed with warm hospitality and a comfortable ambience that made me feel relaxed right away.
The food was the highlight—beautifully presented, flavourful, and truly authentic. Every dish was cooked to perfection, especially the grilled meats and signature Middle Eastern specialties. The portions were generous, and the ingredients tasted fresh.
The staff were friendly, attentive, and always ready to help with recommendations. Service was fast, and the overall environment was clean and well-maintained.
If you're looking for delicious Middle Eastern cuisine with excellent service, Halab Restaurant is definitely worth visiting. I would happily return again!

Visited with family while travelling to Penang. Had an amazing dinner in this restaurant!

The dining environment is comfortable and the waiter has been helpful.
The restaurant offer variety authentic Arabic cuisine. We ordered salad, chicken shawarma and chicken mandi rice. The shawarma is definitely worth ordering! The skin dough is thin and crispy, with generous amount of chicken meat, make the perfect texture and flavour!
The mutton is tender and flavourful, goes perfectly with the rice. The price is a little high, but it's definitely worth.

As a Syrian, I can tell you that Halab Penang is absolutely amazing! The atmosphere is warm, the staff are super friendly, and the food? Truly authentic, just like back home in Syria. I’ve tried fatteh with ghee,, falafel, shakshukah, appetizers, and main courses, and honestly, I’ve been back many times because everything is that good. They are also incredibly generous with both the food and their hospitality. Every bite is full of flavor, perfectly prepared. If you want real Syrian food in Penang, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommend!

name: Halab KL Arabic Restaurant
reviews:
We had dinner here and oh my—everything we ordered was absolutely delicious! We were served by Tahshin, and every dish we tried was based on his recommendations… and he nailed it.

The baba ganoush was incredibly fresh, the lamb shawarma Halab was packed with flavor and generously portioned, and the lamb cubes were juicy and perfectly cooked. Tahshin even guided us on the best way to enjoy the dishes, which made the experience even better.

Definitely looking forward to coming back to try more dishes—next time for sure!

We came here for lunch on a Friday around 11:30 AM, about a 10-minute walk from our hotel, and it was a great choice for our first meal in Malaysia. We ordered the mixed kebab platter (RM 65), which was very generous and easily enough for two people. The meat was cooked perfectly, juicy, and full of flavor. We also had fresh watermelon and mango juices, both refreshing and delicious, followed by a rice pudding and lemon-mint juice — everything tasted excellent.

The restaurant is very clean and comfortable, and it filled up quickly with both locals and tourists. A special thanks to Tahsin, who was extremely friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome. Overall, great food quality, fair prices, and warm service — I would definitely come back and highly recommend this place if you’re in Bukit Bintang.

I tried three Arabic restaurants in Kuala Lumpur, and I believe Halab is the best among them for Syrian Arabic food. The food was amazing, the service was very good, and the staff were friendly.

I have eaten in many restaurants, but Halab was the only one that provided extra tissues and wet wipes without me having to ask 😃. In many other restaurants, you need to ask several times for these small things.

After food a Watermelon has given to us as a complementary 🤩

Overall, it was a great experience.

name: WHEELER'S
reviews:
Very good food - we really enjoyed our meals here. I got the chicken panini and my boyfriend got the fruit bowl.

Service could be better, waiting 25 minutes for an avocado smoothie is ridiculous. I wish they served food all at once with drinks first, but we got our food and then drinks were much later.

If you’re going to charge western prices, then I expect a more efficient and attentive service.

To be fair, sounds like the manager heard my feedback and gave us 10 MYR voucher.

If you only have time for one cafe in Penang, make it Wheeler’s. Located on the iconic Love Lane, this place perfectly blends great food with a relaxing atmosphere. The portions were generous and the ingredients felt very fresh. Their coffee game is strong, too; the latte was smooth with just the right amount of acidity.
The staff are incredibly attentive despite how busy it gets. Even though there’s often a short queue, the turnaround is fast. It’s a great spot to escape the Penang heat for an hour or two. Highly recommended!

The vibe is relaxed and artsy, Their menu offers a good mix of Western and local flavors, with clearly marked vegetarian and vegan options—something I really appreciated. It’s a bit pricier than your average local eatery, but the quality, atmosphere, and service make it worth every ringgit. If you’re exploring Georgetown and want a break with great food, good coffee, and a cozy vibe, Wheeler’s Cafe is a must-visit.

name: Niko Neko Matcha 2.0 / Chinatown
reviews: Super good matcha! The matcha flavour is very kaw (strong and rich). I ordered a hot matcha with no milk and no sugar, and the taste was still very smooth and fragrant. The matcha gelato also has a strong matcha taste. Very satisfied and the place is comfortable too.

🍵 A truly authentic matcha café — straight from Japan (yes, we did our investigation with the staff 🤪).
We ended up with the Tsuyuhikari M1 Matcha (no sugar, of course) and the Ajisai 2.0 Matcha Burnt Cheesecake — and wow… both literally exploded in our mouths 😱
I’m not exaggerating when I say the matcha here is something special. Deep, bold, and clean — the kind of flavor that matcha lovers will instantly appreciate. If you’re serious about matcha, this place is a must-visit.
The burnt cheesecake deserves its own applause: thick matcha flavor on one side, rich and creamy cheese on the other. Perfect balance.
💸 Price-wise, it’s on the higher side — but that’s expected for premium-grade matcha like this.
👉 Definitely worth a visit… and a second visit… and a third… you get the idea 😄

We ordered a Kiyone matcha latte with fresh milk no sugar hot, tsubaki houjicha with oat milk no sugar iced, a yuri matcha strawberry rouladr and a ajisai matcha tsubaki houjicha burnt cheesecake.

Everything was amazing!

I loved my matcha latte, it was very umami, and even without sugar, it was sweet enough and very well balanced. It was matcha forward, I have tried so many matcha latte that is too milk forward and the matcha is so diluted.

The hojicha was super yummy too, the oat milk went well with the houjicha.

Every cup is hand made and not like other cafes, batch made.

Highly recommended.

name: Daikanbo
reviews:
What a view before we descend to the Dam.
Only lament is one can’t really explore the area around the stop here. Much of the entire Alpine trip here is controlled and protected from too much tourist interference. Good job in protecting the nature in pristine conditions.

This place is the last stop on Alpine tour in Japan which was covered by 7 modes of transport .The mountain covered with snow was beautiful.The best is the road between Snow walls which has reached about 16 metres

This is our number one destination in Japan!!

Totally worth it!!

We traveled on 19 Nov and arrive at the top 12.20 PM.

Prepare your shoes for the snow at this time.

Sun glasses are a must!!

Be sure to pack your lunch since there was only one shop selling hot Soba here.

name: Me’nate Ampang - Steak & Middle Eastern (M-City Ampang)
reviews: The food is delicious and the environment is very comfortable. The staff are kind and friendly. Tareq and Iskandar are efficient employees who provide excellent service. Willingly taking any orders.

Thank you Iskandar, without you there, my wife and I would definitely just left the restaurant. We just asked how the loyalty redemption works and the way the other staff respond was so unprofessional. We just want to celebrate our anniversary there but the service a bit disappointed. Luckily, Iskandar helps us. Please give him rise.

Worst thing is when there was 1 foreign staff serve hot mushroom soup, and place it near with my baby, and left it there.

While another staff serve our hot mac and cheese, he told us "this is hot" and carefully serve near me instead of my baby. Please investigate that staff but I do not have his name as he did not wear his name tag on that moment. He just ruin the moment and the brand.

Thank you Iskandar.

Idk what to say, maybe i should move on, the reputation went down , definitely not like before. Came here to bring my sister for her birthday celebration as she wants steak. Came all the way far but to my dissapointment the meat not tender and lagi sgt2 kecewa the mashed potato served basi . I ask to see the chef/ cook, he replaced it and said the mashed potato baru buat harini which hard to believe and he offered to replace which he did but damage has been done. Also, the cake, even the staff tak berani nak serve the cake , he said maybe not okay or idk he just dont really speak fluent Bahasa or English.

Ambience idk, berbau kepam and meja melekit.

Then staff cakap we gave discount, dis i ask?

Im so dissapointed. Never again ….

name: Dolly Dim Sum, Suria KLCC
street: Suria Klcc, Petronas Twin Tower, Lot 426-428, 4th Floor
reviews:
Had a delightful dim sum experience at Dolly Dim Sum in KLCC. The restaurant offers a modern interpretation of a traditional Chinese teahouse, with a cozy and stylish interior that makes it a comfortable place to dine and relax.  
Dolly Dim Sum +1
The dim sum selection was impressive, featuring both classic favorites and creative signature dishes. The har gow and siew mai were fresh and flavorful, with juicy fillings and delicate wrappers. The crispy shrimp cheong fun stood out with its nice contrast between the soft rice roll and the crunchy shrimp inside.  
The Yum List
Service was attentive and efficient, and the food arrived promptly despite the busy lunch crowd. The ambiance is bright and welcoming, making it suitable for casual meals, family gatherings, or even business lunches.
Overall, Dolly Dim Sum delivers a solid dim sum experience with good quality dishes and pleasant service. Prices are slightly on the higher side, but the location in Suria KLCC and the overall dining experience make it worthwhile.

First visit here at close to 9pm and just looking for a small bite.  Ordered Cheong fun chicken ,Stuffed Chicken drummettes and sweet sour beancurd rolls.  All the items are flavourful and delicious.  Dining environment is also spacious bright and comfortable.

Overall, the experience was average. The all-day dim sum selection was decent, but nothing really stood out. The beef fried kway teow was quite oily, which affected the taste.  Personally only enjoyed the chewy meat croquettes.  Service and atmosphere were acceptable, but there wasn’t anything memorable enough to make it a must-visit.

name: Gaburi Chicken Osu 3-Chome
reviews: The food was amazing and service too! The white peach and orange drink was wonderful, thank you to Kotekote for their service!

amazing service. great staff. wonderful late night dinner. plenty options on the menu. tried most of their chicken dishes + their award winning chicken dish. all enjoyable. their recommended pudding was both adorable and delicious. they even got their own brand of soda to pair with chicken. a good late night visit to clear the munchies.

Chicken was delicious - crunchy outside and moist inside. Online ordering with English options. Drink sizes were pretty generous. Nice casual vibe to meet up with friends.
The desserts are pretty good too, the pudding was adorable (see picture)

name: Murodo-daira
reviews: Murodo Plateau is located at the summit of Mount Tateyama, boasting beautiful mountain ranges and incredibly picturesque scenery. There are plenty of tourists enjoying the views, and at some popular photo spots, queues are to be expected.
too beautiful, you will spend quite some time here at murodo

Simply amazing, am still wondering how they cut through the snow to form the wall. Unfortunately, we chose the wrong day to go and there was a blizzard. So visitors were not allowed to venture out. So near, yet so far as the wall is right in front but couldn't walk to it.

name: Michelangelo's Ristorante Italiano
street: Lot C3 . 04 . 00, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur, 168, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews:
The food was totally beyond my expectations—seriously so good! Prices are very reasonable, totally worth it. Definitely coming back.

Service was great too, especially the guy who helped us (forgot to ask his name, but he was really lively and thoughtful). He even suggested switching tables for us when we wanted all the dishes served together—so considerate.

The place isn’t very big, but the vibe is super cozy and relaxing. The Christmas decorations also added such a nice touch 🎄

Highly recommend!

We celebrated my dad’s birthday at Michelangelo’s on our recent trip, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The food was delicious, the atmosphere warm and inviting, and the entire team made us feel so welcomed.

A special shout-out to Bhagya, who went above and beyond from start to finish. Her attentiveness, genuine warmth, and thoughtful service made the celebration extra meaningful for my dad and the whole family.

Thank you, Michelangelo’s, for making our evening so memorable. We’ll definitely be back! 💛🎉🍽️

Servers name was Vert.
He was very attentive, welcoming and great at his job.

Salad with pear n Blue was superb

Carpaccio very good, although not keen on the mushrooms.

Risotto and Fettucine Ragu were very good, as was the Italian Wines.

Thank you to Vert who made the dining experience that much better.

- Liza

name: Yeast Bistronomy
reviews:
Met a couple of friends over lunch at Yeast. It was their recommendations that we try it.

Really good food and service. The taste of food is different, in a good way.

Would suggest you try this place the next time you are in Bangsar and looking to have lunch or dinner.

Must haves: Oysters, Fish.

Previously I came here for breakfast and it was good. This time we came here for Christmas dinner. The staff that serving us is friendly and accommodating, the food was good and delicious, the price is also reasonable, the portion is just right  and can be for sharing,  they also gave us a lot of breads, they even give us a loaf of bread after we finished our dinner.

Dropped by Yeast at Bangsar and it was an okay experience. The hot chocolate was the highlight — rich, smooth, and comforting.

The French toast, however, didn’t really work for me. The texture and overall flavour felt a bit off, and it wasn’t as satisfying as I expected (especially for a place known for bakes/brunch).

Overall: worth a try if you’re nearby and want a good drink, but I wouldn’t come specifically for the French toast.

name: Rainbow Skywalk @The TOP Penang
reviews:
Visiting the Rainbow Skywalk was one of the most exciting parts of my time at The TOP Penang. Standing on the glass walkway high above the city feels thrilling, especially when you look straight down and realize how high up you are. It’s a mix of fear and fun, but once you take that first step, it turns into a really memorable experience. The views of George Town and the sea from up there are amazing, and it’s a perfect spot for photos, especially during sunset or early evening when the sky colors look beautiful.

The area is well organized, and staff guide visitors properly to make sure everyone feels safe. Even if you’re scared of heights, it’s worth trying because it feels secure and well maintained. It can get busy, so you may need to wait a bit for your turn to take photos, but the experience is still worth it. Overall, Rainbow Skywalk is a must try if you enjoy unique viewpoints and want to challenge yourself while seeing Penang from a whole new perspective.

Guess I came over at the wrong time, which was near mid-day. The rooftop restaurant and deck were deserted - can imagine the place to be a lot more lively when it cools down in the evening.

The main attraction here is the glass bridge. The access is included in the TOP observatory ticket. One can take professional pictures on the glass bridge with added fee of RM 50, which is kinda overpriced.

Walking on the Skywalk in Penang was an experience I’ll never forget. The glass floor beneath my feet made my heart race, but the view was absolutely worth it endless blue sky, the city stretching far below, and the sea shimmering in the distance. The higher I went, the more peaceful it felt a mix of adrenaline and awe.

If you love a little adventure mixed with stunning scenery, the Skywalk is a must visit. A legendary view, especially at sunset where the sky turns gold, and the island looks like it’s glowing. 🌅💛

name: Rossi Italian
reviews:
Overall, it was a great experience. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. The pasta was good, though slightly less salty than expected. Everything we ordered was served quickly and nicely presented.

The service was friendly, and the atmosphere was chill and welcoming, making it a comfortable place to dine. However, we noticed that water was not served when we were seated. The food portions were decent. The fried seafood was so-so, nothing particularly outstanding.

Prices are reasonable for the overall experience. It’s also a nice place for anniversary or birthday celebrations, thanks to the pleasant ambience.

Rossi Italian 🇮🇹 truly exceeded my expectations. I didn’t expect such a beautiful Italian-style restaurant to be tucked inside a hotel — it was a lovely surprise. The Italian vibes are just right: cozy, elegant, and relaxing, paired with a beautiful environment and a pleasant view.
The food was simply perfect — well-presented, full of flavour, and clearly made with quality ingredients. Every dish was satisfying and thoughtfully prepared.
What made the experience even more special was the service. All the staff were polite, friendly, and attentive. They even went the extra mile by giving a sweet birthday greeting to our boss and colleague, thoughtfully represented by the team — such a warm and memorable touch that truly made us feel valued.
Overall, Rossi Italian offers an excellent dining experience with great ambiance, delicious food, and outstanding hospitality. Highly recommended and definitely a place we would love to return to. 🍝🍷✨

I’m absolutely in love with this place mostly because every restaurant in Penang is closed during Chinese new year and or they require you to order big family sets (8-10 pax) This was one of the only places that let you order à la cart and the food is actually really decent for the price!! Paid about 60MB/person can’t believe we got this level of food 😂 other than the fact service is kind of terrible, no one responds to your requests but who cares. At this price I can deal with anything . They do decorations special occasions, roses and candles or birthday set up. It’s actually pretty sweet definitely recommend! Do try their lamb and risotto !

name: Serai@KLCC
reviews:
Came for Iftar with my Collegues, around 20+ people. reservation process was smooth for breaking fast was smooth. Service was great, staff was very attentive with what their customer requests.

main food was mediocre tbh. but the dessert berry pavlova was chef's kiss 😙🤌🏻✨ love it veru much

We had lunch here. The decor is nice and seats comfortable. Food was served soon after ordering. The nasi ulam was delicious and the other dishes we ordered were also tasty. The sambal and chilli sauces had a good spicy kick and very addictive. Food presentation was very good, even for something simple like char kuey teow. The serai drink was refreshing. We had a nice lunch here.

Understandably, service can be slower during lunch hours, especially since the restaurant appeared to be short-staffed. However, the service was still much slower than expected. On a positive note, the food was surprisingly great, as I’ve always felt this restaurant was somewhat overrated. The quality of the food definitely stood out despite the wait.

Spicy thai rice is 9/10

name: Lagenda House & Cafe
reviews: I had a good experience dining here. The food are all delicious. Really love the atmosphere which is calm. The servers are all very good at their job. Will come again insha Allah.
Good and tasty food, it arrived quickly and staff is very friendly. The place is clean and also western people stomach friendly, not too spicy and clean. I recommend this place if you are new to city
Dinner with friends.  We had a pleasant experience.  Foods are amazing and nicely presented.  Loves the vibes & the in-house music i.e Tan Sri P Ramlee's songs create the classic & nostalgic mood.

name: Kurobe Dam Observatory and Rest House
street: Ashikuraji, 字ブナ坂外11 国有林内
reviews: Beautiful views although the climb to the observatory was not for the faint hearted. The connection to the dam is near the bottom of the outdoor observatory stairs. Perpetual rainbow when the sun hits the water discharge. Recommend to spend around 20 minutes before making a move to the next part.

can be tiring to climb up the stairs to the highest point
many beetles/bugs on the railing along the dam, hence i didnt wanna stand near it for photos because of it 😔

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Visiting Kurobe Dam was an incredible experience! The breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and the impressive engineering of the dam itself are truly awe-inspiring. The panoramic observation deck offers stunning vistas, and the serene atmosphere makes it a perfect spot for nature lovers. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Japan!

name: The Hungry Tapir
reviews:
Our visit to The Hungry Tapir turned out to be a lovely surprise. This plant-based restaurant is truly a hidden gem. We ordered the Glowing Guardian salad, the Ay-Yam Geprek burger, the Pink Bombshell burger, and a mixed fresh juice — and everything was a hit.

Both burgers were delicious, but the Pink Bombshell stole the show. Its bright pink bun, made with beetroot, gave it a fun look and a unique flavor. It came with sweet potato fries and was easily the highlight of the meal.

The service was warm and attentive, and the atmosphere was calm and cozy. With soft lighting, comfortable seating, and gentle music playing in the background, it felt like the perfect place to relax and enjoy good food. Portions were generous, prices were fair, and the overall experience was excellent.

I’ll definitely be back to try more from their menu.

Always love checking out vegan places. We had a wonderful meal. Portion size is large. Satay and burger were excellent.  The salad sides were fresh and delish. A note to have more salad next time.. Nasi lemak was ok, rendang was tasty, tempeh was a disappointment for me, the vegetable side was overcooked and bland, rice could be more fragrant …  only issue is almost every dish is fried ….
Love that they stick Wild Kombucha, my fav go to brand.
Overall a nice experience, will be back to try the other food

Tucked away in the heart of KL, The Hungry Tapir is a cosy bistro-style vegan spot that blends local flavours with Western-inspired comfort food. The vibe is relaxed and artsy, making it a fun place to hang out even if you’re not strictly vegan.
One of their must-tries is the Nasi Lemak, one of the house signatures. It comes generously loaded with sides like tempeh and hedgehog mushrooms, making the dish hearty and satisfying despite being fully plant-based. The flavours are well-balanced and surprisingly filling.
The “Fried Cheeken” is made from battered oyster mushrooms. Crispy on the outside and juicy inside, it’s perfect for nibbling and sharing at the table.
Another highlight is Mama’s Satay — marinated hedgehog mushroom skewers that are nicely crunchy with a smoky, savoury flavour. Paired with a rich peanut satay sauce, this dish really hits close to home for local taste buds.
As for the kombucha, it definitely leans towards the strong side. The fermentation taste is quite intense and noticeably sour, with a sharp tang that lingers. Kombucha lovers who enjoy bold, punchy flavours might appreciate it, but personally, it was a bit too sour for my liking.
Overall, if you have vegan friends or you’re looking for a more fun, creative take on vegan food in KL, The Hungry Tapir is worth checking out. 🌱🍽️

name: Marble 8 Steakhouse & Fine Dining Restaurant
reviews: Brought overseas friends here who wanted to try a premium steakhouse in KL. The overall experience was smooth from arrival to dessert. The team explained the different Wagyu grades clearly and even recommended suitable wine pairings. The steaks were consistently prepared and beautifully plated. My guests were impressed not just with the food, but also the professional service. It’s a good place to showcase a high-end dining experience in the city.

Marble 8, Kuala Lumpur is one of those rare spots where the entire experience feels elevated from the moment you arrive. The setting alone is worth a visit — perched high above the city, the sublime view of the KL skyline sets the stage for an unforgettable evening. Watching the lights flicker on while enjoying a glass of wine adds a touch of theatre to dinner that few restaurants can match.

The star of the night, of course, was the steak. Perfectly cooked to the requested doneness, it arrived with a beautiful sear on the outside and a tender, juicy interior that showed off the kitchen’s skill. What made it even more memorable was the pairing with roasted garlic — simple, fragrant, and just enough sweetness to complement the rich, savory meat. It’s the kind of detail that transforms a great steak into a perfect one.

Service was polished yet warm, striking that balance between professionalism and genuine hospitality. From wine suggestions to ensuring the timing of dishes matched the pacing of the evening, the staff enhanced the experience without ever intruding on it.

In short: Marble 8 is not just about steak, it’s about the full package — world-class food, thoughtful pairings, attentive service, and a view that makes the city itself part of your dinner. A place to mark special occasions or to remind yourself why fine dining in KL can stand tall among the best.

I’ve found the best steakhouse in Kuala Lumpur!
The atmosphere is calm and perfect for a date night.
You can get an incredibly well-made steak here, cooked exactly the way you like it.

Highly recommended if you’re a steak lover!

name: Kobe Beef Steak Restaurant Mouriya Honten
street: Shimoyamatedori, 2 Chome−1−17 モーリヤビル
reviews:
We had an amazing dining experience at Royal Mouriya. The Kobe beef was incredibly tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked right in front of us. You can truly taste the quality of the meat — it was one of the best meals we had in Japan.

The teppanyaki chefs were very professional and skilled, making the whole experience enjoyable and entertaining. The staff were also warm, attentive, and made us feel very well taken care of throughout the meal.

Everything from the food to the service was excellent. This is definitely a must-visit if you want to experience authentic Kobe beef. Highly recommended!

We had a fantastic experience here at Mouriya. We got lucky enough to get in without a lunch reservation. We got a private room where the chef cooked right in front of us. The onion soup was our appetizer and it was delightful. The steak was absolutely perfect. I got the Kobe beef A5 sirloin, and my friends got the A5 Wagyu (non-Kobe) rib eye. You cannot share pieces between guests. The chef was so nice and friendly, as were all the staff taking care of us. The price was extremely reasonable for what we got. We traveled from Kyoto to visit, and it was more than worth it. This restaurant should absolutely have a Michelin star. I highly recommend trying this restaurant!!

We did a walk in without issue for lunch on a weekday, but several parties had a reservation. I'd recommend making one if you're visiting during high season, but we were coming for lunch on a weekday so we didn't. Probably the most expensive meal of our trip.

Service was impeccable. Meat lived up to expectations. They also ask you if you're okay with all the vegetable sides they offer with the set, so it seems like you have some leeway there (we accepted everything, but probably could have declined the mushrooms, for example). We rolled out of there sufficiently full and satisfied.

name: Steak & Hamburger Steak Gottie's BEEF UNIVERSAL CITYWALK OSAKA
street: Shimaya, 6 Chome−2−61 ユニバーサル・シティウォーク大阪 ５Ｆ
reviews: We had the Double Cheeseburger and Double Cheeseburger Cheese Sauce, both were delicious. The service was great and the Atmosphere was Welcoming. My husband and I shared our meals and it was fulfilling. The Mango Beer was Yummy and my Husband had the Draft Beer. Thank you to the Gentleman who served us, we give him 10 stars!

Incredible! Steak was delicious. All three of my kids (9,6,3) kept telling me they wanted more!!!! The waiter was incredible. He hand made miniature origami pigs and the kids got to pick their favourite colour. The kids all got a free toy as well. Definitely recommend! The kids keep begging me to go back!

Amazing meal and experience! We tried the max gimmick cheesy Cheeseburger drowning in bubing sheese sauce as well as the Osaka Special with triple meats. Delicious food and good vibes if you're in Universal City Walk Japan.

name: Le Mirch
street: Level 4, on Rooftop, Above, Avenue K, 156, Jln Ampang
reviews:
I had a wonderful dinner ( birthday celebration for my father in law ) and everything exceeded my expectations. The food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. Every dish was full of flavor and clearly made with care.
What really made the experience special was the service ( Sojul ) The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome from start to finish. They were happy to answer questions and made sure we were comfortable the entire evening.
Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience, and I will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and excellent service!

Had such an amazing dinner tonight and highly recommend coming here!

First, the service was the best we’ve experienced so far! We have a toddler and a baby and never felt fully welcomed at other restaurants, but Le Mirch was quick to accommodate us with two high chairs and children plates and cutlery. They also periodically checked in on us and we really appreciated the top-notch service. Everyone there was very professional and warm.

Second, the food was delicious. My husband is vegetarian and this is the first restaurant that had so many vegetarian options! We loved every dish we got.

Third, the view and overall atmosphere was nice. We sat outside and although it ended up raining, we still had a great meal together and enjoyed the music and views.

✨ A Magical Birthday Dinner by the Twin Towers ✨

We had the most unforgettable candle-light dinner here for my birthday, my husband surprised me right in front of the Twin Towers, and this restaurant made the night even more special.

The food was incredibly delicious and tempting, every dish full of flavour and presented beautifully. The serving was perfect, and we felt truly taken care of from start to finish.

A special mention to Ramzan, who served us that night, he was absolutely amazing. His communication was warm and professional, and he even took a video of us that looked straight out of a movie.

The environment was clean, cosy, and romantic, the perfect vibe for a special celebration.

Highly, highly recommend this place for anyone looking to create a beautiful memory. ❤️✨

name: Sun Yat Sen Museum Penang
reviews: The Sun Yat Sen Museum in George Town was one of the most meaningful stops on our heritage walk. The house itself is beautiful and full of history, but what made the visit special was Emily’s tour. She explained everything in a clear and engaging way, making it easy for you to understand the life of Sun Yat Sen and his connection to Penang. You learn how this house served as a base for revolutionary activities and how important Penang was in supporting his movement. The exhibits, photos, and preserved rooms help you picture what life was like during that time. The short discussion about his vision and leadership adds depth to the experience, not just as history but as a story of determination and change. We also had a quick meet and greet with other foreign visitors, which made the visit feel more interactive and friendly. Overall, it’s a small museum but rich in stories, and the guided experience really brings the place to life.

My visit to this museum last September was truly memorable, mainly because of Gerald, an incredibly knowledgeable guide who took the time to accompany me throughout the tour and explain the museum’s history with great clarity and eloquence.

He also impressed me with his awareness of political history beyond Malaysia, including Indonesia, where I’m from. Even though I was the only English-speaking visitor at the time, I felt very welcomed. Gerald guided me from the front of the house all the way to the kitchen area at the back. It honestly felt like a private tour session with him haha.

The museum itself isn’t very large, but its collection is well-curated and diverse. The layout makes it easy to follow the narrative and understand the historical context behind each exhibit.

I highly recommend this museum to anyone visiting Penang. You’ll gain meaningful insights into Sun Yat Sen’s influence and the legacy he left in the city.

Sun Yat Sen Museum is an excellent heritage site for anyone interested in modern Chinese history. The house at 120 Armenian Street is beautifully preserved by the same family whose ancestors once hosted Dr Sun Yat Sen during his visits to Penang. The museum presents a focused and well curated narrative of his activities on the island. Penang was home to some of the most influential Chinese communities outside China and played a key role in supporting his revolutionary work. One of his speeches delivered here included the striking line: You, offer money; the comrades in our homeland offer their lives.
The collection features photographs, documents, and memorabilia that clearly illustrate his fundraising efforts, political meetings, and the founding of a newspaper that is still published today. The displays are concise, informative, and respectful of the historical context.
A special mention goes to Carina, the staff member who guided me through the exhibition. Her explanations were clear, engaging, and helpful, and she added valuable background that enriched the visit.
Overall, this museum is a highly recommended stop for visitors who appreciate well-presented history and meaningful cultural heritage.

name: Ome by Spacebar Coffee
reviews:
We came here with my husband on September 27, 2025 at around 9:00 AM before heading to the airport. It was our last stop in Penang.

We ordered a coffee and some kind of orange juice (I forgot the exact name), and both tasted amazing. My husband even said it was one of the best coffees he has ever had. They also sell several cake options, but unfortunately we didn’t try any because we were in a hurry.

The place is quite small but feels very cozy. In front of the café, there were beautiful purple flowers that made the place even more charming. When we visited, it was very crowded — almost all the tables were occupied.

They also sell cute Malaysia-themed merchandise, which was really tempting. It’s such a shame we didn’t have time to properly dine in and enjoy the atmosphere.

If we ever come back to Penang, we will definitely visit this place again.

🫧🥨

First time to Penang and its no surprise why this cafe is the most coveted for filter/speciality coffee on the island. Ebbie is an outstanding barista and I mean outstanding. She made me two coffees from two regions I would ordinarily not gravitate to and they were exceptional. Friendly affable and just such a warm space to visit. Coupled that by Shen one of the co-owners, who is a master Baker. She was so welcoming, constantly smiling. It's an amazing cafe and one that should be visited. Shout out to Pablo from KL who roasted in conjunction with ome a lovely 🇪🇹 natural on batch brew. If you want exceptional filter coffee, espressos and batch brew. This is the space!

Hands down, best coffee i had so far in Penang. The place is small but very cozy. I had hot white single shot which is very comfortable to drink and they steamed the milk perfectly. The crumble cake is also good, very generous with the fruit filling and wasn’t too sweet (which is a compliment).
They also provide some books for you to read. The lighting is warm with some natural lighting. Inside is cool enough to safe you from outside scorching hot sun.
Overall i will definitely be back for a good cup of coffee and the mood.

name: Mikuriga-ike Pond
reviews:
Went 3 days ago to great weather . It just started snowing earlier this week so the whole tateyama mountain is snow covered above 2000m
Gorgeous views. Initially wanted to come see fall leaves but this is better!

Visited may 23rd
Beautiful alpine lake. 10 minutes walk from the main hub of Murodo.
You may get a bit wet on the way there, but it's totally worth it
It doesn’t make sense. The most beautiful nature landscape I’ve ever seen. Alpine Route.

name: Pavilion Crystal Fountain
reviews: This place is really nice and classy. It looks especially beautiful at night when the lights reflect off the crystal. It’s a great spot to stop for photos and enjoy the Bukit Bintang vibe while shopping or walking around Pavilion. Not a long show, but definitely worth checking out when you’re nearby.

Pavilion Crystal Fountain is a great urban landmark right outside Pavilion KL! The towering crystal waterfalls and vibrant hibiscus sculpture are absolutely mesmerizing, especially as the light catches the cascading water. It’s always buzzing with people – locals, tourists, and selfie lovers – yet still feels spacious and welcoming. A beautiful spot for photos day or night, and conveniently located next to shops and public transport. A must-see slice of art and serenity in the heart of Bukit Bintang!

4.5 stars
It's one of the icon of KL. It's also a kind of glass art sitting outside the entrance of popular Pavillion KL.
3.6 meters in height and 6 meters in width. The fountain features the blooms of hibiscus (the national flower of Malaysia- symbol of opulence, passion and progression). Three bowls represent harmony Malaysian multi-racial culture. The water converging from all directions represents endless blessings and prosperity.
It's beautiful and colorful particular when the lights are on at night. Busy and hustle there. So crowded at weekends.

name: 好時節 | Restaurant Good Timing
reviews:
Best spot, right in the middle of Alor Street, you can take picture on both side of the road.

BEST BUTTER MILK CHICKEN!
And they serve Halal Char Kuey Teow

Best steamed cockles I have ever had. Tasted like oyster, with perfect tenderness and very very fresh. I thought it’s going to be bland, but it was steamed with salt, chilli and basil, resulting in rich yet light flavour. Eat while still hot.

Penang Kweytiao wasn’t worth it, just order seafood instead.

STAY AWAY! Don’t believe the photos in the menu. Portions are tiny. The grilled stingray was super dry like overcooked until dead. The salted egg squid was super chewy, worse than chewing rubber. The oyster omelette egg was thin like paper. This has to be the worse seafood place I have ever eaten along Alor. Avoid this place at all cost and don’t believe the ratings.

name: Ciccio Bar Pizzeria
reviews:
If I could give this restaurant six stars, I would! Ciccio quickly became one of our favourite places to eat in Kuala Lumpur. My husband is gluten-free (I’m not), so we were able to try both the regular and gluten-free menu — and honestly, everything we ate was outstanding.

What really sets Ciccio apart is how genuinely accommodating they are for gluten-free diners. My husband was able to enjoy gluten-free bruschetta, pasta, and pizza, and incredibly, there were multiple gluten-free dessert options too. In a city where gluten-free can be very hit-or-miss, this was such a relief and made dining out feel relaxed rather than stressful.
The food itself was delicious and authentic — proper Italian cooking done well. There was absolutely no sense that the gluten-free dishes were a “lesser” option; they were just as flavourful and thoughtfully prepared as the regular meals I enjoyed.

The service deserves a special mention. Franco, the manager, runs a wonderful team, and Sue and Grace, our waitresses, were an absolute joy. They were warm, attentive, and genuinely kind, and remembered us across visits, which made us feel so welcome.

Ciccio is the kind of place you leave already planning your next visit. Whether you’re gluten-free or not, I couldn’t recommend it more highly to anyone wanting authentic, delicious Italian food while in Kuala Lumpur!

Grazie Franco and Ciccio!

NB - Important regarding price indication: Price indicated in this review encompassed 2x appetizers, 1x regular pizza, 2x gluten free pizzas, 6x drinks, and 2x desserts (yes I am aware it is a lot of food but it's SO GOOD!!!!!)

This was one of the most delicious dinners of our lives. The waiters were knowledgeable and polite, and the pizza was incredibly delicious. It's now our basic, decent minimum; we wouldn't settle for anything less. We're sure pizza of this caliber is made by the best chefs in Italy. The buratta  salad is a work of art in itself. I'd also like to highlight the attentive service of our waiter, Grace. We don't drink alcohol, so we asked for a non-alcoholic Bloody Mary (even though it wasn't on the menu), and she made it for us – super.

The restaurant's atmosphere, the well-chosen music, the sophisticated interior design – everything feels top-notch!

We recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Kuala Lumpur; if you don't try it, you'll be missing out.

Fantastic!
The best Pizza I've ever had in whole of Asia and also definetely one of the best ones I've ever had!
Owner is Italian himself and even many other guests where actually Italians, I mean what better sign of amazing Pizza could there even be?
Also the ambiente was really nice and perfect to have a gorgeous dinner evening.
Incredible delicious, perfectly thin and crispy dough, everything fresh and high quality ingrediants - totally authentic!
Everything was just perfect.

name: Shōmyō Waterfall Observation Square.
reviews: This place is really beautiful, it is the tallest waterfall in Japan
This place is amazing.

Beautiful place to appreciate the nature. The way the air is filled with water particles as you get closer to the waterfall is mesmerizing. On weekdays there aren’t usually that many people going there, but I’ve heard on weekends and holidays it gets a little bit crowded.

Something to keep in mind when going there: the parking lot is about 1.5km down the hill from the waterfall, so you’ll have about 20 minutes of uphill walking until the observation deck.

name: Kusa Vegan - Bukit Bintang
street: Unit G2, Wisma Noble Land No 2, Lorong Changkat, Lorong Ceylon
reviews:
I think this is my first 3 star review!
We enjoyed some parts of this dining experience although we ordered a 59 rm sushi platter with Mango not available and the strawberry sushi as a replacement. Unfortunately at the end when we paid, the staff said he made a mistake and left it at that. Problem was that it was replaced with more of the same of a single sushi platter we ordered so we ended up eating mostly one type of sushi.
The herbal soup was nice but it was definitely not a strong herbal soup and mainly more soya sauce based.
The passionfruit drink was really tasty. All in all we had hoped to have a better experience. The night was capped off with a family and incredibly noisy screamy crying child who was left to cry which ended the dinner feeling less calm then when we entered.
I think the staff member could be more attentive, we don't usually expect much but we didn't even get water for our table.

Incredible plant-based meal! The Yee Sang was so fresh and flavorful, and the Mushroom Popcorn was the perfect crispy, addictive snack.

The Nori-wrapped fried rice was a creative highlight. Everything was beautifully presented and delicious. Highly recommend for anyone in Bukit Bintang!

This is the second Vegan restaurant that i patronized for Japanese-Styled cuisine (Ramen, Sushi, Maki, Inari, Hand Roll and etc), while in KL. Not only that, they offer popular Korean (Jjajiang Rice), Chinese (Mian Xian Soup, Bee Hoon Soup) and Local (Tempeh Fried Rice) dishes too.

From their exquisite menu, we ordered their All-In-One (S) Sushi Platter that included their signature G-Ken Floss Inside-Out Roll, Rainbow Maki, Climax Maki, Spices Maki, Pure Inari and Chuka Wakame Gunkan.
