name: Fushimiya
reviews:
JR東海道本線・熱田駅より南へ…又は、名古屋鉄道名古屋本線、常滑線・神宮前駅より北へ…それぞれ徒歩５分弱で到着。
シャッター街の熱田神宮前商店街に店舗があります。
女将さん１人で切り盛りしています。
メニュー表から「焼きそば(肉玉入り)」を注文。
さほど時間を要さずに着丼。
大きな鉄板で、焼かれた焼きそばですから、とても美味しかったですけど、少し量が少ないと思いました。
次回、お邪魔した時は…大盛にしたいと思います。
ご馳走様でした。

名古屋ローカル焼きそば！
【伏見屋】
熱田神宮近くにある昔ながらの焼きそばと
お好み焼きのお店です。(現在は焼きそばのみ)

名鉄神宮前駅から徒歩圏内にあり、懐かしい
雰囲気が漂う店内で、地元の人々に愛され
続けているよ🎶

目玉焼きが乗った名古屋ローカルスタイルで、
もちもちの中太麺とバランスの取れたソースが
特徴です。
シンプルながらも奥深い味わいで、昭和の時代
にタイムスリップしたような気分を味わえるよ。

お店は年配の女将さんが一人で切り盛りして
おり、鉄板で丁寧に焼き上げる様子もノスタルジックな魅力の一つ。
価格もリーズナブルで、気軽に立ち寄れるのも嬉しいポイント！

熱田神宮界隈は新しいお店と歴史ある老舗が
共存し、それぞれ異なる魅力を持ってるよ☝️
このような昔ながらの焼きそば店は、
もはや文化遺産とも言える存在😆
次世代にも受け継がれてほしいよね。

"ブックマーク"をしていたところです
部活の帰りに食べたような懐かしさを感じます
ファンタグレープはいつぶりぐらいでしょうか
瓶のバヤリーズとファンタは70年代を代表する飲み物かもしれません
"イカ玉"の焼きそばは、値段的に具材の量も部活帰りのお店感はあります
味は薄口の人にとっても淡い感じです
卓上にソースもあります
雰囲気と素朴な味を愉しむ場所でしょうか

name: Jumpstart@65
reviews:
New coffee place in town.

Suitable for those who work remotely or want to do coffee meet up

A great spot if you're looking for a quiet place to work. The atmosphere is calm and the staff are very friendly and welcoming. There's also a cozy café on the ground floor where you can work or just have your coffee.

Not sure what this is, but it‘s not looking like a coworking space. I couldn‘t see any of the fancy desks on the pictures, only very basic coffee tables.

Also, they we‘re only opening at 9:30 they said, which is rather late for coworking

name: Petaling Street Market
reviews:
Recently visited Jalan Petaling Street Market which is famous for street shopping which offers branded bags, clothes, watches, souvenirs and many more items. Before buying anything remember they are not original but copy of expensive brands.

This market is very huge, so you must try street food available and having various options to eat such as noodles, dimsums, fresh juices, waffles and many more. Literally it is a paradise for foodies.

The vendors quote very high prices for the product in this market, so you should always bargain and negotiate before buying anything. And the best part of shopping through which my experience becomes better is bargaining.

Always keep an eye on your belongings as this market is very crowded. And yes always carry cash they don’t accept cards easily.

Highly recommended to visit this market to enjoy your trip of Malaysia. You can also visit Central market and Kasturi Walk which is at walking distance from here.
You can visit Texas Chicken just opposite side of entrance of this market where you can get unlimited refills of drinks but it is applicable for dine in customers only.

Location: Petaling Street (Chinatown)

Petaling Street Market is one of the most vibrant and lively places to experience the true local flavor of Kuala Lumpur. Located in the heart of Chinatown, this bustling street market is famous for its energetic atmosphere, affordable shopping, and wide variety of street food.

🛍️ Shopping Experience

The market is packed with stalls selling clothes, handbags, shoes, souvenirs, watches, sunglasses, and local accessories. Bargaining is part of the experience here, and vendors usually expect it—so don’t hesitate to negotiate for a better price. It’s a great place to buy gifts and budget-friendly items, though quality can vary.

🍜 Food & Street Eats

Food lovers will enjoy the many street food stalls and small eateries around Petaling Street. You can find local Malaysian, Chinese, and fusion snacks like noodles, dumplings, fruit juices, and desserts. The aroma of freshly cooked food adds to the charm of the place. Hygiene is generally decent, but it’s best to choose busy stalls with good turnover.

🌆 Atmosphere

Petaling Street truly comes alive in the evening. Bright lights, loud bargaining, music, and crowds create an exciting and authentic street-market vibe. It can get crowded, especially on weekends, but that’s part of what makes it special.

👍 Pros

Lively local market experience

Affordable shopping with bargaining options

Wide variety of street food

Easily accessible by public transport

👎 Cons

Very crowded during peak hours

Some items may be replicas or low quality

Can feel overwhelming for first-time visitors

The place you are referring to, where prices are high but bargaining is common and a must-visit, is likely Petaling Street (Chinatown) or one of the various night markets in Kuala Lumpur. This is characteristic of many street markets where initial prices are often marked up, and negotiation is an expected part of the shopping experience.
Key Characteristics
Location: Petaling Street is located in the heart of Kuala Lumpur's Chinatown district. Other popular spots with similar dynamics include the various night markets (Pasar Malam) like the one at Taman Connaught.
Vibe and Offerings: These areas are known for their lively, bustling, and chaotic atmosphere, especially at night when they transform into vibrant hubs of activity. You can find a wide array of goods, from souvenirs, clothing, watches, and handicrafts to delicious street food.
Bargaining Culture: Haggling is not only socially accepted but expected by the vendors. Prices are often initially inflated for tourists, so you can negotiate to get a better deal. It is recommended to keep a friendly tone and be prepared to walk away if the price is not right.
Contrast: These street markets offer a distinct contrast to the fixed-price luxury shopping malls in the city center, such as Pavilion Kuala Lumpur or Suria KLCC, where prices are generally set.

name: Kuromon Market
reviews:
The market was lively, colorful, and full of amazing aromas. There was a huge variety of fresh seafood, grilled skewers, wagyu, takoyaki, and snacks, making it easy to enjoy different foods together.

Visiting with my wife and kids was very enjoyable—the atmosphere felt safe, friendly, and exciting for children to see how local food is prepared. Even though it can get busy, the vibe was fun rather than overwhelming. A must-visit place in Osaka, especially for families who love food and local culture

★★★★★

Kuromon Market is an absolute must-visit when in Osaka. The atmosphere is vibrant and energetic, filled with the sights, sounds, and incredible aromas of fresh Japanese street food.

From freshly grilled seafood to premium wagyu skewers and seasonal fruits, everything is beautifully displayed and made to order. You can taste the freshness in every bite. The seafood in particular was outstanding — sweet, juicy, and incredibly fresh.

What makes Kuromon special is not just the food, but the experience. Walking through the market, sampling different stalls, interacting with friendly vendors, and soaking in the lively atmosphere makes it unforgettable.

It’s the perfect place to experience authentic Osaka food culture in one location. Whether you’re a foodie or just exploring the city, Kuromon Market is 100% worth the visit.

Highly recommended. I will definitely return on my next trip to Osaka.

Visited there since October 2025, i wish to go back there again and try more food. Love the combination of everything there. I’m not sure about the price you just have to look around. It was many people there but wasn’t that packed on that Saturday morning. I always include market walk on my trip. Would love to explore more local one next time

name: Sungei Wang Plaza
reviews: Legendary Shopping Centre for decades in Kuala Lumpur at Bukit Bintang, the 1st & largest KFC restaurant was here a long time ago. Now it is the best place for good value quality foot massage, hair dressers, local fashion brands. Across the street is the beautiful & very expensive Pavilion KL shopping centre & Lot 10 shopping centre’s basement amusing food court has the best of the best local cuisines in one place.

I recently visited Sungei Wang Plaza during their ‘Glow Up Raya’ campaign and had a really enjoyable experience. The mall has a vibrant festive atmosphere with beautiful Raya decorations that blend traditional Malaysian kampung elements with a modern city vibe. It’s definitely a great place to explore, especially during the Ramadan season.

Sungei Wang is always there for you when you need a hair makeover, foot massage, pedicure, facial and reasonable price fashion buys.
Also you will be spoilt for choice looking for a new pair of glasses and shades.
Foot traffic might have slowed over the years, but the good ole vibes remain.
A new food court at 3rd floor is available, lots of local food including nasi lemak and curry chicken. I will try them in my next visit, but if you have, share with us and thanks.

name: Kobe Harborland umie
reviews: Winter is the best season to visit for sightseeing.  The lights, the clean air, the stable weather.   100% recommended
The Kobe Harborland is amazing.  Shopping, entertainment, and tons of food options.

This is not your normal review:

Ive lost my parking ticket and I found it in the information center. And I was told that the staff found it within MINUTES and was dealt with accordingly and nicely.

That’s how good their staff is

name: Lot 10
reviews: It has exciting Donki in there can shop variety of Japanese products, many are house brand which makes it very cheap compared others. Not as much as Japan but still exciting to shop in it. Love the skincare selection, they have the most popular masks selling.

One of the famous and biggest shopping mall located at Bukit Bintang Kuala Lumpur. Not only famous because of one shopping mall but also lot of Japanese food shops, play ground for kids, space cube and so on located at the different level that you can see. This mall also very clean and look nice very comfortable for everyone.

Top 10 places to have brunch, lunch & dinner in Kuala Lumpur at Bukit Bintang. Lot 10 shopping centre is famous for the best food court that serve the best of the best Malaysian, Penang, Kuala Lumpur cuisines. Every dish is delicious & well priced. You can enjoy the best noodles, rice, soup & stir fried dishes in its basement food court. Lot 10 invited many famous & tastiest local Malaysian cuisines chefs be in its basement food court as an “one stop shop” for everyone to enjoy the best meals in one location.

name: Oasis 21
reviews: No entrance fee is charged. The aqua space is fantastic. Amazing view at night. The ground floor has many shops you can enjoy any food there.Amazing view if you love water and colourful lights. No animals, no food & drinks are allowed to bring at the aqua space but you can enjoy food at the ground floor.

Visited Oasis 21 in Nagoya – a unique multi-level complex with the famous ‘Spaceship-Aqua’ glass roof. While the exterior didn’t exactly feel like a spaceship of water, I appreciated the idea of designing the underground and ground floors horizontally rather than stacking them vertically. Instead of filling space with dense vertical buildings, this complex shows how multifunctional use can be achieved in a more open way. The underground level connects directly to the subway, and the under floor links to the bus terminal, making it highly accessible. I had mentioned this facility in a seminar on urban regeneration, and actually visiting it gave the experience much more meaning. Overall, a modern landmark worth seeing during a Nagoya trip.

This place is pretty cool for something that costs you zero dollars. I'd recommend coming at night as the lighting really adds to the ambience.

The concourse area is mostly populated by young teens but going up to the rooftop was very peaceful. The running water helps to project an atmosphere of calm. The tourist information booth was very helpful in directing us where to go to get where we wanted.

We also bought an item from the ghibli store in the concourse. It was a better store that carried a lot of the items we saw at the store in ghibli park, but without it being overpopulared and uncomfortable.

name: Restoran Nasi Kandar Pelita - KLCC
reviews: We have a late breakfast for 3 here on a Friday late morning. Ordered Roti Canai, Nasi Lemak Ayam & Mee Goreng Mamak Telur mata. The Mee Goreng taste great and good portion, nasi lemak chicken taste good too, but roti canai was so-so average. But no worries plenty more choices - nasi kandar and lauk pauk, Rojak Singapore, Tandhori Chicken, Poori, Tosey, Capati, Fried Rice Noodles and more. Service was quick and friendly, price was fair. They have lots of seating area must be to cater for peak time, night & weekend crowd. Quite popular with tourist too. I saw many pulling their luggages inside here to eat. Paid parking is available. Walking distance to KLCC. I say around 150+ meters. If you are in Suria KLCC mall and want to taste good southern Indian Style - Mamak food for a big group or family walk here instead of eating at the upmarket Suria KLCC Mall. Lots of choices, taste good, quick service and good price. Located right accross Hotel Maya on busy Jalan Ampang.

If you are in kl city center, then thisnis the nearest mamak for you. The problemiaonly theparking especially if you are lazy to walk like me lol

It opens 24jam.

The roti canaii is soo good and garing but i prefwr kayu’s dhal more. But hey beggars cant be choosers. Oh ohj the maggi goreng koaong kurang pedasss iss sooooo sedappp. The truth: i actually got to taste one spoon (my nephew’s and he is so kedekut lol). So I ordered one for myswld - the only difference i got a different one just because i wanted sayur - maybe he disnt hear i wanted kurang pedass. But it wasnt that bad.  Still a star. Though the maggi type is the wet typa so if you like those dry ones might not be for you.

Of course recommended. Just be patient

Located near MRT station Butik Nanas and walking distance from Petronas Twin Towers, you will get decent Malaysian and South Indian food at affordable rates. It opens from 6:00 in the morning. Rush hours are around 10-11 am, but you will get a table there as they have large dining area. Service is good and taste is good.

name: Chew Jetty
reviews:
Chew Jetty was one of the most interesting places I visited in Penang. It’s not just a tourist spot, it’s a living village built on stilts over the water, which makes the experience feel unique and authentic.

Walking along the wooden walkway, you can see traditional houses, small souvenir stalls, and parts of daily life of the local community. I liked how the place keeps its heritage while still being welcoming to visitors. The view of the sea at the end of the jetty is also relaxing, especially if you go near sunset.

It can get crowded, but the atmosphere is still nice and peaceful. Just be respectful since people actually live there. Definitely worth visiting if you want to see a cultural side of Penang, not just malls and modern attractions.

It's ok and worth a visit if exploring the city. However, don't expect anything exciting, there's just not much there besides clothes shops, souvenir shops and drink vendors. We did buy a nice piece of art from a souvenir shop. Best thing were the peaceful views from the end of the jetty

Interesting place to visit and walk around. There are lots of commercial stalls for souvenirs or water. It’s interesting to see how the construction of the houses is set up. We even spotted some street art along the way. Worth a visit and a short walk through.

name: Penang Road Famous Teochew Chendul
reviews:
Highly recommend eating in the restaurant beside, if you can find a seat despite it’s chaotic nature.

The char Kuey teow is above average in taste, not too expensive either. Would recommend. Same for the famous chendol, it’s watery with more coconut milk with chunk of shaved ice which makes it really refreshing and you won’t get a brain freeze gulping in down.
Asam laksa is good (average) worth a try but nothing to cry home about.
Also offer oyster omelette, lor bak and Chee Cheong fun. Which were all of decent quality. Locals can skip but tourists gotta give it a try.

I enjoyed Penang Road Famous Teochew Chendul for its refreshing, nostalgic flavours. The pandan jelly is smooth, the gula melaka is nicely balanced, and the coconut milk isn’t too heavy...making this perfect for the hot weather. They also serve assam laksa and char kueh teow, making it a convenient stop for both dessert and local favourites. The queue can be long and seating is simple, but I think it’s still worth the visit for the overall experience.

I knew this place from social media because it went really viral. People said you have to try this Penang Road Famous Cendol before you can say you’ve truly been to Penang. My husband and I usually don’t go out of our way to try super viral food, but we happened to pass by and decided to give it a try.

We came here on September 25, 2025 at 10:11 AM and there was no queue at all. We ordered one bowl of ice cendol.

For me, the taste was pretty average (sorry… but there are many cendol in Indonesia that taste better 🙈 hehe). The only extraordinary things for me were the shape of the cendol — long and thin like noodles, so you can easily slurp them — and the palm sugar. The gula melaka tasted very different from the palm sugar in Indonesia. I’ve never tasted palm sugar with that kind of flavor before.

Overall, it’s okay to try once in a lifetime if you’re curious and already nearby.

🫧🥨

name: Higashi Yuenchi
reviews:
Higashi Yuenchi Park in Kobe is a beautiful and relaxing public park located right in the heart of the city. It’s a great place to take a walk, rest, or enjoy some greenery after exploring downtown Kobe.

The park is clean, peaceful, and well-maintained, with open lawns and benches that make it perfect for families, couples, or solo travelers. It’s also close to many popular spots like Sannomiya and the City Museum, so it’s easy to stop by while sightseeing.

Throughout the year, the park hosts seasonal events — including the famous Kobe Luminarie light festival — which makes it even more special.

A lovely spot that shows Kobe’s calm and welcoming side. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to take a quiet break in the middle of the city.
Best city park in Kobe, under the moto "let's sit and eat". A lot of places where locals come to have lunch at. Beautiful flower clock, waterfall and fall trees.

It’s really calm and peaceful vibes with plenty of green. An outdoor picnic spot with serene beauty. They played soothing music for perfect vibe. The benches in the park for keeping for and beverages was ultimate.

name: Chulia Street Hawker Food
reviews: All of these Hawkers come out j. The evening only . Along Lebuh Carnavon. I really did read all the reviews and picked those we wanted to eat. The Wan Tan Mee was also good( sorry with no picture🤭)4 of us went back satisfied with all that we had. Drinks served was prompt n friendly.

Came late around 10pm, the famous wan tan mee shop was closed. I had the char kuey teow (1st runner up in some competition). Was AMAZING! Just absolutely perfect, probably the best ckt i’ve ever had. super fresh, huge prawns too.

Lots of hawker stalls selling all kinds of deliciousness. Prices are reasonable and the food is so good. I ate here two nights in a row and got a full belly each time for little money. The hawkers swarm you like locust but you get to see a lot of dishes at once but can be overwhelming. Recommended

name: SkyBar | Rooftop Bar KL
reviews:
SkyBar at Traders Hotel offers a convenient option for guests staying in the hotel who want to enjoy a drink without heading out. The skyline views are nice, especially at night, and the atmosphere is relaxed.
That said, the drinks were fairly average and the live band was decent but nothing particularly memorable. If you’re specifically looking for standout cocktails or a more vibrant rooftop experience, there are several other spots in KL that offer better skyline views along with stronger food and beverage options.
Good for convenience, but not necessarily a destination on its own.

The SkyBar is famous for its views of the Petronas Twin Towers and ambiance, and it is well worth the visit. Every member of staff was absolutely lovely. Towards the start of my visit I spilled my drink; it was cleaned up quickly and I was brought a new drink even though the spill was entirely my own fault.

It was not busy when I arrived at about 7pm, but the place got livelier as the night went on.

The food and drink exceeded my expectations and I thought the minimum spend of MYR100 for a window booth was entirely reasonable.

Highly recommend!

The Sky Bar on the 33rd floor of Traders Hotel was absolutely amazing! A bar with a superb view of the Petronas Twin Towers at night. We were lucky enough to catch the Deepavali-themed colors of the Twin Towers, which were stunning! Although there was a minimum spend of RM100 per person (Shangri-La members get a 10% discount), we had dinner at the our hotel’s lounge before coming, so we were pretty full, but the salmon quinoa salad we ordered was incredibly delicious, and the desserts were also very tasty. The only downside was the cocktails, which were just average. Considering the view and the food, I think it was well worth it.

name: Higashiyama Sky Tower
reviews: A superb view of Nagoya City. This is a location I think not a lot of non-japanese tourists go and I visit this place because of its potential view of Nagoya City. Very nice place except traveling to here will need a bit of a walk. There is a zoo nearby the tower but close fairly early before 6pm. Worth coming for that break taking view.
Even though this is optional during our purchase of Higashiyama Zoo, i made the right choice to include the Sky Tower. On a good day, the views are so good. Totally enjoy the side trip to Sky Tower

I stopped by here one night, almost near closing time.
I walked from the train station and walked the back route, by the zoo (it was dark and the woods made it creepy).

Finally reaching Higashiyama Sky Tower!
Friendly staff!
I also stopped by here because of the All Japan Towers stamp rally.

Great views on a clear night and it wasn't busy.

If you are in the area, definitely put this on your list!

name: Ichiran Nagoya Sakae
reviews:
Ichiran Ramen at Nagoya Sakae offers a slightly different experience compared to other Ichiran outlets in Japan. While it still features the brand’s signature individual counter booths for solo diners, this branch also includes one special table designed for small groups — accommodating up to six people. The table even has the same signature ordering “window” for food delivery, preserving Ichiran’s unique no-interaction concept.

However, the group space is quite compact and can feel cramped, especially for taller diners or anyone uncomfortable in tight spaces. It’s a creative addition, but not ideal if you’re claustrophobic or prefer a bit of elbow room.

As for the food, the ramen quality remains consistent with other Ichiran locations — rich, flavorful tonkotsu broth, perfectly cooked noodles, and customizable seasoning options. Service is efficient, and the overall experience still captures Ichiran’s signature focus on solo enjoyment and ramen perfection.

Been to a few ichirans but this one has a small room that can sit 4 to 6 (i think) people, so cool!

Also for some reason, ramen here taste better than other branches.

We were staying at the hotel beside this store and everytime we get out, there' always a queue.

While Ichiran's reputation for streamlined, solo ramen dining is well-deserved, my recent visit left me disappointed with the fundamentals. The broth, though aromatic, lacked the profound, multi-layered richness I associate with the original Ichiran flavor profile, tasting somewhat diluted and one-dimensional. This was compounded by a critical flaw in the ajitsuke tamago; the egg was unacceptably hard-boiled, with a fully set, chalky yolk that lacked the signature creamy, molten center essential for blending with the broth. For a chain built on specific, revered standards, these deviations from the core experience made for a regrettably mediocre bowl.

name: Kuala Lumpur
reviews:
One of the KTM Commuter stop at KL. Near from pasar seni & petaling street. So if you want to hang around in chinatown after visiting batu cave this is the best stop you can choose.

Maybe long time ago this station is very crowded. But now it not very crowd as KL sentral. I fell this station is dimmer than other station. I see not all the lights are on. There is no officer here. With an old style building surrounding and Lot of empty room at the building For me when day time its okey, but idk the situation at night..
So beautiful historical building 😍 Art nouveau + neogothic + moorish styles. Hope it will be reopen not as usual railway station but smth modern and interesting like exhibition hall, for example

This must be the worst train station of KL! The building is in very poor conditions, with little light only and bad maintained facilities. This station looks more like a lost place than a train station. Wouldn't recommend visiting especially by night

name: ICHIRAN Nagoya Station
street: Meieki, 3 Chome−25−6 ホテルリソル名古屋 B1F
reviews:
We really enjoyed the ramen here; the tonkotsu broth was rich and comforting, and the noodles had a great springy texture. It’s not the single best ramen we’ve had in Japan, but it sits comfortably in the “very good” category: consistent, flavorful, and satisfying.
We went for the extra set which was great value and included a full soft-boiled egg with a silky yolk and extra pieces of chashu that were tender and well seasoned. For the price you pay, the portion and quality felt very reasonable.
The shop itself is clean and straightforward rather than flashy, which I actually liked as it keeps the focus on the food. It is very standard like other branches; ordering from the vending machine was fast and convenient and the sheet you fill out allows you to customise the noodles and broth to your preference in terms of texture and richness as well as providing an option for spice. The booths offer a level of privacy and the little cubby holes where staff hand over the bowls make interactions efficient but still polite.
The booths were full when we arrived, however we waited less than 5 minutes to be seated and service was quick. The staff were very attentive without being intrusive.
If you’re passing through Nagoya Station and want a reliable, tasty bowl of ramem with good value and a unique seating setup, this is a great pick and is only a short walk away from the station. I’d happily come back, just not quite a 5/5 only because we’ve had a couple of bowls elsewhere that edged it out for us.

It is located in the basement, so you will need to go down the stairs. Actually nice in winter since you do not have to wait outside in the cold. We have always enjoyed this brand’s ramen, and even the basic bowl is satisfying, especially with a few extra toppings. We arrived around 2 pm expecting a quieter time, but still waited about 20 minutes.

The staff are friendly, though the turnover from seating to ordering, serving, and clearing tables feels a bit slow. It is a place where you go mainly to enjoy your meal rather than chat.

Overall, it is definitely a great spot for ramen.

Long queues but the consistent quality of Ichiran across all locations make it worth the wait.
Rich creamy tonkotsu ramen with generous noodles and char Siew meats. Should try the matcha dessert as well, quite good.

Simple ordering system, this location is all booths and minimal contact, just get your orders across the curtain dividers.

Slightly noisy those with people talking, order buzzers chiming constantly.

OWill go again!

name: Gravybaby Jalan P Ramlee
reviews:
The Gravybaby Jalan P Ramlee is so nice, they have cool  ambiance with friendly atmosphere, the interior is modern with retro vibes that makes you feel real. The location itself is touristic because it's nearby at Petronas Twin Tower.

For there Food they quit a lot of variety of foods to chose, from Delicious dessert, Burger, Pasta, Fajitas, Curries, Chicken Wings, steaks, Waffles even sandwiches and manny more. The Drinks option also is a lot, from liquor, mocktails, cocktails and beers. The price is reasonable and worth to try.

The services is good before you enter the hostess is welcoming, the service is so friendly and entertaining specially Jean who assist us, the Filipino bartender is nice talk too.I recommend this place if you like to have drink and  to have a chill vibes this is the place for you.

I heard of this place from a friend sometime ago. It is not on my list, but surprisingly here we were on a Sunday for a very late lunch. I'm a pie person so I got really excited when I see their selection of pies. We went for their Steak and Ale Pie with British Meat Gravy and it was really good. Buttery crust, and tender meat with lots of gravy, my kind of comfort food. The Mac N Cheese was nice too. The Sunday Roast Chicken was alright, can't say much as I am not a fan of roasted chicken.  For dessert, we agreed on apple pie which turned out to be an awesome choice. We loved it.

Gravybaby on Jalan P Ramlee is a stylish and trendy spot in Kuala Lumpur that immediately catches your eye with its chic interior and vibrant atmosphere. I stopped by for lunch and was impressed by the wide variety of dishes on the menu – it really feels like there’s something for everyone, from hearty burgers to lighter options. The staff, especially the lady who served my table, was incredibly warm and welcoming, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

I decided to order a burger and, thinking I might want a little extra, I also added a side of fries. To my surprise, the burger already came with fries, so I ended up with two generous portions – delicious but definitely more than I could finish! It made me laugh, and honestly, it shows how generous their portions are. The fries themselves were crispy and flavorful, definitely worth trying.

Prices are a little on the higher side compared to some other places in KL, but the quality of the food, the portion sizes, and the cool ambiance make it worth it. The vibe inside is modern yet cozy, making it a great spot for casual lunches, dinners, or even catching up with friends over drinks.

Overall, Gravybaby Jalan P Ramlee is a place I’d recommend if you’re looking for a lively atmosphere, friendly service, and a menu full of tempting options. Just be careful when ordering extra fries – you might end up with more than you can handle, in the best possible way!

name: Sri Weld Food Court
reviews:
Sri Weld Food Court is one of the most comfortable and enjoyable places to experience classic Penang street food. The food court is airy, clean, and well organised, making it an easy choice for both locals and visitors. There is an excellent range of Penang favourites, including nasi lemak, char kuey teow, and Hokkien prawn noodles, all under one roof. The only notable omission is Penang assam laksa, which would have completed the line-up.

A particular highlight is Ali Nasi Lemak Daun Pisang, a Michelin Selected stall. The banana leaf–wrapped nasi lemak is fragrant, well balanced, and exceptional value, at RM3 per pack. Equally impressive, though not on any guide, are the beef noodles and the Penang prawn noodles, both rich and satisfying.

Ordering is straightforward. Drinks are ordered at the table, while food is ordered directly from stalls. Inform the stall of your table number, and the food will be delivered to you. Payment is made upon receiving the dish. An outstanding food court experience in Penang.

Sri Weld Food Court is a fantastic food hall with a great variety of stalls — each offering a different cuisine, different flavors, and a glimpse into a different culture. One place, many culinary worlds.

The atmosphere is wonderful, with a mix of locals and tourists, which is always a good sign. Prices are very affordable, the place is clean, and it has a genuinely authentic and lively vibe. A great spot to try many dishes and experience the real food culture of George Town. Highly recommended.

This is a popular one stop food court for a variety of local hot food  in particular. It's open 7 days a week and many locals and tourists frequent it. Prices are reasonable and it boasts some Michelin guide rank stores eg the nasi lemak which is extremely popular. Most clients sit down at one table after placing their orders.  Food preparation and delivery is prompt.  Only cash is required for payment,  so make sure you have sufficient funds. Parking is difficult in the area,  hence best to take public transport.

name: Gravybaby (Changkat)
reviews:
We had lunch here on two consecutive days while on holiday, and the food was truly impressive. I’m a big burger fan, so naturally I tried their burger..it was delicious, juicy, and cooked perfectly. I absolutely loved it! My other half ordered a pie, and he said it was spot on.

The following day, we both went for the roasted half chicken, and it was just as amazing.. tender, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. When it comes to food, this place really delivers and deserves praise.

The only issue we experienced was after lunch, when we wanted to stay a little longer, enjoy a drink, and make use of their entertainment options like pool or basketball. Unfortunately, it felt as though the staff weren’t very welcoming about us playing, and instead kept coming over to ask for the bill repeatedly. Since we were just visiting on holiday, we weren’t sure how things usually work, but it gave us the impression that they didn’t want us to stay and enjoy the games. We simply wanted to relax, have a drink, and play a bit.

Because of that, we decided to go to another bar that offered similar entertainment and felt more accommodating.

The oysters were next level 🦪 — super fresh and perfectly served. I also tried their burgers, pies, and grilled salmon — all cooked just right. The fajitas are incredibly delicious, and their sandwiches — in all varieties — are amazing too! Huge shoutout to Rabby for the amazing service — super friendly, attentive, and really made the experience even better. And a special mention to HTWE— such a lovely person with excellent service! This has definitely become my favorite spot on Changkat Street — truly the best place around!

Super awesome vibes. Happening live music in weekend. Awesome place to sit drink, eat and chill with or without your friends. As a solo traveler I personally like the place. Staff is humble, polite. They have good menu options snd also have fresh food. Drinks are awesome must try there mango cocktail. Outdoor sitting available. Very happening place with music, chit chat, love, laugh. Most recommended! ♥️💫

name: Little Penang Kafé - KLCC
street: Lot No. 409-11, Level 4, Petronas Twin Tower, Persiaran Petronas
reviews:
The char kuay teow was good, though the curry mee wasn’t quite to my taste. The other dishes were decent overall.

Even though the place gets quite busy, the queue was well managed and the waiting time was reasonable.

Seating is rather small and tight, which may not be very comfortable for elderly diners or families with young children.

The staff are attentive, but during peak hours it helps to raise your hand to get their attention when placing an order.

I visited Little Penang Kafe at KLCC recently for a family dinner, hoping to enjoy familiar Penang flavours. Unfortunately, this turned out to be one of my worst experiences with Penang food in Malaysia.

We ordered several signature dishes. The Penang fried kway teow was extremely disappointing. It lacked wok hei, tasted flat, and bore little resemblance to the authentic Penang version. The noodles were oily yet dry, and the overall flavour was unbalanced. The nasi lemak was poorly presented, with sambal that lacked depth and fragrance. The chicken was especially disappointing, as it was dry, hard, and overcooked, making it unpleasant to eat.

The fried rice and satay were average at best. They were edible but unremarkable, with nothing that justified the premium mall location or pricing. One of the biggest letdowns was the nutmeg sour plum drink, which should be a Penang classic. There was no distinct nutmeg aroma or taste. Instead, it tasted overly salty and sour, without any refreshing balance. It felt more like a poorly mixed drink rather than a traditional Penang beverage.

Service further worsened the experience. The waiter serving our table was not attentive, showed little interest, and came across as rude when we tried to clarify our order. Plates were not cleared promptly, and there was no effort to check on our dining experience.

Overall, this visit was very disappointing. Little Penang Kafe markets itself as a place for Penang comfort food, but what we experienced was far from authentic in taste, quality, and service. Based on this visit, I would not recommend this outlet at KLCC, especially for diners looking for genuine Penang flavours or a pleasant family dining experience.

Little Penang @ KLCC

Dropped by Little Penang for lunch today — maybe we were too hungry 😂
Ended up ordering pie tee, rojak, lobak, and two plates of char kuey teow.

Food came out fast and tasted comforting, especially when you’re craving local flavours.
Char kuey teow was satisfying, rojak sauce decent, and pie tee was crunchy enough to enjoy.

Place was quite crowded, but overall still happy to be eating familiar Penang food in the middle of KLCC.
A good spot when hunger hits hard and you just want proper Malaysian food 🇲🇾😋

name: Nagoya Port
reviews: This is not just a port; it's a historical site with a lot of content and is very important to the city of Nagoya. There are many attractions around that require payment, but there are also free options such as having a picnic, relaxing, or walking along the enormous trail while observing the wonder that is the sea... Special mention goes to the excellent infrastructure, organization, cleanliness, and security. Thank you to everyone who maintains such care for visitors in general 👏🙏
A sight seeing area for a relaxing day by the harbour and for travellers who want to see the aquarium - ideal for half day trips and lunch
I was a beautiful space and garden. There was Khmer New time (Cambodian peoples New Year) and many people joined.

name: Komtar Walk
reviews: Komtar is a major transport hub in Penang, serving as the main station for nearly all city buses. Built in the 1980s, it quickly became an iconic landmark in George Town. Besides being a key transit point, Komtar also houses The Top, an indoor attraction park, making it a hub for both travel and leisure in the city.

Just go to the restaurant and you’ll get to see the amazing view without paying the high prices for mediocre activities.
The shopping center doesn’t have a lot of nice stores, just struggling little kiosks. There is a decent cafe though.

Went to komtar to check it out..The view from the top was nice and the skywalk was fun but the place feels a bit old and not many shops inside..Okay to visit once but nothing special. Just good for quick sightseeing..

name: Louie's N.Y. Pizza Parlor
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−1 ニューヨーク・エリア
reviews: Came on New Year’s eve, and it was pretty nice! The system is efficient, although there weren’t many tables left. But as you expect from a Usj place, it’s definitely not cheap.

I stopped here with my friends around 12:50pm on a Wednesday afternoon after finishing a ride. It was busy but overcrowded. They have indoor and outdoor seating. A staff member saw us and presented a QR for English menu, which was so helpful!

We then got in a short line and ordered. It’s a conveyor belt system where we get the order and then pay at the register. There are two lines. I for the spicy pizza meal that came with pizza and drink (Coke zero) for ¥1750, which is less than $12 USD. They do have whole pizza options, which one of my friends got.

We were able to find a place for us to sit at a low top bar like area. It wasn’t the best pizza and fries but it did the job. I did enjoy the crisp on the pepperoni.

The music playing was at the perfect volume. They played American songs but with a different artist singing the song. I would definitely stop in here again. It seems like a popular place as well.

An overpriced affront to any pizza parlor, I would only recommend it if you just want to waste money. The fries were soggy, undercooked, and had almost no salt on them. The pizza itself was mediocre at best, reminicent of cheap buffet pizza in the states, but with California-esc prices.

name: Suzuka Flower Park
reviews: Very beautiful, and there are many kind of beautiful flowers
Fansastic park with many open spaces for playing sports. I really appreciate the playground for kids which has separate age appropriate areas. Plenty of parking and good bathroom facilities as well.
We super love this place. So many cherry blossoms.

name: Yokkaichi Himono Shukudou - Suzuka
reviews: السلام علیکم every one: Wow The test of fish Himono shukodo is very salty delicious yamy & perfect

初めて利用させて頂きました。
私は魚が苦手なので妻と娘がアジと赤魚をそれぞれ選んでました。私はカレーとおでんにしました。焼きたてのふっくらしたヒモノを美味しそうに食べていました。

ひものデビュー🐟
まず、総じて申しますと、魚はやや軽めのお味でした。
私は「しまほっけ」、相方は「さば」でしたが、どちらも脂のノリはイマイチでしたが、味は十二分に美味しく頂けました☺️
机には「旨だれ」がありますが、こちらをオンする事で、お味は最高となりました♪

ひもの食堂自体が初めてで、若干システムに不安はありましたが、そこは大きな貼り紙にてカバーされておりました😁

name: Western food Mogu
reviews:
Amazing food!
Great customer service!
Coming back soon :)
always so nice to eat here. big servings. I didnt finish everything so I had my hamburger patty be taken out. price is very reasonable for its serving. will come back for sure
Nice restuarant.

name: The BRGR - Kuala Lumpur Setapak
street: No G-20, PV12 Platinum Lake Condominium, Jln Langkawi
reviews: We tried the eat all u can burger, pasta and sides. For what it’s worth, it is highly recommended especially for people with big appetite! The taste is not too bad. If you like cheese, they got all the cheese you want! Must try!

My husband loves burger, so we decided to give this place a try. It serves both burger and other western dishes, particularly spaghetti, which works perfect for me who enjoys western and not burger (not so fulfilling for me).

The burger is juicy and thick, and it comes with sides, which is quite a set. The shop has open air and air-conditioned spaces, so it works great for those who want to stick a long time to do work or who enjoy some quiet time.

Overall the burgers are delicious.
Buns are soft and the patties are juicy.

For the burger's size, i was expecting it to be a little bigger 🤣🤣.

FB sharing will get one free scoop of ice cream 😆🥰

Recommended 👍

name: Utaandon
reviews:
4pax dinner @ utaandon ..a restaurant famous for big clams

our second dinner after nabana no sato

we ordered 2 clams set

plus clam maki, octopus furai and karaage

maki & chicken good, octopus calamari a bit tough, rather disappointing

the dashi for big clams udon was good

the clams though a bit tough, overcooked

overall just above average dinner, kind of underwhelming in my opinion

7.12.2024

Amazing Udon spot.
We showed up w no reservation and close to closing time. The lady was very kind to allow us visitors to their restaurant which they could easily turn us away which a few restaurants in the area had. Thank you for being so warm and welcoming.
Biggest fresh clams I've ever had.

name: Suzuka Youth Park
street: Sumiyoshicho, 字中大谷6757-1 南谷口 住吉町南谷口
reviews: So wide. Perfect for picnic, children playing etc
It's good to read some books and make exercises. There's a big lake area.
The place has a lake with big koi fishes.

name: Kani Honke Sakae Central Branch
reviews: A restaurant specialising in crab cuisine. We had to preorder our meals in advance. The private room was comfortable but a little hot (even after adjusting the a/c). The food was meticulously prepared and presented, and it came to a point where I wasn't really sure what I was eating. Food was delicious nonetheless, and I personally enjoyed the crab sashimi the most. The crab porridge was supposedly the protagonist, but it wasn't as flavourful as I'd hoped. Staff were very friendly and could speak multiple languages.
Very tasty crab with good dessert and service.

Very delicious and fresh!
Relax and comfy environment to dine in.
Services are good and efficient. They even assigned a staff who know Chinese to serve us.
Although a bit expensive, overall is very satisfied and worth with it.

name: Cecil Street Food Court
reviews:
Cecil Street Food Court feels a bit overrated overall. We went during breakfast around 7am and it wasn’t too crowded, which made the visit more comfortable.

They have a wide range of stalls, mainly offering Chinese food, and most of the options are non-halal. While there is good variety, the overall food quality is mostly average.

Most stalls require customers to self-collect their food, which can be frustrating, especially when there seems to be sufficient staff available but they choose not to serve. They do have indoor seating and the seating area is quite spread out, which is a plus.

My experience with the Barefoot Char Koey Teow was disappointing. It cost RM8, which didn’t feel worth it as the portion was small, not to my taste, and the prawns were small. I requested it without taugeh, but the hawker insisted it couldn’t be done. I also asked for more chilli, but the chilli was pre-blended and not spicy since it’s prepared in batches.

My husband had the curry mee, which tasted normal and not the best we’ve tried, but the portion was generous, so it was acceptable for RM8.

Overall, prices feel slightly high for the quality offered. It’s okay for a quick meal if you’re nearby, but definitely not a place I would revisit for breakfast.

We really enjoyed the duck meat kway teow t'ng from the famous stall, such a great comfort food. The kueh we bought from the front stall was remarkably delicious, until now im craving for it hehe. We also had the wantan mee from the famous stall which was flavorful too. The hawker was surprisingly not that hot and got lots of tables so didnt had trouble getting a seat fast.

Top 10 places to visit in Penang to enjoy the best local Penang cooking & dishes. Must visit this place in the morning or before 2pm. Many famous chefs would sold out & packed up after 2:30pm. It is one place that serves all the best local Penang cuisines here, include delicious crispiest roast pork & tastiest succulent BBQ pork.

name: Alor Food Corner
reviews:
Good market food street.
Mix of seated and fast street food stalls.
Most are well priced and tasty. Some skewers can be a bit tough and chewy. The potato skewer was sweet which was not a favourite. Scallops were fresh and really yummy. The dumplings are very popular- full of meat and super juicy.
Can get very busy and there's no structure to who gets served first. Stalls are all cash.
The food was very good but the wait was a bit long, some people who arrived after us were served before us...
There is a lot of verygood food here.

name: Shinpachi Shokudō Nagoya Station West Exit
reviews:
Great Japanese fish set meals near west NGY station. Using traditional charcoal grilled fish (or Robata-yaki fish) is a really delicious and fresh choice when choosing dinner restaurants.

Highly recommended and want to drop by again next time.

I chanced upon this restuarant while walking towards Nagoya station and decided to try it for our lunch . It turned out to be our best meal in Nagoya . The fishes were grilled to perfection ( charcoal grilled ) . The mackerel , yellow tail and salmon were fresh and juicy. As for herring ,we  have to be careful as there were too many small bones ( maybe that is the nature of the fish) . Overall meal is reasonable priced . Highly recommended !

Great stop over for tourist to find dinner at late evening. They are popular for grilled fish meal set.
Price is very reasonable with good quality of food. My family enjoyed the meals 👍

name: Red Lobster Universal Citywalk Osaka
street: Shimaya, 6 Chome−2−61 ユニバーサル・シティウォーク大阪5F
reviews: Inside Universal Studios Japan, halal friendly dining options are very limited. At CityWalk, Red Lobster appears to be the only place offering a dedicated halal friendly menu, which we were extremely thankful for. We have visited many Red Lobster locations in the US and in Saudi, and this was by far the best experience among them all. The food was extremely good and the service was outstanding. Overall, a great experience and highly recommended for anyone visiting Universal Studios Japan and looking for halal friendly options.

Pleasantly surprised with the meal compared to locations in Canada.
Great quality food and quick service.
Went with a group and the only downside is they couldn't split the bill.
Good spot to go after going to USJ.

A good place in Universal city to have seafood. The lobster,oysters and paella was amazing and oishi! Service was good as well. The seafood was incredibly fresh. The seafood was not too pricey.If you are in Universal city this is the place to get your seafood.

name: Nagomidori
street: Osu, 3 Chome−33−1 地鶏料理なごみどり
reviews: We just stopped by for a snack as a family, the staff warned us that smoking is allowed so it may not be children friendly but at the time we were there, no one was smoking so that was okay. They served our food pretty quick so we could enjoy before anyone comes in smoking. The chicken wings and yakitori are delicious

The chicken dishes were all really good. The yakitori was a little salty for me but the texture was a 10. The chicken wings were real good and the seasoning on the outside was delish.  My fave was the miso katsu. The aka miso sauce just goes so well with the crispy fried katsu. The finisher was a chicken soup porridge which left us feeling warm and cozy inside.
The shop owner was friendly too. Will revisit if I come back to Nagoya.

The red miso paste is indeed special to Nagoya. Though it is dark red, it is sweet actually. Tried the cutlet and skewer serving. The set is quite worth it, it comes with an oolong tea, tofu, miso soup and rice. The portion is huge too!

name: Park Side Grille
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−1 ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン ニューヨーク・エリア
reviews:
I can safely guarantee that there no better theme park food than the ones in Japan 🇯🇵 The ribeye was pretty good. Just as good in any American steak house if I’m to be honest. The lamb doesn’t have that gamy smell. The meat was soft and tender and juicy! If you have a bigger appetite, go for the sale and soup set; those are delicious as well.

The restaurant can get busy real quick after the park opens. You could either make the reservation in advance or you could go and get the Q when you arrive at the park.

The steak is good, we had the Sirlon. Was Tasty. It came with mashed patatoes and bread. Sadly it was more like 1 smal mashed potato. When we asked for another bit of mashed patatoes they said it wasn't possible. Shame because now it felt like the price wasn't worth the food.

Great service from the waiter named So__ (forgot his name). This place requires a reservation so do book beforehand. It’s probably one of the most upscale places in the theme park.

Chicken felt sub-par, Kurobuta pork that was recommended was decent. The soups were average.

This restaurant was a bit out of place but works well for those who don’t mind paying a bit more for a sit-down meal.

name: Jerry's Uno Osu Shop
reviews: It’s not bad at all! It’s not proper Mexican food but what do you expect? It’s cheap, quick, easy fast food. The wraps we had were delicious. Service wasn’t bad, little slow if I’m being honest. Of course there are better places for this sort of thing but if you’re passing through and want something cheap and simple, it’s fine.

This place is fantastic, I would highly recommend the chicken tacos, burritos and any option of loaded fries. The atmosphere and staff are amazing. We will be back again before we leave Nagoya, because Jerry's is amazing.

Worst food we’ve had out of our 3 wks in japan. If you’re going to eat here, definitely get something with the tortilla chips because they were fantastic. But I would recommend just getting Mexican somewhere else and paying a bit more. The food was so basic and terrible but we should’ve known from how grungy the place looks.

name: Mega Kebab (Osu Shopping Arcade)
reviews:
Went here after touring around Osu Shopping arcade. I've been looking for a kebab or turkish restaurant around the place for a while, luckily, I found this place.

I'm satisfied with my Kebab cravings because of their mega kebab pita. I love how tender and savory it is, plus the portion is big with lots of meat inside. They also have other options and set meals that might suit your interests.

I highly recommend this shop for people like me who loves shawarma and kebabs.

One of the worst kebabs I’ve had in Japan (and I’ve tried 100+ across the country). Nothing like Turkey, or a Döner. Sauce is full of mayo, you get tiny slices of meat, and it’s expensive for the price. 90% of the content is cheap cabbage. Won’t be coming here again.

Went there with my family and the arrogance of the cashier guy was too much! He made us change our minds about the possibility of having a meal there. We changed for the store near the temple and it was the best choice!

name: Wadafuku
reviews:
4.5 Great staffs, great vibes, clean and spacious.
The tonkatsu and fried shrimp is great! Yet the cooking quality of the tonkatsu from the main store is magical. I will go back to the main store next time.

Delicious tonkatsu with free rice top up. There are English instructions that recommends the different ways to savour the meat with the different condiments and sauces.
Beautifully decorated interior with automated payment checkout.

Very tasty tonkatsu with many little seasonings to try too! Also had an English menu and a guide explaining what everything was. I took the first deluxe pork set.

The interior of the restaurant was nice and spacious with many tables, and had a bright but relaxed mood. I really enjoyed that after my cramped experience in Tokyo!

name: Breakfast Spot (Petaling Street)
reviews:
Ive been popping in for my morning coffee here all week, and finally had the time to sit down and order a breakfast.

The first point is that the coffee is excellent, and by my third visit the staff knew what i wanted before I even walked through the door. As a visiting traveller I appreciated being recognised so quickly.

The restaurant is beautiful inside, the ac is cooling but not excessively so.

The coffee is prepared fresh and fast, the taste is to me, pure Joy in the morning.

Today for my last visit i also selected two "single" toast options. The salmon with cream cheese and mandarin, as well as the tomato cheese basil and pomegranate options.

The menu is impressive, the food is beautifully presented and the flavours combined to make this breakfast a genuine "happy dance" meal.

I cannot overstate how much i enjoyed this, and I will return to eat here again the next time im in KL.

Full marks fully deserved

Spacious and nice ambience when we happen to drop by for tea around 3pm. Very welcoming and friendly staffs.

We tried their latte and tiramisu, it’s okay but a lot of improvement will be appreciated. 🤗

I think they have only 1 toilet for each gender and dark theme (really dark). 😎

Good location with a beautiful external side wall painting, great place for photo spot.

Inside the cafe, there are more wall paintings and decorations. Great place to chill out.

We ordered prawn aglio olio, chicken waffle, hot cafe latte and peach tea with rose flavor.

name: EKIZO
reviews: Excellent menu and service. Gluten free and vegan options. Check out the gluten free noodles, very nice
Lots of people during weekends. Some store are having their sale.
Still the same since 2022 last time i went there!

name: インド村 鈴鹿本店
reviews: So far the closest Indian food I had in Japan. Flavourful, aromatic and served beautifully in  Indian style utensils. Beautiful staff, super polite and friendly. And also, the place is visited by former Mercedes F1 team driver Valtteri Bottas!
Eat all you can, u won’t stop to bite the  spicy grilled chicken. I can request the NaN of India look not the round one.
decent curry at a very reasonable price, they even have all you can eat curry buffets on weekends. best (and maybe the only?) in town

name: Matoba
reviews: Welcome to Matoda restaurant, I was sitting in a private room with my colleague. In the middle on the table a kind of braseiro tor the diner preparation. The beef is a fatty wagyu that is panned and dip in fresh egg. The vegetables are leaks, carrots, oignons and cabbage. This is an amazing experience

松阪駅からほど近い「まと場」は、食肉市場直送の松阪牛を味わえるお店。今回はすき焼きをいただきました。仲居さんが目の前で焼いてくれるスタイルで、肉が割下に触れると瞬く間に食欲をそそる香りが広がります。一口食べれば旨み濃厚で、柔らかさに驚かされるほど。肉の質はもちろん、季節の野菜も瑞々しく、全体が上品にまとまっています。平日の夜に伺った際は待ち時間なくスムーズに入店できました。駐車場が完備されているので車でのアクセスが便利。

コース　竹 ¥10,500
まと場特製　しぐれ煮 ¥800
ハンバーグプレート　¥1750
牛肉とさしみ　¥時価
牛肉のたたき　¥時価

中居さんが作ってくれるみたいです！
お肉はレアか赤みなくなるまで焼くか
初めに聞いてくれます
お肉はほんっとに柔らかくてとろけました
追加4枚しましたが胃もたれ確定です笑
ネギも玉ねぎも甘みがありました。
子供プレートもあるので子連れでも安心
またいきたいお店です！！！

name: Misai
reviews:
行ってみたかったお店。電子マネー使えました。
お昼時で賑わってました。
ランチのつつみが目当てでしたので予約して行きました。２部制のようで私は12:30の２部に予約。
ランチに500円プラスで天ぷらがつけられます。

手巻き寿司ランチと焼き蛤をランチでいただきました
料理デザートともとても美味しかったですが
焼き蛤を注文した際は何も言われなかったのですが
どうやら一つから注文出来るそうなのです
私は1人5個くらい出てくるのかなと思い2人前をお願いしましたがしばらくしてお一人様一つでよろしいですかと聞き直して来たので思わずハイと答えてしまいました
板場にはってあるメニューの焼蛤1200円をみて注文したのでそのつもりでしたので頭の中は？？？になって
えっ一つ1200円もするの？とか思わずハイと答えてしまいましたが画像のサイズなら3個くらいは食べたかったです
最初に一つからご提供出来ますが何個になさいますか？又はお一人様〇つまでの提供となりますがいかがいたしましょう？などと聞いてくれたらスムーズなやり取りが出来たのにと感じました

席についてです
カウンター席に案内されましたが隣り客とのパーソナルスペースが狭くて気になりゆっくり食事出来なかったです
食後のデザートもお願いするのも忘れるくらい早く出なきゃ感を私は感じました
この辺は人によりますので「私は」です
どれくらい狭いかというとランチのご飯のお椀の蓋を横に置いたら隣の人のおしぼりと接触しそうな距離と
置いてあるメニュー表を隣の人と共有しなければならない感じです
パーソナルスペースが気になる方は参考にして下さい
後ろには4人用のテーブル席がありますので予約の際相談してみて下さい

実は連れも気づいていたけど我慢したそうです
気を使わせてしまいました
人気のお店なので忙しいのはわかりますがもう少し店内の清掃に気をつけてもらえるとよかったと感じました

name: Padi House, Suria KLCC
street: Lot G03-H G/Floor, Petronas Twin Tower, Shopping Centre, Jln Ampang
reviews:
Less visible place as it's situated at at opposite of both KLCC and Isetan's side entrances. Service was just so-so. However the food was decent. Also, certain seatings were less ventilated as the smell from the kitchen was quite pungent
‎
‎
Came here for brunch,fast service,tasty food and my soft boiled eggs was perfectly boiled. Usually I would get runny ones and not cooked well. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
The food is fine, but I was disappointed by the service. Some staff members seemed unenthusiastic and didn't respond even when we say thank you

name: Misono
reviews: 2026-02-26 I'd give 3.5 stars overall. The thick udon was not bad but I prefer the chewier ones personally. The curry sauce was nice. It's spicier and less sweet than the typical Japanese curry. Beware of curry splash when slurping the udon! Luckily I was not wearing anything light coloured 🤣

Local restaurant run by a sweet and friendly couple. Once arriving at Arima Onsen, we tried looking for a good place to try local food, that feels authentic. I'm glad we stepped inside - we were greeted and treated well. Their food is absolutely delicious! We got the wagyu beef set meal with some tempura starters, and topped it off with a hot and refreshing curry bowl. The meat was spectacular - melts in your mouth and delicious. Unfortunately their high grade Kobe beef was all finished, so if you come here should definitely try that and be blessex by the gods of meat. Highly recommended!

Despite the small space and limited seats, it gives intimate experience with the owners. The location is a bit away from the main shopping area where that area offers more restaurants with more crowded tourists. This place is awesome.

They offer humble curry options with various drink options to choose from. As we were so hungry for lunch and hadn't had curry for a  while, our curries were so delicious. The flavor was great, the onsen egg is the best complimentary.

We had Asahi Zero because it was our first time to drink beers (including non-alcoholic ones because my husband doesn't drink alcohol) and it gave a clean aftertaste, best for cleaning the 'heavy' mouth-feeling when you eat curry ragout - especially when we came there during early summer.

Would recommend for those who want to enjoy curry in a less crowded space 🍛🥰🙏🏻

name: Ship Kobe Kaigan Building
reviews:
The Former Bank of Japan Kobe Branch is a historic stone building completed in 1912 and designed by Tatsuno Kingo, the architect of Tokyo Station. Its Western classical style reflects Kobe’s importance as an international port city in the early 20th century.

The building survived World War II and the 1995 Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake and remains a protected architectural landmark along Kaigan-dōri. Even viewed from the outside, it offers a strong sense of Kobe’s financial and maritime history.

Part of what would once have formed the Kobe equivalent of the Shanghai Bund, and one of the few period or period style buildings remaining in Kobe. Critically damaged in the 1995 earthquake; rebuilt retaining the facade on the lower floors and with a tower block above. Such is progress. Now separated from the water of the harbour by a busy road and a waterside walkway.
Very creative way to save an earthquake damaged building. Keep the facade and construct a new building inside. I love it.

name: Mega Kebab Osu 2 Halal ‎حلال
reviews: What can i say, its a kebab..its nice and yummy..meat is delicious and not bland. Halal hot food on the go. Good for a wuick pit stop. The shopkeepers are friendly and helpful!
Very tasty chicken roll. Great food. Good staff. Clean and friendly environment.

While the main guy at the counter did complete his job. He was cat calling every woman who walked past. It was disgusting.
As food food, it's ok for 900yen. Portion size a bit small.
No disrespect to the other staff member there the one actually assembling the wraps, he did his job fine.
But I was completely repulsed by the other staff member. I'm sure this is not the way they want their store represented. It was extremely sexist. I will never buy from there again as long as I see that staff member.

name: サーキットダイニング
reviews: Food taste here was great and the pricing was also reasonable. Their services were also great.

鈴鹿サーキットに家族で行ってきました♪
モータースポーツ大好きな私ですが、実は鈴鹿サーキットに来るのは初めて。富士スピードウェイは数えきれないほど行っているんですけどね～

宿泊は鈴鹿サーキットホテル。部屋は鈴鹿サーキットならでは、タイヤデザインの座椅子や壁、工具型のクッションなどなど、息子はもちろん、私もテンション上がります(^^)

此方のホテルのビュッフェレストラン｢サーキットダイニング｣はかなり質の高い料理を楽しむことが出来、三重県産地物の美味しい食材と料理の数々がギュッと詰まっています！
ビックリしたのが三重県松阪市でよく食べられている牛ホルモンとか、伊勢うどんとか、普通のビュッフェレストランでは見ないような料理もあって新感覚ビュッフェです！
私が気に入った一品もまさに牛ホルモン味噌焼きで、たくさん持ってきて生ビールと一緒に堪能しました(^-^)/
他にも地の利を生かした海産物。海鮮丼も自分で好きなように作れます(^^)v
朝食も豪華です。鯛茶漬けとフレンチトースト、和と洋が混同ですが、どちらも美味しくて何回かおかわりしちゃいました(笑)

大満足です。ご馳走様でした＼(^^)／
在樂園結束一天的玩樂後最佳的食物補充站，建議事先於官網預約避免客滿無法用餐。餐廳內提供蜜柑汁與三重縣地產物吃到飽。烤牛排必吃鮮嫩多汁。選項不多但吃飽沒問題。

name: Odashi to Oyasai Midori
street: Arimacho, 1021-1 有馬スプリングテラス Ｂ
reviews:
Absolutely loved it. We had this meal the first night we arrived at Arima Onsen.

Steamed Dinner Set
I thought originally that the food would be bland since this was steamed, but when I tried it with the 4 types of sauces/dips (sesame paste, salt, white miso, and a red chili paste which they sell for 900 yen in store) I found them to be an ideal complement that you get to fully control - you decide on the depth of flavor by either enjoying the natural sweetness of the steamed vegetables or use the sauces to add to the depth of the taste.

The small dishes they give you on the side are also a perfect addition, with each one being unique in its own way. There’s a dish that we thought was king oyster mushroom but when we bit into it we were surprised to find it to be taro - thoroughly steamed and lightly seasoned to bring out full flavor of the taro itself (enjoy this in small bites as eating it whole can tend to be dry). There’s another grated carrot dish mixed with another vegetable that we couldn’t figure out, a pickled vegetable dish, and warabi mochi to finish off your meal.

Great place for a healthy meal. The menu for meals is quite limited (only 2 different kind of sets—one sukiyaki, one steamed), but each gives you a diverse and yummy spread. Feels very much like home cooking—light and healthy and reasonably priced. Great to accompany a “detoxing” environment if you’re in Arima for onsen. (Of course you are!)

We didn’t have a reservation so we had to sit outside, but essentially when another group left, we were seated inside for our meal, which was very nice.

They also have an extensive alcohol menu if you’re into that. (We are not, so can’t speak on that.)

Definitely be sure to get the sukiyaki set so you can have the rice in the soup bowl “risotto” style. It was a very nice touch.

We had one of the most authentic Japanese dinners here! I found this place on Google Maps and noticed it had vegetarian options so I booked it by directly messaging them on Instagram (with japanese translation).

name: Matsushima
reviews:
定食屋 松島さんで「さわらの塩焼き定食」をいただきました。
メインのさわらが本当に絶品！**身はふっくらと焼き上げられており、驚くほどしっかり脂がのっていて、旨味が口いっぱいに広がります。**塩加減も絶妙で、ご飯が進む最高の美味しさでした。
また、定食に付いてきた赤だしも、風味豊かでホッとできる味わい。さわらの美味しさを引き立てる、丁寧な仕事ぶりが感じられました。質の高いお魚料理を定食で気軽にいただけるのが、とても嬉しいです。
ごちそうさまでした、また必ず伺います！

地下鉄熱田神宮伝馬町駅からすぐのところにある昭和レトロ感が残る定食屋。定食屋ですが出される定食はどれも価格高めのワングレード上なものばかりで和風レストラン的なお店です。平日夜の部開店直後に訪れましたがまだ空いておりました。メニューは店前にあるホワイトボードに書かれた日替わりなラインナップで魚料理・肉料理ともにいい食材を使った美味しそうなものばかりでどれを食べようか迷うほどです。この日のメニューからは和牛イチボの牛カツ定食を単品のかつおのたたきも付けて注文。牛カツもかつおのたたきも丁寧に作られて素材が良くご飯が進みとても美味しかったです。赤だしも出汁が効いて香ばしくこれは何度も行きたくなるお店です。

熱田区にある老舗の定食屋さん
旧東海道沿いにあります
定食メニューが豊富で仕入れの状況によって内容や値段も変わるようです
お刺身は新鮮でカキフライもジューシーでホクホクです
ご夫妻2人での営業のため
混雑時にはお時間がかかりますが
ゆっくり食事が出来ると思えば
それもこの店の味でしょう

焼き魚やカツも食べてみたいですね

name: Việt Nam Nướng Đá Xông Khói
street: No. 15A (R-1-18),, Jalan Tong Shin, Off, Jln Alor
reviews:
I didn't want to dine at the crowded and noisy Alor Street, so I saw the sign through an alley. Vietnamese restaurant, I always love it. The price is reasonable in my opinion, for RM.50 I had 2 dishes with pineapple juice. The outside of the spring roll was a bit dry, but the pineapple juice was lovely.

Anyone would be able to find something out of 620 dishes on the menu, no kidding. That's excluding the drink list.

The owner and staffs could do better with a smile though, none and really none was serving the customers with a smile. Polite but cold. They had 2 sections, the open air and the AC room.

Looks like it is owned and run by Vietnamese people, so it'll score highly for authenticity, especially when pork is NOT excluded from the menu. Also looks like it has a fairly big Vietnamese clientele.

Menu has quite a wide range with English and Chinese subtitles. In addition to the "usual" stuff like pho and spring rolls, it has many interesting items on the menu, that us non-Vietnamese might not immediately think of when thinking about Vietnamese food.

A Vietnamese restaurant with a lot choices of foods, even  you order 3 or 4 different dishes every week, you still unable to try all the dishes in this restaurant. For rices, soup noodles, starter, hotpot, barbecue skewer, seafood and many more. The foods taste also very good, definitely will come back to test others dishes.

name: Carnarvon Street (Street food)
reviews:
This place is one of the known Penang street food places. I can understand why there are mixed reviews for this place as there were some hits and some misses for me.

My highlights and tips:
- Nearby coffee shops and roadside tables can be occupied to consume any of the street food stalls. If seated in the coffee shops, the same food item available in the coffee shop cannot be ordered from the street food stall.
- Drinks must be ordered when dining there.
- All stalls accept cash.
- Stallholders can be pushy to get you to order. You can always say no and they will respect the choice/ decision conveyed.

- The top choices:
1. Char koay kak for the tasty, soft textured and fragrant cubes of noodles. The ingredients are all well cooked and go well together. The wrap up presentation is cool too and with banana leaf being used, it adds on to the fragrance of the dish.
2. White curry mee for the fragrant curry paste. It was tasty and rich.
- The ok: the satay and bbq chicken wings. I liked the taste of char from being cooked in charcoal but could do with more depth of flavour. The apom was ok but it was rather thin. Though the lady who was selling it was rather sweet.
- The misses: char koay teow as it didnt taste as good as a number of the other char koay teow places in Penang.

With the plethora of street food choices, this probably is not the top one on my list. Still decent nevertheless.

Go to the stand with three old uncles running it. They serve a DELICIOUS duck broth rice noodle. The best part about the whole experience is the three old uncles. One uncle is responsible for the cooking (he can barely hear), one old uncle is responsible for the ordering (he can barely speak), and the last uncle handles the communication (and miscommunication) between the two of them. It’s a super cute and heart warming experience to see them all working together. Go support them for good food and heart and body warming yummy noodles!

I just have to quote Wanderful Travelling's review: "Honestly the worst place to eat in Georgetown. You really like eating between cars, exhaust gases and traffic jam? Go here! Price for food also expensive
You will find no local people here for dinner."
The satay is a scam. The real dishes are much smaller in the picture. The pork satay is interspersed with what tastes like mutton fat. We will never return.

name: Kawasaki Good Times World
reviews: A very interesting museum and entertainment complex exploring the history of seafaring and the achievements of Kawasaki. Interesting simulators of ship control, harbor cranes, jet skis, and more are available. You can admire magnificent Kawasaki motorcycles. Admission is 900 yen for adults.

This was actually surprisingly enjoyable!  My husband wanted to visit here on our trip, and I expected to be bored but there was quite a bit to see and do.  I enjoyed the ship models and history in the same building, and my 12yo enjoyed the flight simulator.   There was some robotics, and also miniature trains.  It was very easy to spend a couple of hours here.

I didn't know Kawasaki was way more than motorcycles till I visited the museum.
If you are a Kawasaki enthusiast it's a most see.

name: Mi Fun House
reviews: Perched at the top of the street in Jalan Alor, this restaurant gives you a great view down this lantern lit bustling alley. Warm and attentive service combined with a chef who runs a kitchen that knows how to produce delicious Chinese and Malaysian dishes, fast and fresh. The quality of the pork and seafood dishes were top knotch and left us all very satisfied. Well priced too, unlike some of the restaurants also on this strip.

Restoren Chu Cha instead, situated a little further up the road. As with most of the other restaurants in this area, you can sit inside but most people choose to dine "al fresco" - seated at plastic tables spread across the sidewalk and part of the road... with the night sky as your canopy. The rather fidgety waiter handed us a menu (A surprisingly well laid out menu! - decent photos, clear pricing stated and with descriptions in English)... and we scanned the wide range of fried noodles/ rice, tai chow styled dishes and many other Malaysian favourites they had to offer.
Personally, it's the top 3 best curry noodle & asam laksa in Klang Valley. Fish ball also pretty good. All @ RM7 each! Value for money. Highly recommended for locals & foreigners alike!

name: Yabaton JR Nagoya Station Takashimaya
street: Meieki, 1 Chome−1−4 ジェイアールタカシマヤ 地下
reviews:
Bought back the loin Katsu . They provided a very nice packaging as well as the miso sauce for the Katsu.

The shop keeper was really lovely and even gave a stamp card for us when we bought the food.

The store only does takeouts and it is in the basement 1 of Takashimaya which I would have appreciated the know before hand. Hope this information serves you well.

Overall the food was good but not a fan of the miso sauce in the end.

I ordered tonkatsu with two sauces - miso and regular tonkatsu sauce. It was the first time I'd had miso sauce and it was delicious. I should have had miso for the whole meal. The pork was delicious, the service fast and friendly, and the atmosphere was lively. Great Nagoya-style tonkatsu.
Taking the recommendation of a local we had dinner at Yabaton and we were not disappointed. Fabulous flavour!

name: 호리강 Nayabashi Pier Samurai Cruise
reviews: Samurai cruise... Worth try once.

我們是從名古屋城搭乘回納屋橋
沿途都有詳盡的日文導覽講解堀川的歷史
如果想在都市就享受遊船樂趣，推薦來這
到堀川可以逛maill，很方便

name: 石垣池
reviews: Very scenic view especially during spring where cherry blossoms bloom beautifully. A good place to picnic, jogging and have playground for kids, just across the road. Free parking.

三重県鈴鹿市桜島町　石垣池公園🏞️さんを、2025年11月29日（土曜日）に訪問させていただきました。

午後と午後に分けて、訪問させていただきました。

来訪されているかたも多数みえました。
また、訪問させていただきたいと思います😊

2024年12月08日（日曜日)に、訪れました。
インスタグラムに記載があり、グーグルマップさんを拝見してから、伺いました。
なかなかな、メタセコイアの並木を見ることができました✨

１５時過ぎで、けっこうな寒さでしたが、メタセコイアを見に来られるかたがたが、大勢見えました。
駐車場も、ほぼ満タンという盛況ぶりでした✨

休日の夕方🌇、天候良好だと、人気なスポットは混みますね。
車両との写真は難しくてあきらめました。また、機会をみて、伺いたいと思います。

はじめて訪問しました。
とても整備されていて、いいところでした。
ウォーキング、ランニングや、ペットの散歩などで市民の憩いの場になってるような感じでした。
公園の遊具もあり、小さいお子さんの遊ぶところもありました。

name: Penang Trishaw Station
reviews: If you are lost and looking for a guide in Georgetown, get a ride on the trishaw along the Armenian Street and explore around the town area. Look out for this uncle, he is very honest and nice. He explain everything about the the history behind the paintings and also very polite. Please support him you will be delighted to have him as your guide.
Epicentre of the trishaws. They all get left here overnight. Certainly the place to come if you fancy a rickshaw ride.

Very disappointed. We asked for an English speaking rider as we had seen great reviews. No problem. He shouted out 3 sentences  the whole trip.  "Chinese temple" - no really. "Church" - I could see that. "Get out here go inside" at 2 crappy shops. Wanted to see the clan jetty - nope. My advice - ask the rider to explain what you will see on the trip. if he can't explain ask for a different one. Cost was 70 Ringgits for an hour. At the end the rider wanted more. I gave him 80.

name: Sannomiya Hondori Shopping Street
reviews:
Calm and lively at the same time — a perfect balance that only Kobe can keep.
This covered street connects everyday shops, cafés, and hidden gems. Even on cold days, the light through the glass roof feels warm.
Clean, organized, and never too crowded — a good spot to slow down and watch the rhythm of the city.
Nice shopping street in Kobe
三宮通商店街位於三宮站和元町商店街中間，人潮沒有元町商店街來得多，分為1~3丁目，1丁目有台灣人最愛的HARBS千層蛋糕，3丁目附近有當地人氣相當高的「歇斯底里果醬」可麗餅。

name: BAZAAR RAMADAN BUKIT BINTANG (Street Foods)
reviews: Tbh some of the stalls here offer reasonable prices compared to other bazar. Worth trying coming here at least once.

Too tight and small spaces bazaar walkway. The food are just nice but nothing awe though. Perfect for urban workers looking for immediate break food but can be compromised by MRT Bukit Bintang sardine-packed station
Ok laa not many shop

name: Namba Parks
reviews:
The soft lighting, modern architecture, and the rooftop garden vibe created a calm escape right in the middle of busy Osaka. It felt cozy, romantic, yet still very family-friendly.

Walking around with my wife and kids at night was super comfortable—clean paths, safe atmosphere, and plenty of spots to sit and enjoy the view. The contrast between the city lights and the greenery made the moment feel special and memorable. Perfect place for a slow evening stroll after dinner.

​I highly recommend visiting this place! The winter night lights are absolutely breathtaking. You can enjoy a variety of plants as you take a leisurely stroll uphill, and there are plenty of spots to sit and relax along the way. It is a perfect location for photos. If you get tired or cold, there are buildings and shops where you can take a break. It's the perfect blend of nature and comfort.

Namba Park is a modern shopping and leisure destination in Osaka, offering a great mix of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment options. The mall is spacious, clean, and well-organized, making it easy to explore and enjoy.

The Rooftop Garden is a standout feature, providing a relaxing escape with beautiful greenery and stunning views of the city. It’s perfect for enjoying a coffee, light meal, or simply taking in the scenery. The staff are friendly and attentive, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable visit. Overall, Namba Park and its Rooftop offer a complete experience for shopping, dining, and relaxation in the heart of Osaka.

name: Shirakawa Park
reviews: Nestled within Nagoya’s urban landscape, Shirakawa Park offers a serene and beautifully curated natural escape that feels both intimate and refreshing. Its well-maintained paths wind through lush, mature greenery, past a tranquil central pond, and alongside gentle streams, creating a peaceful atmosphere that effectively muffles the city's hustle. While compact, the park’s design maximizes its space with charming bridges, seasonal flower displays—particularly lovely during the plum and iris blooms—and quiet benches perfect for contemplation. More than just a green space, it serves as a cherished local retreat for morning walks, quiet reading, or a brief restorative pause, embodying the Japanese appreciation for harmonious, accessible nature within the metropolitan fabric.
Shirakawa Park is a great place to visit in Nagoya, we can walk around and watch the fountain nearby is also beautiful to see and there is a rainbow there

It's nice! It bet it will be so fantastic when the peak of autumn. There's much bench so you can enjoy food. I bought my food from Osu Shopping District! By walking around 8 minutes, you can do the same~

name: Nagoya Station
reviews: Nagoya Station is the central hub of travel in Japan’s Chubu region. With Shinkansen, JR lines, subway, and buses all connected, transportation is extremely convenient. The station building is one of the largest in the world, housing shopping malls, restaurants, and hotels, making it a true “station city.” As I noted in my book *How Cities Become Brands", Nagoya Station is not just a transit facility but an expanded concept of a city within the station itself. When unsure about where to eat, meet, or get tourist information in a new city, heading to the station is always a reliable strategy. The signage inside is clear, so even foreign visitors can navigate easily, and it’s an excellent starting point for nearby attractions. The only challenge is its massive scale and multiple lines, which can feel overwhelming at first. Overall, it was a very satisfying experience!

To go Meitetsu Bus Centre: just follow the signboard that says MEITETSU LINE until you see MEITETSU BUS STATION

We took a Shinkansen from Osaka to Nagoya. The station is very busy and fairly big. After that we took a bus from Meitetsu Bus Terminal which is just around 5-8mins walk from here.

Another typical JR Station that is in one of the well know cities. I was only transferring there from shinkensan to JR but it was relatively smooth and easy to navigate around without any issue.  As many other JR stations, it has washrooms, tons of signs and guidance in various languages on aiding tourist and shops.

name: Ben's Suria KLCC
street: Lot No. 140, Level 1, Suria KLCC, Persiaran Petronas
reviews:
Have frequented here for so long, and I’ve always loved Ben’s. Recently hosted someone’s birthday here and staff were very kind to us despite it being near iftar time.
