Food was lovely and everyone complimented the choices they picked. Ambience as always is nice and staff is quick to respond to our needs.

I do have to note that the Vietnamese pho is out of the world. The soup itself tasted amazing to me, and it was very hearty. Second good choice was the Hainanese chicken chop which to me fit the standards.

Had a great dining experience at Ben’s @ KLCC. The overall vibe was relaxed and comfortable, making it a nice place to enjoy a proper sit-down meal. While waiting for our order, we tried Ben’s Chit Chat Cards, which turned out to be surprisingly fun. It’s a combination of Q&A and trivia questions, and it really helped pass the time and made the wait more enjoyable.

We ordered a mix of mains and drinks, and everything was well prepared. The Peri-Peri Satay stood out with its tender, well-grilled chicken and mild smoky heat that added a nice twist to a familiar dish without being overpowering. The Vietnamese Beef Pho was comforting and flavourful, with a clear yet rich broth, tender beef, and well-balanced seasoning. The Hainanese Chicken Rice was simple but satisfying — the chicken breast was moist and tender, and the fragrant rice complemented it well without being oily.

For drinks, both the Watermelon Lychee Frosty and the Korean Citron Lychee Frosty were refreshing and not overly sweet. The flavours tasted clean and natural, making them great palate cleansers alongside the savoury dishes.

Overall, the food was consistently good, portions were satisfying, and the experience felt enjoyable and well thought out. A solid choice at KLCC for comforting meals, refreshing drinks, and a fun dining touch. Would definitely return.

I had hoped for a good experience here as it was a night out with my son, and we were grabbing a late dinner.

The aglio olio was absolutely drowning in oil, and we couldn’t bring ourselves to finish the add-on “chicken tenders” (extra RM12 charge). Without this bland add-on chicken, it would be RM28 for plain pasta soaked in oil with some chili flakes.

The RM32 Caesar salad was also poor value for money.

Cleanliness doesn’t seem a priority either.

Service-wise, poor for a cafe at this price-point - okay if it was a mamak.

Immediately after serving our food, the waiter announced that the kitchen is closing (about 9:15 - he told us earlier that the last order is at 9:30) and the credit card machine was brought to me to pay my bill just as I had barely begun eating.

I’m just disappointed. I don’t know who owns this place but it comes across as there being little care or concern for how customer’s experience.

I think much reflection is in order for the owners.

name: Kimberley Street Food Night Market
reviews:
If you come here, make sure to queue for this legendary kuey teow! The line is usually long, but it’s totally worth it. It’s so interesting that the seller writes your order on the plate with sambal instead of paper, they’re literally pros 👍👍👍

Don’t miss the roasted duck from the stall behind this one too it’s super tender and melts in your mouth, a perfect combo with the kuey teow!

Nice street food at Kimberley Street Food Night Market… you’ll find tasty street food hawkers, little tables to sit. Just need to order and they’ll bring it to you. Someone will also come to order drinks… menu start around 15RM, so you can try different things. The atmosphere is nice and authentic. We were there while raining and it was still possible to find some place sheltered. The hawkers start around 6.30 pm, they are very friendly. It’s very nice place to stop by in historic George Town and walk around little alley ways…

One of Penang’s most famous food streets. The longest queues are usually for kwap chap and char kuey teow. Honestly, the taste isn’t anything special, people line up mainly because it’s popular with tourists, and the prices are on the higher side.

name: Kafei Dian (Petaling Street KL)
reviews: Had a quick breakfast with my friends here after our morning jog. Ordered our usual and the food is amazing. The staff were friendly - she even spoke a little bit of Tagalog which is a surprise. We loved the vibe and atmosphere. Overall, the experience was pleasant.

I’ve been back to this cafe a couple of times now.
I’m a big fan of their heritage-style Chinese, Peranakan and Malaysian dishes.
Today, we had Hainam fried noodles, and the sambal was dead set amazing!
The ginger stewed duck was also pretty good.
The chicken roll was tasty, but it was a bit greasy.
The winter melon soup was refreshing!

Kafei Dian captures that perfect nostalgic vibe, making it a great spot to soak in a bit of old-world charm while you eat. The Nasi Lemak is flavorful and hit the spot perfectly. If you're a caffeine lover, the coffee here is impressively strong and rich, exactly how a traditional brew should be. Plus, the prices are very affordable, so you get a fantastic meal and experience without breaking the bank.

name: Plaza Imbi
reviews: went here to repair my laptop and so far my experience was good. i went there by myself and the shoplots were mostly empty, but it was safe nonetheless. the commute was not bad as well. there's an option for you to walk inside the mall to get here. it was perfect because when i went to pickup my laptop, it was raining heavily but thankfully the sidewalk has roof(?)
2nd hand  and refurbished computers service center like Subastu elephant road market

Good look for Matrix Data Recovery, they can do anything from fixing your broken hard drive / retrieving data or trading in to get a refurbished or second-hand PC or laptop.

Tell them you say you know me. 😉

name: Mingle Cafe
reviews:
The storefront design is very stylish.

Although I went on a cloudy day, it still had a unique charm.
The lush greenery, vines growing wildly, and the weathered old walls...

The interior decor is retro, and the seating arrangement is quite reasonable.

What attracted me most were the cakes at the bar; they looked so comforting! But I was in a rush and didn't get to try them...

The food prices were moderate, and the taste was okay.

What I liked about it : The tiramisu is nice. Pasta is acceptable.
: There were only 2 tables when we came, service was quick.
: The place is pleasing in the eyes.

What can be improved : I didn't like the steak. Sorry. For RM 38, it was a bit high for me.
: The servers can be more friendly. It may be because they are almost closing, but still, a smile while talking to us is appreciated.

First impression for the Mingle Cafe was good and stunning with old vibes of building and blend with nature.

Warm Welcoming by staff/ crew and accompanying to the seat.
Giving us menu booklet but the staff advice to make an order/ pay at the counter. 👎 ermmm.
Which is bad impression at beginning.
If you’re come in big group and hardly to remember all menu to order and make payment at counter was not a good idea.

About food and beverages;
Really tasty. Recommended nasi ulam served in bowl.

My personal comment and review which is i not prefer about presentable/ suitable as a crew who serve the customer and blend with local culture.
I remembered about our signature Malaysian Hospitality bu Malaysia Airlines and refer to great cabin crew.
If they have a tattoo no problem but not appear the tattoo during working and serve customer.
But one of this staff at Mingle Cafe was okay and good service. Unfortunately too many tattoo on her hand and really not comfortable and presentable to serve customer.
Something to ponder about this especially local culture.

name: Namba Udon
reviews:
Had to wait for 10 minutes , but it was worth it.
Understated tiny place .
Generous servings , bowls were perfectly seasoned .
Had the udon with beef and egg, and had additions of fried tofu and wakame seaweed.
Also had the oyakudon bowl with egg .
All my favorite ingredients in one big hot slurp !
Absolutely delicious and  hearty 🩷

11/October/2025
Had 1 beef soba soup (¥530) for lunch, was quite good. Service was prompt. Nice ambience. I can literally see them cooking my food, nice. Taste was slightly on the savory note, I'll be back to try their other items on the menu.
Stopped into this great udon joint. The price was amazing, the food was fresh, and the service was great. The offer free water but you cannot have any other drink as they don’t serve drinks

name: Nagoya Port Building
reviews:
Outside, this place doesn't look like it has much.
Inside, there is a full Museum and observation deck.
Very clean place and friendly staff.
Huge waiting area wit a lot of chairs.
Great views!

But there is no Mitan and Portan stamps!
There is a very big port with a big garden and sea you view. There is an aquarium with Dolphin. We can go direct by subway.
A little bit boring for me. Like all the other high towers. All you can do is going up and see the view. But I need to say the view is really nice.

name: Solo Pizza Napoletana
reviews:
After my job interview, I head back December 1st, I stopped by Solo Pizza Napoletana for a pizza.

From outside the place looked like it was gonna be very expensive so I was really surprised when I got in and saw the prices were much lower than expected. Of course, this meant I also figured the pizza would be very small.

I ordered a margarita (¥500) and a marinara pizza (¥680) as both were very small. I was surprised the pizza is actually when they arrived with bigger than I thought they’d be. And they actually were both really good. Go to cook, medium sized wood fire oven.

The speed in which both pizzas came out was very fast. I was surprised when they were both put on paper plates. Overall, it ended up being more like a slice shop. I gave the impression of being an Italian restaurant I kind of like the fee on this because the pricing was good. The quality of pizza was also very good.

The two pizzas and a bottle of coke in an actual glass bottle came to about ¥1600 which wasn’t bad. And i left feeling pretty full. I was thinking about ordering a third piece, but I’m glad I didn’t cause I probably couldn’t finish it.

PRO: vert affordable and good quality  CON: i have no complaints.
See all the pizzas on my IG at  at @pizzabastard.

Honestly they’ve captured the essence of Italian culture and food.

I was here for lunch and loved everything we ordered. My personal favourite would be the sausage and margarita pizza.

Would definitely visit again in the future.

I wish they had more Italian draft beer options which would’ve been top notch,but still moretti will do.

Also they have variety of quality wine would defensively try it next time.

Note: Call ahead or book a course or you have to wait in queue (quite a long one) as it is busy from the start till end.

The pizza was totally delicious - favourably comparable to what we had in Naples. A fun buzzy space with heated outdoor tables available as well (it was busy inside so we sat outside). It was a little tricky to understand how to receive our food once we had ordered (you order on a screen and get a receipt number which is called out once your food is ready) but a friendly server helped us out a lot. Lots of vegetarian options and the menu is available in English.

name: NAMBA DINING MAISON
street: Namba, 5 Chome−1−18 髙島屋大阪店 ７･８･９Ｆ
reviews: Based on our experience in Singapore, Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka, restaurants located at the top of Takashimaya offer excellent value for the money and are of top quality. During our stay in Osaka, we tried 2 of them: Wabiyakorekido (chicken yakitori in the 8 floor) and Grill Capital Touyoutei (japanese-french in the 7 floor) and both were excellent.

This restaurant was on the top floor of the mall and could have been easily missed but it was a great find.  The Japanese hamburger steak is their specialty.  You can also get a Kobe beef hamburger steak instead.  Give this place a try if you are in the area.

i was eager for an eel bowl at lunch and didn't mind to pick a chain store. although it's a china, the quality is kept consistent and guaranteed. simple eel bowl set just around 4,000 yen but very promising. the eel was fat and juicy. in addition we ordered an eel egg roll and an eel liver skewer, i think both are the must try item in every eel restaurant in japan. both were good. it's slightly after lunch time so plenty of seats.

name: Coco Island Street Food
reviews: We tried a variety of dishes and my favourites ended up being the char hor fun, ikan bakar, hokkien mee, and rojak. The char hor fun had a nice wok aroma with silky noodles, while the ikan bakar was flavourful with a good balance of spice. The hokkien mee was comforting and satisfying, and the rojak made for a refreshing finish with its sweet and tangy sauce.

A perfect place to enjoy an early morning dimsum breakfast. The dimsum eatery here serves the most scrumptious dimsum that is truly mouthwateringly delicious. The nostalgic taste of the char siew bao reminds me of the pork bun I enjoyed at the old Halomon Restaurant. Those of you who were kids in Penang in the 1970s-80s would definitely know what I mean 😉😋🤭. Also tried the Bak Kut Teh, which featured a nice light tasting broth that went perfectly well as a meaty soupy accompaniment to the main dimsum meal. ❤️❤️😋👍

Coco Island Street Food in Gurney, George Town, Penang, is the perfect place to enjoy the vibrant street food culture that Malaysia is famous for. With its colorful neon sign and lively open-air atmosphere, this food court immediately feels inviting and full of energy. It is one of those places where you can sit back with friends or family and enjoy a true Penang dining experience under the night sky.

The best part of Coco Island Street Food is the incredible variety of food stalls offering local Malaysian favorites, seafood, barbecue, noodles, satay, fried rice, and refreshing drinks. Prices are reasonable (RM20–40 per person), making it a budget-friendly spot for both locals and tourists. I tried several dishes, and everything tasted delicious and fresh. The portion sizes are generous, and the flavors are authentic, giving you that true Penang taste.

Even though it gets quite busy in the evening, especially on weekends, the seating area is large enough to accommodate many visitors. The staff and stall owners are friendly and helpful, making the whole experience warm and enjoyable. The atmosphere is lively with a mix of tourists and locals, creating that unique street food charm that Penang is known for.

If you are visiting George Town or staying near Gurney Drive, Coco Island Street Food is definitely worth adding to your list. It’s not only about food, but also about the experience of being in the middle of Penang’s culinary heart. Perfect for a casual night out with delicious, affordable meals and a fun local vibe. Highly recommended for anyone who loves discovering Penang’s street food culture!

name: Old China Cafe
reviews:
We went during lunar new year period and with kids, so we ordered yee sang and non-spicy food. The overall experience was nice, food was good.

We highly recommend ayam pong teh, sweet & sour fish, chui pei tofu. Yee sang was really good too, but it’s probably seasonal.

The traditional dessert - sago gula melaka - was also nice and you can adjust the sweetness based on your taste.

The buah keluak chicken was quite special as it was cooked with a kind of jungle nut that gave the color of black. The taste is a bit sweet.

I was in search of a good laksa in town while exploring this area. Old China Cafe is what Google Maps was recommending. The atmosphere was great, it offers a great 60's or 30's theme (don't know, because it was definitely way before my time.) The laksa here is just OK, I think I have tasted better ones out there. However, everything else is great here for sure.

A fantastic spot if you want to experience the atmosphere of the past. The interior design is wonderful, perfectly capturing the Old China style—very authentic and beautiful. The food was simple, yet delicious and comforting. Plus, the prices are very affordable. We really loved it; it's a place with a soul where you can enjoy a great meal without breaking the bank.

name: Kyuka Koen (Park)
reviews: Its quite large park surrounded by waters and several bridges over it. Turtles, pigeons water and a small castle together gives a relaxing atmosphere.
Beautiful park especially around Hanami but all year round.
very nice place so relaxing there ate many turtle floating in the water i love the place

name: Kanizanmai Suzuka
reviews: Delicious
anything soso
人生で初めてこんなに蟹を食べました。身もしっかり入った蟹だったし、混雑していなかったので注文すればすぐに持ってきてくれました。ドリンクも飲み放題。満足できました。

name: Torikai Sohonke Nagoya Station Esca Store
street: Tsubakicho, 6−9 エスカ地下街 北口フロア
reviews: I tried the oyakodon (chicken and egg rice bowl) here. The flavor was decent — not the best I’ve had, but still enjoyable. The chicken was tender, and the egg was soft and nicely cooked, though I personally prefer a bit more seasoning. The portion size was just right, and the rice had a good texture. The atmosphere was quiet and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and polite. If you’re nearby and craving a warm, simple Japanese meal, this place is worth a try.

Tried the cochin oyakodon. Went to this branch since it's near my hotel. Got the set so that I can try the fried chicken and chicken wing as well. The oyakodon is quite nice, easy to eat but lack the wow factor. The fried chicken is really good though!
Delicious oyakodon - plump and bouncy pieces of chicken, amidst really savoury broth and smooth silky runny egg atop a thin layer of rice

name: Shike-michi Townscape Preservation District
reviews: You get a feel for prewar Japan here. Homes, shops, restaurants in the old style. Business on the nearby Enoji Shotengai shopping street open after 12n-1pm on the Thursday we were there. Blocks are small, streets narrow, no sidewalks, so watch for cars, but traffic is light. Peaceful, quiet. Temples and shrines without tourist mobs.

A quaint space with truly traditional architecture that has been gentrified a little with hip cafes, a friendly vintage little flea market street. I really enjoyed the friendly locals who educated us about their craft and we had good conversations with farmers selling fresh produce. Definitely a great spot to explore

A lot of beautifully preserved houses here, featuring what looks like charred planks and timber members, perhaps as a way to fire proof them to a certain extent? Really a great neighborhood to be walking around in the evening,  where the light brings out the colors of the old houses!

name: Guriko Nagoya Sakae
reviews:
Chance upon this restaurant when in Sakae

The chicken broth is out of this world, very nice, umami and not salty, can literally finish the whole bowl of soup

The ordering machine is in Japanese and we seek help from the lady staff which is extremely helpful.

The noodle texture is chewy and fresh taste, the chashu is the best I had tasted. Moist and tasty and with charred smell. Wonder how they do it?

Highly recommended to try
Will go back again

We are there before 5pm and no queue, by the time we finish our ramen at 5+, a long queue is forming

Ramen diary 9-12-25
Tried: No.1 Special chicken ramen (bottom of pic)
Noodles - 7/10 nice and boucy, eggy, similar to chicnese style noodles
Charsiu - 6.5/10 thin and lightly flavoured, slightly porky. Interesting they kept pork charsiu for a chicken broth
Broth - 7/10 the chicken broth is really light yet has enough flavour, not too salty nor savoury or chickeny. It feels a bit chinese tbh. The chicken ramen would be great to have with a side dish.
Condiments - 9/10 free eggs and seaweed and assorted spices. Their furikake (rice seasoning) is excellent with any rice side.
Overall - 7.25/10 lots of greens, almost too much for the lack of richness it was fresh throughout. My mother got the soy truffle, which i tried a spoon of, it was excellent and a combination that works. Not too salty or too much soy flavour, and the truffle was a perfect amount, not overpowering that you can finish and not too subtle. I would reccomend the Soy Truffle Ramen!

you order at a ticket counter, did not support english but one of the employees came out to help us and explain things.

after we ordered and were seated they brough the food very fast and explained that we could take as much noriband raw egg as we wanted.

we paid 1700yen, the food was a lot and very delicious. the people were super nice which is really the only reason i take time to write a review.

loved the entire experience

name: Three Broomsticks
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−33 ウィザーディング・ワールド・オブ・ハリー・ポッタ
reviews: So surreal to eat at Three Broomsticks in Harry Potter, Universal Osaka Japan. A complete replica of the HP set. Food was filling and there’s this magical feeling of reeling you in the movie. Serving was so generous. Make sure you are famished because you can not take it out. Staff are so pleasant and food and drinks are so worth it! Must try really it was bloody great! Codswallop as Hagrid would always say!

Surprisingly good food for a themed park restaurant. The butter beer was excellent as were the ribs and fish & chips. You could sit either inside or by the black lake's edge out back. We sat down around 550pm and the weather was just perfect. Sitting outside at that time also gave us a perfect view of hogwarts school of witchcraft and wizardry. The setting sun really made the building glow and you just couldn't take a bad picture of it even if you tried. Best meal of the day by far. But be prepared to pay through your teeth as the meal was far from cheap.

Roast beef is really tough. Imagine having to cut with plastic cutlery.  I recommend the roast chicken which is juicy tender and came with a pie.  The kid's nugget curry meal is just pitiful, but my kids definitely love it.

name: Gravybaby Bangsar
reviews:
The food is good… unfortunately the service is rather poor. The staffs did not look welcoming…

Also, we tried to order veggie nachos but just telling them to not put onions and separate the sauce, and he suggested that we take the guac and chips. He kept saying the things are already mixed, but we had the same order before few months back and they did it for us no problem…

After that they just say oh sorry we ran out of chips….

Wanted to eat mozzarella sticks but again out of stock…

Ordered the sweet basil lemonade, and looks like they forgot the sugar, cause it wasn’t sweet, but no issue on that we asked for sugar syrup.

Ice blended Matcha tasted really good! Tempeh burger was nice too! And the truffle pizza is to die for! Basically the food is really good… just hope the service is better

On my off day, I love exploring the amazing food Malaysia has to offer — and one place I regularly visit is Gravy Baby Bangsar. I go there pretty often, but whenever I have time, I make sure to drop by for their delicious food.
This Monday was my off day (aka my cheat day 🤣), so I decided to treat myself to lunch at Gravy Baby. I’m usually a one-meal-a-day person because of my diet, but off days are for enjoying life! Since I’m not an early bird, I arrived a bit late and started with my favourite black coffee, then later ordered a fresh apple juice.
For my meal, I chose their roasted chicken with yellow rice. The dish comes with two pieces of chicken — tender, juicy, and full of flavour. Personally, I wasn’t too fond of the saffron yellow rice, so I asked the waiter if I could change it to something else. He immediately offered to switch it to steamed vegetables, and I really appreciated the service and the friendly attitude from the host. The chicken with vegetables turned out to be perfect.
But the real star of the day? Their lamb curry with bread. That dish seriously blew my mind — rich, aromatic, and incredibly satisfying. I loved it so much that I ended up ordering three more rotis to go with it!
Overall, everything was superb — great food, warm service, and a meal that left me heading home with a happy face and an even happier tummy 🤣. Gravy Baby Bangsar never disappoints!

i was so shocked why on earth your sausage is sour!!!! you guys don’t check weather your food is good or not? Customer service was also poor! We asked for water and a glass of iced but the waiter just looked at us! Luckily one of your waiter who was  a bit tall and slightly bald was friendly and attentive but, pls improve your customer service!! They didn’t know how to solve the problem with customer!!!! Never plan to come back again!!

name: Takenaka Nikuten
reviews: tasty deep fried croquette with potato or/and kobe beef. there is eat-in area to shelter us from the cold weather. but you need to buy it outside at the counter first. it's very good that we wanted to encore unfortunately it's always a long queue outside so we don't want to postpone our itinerary. leave it for next visit!

The feeling of eating a wagyu beef croquette on a cold 🥶 day with tons of people in an open quaint street is such a memorable experience! The croquette is really yummy and is served piping hot as the queue moves really fast. Highly recommended activity as you take a stroll down the quaint little street. They offer a few options for the croquette but the best one was sold out, so we took the Wagyu beef croquette and the potato beef croquette- both were wonderful !

DEC 2024

Ordered a ground wagyu beef and onion croquette, kobe beef mini steak and a bottle of Arima cider soda. Inside is a small dining area to eat which is nice as it was crowded outside. The Arima cider was quite fizzy with a hint of sweetness which tasted like the ramune drink. The wagyu croquette was crispy with a nice beefy flavor and some sweetness from the onions; pretty tasty. The grilled kobe beef steak was seasoned with a bit of salt and cut into three pieces. There was not much marbling and the beef required some chewing; not bad if you prefer leaner cuts but not worth the price. Recommend coming here for the croquette.

name: Sakuranomori Park
reviews: Good place for a walk
Great place to exercise and play for children.

I love this place and cold weather when I was there.
Best place to take a relax.

name: Yellow Tail
reviews:
The range of menu, price, volume, atmosphere, everything was more than good. I ordered a roast beef rice, which seems like a best-selling menu here, and it was worth the hype. I would have preferred if it had more of the cream sauce and pepper rather than unnecessary yuzu ponzu sauce which didn’t go very well with the beef, but I guess that’s how Japanese people like it. Heart-shaped croquette had a little sweetness but lacked umami, a little improvement needed here. My companies ordered loco-moco, quiche and hamburg steaks, and they all were satisfied with the volume and flavor. For dessert, we ordered a strawberry millefeuille and caramelized banana & chocolate pancakes. The worst thing we ordered was the strawberry millefeuille in that the original pastry layers were substituted with biscuits, I would not recommend ordering it. But the pancakes were great with overflowing amount of whipped cream and chocolate. Other menus seemed all delicious so we needed a long time making choices.

However, this is all dream if you don’t reserve. So make sure you make a reservation and refrain from coming here walk-in. The waiting is usually hideous and decorations are better off at the reserved zone.

津市にあるおサカナ喫茶イエローテイルさん、最高でした！
お店の名前の通り、お魚料理が本当においしい✨
ランチでいただいたお魚プレートは、身がふっくらしていて香ばしく、ソースとの相性も抜群。
新鮮な素材を使っていて、一口ごとに丁寧さが伝わります。
副菜やスープも手作り感があって、栄養バランスも◎
店内は明るくて落ち着く雰囲気で、ゆっくり過ごせました。
スタッフさんの接客も丁寧で心地よく、初めてでも安心できるお店です。
お魚好きの方はもちろん、カフェ好きにもおすすめしたい素敵な喫茶店🐟☕️
また絶対行きます！

友達のSNSをみて来店しました。
雰囲気も良くオシャレでとても良かったです。
男性定員さんの笑顔やサービス力がとても良く見入ってしまいました。

12:30頃来店受付に名前を記入して車でも待てるように連絡先をかけるので非常に良いです。
今回はバイクで娘と来たので店内で待たせてもらいました。

料金も高くも無く量も多いです。
女性の方なら少し大変かと思います。

ブリカツとサーモン丼にしましたが大正解でした。
娘はレアサーモンにイクラサーモン丼にしましたがサーモンサーモンだと胸焼けするかもしれません。
あと烏龍茶は少し違う味がするのでお子様には苦手の可能性があります。

今度は車で妻とも来店したいと思いました。

name: Arima juhachi-ban
reviews:
Foreigner Friendly. LGBTQ + Friendly.

Amazing food! Easy to order with WR code. I had the Siumai with Green Pepper & the Arima Dumplings with dash sauce. It was sooooo good! You could hear exclamations of oishii and umai from all around the restaurant. Cozy ambience and great service. The fresh lime sour was so refreshing and paired well with the meal. Will go back soon!

(Trip was made back then on 9 Dec 2019, 2 years before the Covid-19 Pandemic hit)

Couldn’t find much lunch options while exploring Yumotozaka, so we ended up at a restaurant which serves akashiyaki and gyoza. The former being a specialty which originated from Akashi.

Think of it as something resembling to takoyaki, except it’s mostly made with eggs and served with a broth instead of sauce.
Luckily, we got to try this Akashi specialty since we missed the chance while we’re in Akashi.

It’s a refreshing taste from the usual heavy flavoured takoyaki. Their gyoza was meaty and delicious, and the whitebait rice bowl wasn’t too bad either.

We were first in for lunch and took up the row of seats along the wall.  The siew mai and gyoza were pretty tasty, while the squid eggy balls were served with a bowl of soup with some greens. The balls were light and eggy in taste.

The beef tongue skewer was a little on the dry and tough side though, but the beef on rice was really delish.  Everything about this dish was good and it was full of flavour and was a generous portion.

We also ordered white bait sushi on rice, though they also have a fried white bait version.  Service was warm and fast, and we were out within 40 minutes.

name: ガーデンふ頭臨港緑園
reviews: Beautiful place with X'mas firework and music concert. A park had almost 10 food's car attract lots of couple hang out. It's really suitable for a date.
Quiet harbour park, great sunset view.
Beautiful scenery, subway takes you right there, the artic boat museum and the aquarium are nice, you actually see most animals without attending the show

name: Okinawa Cafe
reviews:
A very stylish place with a lot of delicious food from Okinawa. We ordered two sets from the sets menu and the dishes were not only tasty, but also unusually big! And weren't pricey at all.
The staff is very friendly, but speaks no English... Prepare to use a translator :)

I have come to eat at this restaurant very consistently over the past 5 years and I am a big fan of their Okinawa Soba, Soki Soba, Seasoned Curly Fries, and their Blue Seal Ice Cream for dessert. There's even an Okinawa store right across from the restaurant so you can buy ingredients to take home and make your own Okinawan cuisine. Highly recommended.
Okinawa cafe sells American ice cream, great desserts, and delicious food! But, it's small and allows smoking, so that is quite unfortunate.

name: Port Island Minami Park
reviews: It’s the best park in Iryo Center, very peaceful and so many elements in the park, during sakura season it becomes just incredible !
Great slides for the children, clean park, nice trees, clean facilities, broad walkways, good fountain
Nice local park on Port Island. Great for picnics or playing with children. A baseball field and some good urban nature.

name: Yabaton JR Nagoya Station
reviews: It was expensive and honestly not very good. I thought it was going to be but it's one of the worst tonkatsu I've ever had. They left all the fat and gristle in the pork chop and the flavor was honestly not very good. The pork was just done but borderline undercooked.
Tonkatsu with miso sauce , rice, soup cabbage meal. The meat is tender and flavored with miso sauce &  soy sauce.
Great pork bento to bring & eat during train rides

name: Beverly Hills Boulangerie
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−1 ユニバーサル・スタジオ・ジャパン ハリウッド・エリア
reviews: The corn chowder was about vending machine quality. The pastrami sandwiches had cheese sauce instead of much actual cheese, overall I would say that they were adequate. The best thing was the salad. They hep you find a seat which was nice, but I was overcharged for my soup.

Refreshing sandwiches, very good portion, the desserts are amazing!

Once we got into the cafe, it's required to order before sitting, which is nice and eliminate those who just comes in and sit around not ordering their food eating up table space for people who ordered. I believe this rule should apply to all cafes and restaurants in the park.

Nice feel, Victorian style type of theme. Wish there was more item on the menu.

Rose strawberry cake was amazing. It had strawberry mousse on the outside and chocolate cake at the center with small balls of chocolate that were a nice surprise. It was not too sweet but nice and tart 10/10. The raspberry cheesecake was refreshing. Sandwiches were light and a bit heavy on the mayo. Service here is wonderful and the workers were kind and helpful!

name: Inpal Osu
reviews:
Found this place as the Shotengai was slowly winding down and we needed a quick bit of dinner. What a delicious bit of dinner that turned out to be. The Honey Cheese Naan smelled so wonderful being made! When it was served up with was the warmest, gooiest, stickiest bit of sweet cheesy mess we could sink our teeth in. There was an epic cheese pull with it too!

Staff was very friendly, even though I was trying my best broken beginner's Japanese. Would definitely visit here again and get more naan, and maybe a beer or highball.
Food quality is very good.. spicy level is same as Indian one. Must visit if you like spicy indian style chicken curry and biryani.
This is the best Indian food I've had in Japan! And super spicy too if you want :) they have excellent Vegetarian options as well. I had the non-vegetarian set.

name: J.S. Burgers Cafe
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−7−2 神戸ハーバーランドumie ２階
reviews:
Quick service, friendly people.
Tried the signature burger. Very Californian.
Left with a pain in my gut. Hard to describe what’s not quite right about it.

The best fried chicken sandwich in Kobe! the maple chicken is awesome and really scratches the sweet and savory itch. The fries are mostly standard affair, very reminiscent of Mcdonalds fries- although a bit less mushy.
There are plenty of delicious looking dessert options. The monster float that is being promoted right now is fun to share between two.
No complaints about the service.
The interior is pleasing to look at, and many of the tables have chairs that allow for relaxed reclining, although you have to lean up quite far to eat.
Would recommend to anyone looking for a more American style fried chicken sandwich or burger in Kobe!

A diner that serves authentic American fast food such as burgers, fries, chicken and milkshakes.

It’s located in the second floor of Umie mall near the connecting bridge to harborland port.

The restaurant is nice and cozy, the staff is very nice and accommodating. You can ask them specifically to remove certain ingredients for your allergies and even customize the cooking of your burgers.

The burger’s legit and tastes like its from an American diner. I recommend any of their chicken burgers, it’s amazing.

name: Kawasemi Japanese Restaurant
reviews:
Love the Clam Set Meal! The presentation was superb and the was freshly made and delicious. Cheers to the kitchen staff and the servers who made the experience truly wonderful after walking a long time around Nabana No Sato.

It was a real treat dining here given the set meal was just 2500 yen. But I only paid 1500 yen after using the 1k yen coupon I got when I bought the entrance ticket to Nabana No Sato.

Really good value for money!

Good Japanese food restaurant inside Nabana no sato area. You can use coupon come with the ticket here. Luckily, we come at the time that has no queue.

There are several choices of food, sashimi, tempura, sukiyaki, etc.

The venue is quite wide and suit for big party. If you travel with large group, it’s fine to dine here.

Price is reasonable.

I ordered Matsusaka beef sukiyaki, and plum jelly and it was really delicious

The beef was really tender and tasty without any additional sauce needed. Jelly was transparent white, but full of flavour.

I used my coupons here.

name: Fujigaoka Design Park
reviews: A great place for exercise and hanami……it looks beautiful and so green and relaxing……they even have a icecream vending machine 😊😊😊🌿💜
Beautiful flowers

桑名市の高台にある公園。水洗トイレ、自販機、子供用遊具、芝生広場、展望台あり。駐車場があるが止めれる台数は少なく感じました。この公園の一番の特徴は何と言っても展望台からの景色だと個人的には思います。御在所山、藤原岳等の鈴鹿山脈の名山。桑名と四日市の街並だけでなく伊勢湾とその向こうに広がる濃尾平野や御嶽山やアルプスも一望できます。また、夜景の名所としても知られているので時間帯によって違う景色を楽しめます。

name: Buffet Dining Akala
reviews:
Meal: Breakfast
Day Visited: Saturday
Budget: Included in Room Charge
Closest Station: Universal City
Reservation Needed?: N/A
Payment: Cash; Credit
Kid Friendly?: Yes
English Menu?: Yes

If Japanese hotel breakfast buffets are your thing, then you will probably like this place more than I did.

I found the food selection to be good, but quality mediocre to poor. Long waits and crowded seating make for a semi-miserable experience.
Breakfast is amazing. You have to reserve or go in early as this place gets busy. Dinner buffet is also good. If you don’t have reservations, you have to do in early. Foods are really good.
We had the breakfast buffet. It was ok. I wish there was more fresh fruit available. Lots of items available.

name: あつた舟鮨
reviews:
The eel was delicious . Crispy skin on the outside with a thick and plump texture . Had beautiful tasty sauce and accompanying pickle.

Had the unagi don for 2300 Yen which is quite affordable considering most unagi prices but still wished for slightly more than 4 pieces.

The restaurant had a nice decor with traditional Japanese seating on tatami. A nice place just opposite atsuta Shrine and less crowded than the nearer store Benten.

I came here two years ago in 2019, so I can only base it off of my experience then: we were walking out of the park across the street and stumbled upon this restaurant and thought to grab a bite before going back to the train station. We had the most wonderful lunch. The unagi was incredibly delicious. And the only thing we had to compare with was a "Michelin-starred" unagi restaurant in Tokyo, and we'd pick to come back to this one over the other hands down. Thank you for such a delicious memory!

ひつまぶしが食べたくなったので、熱田神宮の帰りに。
皮はパリっと。そして海苔がいい風味です。
1杯目はそのまま。
2杯目はネギとワサビをつけて。これもうなぎがさっぱりして美味しいです。
3杯目は出汁茶漬け。さらさらどんどん食べられます。
某有名店より味がしっかりついていたので出汁茶漬けにしてもとても美味しかったです。
味の変化がつけられるのでひつまぶし大好きです。
ちなみに汁物は肝は入ってませんでした。
肝が苦手な私にはこれがちょうどよく。
また来たいです。

name: Hashiriizan Park / Yada castle ruins
reviews: 住宅地にある静かな公園で、丘の上に位置しており、春には桜が美しく咲きます。遊具はなく、子どもが遊ぶというより、散歩や景色を楽しむ場所という印象です。訪れる人は少なく、非常に落ち着いた雰囲気で、静かに過ごせます。公園自体はそれほど広くありませんが、ベンチなどがありちょっと休憩するのに便利です。市街地を見下ろす眺めも穏やかで、季節の移ろいを感じながらゆったりとした時間を過ごせる、公園らしい静かなスポットです。

Mùa hoa anh đào quá là đẹp luôn. Có đèn thắp sáng lúc chiều tối, ngay cạnh ga umamichi ạ🌸
Có nhà vệ sinh, bãi đỗ xe hơi nhỏ ạ

Hari ini saya pergi ke sini, suasanya tenang dan sepi. Sangat menyenangkan.
Saya haraf saya bisa kesini lagi untuk melihat bunga sakura mekar.
Kucingnya juga gemuk2 sekali ❤️⛩️

name: WK FRUITS VALLEY
street: Durian and Fruit Road Stall In front, 81, 亚罗街
reviews:
The **Black Thorn durian** was incredible—creamy, sweet, and rich with tiny seeds. The **Musang King** was equally divine, with its bittersweet, custard-like texture. You can taste the freshness—no artificial ripening here!

The owner was friendly and knowledgeable, patiently explaining each variety and even offering coconutss. The stall was clean, and the service was top-notch.

For authentic, high-quality Malaysian durian served with warmth, this place is a must-visit. A bit pricey, but worth every bite! **10/10 will return.**

Based on the positive reviews on the internet, at noon, my mother and I decided to find this store to savor the delicious durian. As expected, uncle is very warm and friendly, we chose RM100 for 3 capsules of King Cat Yam and RM58 for 1kg of Black Thorn (in total RM157.15), both were very tasty and we were very satisfied with our meal. The store will also thoughtfully provide a free bottle of water for each customer. Highly recommended!!!👍

Really strategic place. Served wide varieties of fruit but the highlight is Durians! From d25 MK until BT durians. Price is good for the quality of durians served here. They offer free small bottle of mineral water for each person here. We came twice here just to fulfill our Durians need LOL

name: Towers Garden
reviews: This isn't a garden. It's a paved area with about 7 trees and some seats. Don't think it's a relaxing place to walk around

クリスマス前に出張してガーデンテラスで天体観測（半月）をしてみました！
１時間ほどのみ短い時間でしたが、きれいな月を望遠鏡で観望、写真も撮影。三重県のおしゃれなカメラマンさん、お子ちゃまファミリーさん、三組、コーカソイド系のカップルさん、ベトナムのにいちゃんたち、15人ほどの方にもきれいな月をみていただきました。
近くにはストリートピアノがあり、外国人のピアニストさんが、ベートーヴェンの熱情を弾かれていました。
OZONE天体観測
2026年1月10日「110の日」で高校生によるコンサートが行われていました。

name: Street Art Casper the ghost
reviews: Oh Gosh!! I witnessed open vandalism. We suppose to beautify the city with beautiful art but instead encourage vandalism. Not sure whether is legal but I am not supporting and we shouldn't encourage vandalism.

Interesting. Seems to have a bunch of street art that people have tagged! Wrote on top of. Kind of ruined it but made it interesting at the same time. Would recommend the buinesses in the area clean up the garbage.
An alley for street art lovers. Worth a look. It's just a little harder to find. I really recommend i

name: Meriken Theater Monument
reviews: Nov 20
It’s okay

這是位於BE KOBE打卡點旁的紀念碑，外觀猶如一塊中間鏤空的螢幕，建立於1987年，是為了紀念1896年，兩台電影放映機被進口到神戶，並在日本首次舉行電影放映。可以透過中空的石頭拍攝後方的海事博物館，相當有趣！
碑前排列著42塊花崗岩岩石塊，猶如觀眾在看電影。石頭上刻有日本和國外電影明星的名字，由已故神戶出生的電影評論家淀川長晴挑選。

name: Welcome to KOBE
reviews: Just a simple board. On the way to port tower
A signature place worth to visit
The Korean was phonetic instead of the actual translation.

name: Aroy Coconut Ice Cream
reviews: Coconut ice cream and can choose 3 flavor & free topping. Little bit pricy RM12 for a small cup but worth for your money. Free 'air kelapa' in cup for each ice cream. Should try when you come to Jalan Alor.
Delicious coconut ice cream in coconut shell. Free topping! Shifted location to in front of travelodge.
Yummy coconut ice cream with real coconut in a coconut shell. You can select your own toppings also. Price is pretty good considering such a busy tourist area.

name: River of Life South Mid Valley
reviews: River of Life South Mid Valley. The start of the bike and walking path goes along the klang river. This stretch follows the Klang river from Mid Valley to Brickfields. The path winds through Brickfields, past an Indian temple and high-rise apartments. Overhead, the KL Monorail track ends at the depot. After Brickfields , one will reach KL Railway Station before Central Market / Pasar Seni and Independent /Medeka Square KL.

Walked from Brickfields end on path closer to the highway and it ended abruptly. Had to cut back and use what was marked as the bicycle path. Again it ended abruptly near Volvo. Would have been nice if it was a loop. Needs some work but promising
There is nothing to see here. Unless you want run, bike or run along the river and not be in the city, okay that's good, but this particular place is not an attraction at all.

name: ARIMA SPRING TERRACE
reviews: We ordered curry beef rice set and Kobe sirloin beef & burger beef from lunch menu. Beef is a bit tough and overall it’s a bit pricy. Ambience is nice and staff are very helpful though.
Great place to eat!

name: Tanghulu, Alor Street Food
reviews:
Candy, fruit with sugar and chocolate.
Recomended for dessert
Tried the tangulu for the first time, and it was really fantastic 😍

name: street art tiger cap
reviews: 菜品味道在线，招牌烤肉外焦内嫩，酱汁层次丰富；服务生反应迅速，加水收盘子很勤快。可惜高峰期等位40分钟，店内嘈杂，桌子间距略窄，影响用餐体验。整体仍值得回访。

name: Kobe Chinatown Nankin-machi
reviews:
Kobe's Chinatown is one of the city's most iconic neighbourhoods. It was my first time visiting a Chinatown in Japan, and I must say it's really impressive, a truly lively place. I came here in the evening, and it was really beautiful. However, the neighbourhood is quite small, so you can see it all very quickly.

It's also worth noting that the neighbourhood is primarily geared towards tourists, with almost nothing but street food stalls. Each stall sells exactly the same food, which is overpriced for what it is. Let's just say that it's part of the atmosphere, but if you plan on getting something to eat, check the prices, as there can be big differences from one stall to another.

There are also a few souvenir shops. To give you an idea of the quality, I bought a T-shirt that fell apart after the first wash. So yes, it's a neighbourhood worth visiting, but it's clearly very tourist-oriented, even if it means ripping them off a little.
In comparison, I preferred Yokohama's Chinatown, which I visited later.

Kobe Chinatown, also called Nankin-machi, is a famous food street in Kobe. It is a popular place for both locals and tourists who love to eat and try new dishes. The area is not very large, but it is always full of people and energy.

There are many food stalls and small restaurants selling different kinds of Chinese food. Visitors can easily find tasty items such as dumplings, buns, noodles, and sweet snacks. The food smells are very attractive, and it is hard to walk past without stopping to try something. Many dishes are easy to eat while walking, which makes the experience more fun.

Because the food is good and well-known, the street is often very crowded, especially on weekends and holidays. Even so, the lively atmosphere makes the visit enjoyable. People laugh, eat, and take photos, creating a cheerful feeling.

Overall, Nankin-machi is a great place to enjoy delicious food and a busy street vibe. If you like food and don’t mind crowds, Kobe Chinatown is definitely worth a visit.

We visited during the day and it was a bit busy, but not overwhelming. We just walked around and didn’t buy anything, but the area itself is really cute. There are so many food stalls, restaurants, and little shops, so it’s definitely a place to explore if you like street food or souvenirs.

The atmosphere is lively and colorful, with traditional decorations and lanterns everywhere. Even if you don’t eat, it’s fun to stroll through and soak up the vibe. Overall, it was okay — nice for a short visit, especially if you’re already in Kobe city.

Tips for visitors:

- Easy to reach on foot from Motomachi Station
- Can get busy during peak lunch hours, but manageable
- Great for photos and just soaking up the Chinatown atmosphere

name: Namba City
reviews: Famous case of shopping mall, parents and children play happily on top. It’s free to shop and take rest as you want.

Namba Street a lively and colorful area full of energy! With its bright lights, delicious street food, and endless shopping options, it’s the perfect place to explore day or night. A must-visit spot to feel the vibrant spirit of the city

The main building of Namba City is one of Osaka’s key shopping hubs, directly connected to Namba Station, making it extremely convenient for both locals and visitors. The complex is spacious and thoughtfully designed, combining modern indoor areas with open-air walkways that create a comfortable atmosphere despite the crowds. It offers a wide range of shops, from local Japanese brands to international stores, along with many restaurants and cafés that suit different tastes and budgets. The experience here is practical rather than luxurious, making it ideal for everyday shopping, dining, or simply passing through and taking a break. While it can get busy during peak hours, the good layout and multiple entrances help manage the flow. Overall, Namba City feels lively and authentic, reflecting the everyday rhythm of Osaka and providing a well-rounded urban experience.

name: Namba Walk
reviews: Namba Walk Osaka is a very very looooong underground linear shopping mall filled with hundreds of interesting shops of all kinds! After 30 mins we didn't even go past 1/2 way and had to leave. Good to escape the outdoor 🌤 or the occasional sudden 🌧 and sit for a nice ice-cream with warabi mochi!
If you want to beat the heat during hot summer months, use this underground walkway. Lots of shops and food stalls and can get you to different stations and destinations

Namba Walk is an underground shopping street with a wide variety of shops, cafes, and restaurants. It’s a great place to hang out if you’re looking to escape the heat or rain. You’ll find everything here, from trendy fashion stores to unique souvenirs, and the food options are endless. Its location is super convenient, as it connects directly to major subway lines. Definitely worth a visit if you enjoy shopping or exploring local spots.

name: Nagoya PARCO
reviews: A shopping mall for lovers of Japan's most well-known characters such as Snoopy, Rilakkuma, Hello Kitty, Kirby, Pokémon, and others, with stores selling merchandise featuring these characters.  There are also several restaurants and clothing and other shops.  There is ample parking, but depending on the day and time, there may be no spaces available or you may have to wait, as there are always events in the park in front, which means the parking lot is almost always full on weekends.
It's a huge mall, and time is never enough to explore everything :) The food court had many options. And one can  enjoy an incredible shopping experience.
Consists of three connected buildings, each slightly different. They have stores for every taste. I love the west building for girly clothes. All the floors have different vibes and price ranges too.

name: LACHIC
reviews:
A relaxed and enjoyable shopping experience @LACHIC ラシック👍👍👏👏💪💪

One of the four department stores in the bustling Sakae shopping cum entertainment district, LACHIC ラシック, nicknamed "fashion building" - is a vibrant, luxurious store run by Mitsukoshi, featuring upscale brands, chic boutiques, jewelry, accessories and cosmetics with trendy atmosphere. Can't believe this retail haven is 20yo👍👍👏👏💪💪

Younger crowds ('20s to '40s) visit it for shopping, events and relaxation. Besides fashion, there're confectioners, diverse dining range of options, unique finds and everything in between. One can get enticing culinary experience - L7-L8 are home to a variety of restaurants, from pancakes and meat dishes to fresh oysters while more casual food offerings are in the basement. Thoughtful of LACHIC ラシック to place comfortable seating in strategic locations for shoppers to rest tired feet, chill or serve as a meeting point👍👍👏👏💪💪

LACHIC ラシック is within easy reach from Sakae Subway Station. Being connected to Mitsukoshi makes it easy to  shop at both stores from the underground without stepping outside👍👍👏👏💪💪

About 6 floors above ground ; another 1 to 2 floors below. The mall itself is not busy, but it seated at the heart of city centre , right by metro yellow H10

You can connect through the metro (B1) and inter connect to the mall next (三越）
We walked from Royal Park Hotel Nagoya using the tunnels underground; very comfortable especially in cold or rainy days!

Floor 7 and 8 of glorious restaurants.. especially floor 8. But floor 7 has a fantastic pancakes restaurant where you can get the best, freshly made Dutch baby (sugar and lemon flavor). 8 floor has great meat restaurants and one oyster restaurant. Great pasta as well. I would avoid the sushi bars. They are over priced for what you get. The basement of the building has food shops as well as inexpensive restaurants. The shops in general are fine. Not really exclusive but certainly a level or two above Donkey and Uniqlo.

name: Sannomiya Center Gai Shopping Street
reviews: The Sannomiya Center Gai Shopping Street and the surrounding areas are a fun place to shop, have a good meal, or have drinks. I found almost all types of stores or restaurants in a pan are available here. The area is very convenient with trains and buses available nearby. This is a lovely area to spend a day.
Wider shopping walkway with buildings adjacent to one another and linked underground basement where most eateries are located, and less crowded than Namba Shinsaibashi.

Sannomiya Center Gai Shopping Street is one of Kobe’s most vibrant and popular shopping destinations, stretching through the heart of the Sannomiya district.

This lively covered arcade is lined with a wide mix of fashion boutiques, international brands, local shops, cafés, and casual restaurants, making it a favorite spot for both locals and visitors.
The atmosphere is energetic throughout the day, with a constant flow of people and a strong urban feel. Its central location makes it easy to combine shopping with sightseeing, dining, or a stroll toward nearby Kobe landmarks.

Whether you are looking for the latest trends, unique souvenirs, or simply want to experience everyday life in Kobe, Sannomiya Center Gai offers a dynamic and enjoyable shopping experience.

name: NZ Curry House - KLCC
reviews:
Stunning views of the Twin Towers and delicious food!

​We had an amazing family dinner at NZ Curry House! The highlight was definitely the incredible view of the Petronas Twin Towers right from our table. It made the meal feel really special, and my kids were absolutely mesmerized by the view throughout dinner.

​The food was very tasty and, surprisingly, the prices were very reasonable for such a prime location. They have plenty of seating inside as well. I highly recommend visiting for a "dinner with a view" combo.

We truly enjoyed ourselves and will definitely be back!

Located in the prime KLCC area, this restaurant draws and equal number of tourists and locals at lunch time. The food is pretty decent but not particularly outstanding.

My order of Ayam Bawang (Onion Chicken) was swapped with Sambal Ayam instead. The latter lacked the caramalised onions of the former and was somewhat disappointing. Likewise, when I requested for Bendi (Ladies Fingers) I was given the chopped and stir-fried version instead of the blanched whole ladies fingers that you get at true Nasi Kandar places.

From my observation, the service staff are not very attentive (or particularly polite) here. My drink order of Limau Ais (Iced Lime) was swapped for Teh Ais (Iced Tea). However they did get it changed for me.

Overall, it’s a popular and busy Nasi Kandar place. Prices are also on the high side. I don't think I will be missed if I don't return again in future.

If you want to have a nice night view of KLCC Twin Tower, here is one of the spot. This restaurant also nearby Saloma Bridge, you can reach there around 5-10 minutes walking. Parking spot quite limited and paid only, not own by this restaurant. Other famous spot also in walking distance like Saloma Kuala Lumpur and Pelita Restaurant. But again, parking is limited and very busy area around here even during midnight.

name: The Jetty Food Court
reviews:
Great place for a quick lunch before or after exploring the Chew Jetty!
Tons on stalls with food from all over the world.  We ate local dishes and loved it!
Good value for the quality of food, but the “hawkers” were cheaper.
If you want food made for you from scratch and not have it sitting around on the street, this is the place for you.
Bathrooms are not that clean.  And finding paper towels is next to impossible here.  Recommend always bringing your own wet wipes!
Great food made to order, served piping hot and fast at a fair price.

We visited the Jetty Food Court twice during our stay in Penang.  The food was so good at the "Thai Food Stall" that we had to return.  The fried fish in sweet chili sauce, the seafood in sweet chili sauce, and the Thai chicken fried rice was delicious!  The food was super fresh and was cooked to order.  I highly recommend the Thai Food stall.  The prices are unbelievable for such a high quality meal.

Visited this place after strolling around the Armenian street and decided to grab a bite before exploring the clan jetties. I had a good experience, enjoyed the char kway teow and the drinks are decent too.

The food court offers a lot of food options and a lively atmosphere, a good spot to grab a meal and experience some local flavors! ✨

name: Sushi Dojo
reviews:
Service was really bad
The staff looked like they don't want to be there.. which is sad to see.
And I didn't really enjoy the sushi.... I would go to a different place to eat sushi 😁
I'm not coming back here
Fresh and big Sushi topping with small rice! It was really good!!
Awesome place. Slightly pricey but totally value for money. Quality was awesome.

name: Sumiyoshi JR Nagoya Station Shinkansen In-bound platform
street: Meieki, 1 Chome−1−4 ＪＲ名古屋駅構内 新幹線上りホーム（14・15番ホーム
reviews:
This kishimen stand on the Shinkansen platform at Nagoya Station offers a uniquely Japanese food experience you won’t find anywhere else.
It features a classic standing-style setup, where businesspeople rushing to meetings and travelers between destinations enjoy a quick, satisfying bowl of noodles side by side.

You start by choosing your preferred toppings for the base kishimen and buying a meal ticket from the vending machine in front of the shop.
Then, simply step up to any open spot, place your ticket on the counter, and wait.

Amazingly, your kishimen is ready in about 30 seconds, making it one of the fastest—and most memorable—meals you can have in Japan.
Water is free and available from a self-service dispenser in the nearby walkway.

Kishimen are flat, wide wheat noodles similar to udon, served in a light soy-based broth that highlights their smooth texture.
They are typically topped with simple ingredients such as green onions, seasoned fried tofu, fish cake, or bonito flakes, allowing the flavor of the noodles and broth to shine.
This style of noodle is a regional specialty of Nagoya, loved for its simplicity, speed, and comfort.

It’s not just a meal, but a glimpse into everyday Japanese life—efficient, delicious, and deeply local.

So theres actually multiple sumiyoshi kiosks. I thought there was only in the shinkansen platforms, but I found one in platform 10/11 and 5/6. I got the kakiage with kishimen noodles, I also ended up buying 2 orders of inari as well. Service was really fast and the food was delicious. They open at 7am, I did not have to wait. There are only a few counter spots.

Small standing shop for a quick local flat noodles. Location is shinkansen platform 14 and 15 at train carriage 4. The shop assistant recommended the ¥420 noodle bowl: generous topping of dashi, spring unions and tofu with delicious broth and chewy noodles. Free ice water. Pay by cash or suica/pasmo at the machine in front of the shop entry. Warms you up whilst waiting for the train.

name: New Yong Len Restaurant
reviews:
New Yong Len Restaurant in TTDI is one of those rare gems that truly captures the charm of authentic Malaysian street food—all under one roof. I’ve been coming here for years, and the variety never fails to impress. Whether you’re craving a hearty bowl of curry mee, a plate of char kuey teow bursting with wok hei, or a comforting bowl of prawn mee, this place delivers every time. Each stall has its own loyal following, and it’s easy to see why.

My personal favourite has to be the prawn mee—rich, aromatic broth with just the right kick of spice, topped with fresh prawns and tender pork slices. The curry mee is another must-try; it’s creamy without being overwhelming, and the sambal adds that addictive depth of flavour. For something lighter, the wantan mee stall serves perfectly springy noodles with smoky char siew, while the chee cheong fun is silky smooth and generously drenched in sweet sauce and sesame seeds.

What I really love about New Yong Len is the nostalgic kopitiam vibe—bustling with regulars, friendly hawkers shouting out orders, and the comforting aroma of freshly brewed Hainan coffee in the air. Service is quick even during the morning rush, and every visit feels like a true local dining experience. If you’re in TTDI and want to sample some of KL’s best-loved street food classics without hopping from stall to stall, this is definitely the spot to visit.

We were taken to this spot by a friend who lives in TTDI.
I ordered the recommended prawn mee, and it was absolutely delightful. The soup was rich with the deep umami of prawns and had a subtle spiciness that paired perfectly with the mix of ramen and rice noodles. The aroma alone was enough to whet the appetite—every bite was full of flavor.

With the perfect trio of “fast, affordable, and delicious,” this place has the vibe of a beloved local eatery. The shop was nearly full, a clear sign of its popularity. I’m truly grateful for the introduction—this is the kind of hidden gem you’d never find without a local’s guidance.

We had prawn mee, curry mee and otak otak . Almost each table order prawn mee. The prawn mee is tasty , so does the curry mee. Otak- otak was abit overcooked. Service delivery was fast . Atmosphere abit noisy, crowded and parking lot really have to search, if not can go to open space parking lots ( pay more for car parking)

name: Nagoya Port Sea Train Land
reviews:
A Small Amusement park sitting next to the port of Nagoya with a few attractions and game stalls.

There is also a nice big Ferris Wheel with cool city views, that also has amazing air conditioning!

The grabber machines weren't amazing, and it would be great to see some Gacha machines added to the park.
Good place to go with your family or with your spouse to relax a bit, but the games are rigged though 😥, cannot really win any game i've tried many times.

We accidentally discovered this place when my kid started to get bored in aquarium. It’s an amusement park with various oldies games. The mini roller coaster got a height requirement, but most other games are open to anyone. There is no entrance fee and you only pay at the game counter that you visit, and the cost is low so everything worths it. There is also a ferris wheel, which takes about 19 mins per round. Enjoy!

name: Sasashima Live
reviews: Business zone at the center of Nagoya. Achi University campus, Nagoya Convention Hall, Prince Hotel etc. are there. Sasashima Raibu station is connected to the subway and it is in Aonami line.
It was snowing when I walked by, but the floor was slippery

I don’t like the fact they force you to pay money for a drink you don’t want. An illegal stunt in most countries. Customers already pay rip off prices to see their favourite artists.  I won’t darken their doors again!!

name: Chocha Foodstore
reviews:
Hits and misses for modern Malaysian food, infused with French techniques and eclectic ingredients from East Malaysia. Baked yam atop sweet potatoes, avocado and salsa verde, umai (citrus cured red snapper) with laksa Sarawak paste and salted sinsilog (thick cut) noodles with local herbs and crispy Borneo salted fish piqued interest.

The passable dishes for us are duck papas made from shredded Cherry Valley duck leg confit then fried in a panko coating served with gulai sauce, and sambal belado eggplant with roasted lentils. Flavours subdued except for the sambal topping of the eggplant dish.

Although lemongrass brined chicken was adroitly cooked with nice crispy skin and juicy meat, the accompanying sambal tuhau and papaya pickles failed to grab us. Ditto for the flank steak with cincalok butter and cured egg yolk.

Dessert of Cempiang (doughnut with spices and roasted sweet corn ice cream), jackfruit with black pulut custard and puffed rice, and bahulu with gula apong, burnt sabayon and coffee foam all sounded good but the actual taste profiles were underwhelming. They were okay but didn’t excite our tastebuds.

Service had its ups and downs; they were anxious to collect back the printed menus (only pieces of paper!) throughout the evening even though there wasn’t many diners apart from our table of four. They did try hard to please though.

The old school vintage setting is charming but do be mindful of the uneven flooring around the toilets area.

The creative 9 course menu was a rare culinary experience: a contemporary interpretation of seasonal regional food (mostly Borneo), absolutely delicious and surprising, course by course, meticulously prepared and beautifully presented. Great service, moody atmosphere. Worth every Ringgit.

If you’re looking for laksa just like grandma used to make, this is not the place.  Chocha serves very innovative food but with traditional Malaysian ingredients. I loved their take on ‘otak otak’ - ordinarily fish cake but they did a veggie mash of fern leaves, mushrooms and bamboo shoots.  Also I loved  their grilled wing bean and okra salad and homemade donuts n ice cream for desert.  Portions are small so it’s more like tapas. Think of it as an opportunity to build your own tasting sampler. I’ve been to this restaurant twice. It’s particularly good for dinner as they offer their own prefix tasting menu. Also it’s 5 minutes walk to all the speakeasies in Chinatown which makes this restaurant a great starting point for a night on the town.

name: Discovery Restaurant
reviews: OP Feast restaurant in Discovery restaurant is not bad. Decent food in terms of taste and aesthetic. The Zoro bottle drink is also a nice souvenir to bring back.

Pretty good burgers and personally I think the best bang for the buck in a theme park. I personally liked the beef burger over the chicken and fish burgers. The normal burgers were filling enough over the t-rex but they're carbs so you might be hungry even more so after walking and queuing in the park all day.

Queues could get long and you thought you might be queue inside but the queue actually starts outside.

QR code for ordering and payment.

We had lunch at a discovery restaurant with a One Piece theme. The atmosphere captures the adventure and spirit of the anime, making it a unique place to relax, especially on a hot summer day of 36°C. If you're a fan, don't miss the chance to take a break and immerse yourself in the world of One Piece while enjoying your meal.

name: Piccadilly Cafe
reviews: The salted egg pasta was too salty for our liking. The spicy garlic prawn and volcano grilled dishes were okay but nothing stood out. The highlight for me was definitely the tiramisu. It was really good and not too sweet. I would come back just for that.

This is my 3rd time visiting Piccadilly Cafe during my lunch break.  In KL, there are many up and coming cafes around the vicinity and the competition for returning customers is tough.  This cafe is situated along the main road and is within the stretch of old shop houses.  It is this that make the cafe so charming.  The facade of the cafe is unassuming.  But the moment you entered it, it’s a different world altogether.  I must admit I have been going up to the 2nd floor dining areas for all these times.  The old narrow wooden staircase bring you up to another “new cavern”.  The food is good and the fries crispy.  The dishes also turn up fast for lunch crowds.  I must admit that it is the deco and old+new charm that makes me to keep coming back to this cafe.  Service is also very prompt and efficient.  Payment is also simple and prompt.  I recommend it to you to give it a try when you are in KL.  $$

Positive points: Wonderful waiter; polite and helpful. The restaurant is quiet, clean, and nicely decorated.

Negative points: Items on the menu were overpriced. I placed an order for Turkish Eggs, which was served cold with two eggs that were overcooked on a bed of sweet yogurt instead of Greek yogurt. There were no chick peas, no salt and pepper, no garnishing at all (mint or dill), no garlic nor olive oil used, and not enough chili oil used; a failure.

name: Osu Shopping Street Fureai Plaza
reviews: crowded as usual, recognised some old shops still around either bustling or simply stood still as the last time i remembered.
Came here on the weekday afternoon and found to be less busy which make the place nice to stroll .

Sensory overload. Just like any shopping street in Japan, there are so many to see and feel and eat and shop. There are lots of people from all over the e world experiencing the same feeling of getting lost and getting in touch with Japanese folks. Japanese culture at its finest.

name: 魚のてっぺん
reviews: Very friendly staff who made a dinner so much more enjoyable than just food.
Oh the staff were so full of fun and sooooo nice! :)
Meals are very tasty and staff are funny and polite!!!

name: GravyBaby (Damansara Heights)
reviews:
Gravy Baby in Damansara Heights exudes a sort of rakish charm and is a slice of London bohemia dressed up for the tropics. I took a table by the window late one afternoon, when the amber light made the chrome fixtures gleam like old silver. The menu, heartily British with mischief about the edges, tempted me first with the Full English, which arrived magnificently arrayed with crispy bacon, golden hash, and a fried egg with a yolk of perfect drama. The fish and chips, meanwhile, crackled audibly as I broke into it, the cod flaking apart in a way that would make any seaside chippy nod in approval. For pudding, the sticky toffee came cloaked in a rich caramel sauce so indulgent I feared for my waistcoat buttons. I concluded with a flat white, properly robust and served with a wink of civility from the staff.  It’s not every day one finds a place abroad that captures the smoky comfort of a British café while managing to remain playfully Malaysian in spirit. Gravy Baby, to its credit, walks that line splendidly, and does so with gravy to spare.
If you enjoyed this review, Please give me a Like!

Where do I begin!
At 10.30pm on a Saturday almost half the restaurant had no lights on. The staff actually told me that it’s SOP. I just didn’t believe this was happening. We were using our phone lights to see the menu. After making some noise abt this issue the staff turned on the lights. Mind you it was merely 5 spot lights.
Then comes the cakes, which felt like it was kept for a few days in the fridge. Then comes the waffles, only after reminding the staff abt the order. Waffles were a disappointment as well. There were left-overs of almost everything we ordered, it was that bad.

In conclusion…
The restaurant is badly managed by inexperienced staff and below par food. It’s a pitty that a restaurant like this in a prominent location would let their restaurant just slide into disaster.
We celebrated our bffs birthday at Gravy baby , had a blast and Sk and sabir assisted us with the best arrangements. Will definitely be back for other gathering .

name: Jalan Alor Night Market
reviews: Must go night market. Enak and price reasonable not so Malah. Per kg 38 moshan king. 155rm have 5 set isi 20 pcs, recommend this kedai. There are lot of food can eat. Happy weekend Sunday . A little bit rain then we find a seat eat some then go walk around. A lot foreigners come here

Highly recommend this local night market. A must visit in KL. The music is loud and the atmosphere is lively. So many food options to try and restaurants to sit down and watch the locals. It does get busy and crowded but you must embrace the way it is here.

This street is the epitome of food paradise. Dazzling billboard-sized signs will entice you to have a feast on sea food and other menu items.
All restaurants are packed full, meaning they're all damn good!! High competition amongst them leaves no places for mediocre chefs.
The only little cons is that most restaurants sell the exact same items; you'll see what I'm saying when you compare the billboard-menu signs.

name: Cu Cha Restaurant
reviews:
Since I was in Alor street food and confused what to eat I decided to give a try this restaurant. I ordered barbecue chicken wings and barbeque stingray portuguese style (if i’m not wrong)

Chicken wings, it taste decent. I get the sweet barbeque taste, the chicken’s tenderness is acceptable. Nothing special in it.

Sting ray, the meat not as tender as I had before in other place but still acceptable, nothing special for the sauce i taste a savoury feeling with a bit sweetness. Better to eat the stingray by dip in the chilli sauce on the side. The good thing is I get to choose my stingray like in a fish market and check the grams which is good and I don’t feel scammed.

Overall, its just an okay seafood restaurant. I’ll only come here for one time for the experience in alor food street.

We ordered some foods that generally taste ok, nothing spectacular.
The saving grace is Penang Char Kwei Teow, the best I’ve taste by far in  surrounding area.
Even portion is not a lot just enough for 1, however it was tasty, delicious and Smokiness from wok hey was amazing!
Chicken and beef satay was ok, nothing special.
Portuguese grill squid was below par acceptable, squid was overcook and served with sauce that doesn’t scream Portuguese to me, lacking of spicy from peri peri chili and zing from lemon
juice that usually dominant with the sauce.

Char Kway Teow has that nice wok hei and tastes really good. The butter prawn is delicious and fragrant, and the fish is also very good. Vegetables portion is on the small side. Satay is decent, though it would be even better if they used thigh meat instead of breast. The BBQ wings are awesome – marinated really well!

name: Kobe Brick Warehouse
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−5−5 神戸煉瓦倉庫 南棟
reviews: It was okay, the incense shop was nice but the other stores were closed…
Nice historical building! Worth the visit

Had a good pasta meal in Harborland.
Friendly staff.

name: Studio Stars Restaurant
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−1 ハリウッド・エリア
reviews: For theme park food - Studio Stars was amazing. The staff is so friendly, and called me cute in my Mario outfit. They were so sweet & really made my day. As for the food, it was quite affordable, and it was delicious. I had the Elmo pulled pork burger, which was served with cheese fries. It was stuffed with delicious, juicy meat, & the cheese fries really hit the spot. We also shared a piece of Hello Kitty cake - it was just okay compared to the burger. If we ever return to USJ we will be sure to stop in.

Service was fast with no line before peak lunch time (around 10:00am). Tried an assortment of the Pokemon Halloween treats. The grape soda was mediocre. The Banette mousse tasted pretty good. The Misdreavus cheesecake tasted artificial. Prices are high.

I went there on a weekday. The restaurant was crowded, and the queue snaked all the way outside. But the wait was quick. As a Muslim, I asked the waitress about vegetarian menu options as soon as we were in line. She called her friend, and another waitress came over with a vegetarian menu that didn’t contain pork or alcohol. We ordered four sets of vegan curry (which included brownies and a drink). The taste was delicious and matched my liking (and my child’s too). The price for one set of the vegan menu was around 1,400 yen, so affordable! Don’t worry about not getting a seat because after we finish paying, the waiter will direct us to our seats. I highly recommend trying this restaurant. The waitstaff were very helpful, and the space was quite spacious. Two thumbs up!

name: Padang Night Food Stalls
reviews:
A good dinner hawker spot in the weekend. It is located at Johor Road (next to the BHP Petrol station, opposite Penang Buddhist Association, next to Padang Brown). My top three food there are:
1) Curry Mee - great taste and remember to add chilli paste if you can eat spicy ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
2) Char Koay Teow - great taste, be prepared to smell like wok if you sit next to the stall ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
3) Fried Rice - cheap and good RM6.50 for small plate ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Drinks are also decent. If you are lucky, you might catch some locals enjoying soccer aka football social game at the field adjacent to it.

This Padang Night Food stalls are located on the opposite side of the Padang towards BHP petrol station.

It only opens on evenings and famous for its huge steamer of dim sums and the Da Fei char hor fun. Patrons eat on the tables set up on the Padang itself and on evenings, it’s a lovely environment before it gets too dark.

This place is famous for their wantan mee & lam mee but both is not to my likings. There's many other wantan mee that is above this. The dimsum here is also 1 of the reasons people drop by. Not much choices, it's basic but cheap. I am here for the underrated fried noodle stall. Taste delicious as well, can taste the wok hei. Portions are huge & prices are cheap. Service is also good. The char koay teow taste average.

name: Lost World Restaurant
reviews: This is the Jurassic Park restaurant inside Universal Studios Japan. It's much more spacious than other restaurants inside, offering a more comfortable dining experience. Avoid peak lunch hours, and you'll find it relatively empty. There's also a restroom inside, making it a convenient place to take a quick break. While the food isn't exactly cheap, the quality and value are commensurate with the price.

Currently this restaurant on event Monster Hunter Wild, VIP discount not available. Food portion is good, tastes normal.
Lunch hour queueing time 40 mins.. 😅

One of the good restaurants in USJ. The portions are quite big and very filling. The food also tastes pretty good for a theme park food!

We arrived before lunchtime (around 11 am) and it was quite empty. However, as soon as 12 am hit, it got really busy, so my advice is to come before lunchtime if you want to avoid the crowd.

The service was excellent and the staff was very friendly.

The restaurant has a really nice ambiance.

name: Bentenyama Park
reviews: Suitable for relaxing with family and near with Suzuka Hunter
This park is very nice to do exercise. I do exercise here everyday

三重県鈴鹿市算所　ショッピングセンター　ハンターさんの南側になります、弁天山公園さんを、2025年08月02日（土曜日）に、久しぶりに訪問させていただきました。

鈴鹿８時間耐久レースのイベント🎪で、パレードの参加者さんと、三重県警察の車両展示を拝見させていただきました。

2024年08月02日(金曜)に訪れました。
暑い夏空のもと、明日から始まる　鈴フェスの準備をされていました。

各所に、幟が設置されていて、ステージの準備もされていましたので、明日からは、多くの来訪者さんが、見えると思います😃

暑い☀️ので、中休みの時間が設けられたそうです✨
時代ですね🎵

name: Yamacho Kuromon
reviews: We randomly picked this restaurant at Kuromon Market and were pleasantly surprised! Unlike many grab-and-go stalls, this place offers a nice area to sit and enjoy your meal. The seafood is fresh and tasty, and the staff are friendly and helpful. I also love the way they decorated the front of the store
Japanese food seems quite salty to me. The grilling sauce was a little salty for my taste, but the staff were very friendly and adjusted it when I asked for less sauce. It was a very enjoyable trip.
We were in Osaka for 2 days. We ate here twice! The garlic butter king crab is delicious!!

name: Mida Park
reviews: 子供連れが多い印象でした。テニスコートなどのエリアと公園部分があります。海が見たいなら飲み物持ってきて階段状の防波堤でゆっくりするのにいいところです。

鈴鹿市箕田にある海岸沿いにある公園です。住宅街の奥にあるので隠れた公園です。グランドやテニス場もありそこそこ広い公園です。駐車場も20台くらい止めれるので、遠方からも行きやすいです。
公園には高台があってそこから、伊勢湾が一望できます。公園内に円形の道がありそこで子供の自転車や三輪車の練習を目にします。子供を連れてのんびりできます。

ウォーキングでよく来てます!
陽気が良くなって土日は家族連れが来ています！
使用してはいけないボードとかで遊んでいる子供がいます!
ボールを通路の壁にぶつけたり
決まりを守らない人が多いのには閉口します!
危ないので止めて欲しい!

name: Loong Kee Dried Meat @ Jalan Alor
reviews:
I bought alotof loongkee in here.. the price is same with another store.
The stock is fresh n a lot of variant, so we will interest to buy n buy again.
My family likes guifei meat and gold coin chicken.
The staff are very helpful.. when i bought a wrong box of meat. N come back to there, n ask for change them. The staff is remember me, n give me to change the loongkee box meat from pork to chic.
Thank you...

Excellent choice for pork and chicken jerky.  This place is famous for Asian style meat jerky, which is softer, moist with a tinge of sweetness as compared to Western style jerky.  Tried all the varieties available, all tasted delicious and addictive.  Meat is well seasoned and moist from the fats and oils.  They have spicy and non-spicy options.
