The minced pork bak kwa (fried meat) is great. Go for the spicy version if you enjoy spicy food. They did not skim on the chilli.

name: 虹の塔
reviews: Surrounded by sakura trees. Beautiful during sakura full bloom.

初めて虹の塔を訪れてみて、その存在感にまず圧倒されました。霞ヶ浦ふれあいランドのシンボルとしてそびえる高さ60メートルのタワーは、遠くからでもよく目立ち、期待感が高まります。エントランスを抜けてエレベーターで展望室へ上がると、扉が開いた瞬間に目の前に広がるのは霞ヶ浦の雄大なパノラマ。360度の展望が楽しめ、霞ヶ浦大橋や筑波山、天気が良ければ牛久大仏やスカイツリーまで見渡せる絶景に感動しました。

展望室からは、青々とした田んぼや湖の景色が一望でき、風が心地よく、思わず深呼吸したくなるほど。特に晴れた日は、湖面の輝きや遠くの山並みが美しく、ずっと眺めていたくなります。展望台の入場料は大人300円と手頃で、混雑も少なくゆったりと過ごせました。

塔の2階には「玉のミュージアム」という球体をテーマにしたユニークな展示もあり、子どもから大人まで楽しめます。また、ふれあいランドの敷地内には親水公園やボルダリングコーナー、ローラー滑り台や水遊び場もあり、家族連れにもぴったりです。

全体的に、都会の喧騒を離れて自然と絶景を満喫できるスポットで、リフレッシュしたい方や写真好きにもおすすめです。霞ヶ浦の魅力を存分に味わえる、思い出に残る観光体験となりました。

平和公園の中にあるコンクリート製の塔です。外観は渦巻き状で宗教的なもの？と思いましたが関係ないようです。人が通ることのできるトンネル状の開口があり、入ってみると、塔の内部が空洞になっていました。何？と思いましたが足元に掘られた説明文を読んでみると、ステンドグラスのようなものが設置されてて、太陽が真上に来ると虹色の光が反射される作りでした。春分秋分の日の正午とあったので、ちょっとズレていましたが、虹色の明かりは見ることができました。　(^^)

name: Nagoya Monument
reviews: Iconic
quite speechless. very touristy.
Historic building

name: Misokatsu Port of Nagoya Ton'umi
reviews:
本当においしかった。まずカツそのものが分厚くてとてもおいしい！ザクっとした衣を噛み締めるとジューシーな肉汁がじゅわあと出てきます。
そこに甘く濃厚なソースがかかっており、ねぎも食感と香りのアクセントになっていて飽きずにもりもり食べられました。

確かにしっかり甘めのソースなのですが、奥深い味噌のコクを感じられ、後味は意外にもさっぱり。なんせカツがジューシーなこともあって瑞々しいぐらいでした。

このカツの分厚さ、クオリティーで1300円は安すぎる。今後みそかつを食べるならわざわざ名駅周辺を離れてでもここに来たいなと思うぐらいです。

閉まっていることも多いお店のようなので開いているときに伺えてよかった。お店の方も穏やかで感じよかったです。
閉まっていて5度目でようやく入店。味噌かつ定食をいただきました。カツがすごい肉厚で他店の倍以上はある。○ 味噌は甘めだがさっぱりしていて中部地方の味噌おでんの味に近く余裕の完食。オムライスも食べたかったが出来ないとの事。残念ッ！黒豚屋らむちぃより美味しいかも⁈
妻が里帰りしているのでランチに時間があり行ってみた。これ今までの味噌カツの概念を覆したね。今まで名古屋以外から友人が来たとき、よく味噌カツ食べたいと言われるんだけどここにこれから連れてこよう。肉は分厚いし、ほんとたまらない。チョコレートのようなタレも甘いけど美味しいです。

name: Lok-Lok
reviews:
Excellent food, great taste and so fresh. Tried only veg items and it was so yummy. Their mushrooms both BBQ n boiled are a must try.
PS: Beer is from another eatery they don't sell beer.

This is a really unique experience.  You'll find everything you can imagine on a skewer and ready to be satayed at your command.  I had chicken, lamb and duck. The flavors are wonderful.  The food preparation is quick.  The sauces are definitely worth trying.  Overall, this was a fun experience and the food was great.

Big selection of lok lok, taste is also really good. Service could be better, we needed some explanation of what is what and people just rushed us.
You can also order sth from the menu from restaurant next to.

name: Jalan Utama Street Food
reviews: Dirty food court that there's reported case of dead rat found in the nasi campur food tray that are being served to the customer

There are many food stall selling a variety of foods here 😋 All cheap and delicious. Beside the opposite side are nons food stalls and coffee shop. In fact that stretch in front of Hostipal are many food shops. No worries for food. Many choices. Try it and satisfy your taste buds.
Not sure if it's still got business. Mostly were closed when I passed by.

name: Kōbe Hankyū
reviews:
Kobe Hankyu is a prominent nine-story department store located adjacent to Sannomiya Station in Kobe. The store comprises a main building connected by bridges to a newer annex, offering a diverse range of merchandise. Shoppers can find mid- to high-priced clothing, accessories, and a variety of other products. The basement level is particularly notable for its extensive food section, featuring ready-to-eat items, baked goods, a supermarket, and local souvenirs such as cookies and snacks.

Visitors often praise the store's beautifully arranged displays and well-maintained facilities. The basement food floor is a highlight, offering a wide selection of ready-to-eat foods, breads, a supermarket, and souvenirs like cookies and snacks.

In addition to shopping, Kobe Hankyu houses various amenities, including restaurants, restrooms on all floors, a beauty salon, and a watch repair shop. The staff are frequently commended for their politeness and helpfulness, enhancing the overall shopping experience.

Overall, Kobe Hankyu offers a comprehensive shopping experience with a blend of retail, dining, and service options, making it a notable destination for both locals and visitors in Kobe.

Wow, just go to the basement for all the wonderful food.
Only issue is there really is no where to eat it apart from, I guess, hopping in an Uber and going to the park near the Tower.

Good shopping mall, clean and luxury feeling. 8 floors of fashion and accessory.
But the best is the B1F (basement -1 floor) with a big food corner.

name: Namba Marui
reviews: Small shopping mall that contained maby interesting things. On the B1F connected to subway, you fill find bakery shop, cosmetic shops. I recommend you to go to second floor, lucky rack is here, very cheap price of clothes and bags. GU and Uniqlo are also in this building that you can do taxfree at time of purchase. The WC are on many floors with very clean.

We popped in for a quick look around and found a clean, well-lit mall with a welcoming vibe. The mall has a duty-free counter, but it’s worth noting that not all purchases are eligible for duty-free claims. For certain items, you may need to process the claim directly at the store where you made the purchase. If in doubt, check with the duty-free staff or the shop staff for guidance.
Good place to shop if you are tired of Dontobori.

name: M-INT Kobe
reviews:
A convenient shopping center. You can go B1 for supermarket, there are groceries and bakery.
Or you can go to upper floor to have a nice city view. And there are plenty restaurants for dining.
Lastly, my favorite brand Mark&Web and Markey are all available. And some stores offer lovely design products. Ideal for picking up gifts for yourself or for family and friends.

Love the movie theater on the 9F! Lots of weekly discounts on tickets like “Date Deal” “Late Show” and “Ladies Night”. Good selection of both foreign and Japanese films, and the ticket machines always take under 5 minutes!
Everything you need when it comes to fashion is here … good outlets to eat too

name: New Lane Street Foodstalls
reviews:
Really good food here, satisfied and filled belly! Highlights were the lor bak, chicken wing and the jagung. We were there about 6pm, still plenty of seats.

Lor bak: favourite item here. The crispy tau kee and lor bak are really good, Ngoh hiang and fish ball also not bad. Nice sauce too. 28rm

Chicken wing: Tasty and well seasoned. Super good when eaten warm. Nice that they sell just 2 pieces too, no minimum. 3.50rm for one.

Apom: We got the coconut w brown sugar, set of 5 for 5rm, it's delicious, soft and fluffy especially when warm.

Jagung: Saw the uncle pushing the cart from awhile before and already eyeing it. 3rm for one corn. It's so flavourful even without spreading butter. We went back for another. Uncle is very nice and chill too. Def a highlight.

Chee cheong fun: Came with black sauce and youtiao, it's not bad but a bit pricey at 9rm.

Laksa: It was okay but not the best, small portion so good to try. Noodles are smooth. 8rm for a bowl. Friendly staff.

Drinks: We got buahlonglong w sembua and a coconut for 14rm. Need to get drink to sit at their table.

kwetiau 15RM with big duck egg, good not so oily, bid portion also and you can choose spicy or not (2nd kwetiau winner, the first is siam kwetiau with excellent fried wings). bbq wings 4RM each, pohpiah 5RM for 2 pcs, ice barley 2.5RM, fried oyster 10RM small size. everything was good. chee cheong Fun 3RM, iced sweet very nice thing we had because not too sweet, boiled corn and peeling corn 3RK was good also. asam laksa taste good 9RM medium size but KL had the best asam laksa

Tried the wantan mee, lobak, and chee cheong fun.

Wantan mee – Would definitely be back for this 👍
Lobak – The wu xiang is the standout here.
CCF – Very different from the Singapore-style version. Not really to my personal taste, but my dad enjoyed it a lot, so it really depends on your palate.

The queue moves very fast, and food is delivered to your table for most stalls — except for the CKT stall, where you still need to queue. Overall, a good experience with some clear highlights.

name: Sunshine Sakae
reviews: It is a bit slow and found the Ferris wheel experienced average.  Can be skipped and instead take photo from outside.

A mall with a large ferris wheel in the middle of the Nagoya. The night view up there is impressive and be able to see the district around .and it cost 600Y for adult.

There is a pachinko and arcade at the basement floor which i didn’t enter becauae i went there with a kid.

There was not much thing to do here. As when we visited, there was no idol show so we ended up to McDonald (which is nothing special). On top floor, there was a tax free shop and souvenir shop, a huge wheel which cost you about 1000 yen. So if you are not idol fan, so there is no need to stop by this place.

name: Center Plaza
reviews: Old-fashioned shopping plaza with multiple eateries and small retail stores that give a somewhat dated atmosphere of past era.

Lots of shop at each floor, with clear objectives: one floor for cosmetics, one for men fashion, etc.
It is connected to other buildings with great shop like LOFT.
And in B1, there is a huge and popular food court (not restaurant, but a lot of shops like Henri Charpentier, 551, RF1, and a famous supermarket for fresh foods, veggies and fish / sushies).
Not the biggest location. But I’m pretty sure it will have everything you would want.

name: Ekikama Kishimen
street: Meieki, 1 Chome−1−4 ＪＲ名古屋駅 名古屋中央通り
reviews: This was the first udon spot I visited right after arriving in Nagoya, and it was fantastic! The wide, chewy noodles were amazing, and the tempura was top-notch. I accidentally ordered the wrong item, but the staff kindly double-checked with me—service was excellent. Be sure to try the cold noodles! Highly recommended.

The noodle is outstanding, silky and chewy, unlike anything I have had before.
I highly recommend it❤️
Kishimin here was slightly above average. Noodles and broth were fresh and delicious. Ingredients were fresh and appropriate in light of only 1850 yen for 2 persons' dinner. 3 stars

name: Maruha Shokudo JR Nagoya Station
street: Meiekiminami, 1 Chome−1−4 JR名古屋駅構内 名古屋うまいもん通り 広小路口
reviews: This place is conveniently located at the Nagoya station, the food is very good, taste good, big portions. The staffs are very attentive and helpful, we can order without problem even though we don’t speak Japanese. The signature fried shrimp with special sauce on top of rice is a must try.

The fried prawns were huge and juicy. Really delicious. Assorted mix tempura were also nice and crispy. Friendly staff (despite not able to speak much English) clarified my order with me to make sure that she got it correctly. There were also a lot of locals having their meals there and to me, it means food is good and not much a tourist trap. Highly recommend.
Surprised by the size of the fried shrimp, it’s huge and taste extremely good, with raw cabbages. Must try!

name: Kōbe Hankyū Annex
reviews:
Nice mall, recently refreshed.
LOFT shop are usually full of funny and good stuff, for those who like to wander while shopping.
¥500/100g Beef in a supermarket under this department store!👍😋🥩🐂
Good shopping center with a lot of fashion stores. There are also some delicious food shops on the underground. A little bit expensive.

name: KURA SUSHI Nagoya Sakae Branch
street: Sakae, 4 Chome−2−29 名古屋広小路プレイス 2F
reviews: Fresh, delicious and well priced sushi train restraunt. All food have covers for food safety. This was a big plus in my book. Their desserts were lovely too

I stayed near here and there wasn't much choice for sushi so I ended up eating here with my young boy. I don't think it's the best quality ingredients, but it was okay at a decent price. Both of us ended up spending ¥3,500 though since we both craved sushi at that time. Service was good, although there was a hick up with the machine that assigned me to a dirty table so the waiter immediately relocated us to another one. Located on the second floor.
Sushi conveyor belt with almost everything self-service. Food was good.

name: Nagoya Sea Life Aquarium
street: SEA LIFE Nagoya, 1 Kinjoufutou, 2 Chome-7 Kinjofuto
reviews: Small but very nice aquarium with several small and bigger fish tanks. Everything is Lego themed due to Legoland being just beside. Lots of activities for kids as well. Tickets need to be purchased outside at the Legoland ticket counters. There are discounts available if you also visited Legoland and/or the railway museum.
Not too expensive but small and pretty. Buying tickets in advance could save 700¥ per person.

🎟️ I don't think it's worth getting the combined ticket with Legoland.
⏱️ You can walk through the whole thing in just 10 minutes.
🐠 Just a few aquariums and touching starfish is the only real activity.
😐 Nothing particularly interesting.

name: World buffet Harborland store
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−3−3 ハーバーセンタ B１階
reviews: BANG for your BUCK! 1400 Yen Lunch 1600 Yen Dinner weekdays not including tax. Extensive food, drinks, dessert option. Taste wise imo it's like family restaurants so don't expect gourmet. If you want to fill your belly up and go sightseeing for the day! Definitely go hungry! You can mix up different drinks. Alcoholic drinks are extra cost. My favorite was their icecream selection! There's even a kid's play area to keep your kids entertained while you pig out! Would definitely come back~ Recommended!

Although the current focus of the buffet during our visit (12/30/2025) is on European cuisine, i observed the locals still preferred more their own takoyaki, okonomiyaki, and sushi.
Very wide variety of food selection, but I expected, craved for more meat dishes and German culinary staples.

I loved the winter melon and strawberry gelato

It is my first time me and my friend going here. such a good place, has a yummy foods and drinks and desserts, has a lot people inside this restaurant. I’ve given 5 star for this place, if a tourists needs to taste yummy food from other country. so, let’s try and take your time…

name: 8 EIGHTH BEEFSteak & Hamburger Specialty Restaurant
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−6−1 神戸ハーバーランドumie モザイク 1F
reviews: I don’t know why this place has only a 3.7 star review at the time of this review. I have been here 3 times now and the services and food have always been amazing. This is in my top 5 places to eat in Japan thus far. Very affordable compared to Osaka. Great atmosphere. And I have never had to wait for a seat around lunch time.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had an amazing dining experience at 8 EIGHTH BEEF. The originality of flavor truly stood out, and the Kobe beef was exceptionally tender and juicy — simply unforgettable!

The warm wooden interior created a calm and cozy atmosphere, making the whole dining experience feel inviting and comfortable.

A perfect place to enjoy high-quality beef in a relaxed and welcoming setting. Highly recommended!

First time in Kobe and of course wanted to try a Kobe Beef burger. We were directed to this restaurant and so decided to give it a try. It’s located at the Kobe Port and was easy to fine. The atmosphere was nice, there is outside and inside seating. The inside is really nice and comfortable. The staff were very nice and helpful with an English menu. We decided the Kobe Beef Burger of course and it was a little disappointing to say the least. We weren’t asked how we wanted it cooked and it was a little over cooked. I have had regular Wagu beef and this wasn’t half as good. The bread wasn’t that soft and fresh either. So we weren’t impressed but will try other places to see if it gets any better.

name: TOOTH TOOTH MART FOOD HALL & NIGHT FES
street: Shinkocho, 7−2 神戸ポートミュージアム 1F
reviews: Easy place for a quick meal after a visit to the aquarium. Food court style so anyone can order the food they are interested in. We thought the dumplings and omu rice were good. Not huge servings so a bit pricey for what you get but handy to eat at so can't beat that

Mojo Mojo Burger located inside TOOTH TOOTH MART FOOD HALL which next to Atoa Aquarium. I can said their Cheese Burger is one of the best burger I’ve been tried. The meat is tender and juicy, and the bread has a smoky, charred aroma—a lunch choice you shouldn't miss.

The Mojomojo Burger was definitely not worth it. For 5,500 yen, they served me a well-done patty that was so tough and chewy it was hard to enjoy — honestly, even McDonald’s might have been better.

The food court was also frustrating, as many tables were reserved for others, making it hard to find a place to sit.

name: Shichiri no Watashiato
reviews:
[Shichiri-no-Watashi (Kuwana, Mie)]

​□ Elements

​・ Access

A 15–20 min walk from Kuwana Station (JR/Kintetsu). It is located just a few minutes on foot from Kyuka Park. For drivers, use the nearby public parking lots serving the park and the riverside area.

​・ Time

15–30 min stay. This is a historic site featuring a large Torii gate that marks the entrance to Ise Province. It’s a perfect spot for a quick historical photo and to enjoy the view of the Ibi River, which was once the bustling maritime gateway of the Tokaido road.

​・ Outfit

Casual travel attire. The area is flat and paved. However, being right on the edge of the river, it is often very windy. A jacket or windbreaker is highly recommended to stay comfortable while taking in the views.

​・ Stay

Stay near Kuwana Station for the best selection of hotels. Since this site is near the Nabana no Sato and Nagashima Spaland areas, Kuwana serves as an excellent base for exploring both historical sites and modern attractions in Mie.

​・ Eat
Visit the nearby Kuwana Machinoeki or local specialty shops for Hamaguri (clams). There are also several traditional confectionery shops in the vicinity selling Yasunaga-mochi. Eating clams at one of the riverside restaurants provides a classic "Old Tokaido" experience.

三重の旅で、立ち寄りました。桑名七里の渡し公園駐車場に車を止め、蟠龍櫓（水門総合管理所）周辺を散策してから、七里の渡跡に行きました。七里の渡跡は、堤防が整備された為、当時の面影はありませんが、東海道唯一の海路で、桑名宿と宮宿の間の距離が七里（約２８ｋｍ）あることから、七里の渡と呼ばれました。更に、ちょうど伊勢国の東の入り口にある為、伊勢国の「一の鳥居」と称され、伊勢神宮の遷宮ごとに、建て替えられています。江戸時代には、伊勢湾から木曽三川を渡り、多くの人が行き交って賑わっていたのが想像出来ます。お伊勢参りに行く前に、立ち寄れて良かったです。
東海道の要所として栄えた七里の渡し。かつて桑名宿と宮宿を結ぶ海路として利用された渡し場で、東海道唯一の海上ルートとして知られている。伊勢湾に向かって広がる水辺と常夜灯、石畳が残る風景は、当時の旅人の往来を思わせる趣がある。歴史を感じさせる佇まいは、今もどこか絵になる景色で、思わず足を止めて眺めたくなる場所。

name: Benten
reviews: There are many Hitsumabushi restaurants in Nagoya, but if you like your eel grilled crispy and fragrantly, this restaurant is recommended.

One of Nagoya's famous restaurant.  All for menu is Traditional Japanese Cuisine, Hitsumabushi  is No.1 recomment for there menu and also have course menus for party.
I just take picture only 3 menu from this course. for this course all menu test good.
Cool

name: Happiness Cafe
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−1 サンフランシスコ・エリア
reviews:
Happiness Café in Universal Studios Japan is a must-visit spot if you’re a fan of unique, themed dining experiences. All the dishes are creatively crafted and designed to look like Minion characters, making the entire meal as fun as it is delicious. We ordered chicken, bacon, a burger, a kiddie meal, and desserts—and everything exceeded our expectations.

Despite the long line, the queue moved steadily, and after about 20 minutes, we were seated comfortably. Ordering is convenient too—you can use the mobile app or the self-service kiosks inside the café. Once you’ve paid, you simply wait for your table and present your receipt to claim your food.

What really stood out is that the food here is far superior to most other restaurants inside Universal Studios Japan. The quality, presentation, and overall experience made it worth every minute of waiting.

Highly recommended for families, friends, and anyone looking for a joyful dining experience in the park!

Minion theme cafeteria in USJ.  Choose this place because according to reviews it's one of the least crowded in the theme park. Indeed large seating area, simple selection offer.  Although it's cafeteria style food , it's quite ok by international standards. However if you want to compare apple to apple in accordance to Japanese theme park , it's just average. Nevertheless plus point of soda fountain free flow selection and coffee machine too. Dessert look super cute too. Recommended if you minion fans.

This cute minion themed cafe felt sort of similar to a high school cafeteria style of dinning. You first queue up and order through a QR code and then pay at the register at the front. Then, a different staff leads to your seat in a large dining area and you are instructed to bring your receipt to one of the two lines where the food is served. After placing your receipt on a tray, the staff will place your meal onto your tray.

Everything was very well organized and the wait wasn’t too long. My friends and I ordered each of the three items available to try them all out. My personal favorite was the fried chicken but the curry was also quite tasty. I was honestly surprised that the food tasted as good as they looked. However, the only thing I wasn’t a fan of was the cold corn soup that came with the fried chicken.

name: Kuwana City Museum
reviews: It actually holds a piece of history that I want to see. The Muramasa Katana. It's legend......its myth.....Muramasa fascinates me. And to actually see it would be that much more rewarding.  I discovered it  through a tale, that I thought was just a myth, but later found out it was a reality. And it exist. Thanks Google Maps

​桑名の歴史と文化が凝縮された、落ち着きある博物館です。​桑名駅から徒歩20分ほどで駐車場もあります。三重県初の市立博物館で歴史も長く古さは否めませんが、キレイに整備されています。今回企画展もありリーズナブルですが質の高い魅力的な展示満載で楽しめました！今回は学芸員さんの解説ツアーにも参加できて更に良かったです。
松平定信ゆかりの品や、郷土が生んだ名刀「村正」、優美な「萬古焼」など、桑名ならではの貴重な展示をじっくり堪能できます。特に、一枚の紙から数十羽の鶴を折る「桑名の千羽鶴」の繊細さには目を奪われました。
​派手な体験型施設ではありませんが、地域の歴史を深く知りたい方には最適な場所で、桑名散策の合間に立ち寄るのにおすすめ。
萬古焼が桑名発祥にはビックリしました!
おすすめですよ!

name: SUZUKA-ZE
street: センターハウス, 内, 7992 Inoucho
reviews:
全日本ロードレース観戦時に利用。パドックパスが無いと利用できないのかな？初日はカフェ利用でドーナツ。こちらは揚げたてを提供してもらった。2日目はお昼&カフェ利用でした。

お昼はだいぶ混むので、ピットウォーク早めに切り上げてしまうか、いっそのことJSB1000が終わった後とかに行くのがいいかもしれない。

ご飯の量が多いので満足感半端無かったです！

美味しかった！

鈴鹿8耐テスト走行の日に利用しました。
プリンは売り切れていた為、ドーナツ、チーズケーキを購入！ドーナツは揚げたてをいただきました！
サクッとふわふわで美味しかった。
店内も涼しく、水はセルフサービス。
先にお会計を済ませて、商品出来上がったらベルで知らせていただけるシステム。返却も返却口にセルフでした。

name: Seianmon Gate
reviews:
Seianmon Gate (西安門) marks the western entrance to Kobe Chinatown (Nankinmachi) and was completed in 1990 as part of the district’s redevelopment and identity-building efforts. Designed in a traditional Chinese architectural style, it features red pillars and a decorative roof that clearly signal the transition into the Chinatown area.

The name “Seian” refers to Xi’an, one of China’s historic capitals, highlighting the cultural background behind the design. While primarily symbolic in function, the gate serves as an important visual landmark and a natural endpoint of Nankinmachi’s main street.

Packed with Chinese style food stalls. Packed with tourists, crowded street food area. Unhygienic. Food exposes to open air. The food not even authentic. The bao I bought tasted the same as the one in 7-11
Food stalls and shops around place..

name: Katsudon Daiki Osu Branch
street: Osu, 3 Chome−28−11 プレジデント大須 １Ｆ
reviews:
A must visit!

The food was so amazing, i forgot to take a photo before eating it!

Its a small place, and although its in the osu shopping district, its not a tourist trap at all. I came at around 2ish in the afternoon, so there's no crowd.

Definitely one of the highlights of my trip, will come back if im ever in nagoya again!
The pork chop is tender and nice, the egg is creamy  and rich, will come again if I visit Nagoya, is a crime if not coming
Tasty katsudon spot in Nagoya, must try for local experience, staff is nice and friendly

name: ごはん家
street: Minatojima Nakamachi, 3 Chome−2-6 グルメシティポートアイランド内
reviews: Very cozy atmostphere and kind staff, food was good quality. I ate there many times during my stay and enjoyed it.

Friend ordered food but was told quite some time later that his order was sold out, so he ordered something else and got it within 10 mins. Staff gave free ice cream to all of us which came as a surprise. 10/10 for service and food. Ganbatte!
Varied menu (from a tablet), good and affordable. Single places as well as tables. Small selection ot craft beer.

name: Restoran Beh Brothers
reviews:
I had a truly horrible experience at this hawker stall. The hygiene was appalling. I personally witnessed a foreign worker putting her finger into the soup bowls, which is completely unacceptable. On top of that, the pork liver they served was undercooked and unsafe to eat.

When I raised my concern, instead of apologizing, the stall owner insisted that it was “deliberately undercooked” because “many customers like it half raw.” This is not only irresponsible but also extremely unprofessional. Food safety should never be compromised
I ordered Beef Ramen and Bean Tofu Soup. They tasted bland. :-(
nice place to have morning chilling but place located at street food center. we ordered Wanton noodle & milk tea (price was RM13 & RM3) it tasted good and nice.

name: 揖斐・長良川の背割提
reviews: 桑名から岐阜方面への移動には、この長良川沿いのルートがおすすめ。信号が少なく、両サイドには川以外何もないので、交通は至極スムーズ。もう名古屋高速を使う必要もない。

個人的には自然に囲まれて癒される場所。
歴史的背景は承知していませんのであしからず。
揖斐川と長良川に挟まれるのは地元民としては贅沢の極。
道が南端の方が低く、水面から結構近いです。長良川より揖斐川の方が水面が低いです。明治以前は、長良川は今の羽島市南端で木曽川と合流し木曽川筋を流れており、木曾三川分流工事で、長良川の流れが変わりこの堤防が出来ました。今は普通の堤防ですが、当時はかなりの苦労があったと思います。

name: 豊臣秀吉公像
reviews:
NHK 大河ドラマ｢豊臣兄弟!｣の聖地巡礼のついでに訪れました。

地下鉄｢国際センター駅｣から少し歩くが｢円頓寺商店街｣の入口近くの歩道に設置されてます。

以前、秀吉像の首が切断された事件をニュースで見ましたが、今は綺麗に修復されてました。

ネットニュースによると１月２８日　愛媛県警の男性警部補と名古屋市の男が犯人として書類送検されたとのこと。立派な器物損壊罪なのに書類送検だけで済ますとは、警察も身内に甘いですね。
もし豊臣秀吉の時代なら一族根絶やしだろね。知らんけど。

ところで事件のせいか、カラーコーンや柵があって目障りです。。。

２０２５年８月。出張してきた愛媛県警の警察官によって首をはねられた…Ｘ…　折られてしまった首は無事修復されました。
大河ドラマ「豊臣兄弟！」の放映に間に合ってよかった。
一枚目画像は２０１６年秋のもの。二枚目以降は２６年２月のものです。

円頓寺商店街の円頓寺交差点側入口に有る像。
周りは三角コーンで囲まれています。

此方は目立ったイタズラ・破壊行為は記憶無いですが、確か、最初は右手に芍を持っていたように記憶しているのですが・・・？

それにしても、なんだか地味な像。何か、らしくない気がしますが・・・？

2025年8月に首が壊されました。
又、破壊行為されたですね。
この辺りの治安はどうなっているのか？？
10月現在も修復されていません。
もう、撤去した方が良いのでは？？

2025年12月18日現在、ブルーシートで覆われて居ます。首も修復されている様に見えます。
2026年度の大河ドラマの主人公なんだから、首無しのままのわけにはいかなかったか？

2026年1月
完全に修復されていました。
右手の芍も復活していました。

name: Takaoka Castle Ruins Park
reviews: Best scenery
立派な駐車場がありますが、先人の口コミのとおり、そこに至る道はかなり狭いです。土塁らしき遺構がありましたが、それ以外に目立った遺構は確認できませんでした。眺望は良いです。

高岡城跡は公園となっていますが、城だった面影はほぼありません。言われないと城趾だと気づかないでしょう。
現状では単なる展望台です。展望台としては伊勢湾まで見渡せますが、標高が高くない(50m程度)ので迫力は今ひとつです。近くに住んでいるなら別ですが、遠方からわざわざ訪れる価値があるかといえば疑問です。
駐車場は山上にありますが、途中の道がたいへん狭いので普通車では厳しいかもしれません。

高岡城は神戸氏家老の山路弾正の城で信長の伊勢侵攻時に落城せず耐えましたが、後に信長に謀反を企てましたが攻め込まれ自害したそうです。

name: Aqiss River Camp
reviews:
Our first time at the campsite. Overall, I love the experience although the entrance can be challenging. You need to drive up a steep hill (20-30°), followed by a steep descends.

Exiting the campsite can be challenging for smaller car but it’s drivable. The road was cemented. Even when it rains, the road can still be used.

Since this campsite is inside a forest reserves, u need to pay RM15 for the entrance fee.

And I have personally encounter a snake around 4:30am in the morning when I walk towards the toilet but it’s all good. The snake was minding its own business.

There’s 1 guy who’s friendly and seems to be taking care of that campsite. I also saw few forest rangers came in the campsite for a short break.

I had an excellent experience staying at this campsite. Very clean place and facilities with superb river in front of your tent. The staffs help us a lot during our stay, keep on asking whether everything is fine or not. Great place for family with kids, safe to run around and a lot of lights during the night. You can also hike to sg pisang waterfall from this place.I will definitely return again to this place soon. Worth it!!
Nice & privacy location.. Clean and kids friendly river.. Accessible by campsite operator's 4x4 or by your own 4x4. Clean toilet and  electricity supplied by generator 7.30pm till 12am

name: Uncle Lim 板面
reviews:
Lovely uncle who check the time to explain the news highlights to us, and was very accommodating about my slightly finicky coffee order. The pan mee was tasty with crispy anchovies. Would I have preferred a saltier sauce and to have the noodles reeking of pork oil? Yes. But it was tasty.

The dumplings, served in a flavourful soup were standout. The uncle had said they were home made and he wasn't kidding. The filling was generous and even the minced meat still had texture. It reminded me of the old school pork mince that was chopped by hand. The prawn inside was fresh, sweet, and crunchy, and the coffee was strong and smooth. The noodles were 12RM as were the dumplings. Not the cheapest, but considering the location, it's understandable.
Wanton is expensive at RM12. Taste so so only. Coffee also taboleh… sigh…

Am glad I didn't read the reviews before trying this place or I would have missed out the best breakfast in my 3 days here. Didn't see the infamous landlady but an old Uncle and auntie were rather nice and took our orders.  I was here for the ban Mee but also tried the pork noodles which turned out to be a bonus for me as it was the best out of the 3 I tried. Ban Mee was good too. Also ordered the fishballs but I thought it was nothing great.

name: Santica
reviews: Decent local shopping mall mostly visited by local residents. Broad range of shopping and eating choices; more than 100 places to shop or eat. Underground and linked to the station. Convenient particularly on rainy days or in the heat. Something for everyone. Good for families. Relaxed atmosphere. Handy on the way to or from somewhere.

This mall is right in the center of the Kobe City Area. Plenty of shops and restaurants are available within a few minutes walking distance to satisfy any craving. The B1 floor of the mall is directly connected to the Kobe-Sannomiya train station for easy access.
I live in Sannomiya, so I'm constantly shopping here. A good chunk of Santica is under renovation right now, but there's still plenty of shopping to be had in the underground of Kobe here.

name: Center Plaza West
reviews:
As an anime lover, this place will disappoint you.
After losing plenty of anime shops, and now surrounded by trading card game shops.
And unofficial crane games, which is dangerous, so please don't visit there.
You should buy anime goods from the internet.

It's simply not just attractive.

It's an easy 0 star for me.
An older style mall, but the secret is in the wonderful locally priced restaurants in the basement. We had our kobe steak lunch experince here. Faultless. ¥21000 with drinks.

When you go around beside it
there is Daiso in 5 floor

name: SAN PLAZA
reviews: This quaint little strip mall is chock full of anime, video game, and hobby stores. I almost thought I was in a mini Akihabara for a second, which is why I keep coming back again and again.
Many small local shops to see. Worth a nice stop when traveling to Kobe
So much to see and do here!! Plan some time to be able to walk around because there is quite a bit.

name: Namba Nannan
street: Namba, 5 Chome−1 なんなんタウン
reviews: Found this place by chance as we took the wrong route when exiting Takashimaya. This place was a little quiet when we stumbled upon it, but nevertheless there seems to be quite a number of eateries here. There were other type of shops around but we were in and out pretty quick due to lack of time having to travel back.
There are various choices of restaurants, and various kinds of shops here. Also, it locates next to Namba metro station and is easy to access.

This place is where Tagoyaki was bron.
If you wanna taste the original and genuine one, please visir.

name: Sakae Chika
reviews: Very expensive stuff some are overpriced. Nice headphones, chargers power bank’s but over 100$ each item

Love the food and atmosphere...
The service from time to time is really slow and the waitresses don't know their menu at all but it is worth going to.
Drinks are pricey though...makes it less likely to go to frequently
Nice coffee but fairly rude to foreigner

name: Sakae Mori no Chikagai
reviews:
Ideal place for shopping from high end to discount items for food and other consumer items, while the area also has numerous restaurants, coffee shops, sweets, and other delicacies. But it is also a good pace to enjoy certain Japanese cultural items.

However, the shopping center can be very crowded in weekday PM rush hours and on Saturday.  It is accessible via Meijo Line and Higashiyama Line of Nagoya subway.
I'm so going to be broke after this holiday
If you want to grab a snack, drinks or really dine in food you can come in this place, located underpass.

name: La Ohana Atsuta Ichiban
reviews: The lobster soup is very tasty, the salad is generous and enough for 2 or 3 people, and some of the main dishes change according to the season.
Delicious

Good atmosphere family restaurant
Great variety of plates 🍽

name: Piazza Kobe
reviews: Lots of little shops selling all sorts of stuff.. good for a browse. Plenty of small cheap eateries..
Medium-sized shopping street that people can walk through. Connecting Sannomiya to Motomachi. Price is reasonable.
Nice shopping belt and not too crowded. Lots of small shops selling everything from street wear to cosmetics

name: クレフィ三宮
reviews:
I went here to check out the X-Large store. We lost our X-Large in LA for some reason but it's still available in Japan. Afterwards I went down to the 3rd floor to the Green Bar and got some vegetable smoothies, soup and bagels. It wasn't bad at all but for some reason cream cheese isn't an automatic option for bagels here. Still good.

It's a neat little mall check it out.

You can find many  more  shopping center & its easy for travel. The immigration office has there . The kobe airport & the fastest train (Shinkansen) also near by this place . So it's a good place to live & travels.
A popular place with great desserts. Expect a long wait during peak hours

name: SAKAE NOVA
reviews: Good place  to shop ... love onitsuka

Easy to get lost 😅
Book off is here somewhere
Ok

name: Rokko Kobe Harborland
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−5−7 神戸情報文化ビル 18F カルメニ
reviews: Authentic Japanese food with a stunning view of Kōbe Harbour. The restaurant is on 18th floor so you could see Osaka and Wakayama prefecture when the weather is clear!

The restaurant offers a stunning view of Kobe city, making it a perfect place to enjoy a meal while admiring the beautiful scenery.

The food was delicious and had a wide variety of options to choose. I would recommend this place for those looking for a nice dining spot with a great view in Kobe.
The food was awesome and had a little bit of everything. However, I'm not so keen on cooking my own meal ( beef) but the experience was rewarding.

name: Kanbe Castle Ruins
reviews: The castle ruin has little left to it but the park it is in is beautiful. There is a partial moat surrounding the bottom with large coy fish and carp. Also there is a playground that has a large slide. I often go here to relax and walk around.
Top

鈴鹿市神戸町にある神戸城跡は、かつて伊勢神戸城として栄えた歴史を感じられる静かな史跡です。現在は天守などの建造物は残っていませんが、公園として整備されており、城跡特有の地形や石垣の名残から往時の姿を想像することができます。特に堀や高低差のある配置は、戦国時代の防御の工夫を身近に感じさせてくれます。観光地としての派手さはありませんが、その分落ち着いた雰囲気で、歴史好きの方や散策を楽しみたい方にはぴったりです。春には桜も美しく、地域の人々の憩いの場として大切にされていることが伝わってきます。歴史と日常が自然に溶け合った、味わい深い城跡です。

name: Lim Kee Restaurant
reviews:
Sadly
cannot give more than 2 star. Would have given 1 star for food but the Garlic Eggplant was so nice and saved the day.

My issues is that I ordered fried Lala’s in dried chili from the menu and to my HUGE SURPRISE the dish tasted so so sweet, like they had poured SUGAR or Syrup in the wok !

what meant to be a nice spicy dish tasted like dessert !

and to make things worst, the chopped red chili were in a sweet soya sauce also. 😵😵🤯

UNACCEPTABLE !

Really can't comment on other's experience. However, we ate here a night ago with absolutely nothing to go on with such a plethora of choices on the street. For a hit or miss opportunity, we were thoroughly happy.
We had curry crab, beef with snow peas, satay chicken, and salt/pepper prawns.
Good...? Yes. It's so good we're going back again to sample more of the menu.
The curry crab was a spicy curry, leaving a warmth on your lips. Crab is nicely cracked in cooking and prep such that you don't need implements to open it. Meat was succulent, sweet, and definitely fresh for the crab. The beef was the most tender slices I've ever had the pleasure of eating, and the sauce left that nice texture across your teeth as you ate it. Salt and pepper prawns were a good size and tasty. Satay sticks were served with the traditional satay paste and oil, nicely cooked, not charred. Delicious. We thoroughly enjoyed the meal and the general ambiance of an open stall restaurant. They do offer A/C dining if preferred. Rare on the street. Every option of payment is accepted, although you pay a premium for credit cards. For us, the same meal back in Canada would be double the price. However, it is likely a little inflated for the tourist area. Recommended for foreigners.

*Extremely Poor Service – Deeply, Deeply Disappointing Experience*

I rarely leave negative reviews because I know everyone is just trying to make a living. But last night, Jalan Alor was packed. WAW and Sai Woo — the two big names — were closed, and most of the other places were full. We were left with no choice but to sit down at Lim Kee while waited for my customers.

The experience was *extremely, extremely, extremely bad*. We ordered about 6 dishes. One plate of broccoli with scallops was RM50 — the price itself I can accept — but the *portion was pitiful, pitiful, pitiful*. Their so-called "medium" portion was even smaller than a small plate at other restaurants. The scallops weren’t even real. Totally unacceptable.

When we raised the issue, the staff kept pushing the matter from one to another — 4 people in total. Finally, a woman who claimed to be the boss came over. Her attitude was *very, very, very, very rude*. Instead of listening, she immediately told us to leave after saying just a couple of words. As we were walking out, she shouted loudly across the entire restaurant, “You don’t know how to eat, and you don’t appreciate good food!”Even more ironic — I asked a friend to order takeaway for the same dishes, and the *portion was clearly double*. This shows they *do* have the ability to serve proper portions — they just treat customers differently. And yet they loudly claimed they "don’t allow takeaway" when we were there!

All we asked was for them to maybe just top up with an extra plate of vegetables — it wasn’t unreasonable. If someone can’t control their temper, they shouldn't be in the F&B business.

I’ve eaten in Jalan Alor for over 10 years — from WAW, Sai Woo, Meng Kee, Hao Tian, Hao Shi Jie, to many Thai and Chinese stalls — and *never* have I encountered such *horrible*, *disgraceful*, *shockingly bad* customer service like Lim Kee.

Please avoid this restaurant. There have many good restaurants out there.

And yet, they said they don't care about Google reviews at all.

name: New World Thai Food
reviews: One of Thai resto along Alor Street. Super crowded and mostly busy in dinner time. Wait time was about an hour. The food is yummy & the portion is pretty big, enough for sharing (2-3 people). Their steamed fish was the star of the dish, warm & flavourful. Don’t forget to order their mango sticky rice, it comes in big portion as well, the mango is very sweet.

We went here on weekend so it's packed, everywhere is packed, so expect to wait for your food for 10-20mins. No rush, just enjoy the night air of foods (and vape from irresponsible diners) & nice music from street musicians.

Our "target" was the mango sticky rice. For 1 set, it's reasonably priced as it's plentiful. The mango was sweet and the glutinous rice was just right, to my liking. Just wish that the coconut gravy to be a tad bit thicker.

The pad thai was nice. The coconut drink was great. The pattaya fried rice was a bit of a disappointment in presentation, but the taste was great. Overall, was a great experience

everything is fine.

service is friendly and cool
location is what it is, is a night market, if you want magical glamour go to some skyscape

food is good, not really super Thai but we are in Malaysia .. is like to eat a pizza here.. come to Italy if u wanna taste real pizza.

portions are good but too price imho

name: Han Travel Sdn Bhd
reviews: We booked the 2 days 1 night taman negara tour with han travel. at first we were a bit afraid because of the bad recommendations on google regarding the driver and his skills which were supposed to be bad. we texted the agency and they assured us that the driver was no longer at work there. so the drive there was good and we felt safe. the hotel (xcape) was not the best tho. we did the night trekking tour, river shooting and the day trekking jungle tour. all tours had a really great guide which explained everything. everything was on time. thanks for the great experience!

I booked a bus from Kuala Tahan to Kuala Lumpur with this travel agency and it was a terrible experience. First of all, it was too pricey compared to other agencies,  but I booked it because it was the only available option for my return date. Second,  without any prior notice, the minibus stopped after less than an hour and dropped off everyone telling us that each group,  depending on their final destination, will need to transfer to another bus. We ended up waiting close to an hour until the other minibus came. Last but not least, the driver was not driving safely,  but rather fast and recklessly.  I can't objectively recommend this service at all.

I see a lot of bad reviews but we had a perfect experience! We took a bus from KL to Kuala tembeling where we took a jetty. The woman in the bus was funny and gave information about the rainforest and their tours. Our jetty was stuck at a shallow point at the river but the boat drivers helped eachother out. A beautiful boat tour! At Kuala tahan we did a short day trip ( it was mostly uphill and really sweaty so be prepared) and a night tour. Our night tour guide spotted a lot of insects and animals for us. Then we took a bus ride in a mini van to the Cameron highlands. It is a bumpy ride so if you have car sickness, be prepared. Overall everything was arranged well, would reccomend!

name: Arribada
reviews: The food is quite tasty but a bit pricey and the portions are small, typical of Western fine dining. The restaurant's location before continuing the route to the south building is perfect for a break, with a quiet and peaceful atmosphere.
I will not recommend a shark steak. It’s too salty and bad smell. Other is fine.
The aquarium dining experience.

name: Loco Burger Osu
reviews: LOCOBURGER in Osu Market, Nagoya, is a great place for cheese hot dogs and karaage. The cheese hot dog had perfectly melted cheese, and the coin bread, available in Nutella and cheese flavors, was soft and tasty. The karaage was crispy and full of flavor. The menu is available in English, Chinese, and Vietnamese, which makes ordering easy. The staff are friendly and provide excellent service. A Korean staff member who speaks excellent English was particularly helpful. Takeout is also available. If you're visiting Osu Market, be sure to stop by LOCOBURGER.

first time ✨✨✨
nice service, they are so kind ❤️✨
best price, take away OK✨
they even putting hiza kake (warm towel) in every seat! so u dont feeling cold when dine in 🥺✨
Such a great place to go. Outdoor seating was nice. Burger was nice and juicy. Fries were super and good quantity. All of that and 2 glass bottles of coke for 1, 030 yen was a good deal.

name: The Dragon’s Pearl
street: Sakurajima, 2 Chome−1−1 サンフランシスコ・エリア
reviews:
I got a proper meal in this restaurant. I feel alive~~,, they have collab packages with apothecary diary for noodles and tea.
You need to check the table first before you queue to order.
Inside the restaurant you might see Jinshi and MaoMao having a meet and great session outside the building. You need to do a mission to get this session. so I just ask the staff how and they will tell you where you should go for a mission.

For a theme park restaurant, we were pleased with the quality and taste of the food. There was also no wait time as we managed to find a seat quickly before ordering our food. They forgot my almond jelly dessert as part of the set, but quickly fixed the situation once mentioned.

When we went, the line was unbearably long. There were also zero tables free, at all. We ordered the special Apothecary Diaries meal, which was all they really had apart from two rice sets. The noodles were okay at best, the jelly pretty good, and the dumplings were decent as well.

name: Rekishiokataru Park
reviews:
江戸の日本橋から京都の三条大橋に至る「東海道五十三次」を、徒歩で数分で達成できる遊歩道がある桑名城跡の、お堀端にある公園です。
富士山のモチーフがなんともレトロ。

「桑名宿」は、「熱田宮宿」に次いで、東海道中で第二位の宿数を誇り、「一の鳥居」を擁する伊勢路の玄関口として賑わっていました。

「日本橋」の所に、休憩できるベンチのある東屋があります。

お堀の向こうに桑名市指定文化財の「桑名城 城壁」を眺めることが出来ます。

東海道の歩き旅の途中に立ち寄りました。
東海道をモチーフにした小さな公園です。

小さい日本橋
東海道のミニチュアというか縮小版の小道を歩けます。

name: Top of Universal
street: Shimaya, 6 Chome−2−45 32F レストラン トップ・オブ・ユニバーサル
reviews: One star for the view and one for the staff. The food at breakfast buffet is a shame. I am really surprised this came out of a Japanese kitchen, whoever put this up had no idea what tastes good.
It's fun

ユニバ前に朝食を食べるべくホテルの最上階の朝食会場に行きました。通常の朝食よりグレードアップしたプランとなります。
景色が綺麗なのでとても良かったです。
ご飯やパンの種類も多く、味もとてもおいしかったです。良いホテルの朝食ブッフェって感じでした。

name: Arima An
reviews:
DEC 2024

This store sells a variety of sweets but what caught my attention was the wild boar meat bun. The bun was fluffy and the meat taste pretty good with only a slight hint of gamey flavor. Ratio of meat to bun was decent.
Wine tarantula and scorpions, gold leaf ice cream and soups from all over the world.
Nice gold leaf ice cream

#神戸三宮グルメ
#ジーライオン
#海鮮バーガー#PR

神戸新港町エリアの注目スポット
TOTTEI KOBEにあるお店。

SNSを見て気になった｢Bay Catchチーズバーガー｣を注文。
ハンバーガーと言えばビーフのイメージだけど、
こちらは兵庫県産の“明石だこ”を使ったパティに“しらす”を贅沢に入った兵庫の恵みたっぷりの海鮮バーガー。

主役はぷりっぷりで旨み濃厚な明石だこ。
それを分厚いパティに仕立て、
さらにたっぷり入ったしらすがふわっと香る
あまりお目にかかったことがない新しい海鮮ハンバーガー。
たこがごろっと入ってるから
食感がとてもいいアクセントになってる！

ビーフのバーガーももちろんいいけど、
たこのパティは比較的あっさりしてて、
野菜もたくさん入ってるから
気持ち罪悪感なく食べれるところも嬉しい。

バンズがよく見るハンバーガーの
倍ぐらいあって、具もたっぷりなので、
片手で持つのがギリギリなボリューム感？

テイクアウトOK🛍
天気のいい日は神戸の港を眺めながら食べるのもいいし、
テラス席はペットも同伴可能🐕 ͗ ͗だから
これからもっとあったかくなってきたら、
お散歩がてら行くのもよさそう。

ジーライオンアリーナがあるので、
スポーツ観戦やライブ前、ライブ終わりに
ふらっと立ち寄れる“港町グルメ”の穴場としても注目が高まる…！

忘年会で利用させていただきました。

男性と女性のスタッフさんの接客が親切で、お勧めのメニューなども教えてくださりほっこりしました。
アリーナでのイベントがない平日は、店内は混雑していないようで、今回はゆったりと過ごすことができました。
ちょうどクリスマスマーケットも開催しており、店内は小さなお子様連れのファミリーが多かったように思います。
12月はイルミネーションが綺麗でお店からの眺めも良い雰囲気でした。

ベビーカーでの入店は特に問題ありませんでしたが、子ども用の椅子がないため、あれば良かったなと感じました。

お勧めのパスタとても美味しかったです。
本日の鮮魚で刺身盛りは、鯛やタコは勿論美味しかったのですが、個人的に石垣鯛(間違っていたらすみません)という炙りのお刺身がとても美味しかったです。日によって取り扱う鮮魚は違うみたいなので、また食べにきた時には注文してみたいと思います。

トリュフ風味の農園パテ、和牛ローストビーフなどのおつまみもとても美味しく、みんなのお酒がすすんでいました。一緒に来ていた子どもたちにはローストビーフとポテトが好評だったようです。

ありがとうございました。
次はバーガーを食べに行きたいです。

name: Kōbe MARUI
reviews:
Kōbe MARUI is a stylish urban shopping destination located in the heart of Sannomiya, directly connected to the train station for easy access.

Known for its clean, modern design, the mall offers a well-curated selection of fashion brands, lifestyle shops, and cafés, with a strong focus on contemporary Japanese style. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, making it a pleasant place to browse or take a break from the busy streets outside.

With its convenient location and thoughtfully chosen stores, Kōbe MARUI is a great stop for both locals and visitors looking for quality shopping in central Kobe.
Very good

Bought my current car from here staff on purchase very helpful and flexible on price

After sales has also maintained this 5 star rating efficient quick and professional service

Would not hesitate to buy from them again

reviews: A decent commercial building with variety of shops, I can go shopping here to buy clothes, gifts, foods and even some toys here. It is worth to spend time to have a walk here, and it is so convenient actually
Good mall with shops that cover everything. I mostly go there for the food court, but still good small mall to shop( not to spend time)
A decent commercial building with lots of shops, eateries, restaurants etc. Just across the road from sannomiya station.

name: FISHERMAN'S MARKET
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−6−1 2F Kobe Harborland umie Mosaic
reviews:
I am from Thailand. This restaurant offers a variety of international food, including sushi, pizza, spaghetti, and seafood, plus lots of desserts. Note that the beef steak is only available during the dinner service.

90 minutes to eat all you can, and the price is very fair (around 800-900 baht, including non-alcoholic drinks)

If you have a big appetite and want to try a lot of different dishes, give this place a try! 👍👍👍

The food is superb..
Very delicious and a lot of menu to pick..

We went during dinner. During dinner they have unlimited steak🥩 while having a nice view

I enjoyed my time here and wont compare it to buffets in my country. Just under 800-1200 yen & 30 min ferry ride from Rinku Airport harbor to Kobe airport.

Japan has their own way for preparing crab legs which people may not enjoy, but I tried the feast. The legs are brine, not marinated and served cold. Very interesting 😊!

Halal - some options available but ask first. The chef was nice enough to show me which dishes were halal, if interested---see video. Not perfect but mashallah they try.

Make sure you check the times before coming. The crabs are all you can eat but only served at 4pm.

name: Fly Me To @ Kuala Lumpur
street: 37th Floor, Block, A, Regalia Residence, 2, Jln Sultan Ismail
reviews:
A friend who's staying in the Airbnb here wanted to try this place for lunch, since I've heard so much about Regalia and it's rooftop, so why not?

I arrived around 12.20pm and it was empty. So, unsure how it the place and service when it's crowded (if it ever gets crowded - so I can't comment).

The restaurant is a bit warm - well I don't like places with super cold AC but since it's on the rooftop, the doors were open, it is a bit warm even when it's empty.

Service is fast... well I expect it to be, since we are the only people there. When asked for recommendation, I felt the server isn't too sure about what's good, because I heard a long list from him (unless everything on the menu is really very good... but it's a 3.6 rating place... so... skeptical)

Anyways, we both order pasta, and since we both have very high expectations of pasta... we decided to have 0 expectations and to our surprised, the pasta we had were more than just OK. I didn't try his pasta but according to him, it was good (or not bad).

The food prices are actually quite expensive. Our pasta were around RM42 - 46 each. The Risotto on the menu ranges between RM42 - 50+ , I understand it's a rooftop, but I don't think the price = matched the taste...

The place, in terms of environment, well it has got a nice view of course, but it's quite old, maybe a little facelift would do the place well.

10/10. This café is super cozy!!! Perfect for introverts, or maybe we were just lucky because we went on a Saturday and expected it to be crowded, but it wasn’t. We were there to celebrate my friend’s birthday. The service and food were tip-top.

There was one staff member named Riad — very talented at taking our pictures and videos. Super clear, super aesthetic, and he’s really alert and sharp. I highly recommend him. He’s very helpful. Definitely coming back to this restaurant.

I texted the staff at 2pm on 17/12 because the celebration that need to be done by 17 dec and the staff directly whatsapp me for confirm book. The decoration only Rm100 including burnt cheese cake 🍰 that’s very delicious and moist inside😍

The decoration was very nice, the staff “Riad” are very good services, he helped me and my bff to take a few photos since there are less customer in the shop and it turns out the photos are sooooo pretty 😍

As for the food, we ordered carbonara chicken, breast chicken (moist inside), pesto pasta, and also drinks which is cocktails for my bff and me is Choc drink. It tastes good and normal bcs i always went for fine dining with my bff so the price are just normal. Idk why people complain a lot but for me, the staff are attending me nicely, thankyou Riad for being there when i ask your for help! 😍🥰

name: Kuwana Castle Ruins
reviews: Beautiful place. Will be more beautiful if we visit in the spring I think, lots of Sakura tree. I visit in winter but it's still good enough. Calm. Birds singing. I could stay hours to watch the ducks swimming

Not much left her except some stone remnants where turrets used to be and some more where the honmaru used to be, but the canal moats are still here in some form and populated by hundreds of turtles and some waterfowl. It's quite a relaxing area that resembles more a greenpark than a castle ruin. That being said, it is still nice to visit for it's historical value and it's beauty. The area with the shrines here as well is a nice, tranquil spot.
I was confused. And I'm still confused. Where is the castle? I just found shrines and some guarding towers ruins (I think it's only foundation).

name: Kobe Motomachi Doria Harborland umie
reviews: I don't understand the low rating this restaurant has; the food we ordered was delicious, bowls of rice, cheese, and whatever toppings you like, all accompanied by a very cold beer. The staff was very friendly and helpful.
Delicious!!! But no Aircon at the area we seated , it was so hot! My friends order the special seasonal menu and also a tomato based rice were all nice!!

Kids friendly restaurant! They offer western-influenced cuisine. Every menu was nice and the service was good.
They offer English menu if you ask the server.

name: Bell of Hortensia
reviews: The famous Bell of Hortensia sculpture, located in Meriken Park in the Kobe Harborland area, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan.
Tremendous. A totemic emblem. It radiates energy from its girth, and propagates power from its shaft. If only it still spoke, but alas its bells have been silenced by fate.
Beautiful view of the Kobe tower

name: Arima yakiniku TASUKU
reviews:
We had the Kobe Beef BBQ Set here last night. Overall, the food, ambiance, and service were all very good, and we had a pleasant experience.

The dinner set costs around 20,000 JPY per person. While eating, we noticed:
•	The 100g beef portion felt a bit small and wasn’t very filling;
•	The 150g beef portion was more substantial but a bit rich and heavy.

To feel full, we ordered two extra bowls of rice each to go with the beef （even for the 150g set）, but the balance of portion size and richness still felt a little off.

It would be great if the restaurant could offer an option like 100g Kobe beef plus more side dishes, which would satisfy appetite without being too rich.

Overall, this restaurant is excellent in terms of taste and service, but the portion size options for the beef set could be improved.

I'm a bit confused about the other reviews, my experience was:

1) food: outstanding, fresh meat, good cuts, good ingredients, excellent equipment = great result! Sauce is delicious, for a Mexican to say that, trust me, it's not easy!

2) attention: the staff is always around and helping

3) price: I'm impressed it's not more expensive, it should be!

Overall, the place is a great choice if you are around the area, ask for the skirt and wagyu lean cut and you'll not be disappointed!

This was my first experience trying yakiniku, and both the hostess and chef were extremely helpful and patient with guiding me through ordering and using the grill. The meat and sauces were absolutely delicious, as well as the kimchi, which was actually spicy! It was very reasonably priced (a meal for a single woman at ~£40), for some of the best beef I have ever eaten.

I would highly recommend, especially as they are a restaurant in Arima Onsen which is open after 7pm. The older reviews don't do justice to this restaurant, this was one of the best meals I had in Japan. Thank you for accommodating me, even when you had a group reservation at the same time!

name: 住吉浦
reviews: 私のパワースポット⭐︎お参り出来て、癒しの景色見れて幸せ♡左が３つの川右が海。エ川から海へと繋がる所はエネルギーが高いそうです。ふるさと思い出します。ありがとう♡

暴れ川の傍らやもんー昔の面影を残すんは難しいやろな💦

name: Fort Cornwallis
reviews:
View @ Fort Cornwallis.
.
The oldest surviving structure in the city, this open-air museum fort was built in 1786 by Captain Francis Light when the British East India Company established its foothold on the island. Designed as a defensive stronghold, it never saw a single battle throughout its history.
.
The fort retains its star-shaped layout and houses several historical features, including a small 18th‑century chapel, old prison cells, and rows of cannons overlooking the sea. Among these is the famed Seri Rambai cannon, over 400 years old and steeped in local folklore.

I visited Fort Cornwallis during my trip to Penang. The fort is located along the waterfront in George Town, making it very easy to access while exploring the city. Its seaside location and historic exterior give a strong sense of colonial history, and it is pleasant to walk around the area. I decided not to enter the fort itself. After watching videos of the interior on YouTube, I felt that the exhibitions were limited and did not justify the admission fee for me. Even without entering, the surroundings and atmosphere are worth experiencing.

Review: A Historic Bastion with a View
Rating: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
"Visited Fort Cornwallis recently and while parts of it were closed for restoration, the experience was still worth it. The newly restored moats look fantastic and add a real sense of history to the perimeter. Even if you can’t explore every corner inside right now, the walk along the Esplanade is lovely. The breeze and the view over the water (the Penang Strait) are absolutely awesome—perfect for photos! It’s a must-see landmark for anyone interested in how George Town began."

name: ATSKY Bukit Bintang
street: Level 4, Menara Worldwide, 198, Jln Bukit Bintang
reviews:
⭐ 1/5 – Very disappointing experience
This is honestly one of the worst restaurant experiences I’ve had.
As a Malay-owned business, it’s really disappointing to see food and service handled this way. It feels like there is no care at all for food quality or customers.
There were around 20 of us, and the restaurant was not crowded at all, so there was really no excuse for the poor food quality and service.
Most of the food tasted pre-cooked and reheated. The meat was badly burnt, very tough, dry, and hard to swallow. The spaghetti also tasted like it was reheated. My mother’s food was spoiled — it smelled really bad, especially after being heated in the oven. That was extremely upsetting and unacceptable.
The crème brûlée was cold on the inside but hot on the outside, clearly not prepared properly. As for drinks, they were all overly sweet. Even mineral water was suspicious — when asking for ice, it tasted sweet, which makes us wonder whether the cups were properly washed or reused without cleaning.
We also paid RM200 for decoration, and it was very, very basic — just simple balloons and small candles. Nothing special at all, definitely not worth the price.
We asked to speak to the manager, but no one showed up. It felt like they were avoiding us and didn’t want to take responsibility. The female staff at the front door was also very rude.
That said, I want to mention one Malay male waiter who was polite and respectful throughout. I truly respect him for remaining professional despite everything.
The restaurant condition itself was poor — the sticker wallpaper on the floor was badly damaged and looked neglected.
Overall, this place is not worth visiting. It feels like the owner only cares about making money and not about food quality, hygiene, or customer experience at all.
Very disappointed.

First of all, the interior. When i first got out of the lift, the grass carpet were worn out. Even the inside looks bad, worn out vinyls, many empty table and spilled spaghetti on the floor.

Second is the service,it was bad.my dad asked “wheres the cashier?” And the staff just IGNORED my dad like he was no one.

Third is the food, I told the waitress i want my steak to be cooked medium well, and it came out well and it taste awful. And the texture, i expect it to be a good crust but it came out BURNT and SALTY. Also the lamb chop, its spicy and hard to chew. And the ribs, i was confused, “is this ribs or what?”. For me personally, i prefer my storebought for rm15 and homecooked. And lastly for the meats, it has 0 tenderness and taste so cheap yet cost so expensive. When it said “if you love wagyu, you’ll love this too” and i was putting high expectation.and yeah the storebought beats it by 100 miles. I ordered a creme brulee and even repeated it. And it DIDNT even get delivered. Same goes to the mix fruits my dad ordered.

I dont even understand why this place is so viral, but its so bad. Maybe the influencer is getting paid and NOT giving an honest review. For me and my family personally, its our FIRST and LAST time coming here. I hope the restaurant reads this feedback and change their mistakes. For the next person thats coming here, dont be fooled by the image and it being viral. Bad experience for my whole family that come from N9 just to having family dinner here. Not recommeded at all.

Love the ambience. Live music. Good for birthday celebration. The singer will sing bday song but you have to approach the staff to pass the name and tip $10 for the singer. Food portion is huge and delicious. View is nice. Will definitely come again if i come to KL.

name: Sannomiya OPA
reviews: Just awesome and convenient area to run my errands
It's been going here for years and there is always something nice to find or eat. Very close to sannomiya area and just outside of the train gate there is lots to do lots to see a lots to eat
Good shops in this small building easy to get too from Soho Sannomiya

name: TWO SONS On The Park @ KLCC
street: Level 1, Lot 160 & Kiosk OS113, Petronas Twin Tower
reviews:
My family and I had high expectations for our lunch here as we have heard many positive reviews of the restaurant, but unfortunately the experience was utterly disappointing.

Our order was placed at 12:28 PM, and by 1:14 PM several of our dishes had yet to arrive. During this time, we noticed that a number of tables who were seated after us were served their food first, suggesting that the service flow and order coordination require significant improvement. The food that did arrive came out at different times. My father received his fish & chips and my daughter her fries while my mother, sister and I were left waiting for almost an hour for our orders.

Only after we brought this to the attention of the staff did our cream chilli clam arrive. Regrettably, while we were eating, we discovered a strand of hair in the dish (photo attached). This raised serious concerns regarding food handling and hygiene.

Given the circumstances, we requested to cancel the remaining items and left the restaurant without having a proper meal.

We hope the management will review both their service efficiency and quality control, as the restaurant has great potential but the current standards did not reflect the reputation it carries.

July 2025- Went for my moms birthday celebration. The service was really pleasant from all staff. The food was all good and up to standard. Not to mention their signature star dish, the mussels. The broth was thick and I loved every bit of it. I lovethe mussel pizza, its so good.The atmosphere and ambience was calm and chilly. Theres also a door that gets you to the outdoor balcony to enjoy the view. Overall good experience and I'll definitely come back. The price of food was pricey but since its a good quality restaurant and with good food, its worth it. P/s: I dont like the drink which was a pitcher of juice. Maybe its just tasteless for me. The chocolate milkshake was fine tho.

Couple issues we faced during my last dinner here;

Firstly, quality of food has gone down a lot. My friend ordered the seafood vongole and its really bland, no seafood taste. Just boring. Same w the caesar salad. Only food thats okay is the spicy pasta and butter cream chili clam.

Secondly, one of the servers kept slamming the plates on the table. What if it spilled on us? Really upsetting.

Just dont think its worth a visit rn, not until they improve.

name: Plico Sannomiya
reviews: Seasonal gift souviour!🎏🎍🎋😋🎑
Good food
Love this place...!!!!!!

name: Kobe Brando-tei (神戸ブランド亭)
street: Kobe Harborland umie Mosaic, 2F, 1 Chome-6-1 Higashikawasakicho
reviews:
This was the worst meal I had during this trip. It’s overpriced for the quality of the food. I understand that Kobe beef isn’t cheap, but when it’s overcooked, the whole meal becomes disappointing and not worth the price. The rice also didn’t taste good as other restaurants I had in Japan.

However, I would still recommend the kids’ meal — it’s only 800 yen and offers great value.

I ordered a medium rare Japanese style kobe beef steak meal (that was the staff recommendation).
The steak was totally over cooked and chewy, i told to the waitress but they didn’t do anything about it, i couldn’t even eat my meal. Salad with out dressing, potatoes and veggies no salt and the bread wasn’t fresh. Very disappointed for a “kobe steak”. I won’t eat here again.
The hamburg was tender. The omelette wasn’t runny but still delicious.

name: Amity Landing Restaurant
reviews: Of course I needed to stop & try the Jaws Swiss Roll! Jaws is one of my all-time favorite movies, and since it was the 50th Anniversary of the movie, it seemed necessary. The dessert was okay, not the best, but it was a lot of fun to look at. If the cake wasn't dry, I would've given it five stars for the flavors alone.

Service is amazing! Highly recommend. Kids meal had a yummy pancake with butter and syrup. Pancake was sweet and delicious. Chicken is amazing. Real deep fried boneless white meat tender. The kids dessert is a yummy blue raspberry jelly. They serve beer it’s very light and delicious. The man at the front will show you how to mobile order. But line moves fast. We are American and love the customer service here! If it’s your first trip tell them at the register and they will give you a sticker.

We can't expect food at the amusement park to be good, but it tastes alright in my opinion, better than HP themed restaurant. Their staff are friendly and polite, they even tried to interact with us in character, trying their best while knowing we don't understand Japanese.

name: restaurant GRILL TABLE
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−3−5 神戸ハーバーランド神戸マリオットホテル 17階
reviews: the beef was so delicious and the dessert section of the buffet was amazing 🤤

Had the worst experience here at Grill Table at Marriott - do not dine here.

The restaurant was mostly empty for dinner, yet every table including ours kept waving and calling but the waiters deliberately ignored and took their time to take everyone's food and drink orders.

They would bring the wrong food and drinks to each table, and completely forget drink orders. I presume because it's all you can drink, they deliberately served very slowly and just ignored every second drink order.

The food was also very average, and definitely not worth the expensive price.

Strongly do not recommend this restaurant. Please avoid this disappointment at all costs.

神戸マリオットホテルのランチビュッフェが話題になっていたので行ってきました。

90分平日ランチビュッフェ　2500円（税・サービス料込）　へ行ってきました。
＊訪店時期　2026年1月上旬の平日
少し先まで予約が埋まっていて人気があります。
当日キャンセルなどもあり、予約なしで入れることもごく稀にあるそうですが、
予約をして行かれることをお勧めします。

ビュッフェはずいぶん久々。
今回足を運びたいと思ったきっかけは、洗練されたビュッフェメニューに興味をもったからです。ビュッフェメニューと選べるメイン料理、ビュッフェにデザートもあって税・サービス料込みで2,500円
足を運んだ日はこんな感じ。
ビュッフェメニュー
* 季節野菜のフリッタータ
*  鶏肉とペンネのバジル風味のサラダ
*  スモークサーモンとクスクス ケッカソース
*  かぼちゃとサツマイモローズマリーの香り チリハニー
*  ムール貝とキノコのアーリオオーリオ
*  イタリア産 グラナパターナ”ロックチーズ”
*  今月のフリットタルタルソース えびのフリッター
*  クリームチーズ アーモンドのコカ
*  神戸ポークとソーセージ、季節野菜のポトフ
* イカスミパエリア
* 鶏肉とペンネバジル風味サラダ
* グリルテーブルオリジナル牛すじカレー
* ココナッツミルクでマイルドにしたグリーンカレー

選べるメイン料理（一部追加料金あり）
■奥丹波鶏のトマト洗込み野菜 淡路業の生パスタ
■ガリシア産ポークハーブ香るロースト季節野菜添え
■エピのケイジャンスパイスローストポテトビューレトマトとレモンパター（+400円）
■カマスのブランチャキノコのハーブバターソースオリーブパン粉（+500円）
■旬魚介のアクアパッツァ（＋700円）
■牛ヒレ肉のクリエ 美産玉ねぎのサルサ（+1,200円）

デザート
* オレンジビスタチオバスクチーズケーキ
* ミルクチョコと苺のムース
* 洋梨と苺のコンポートアニス風味
* ポピーシードキャラメルバウンド

私は、追加料金なしのガリシア産ポークハーブ香るロースト季節野菜添えをチョイスしました。

メインのポーク、柔らかくてジューシー。添えられているマッシュポテトも絶品。
カレーは牛すじ、グリーン両方味わいましたあ、どちらも味が良く本格的。
ビュッフェメニューはとても洗練された味。濃いだけ、甘いだけ、しつこいだけという味付けでなく、奥行きのある味のメニューがいろいろ楽しめました。
パエリアやクスクスを食べたのでパンを食べることができず。
色々な種類のパンがありました。
メニューは季節によって変わるのかな？改めて足を運びたいです。

street: 三宮センター街, 3 Chome-8 Sannomiyacho
reviews: ここも深夜に行くと誰も居ないのに明かりがついていて別世界感はありますが、如何せん距離が短いです。
神戸のグルメとショップが集まったスポット。

name: グルメ回転寿司 鈴木水産 鈴鹿
reviews: For sushi lovers, I recommend this place.  It is a little more expensive, but the delicious taste of fresh fish is different from the sushi restaurants in the region.  It has a menu in English for foreigners.  On Saturdays and Sundays, at lunchtime, the order may take a while.
Nice food

We came to Aeon Mall Suzuka after visiting the Suzuka Circuit and it seemed like everyone had the same idea as the place was packed. It took quite some time to find parking.

It was late afternoon, well before the dinner rush so we got a table here right away.

A decent variety of sushi / sashimi at reasonable prices. We also had the lobster and abalone special, both of which were excellent value.

Don’t expect to be blown out of the park but perfectly satisfying sushi at wallet-friendly prices.

name: Iris Park Mizono
reviews: 規模は大きくありませんが駐車場が数点。トイレあり。季節によっては草競馬もあり。子供向けアスレチック側は子供の歓声があがり、中央付近はトイレとお花見スペースがありますが車道からの走行音が大きめ。特になにもない広場側が一番静かかもしれません。競技場側はもちろん選手たちの掛け声がよくあがります。自販機は故障した模様。飲み物持参し忘れないようご注意を

多度草競馬を観戦しました。
見晴らしの良い土手の下にあるダートコースを馬が疾走します。
いなべ草競馬よりも勝負色の強い印象で、騎手や厩舎関係者の気迫や熱気が伝わってきました。
年3回草競馬を見学できます。向正面で見ると迫力満点。運動公園の駐車場あり。

reviews: Best char koayteow, used to put in Lebuh Keng Kwee now shifted to new place 😄

Cheap and delicious

name: Wong Ah Wah Restaurant | Jalan Alor
reviews:
If you speak Chinese, you basically don’t need the menu. Aunty(staff) is so aggressive, she doesn’t give you time to think or even touch the menu — it’s basically Omakase: her way or the highway.
The food was decent. The wings are their signature dish, though honestly I’ve had better. The stingray was interesting and worth a try.
The experience itself? Horrible. But hey, that’s part of the tourist grind. Overall, it’s a once-and-for-all night market experience — I won’t be back, but it’s worth checking out if you want a story to tell.

The chicken wings were delicious and a must-order dish; the crab was flavourful too and is their signature. We sat by the roadside, and many tourists saw us eating and asked whether it was good. We gave them a thumbs-up, which attracted them after watching us eat. The noodles were a bit oily, but my friend added another plate of fried lard (zhu you zha) and finished everything.

Overall food quality was average. Huge variety of choices of typical zichar dishes we can find anywhere.

Pricing was affordable because the portion was smaller. Generally the food flavour, quality and fresheness was average, given the pricing. Most dishes served was lukewarm only.

Ok to eat but nothing memorable to shout out here. Very typical hawker standard.

Environment wise- Saw a small baby cockcroach crawling within the menu. Bathroom cleaniless was also very hawker centre standard.

name: サンシティ専門店街
reviews: Great place

ミントの地下のコーヨーやダイエーに行くのに必ずこの専門店街を通ります
今は三ノ宮駅が改装中で、周辺色々行き止まりになっていたりするけれど、完成したら人通りがグッと増えるはず
それを見越してか、話題のある新しいお店がどんどんオープンしていて、これからが楽しみな場所ですね✨

ほぼ毎日、行きます♪
買物だけではなく、サンチカや阪急百貨店、阪神電車へ行く近道として、利用しております。
三宮の再開発で、サンシティの回りは工事が始まりませんます。
だいぶ先の話になりますが、かなり良くなりそうなので、楽しみです😉
暫くは、不便ですが慣れるしかないですね🧐

name: Kailash Parbat
reviews:
Ajith, the cashier, was rude towards customers — not only to Malaysians but also to foreign Indian customers. He is not suitable to work at the counter. Please learn proper customer service from Kailash Parbat at Nu Sentral, where the service was top-notch.
The staff preparing the pani puri kept talking and joking with the cashier while customers were waiting for their food. The funniest part was that he kept his mask under his chin while preparing the food.
The taste was nowhere near as good as the Nu Sentral KL branch. The Chennai Indian coffee tasted watery. All the staff seemed too busy chatting, and my coffee was only prepared after the pani puri was served on my tray. It was supposedly freshly made, but he simply poured it from a jug.
Overall, it was a waste of both money and time.
Food is good staff is also good chole bhature  and chaat very tasty

Went to visit twin tower discovered Kailash Parbat restaurant. The food was great quality just like eating in Mumbai. Dosa was crisp and fresh. North Indian combo was very delicious. Authentic Indian flavour. Pricing justifies the food quality and quantity. Mango lassi is a must order.

street: 1-70 , Jalan , Sunway Velocity Mall, Lingkaran Sunway Velocity
reviews:
First visit to this outlet, though my first experience dining at this café was at their 1Utama branch. Compared to that outlet, the coffee here is average. The pastries were underwhelming—the Double Happiness puff with custard and cream was just average, while the custard horn was disappointing. The crust was hard, and the custard filling lacked flavor.

Additionally, they had run out of serviettes during my visit. I suggest improving on these aspects for a better dining experience.

COFFEE NOT GREAT.  (10/12/2025)
