went for their dessert buffet and i can say that the buffet is so worth it. all the food i ate was good but maybe there could be more variety but that's the only   downside.

their service also was excellent. short but good brief about how the buffet works and desserts took little time to be served 👍👍

name: Noy Thai Food
reviews: The food here is very delicious and authentic. I ordered tom yum soup and salted egg prawns. Everything was really delicious. However, when ordering, I suggest specifying the size. Because if you don't, they will give you the large size. I highly recommend this place because the owner is friendly and the food is really delicious although it's a bit pricy. The two of us ate here and spent 103 MYR but were very satisfied with the delicious taste and very big portion.

Noy Thai in Kuala Lumpur is a culinary gem that serves up authentic Thai cuisine reminiscent of Thailand's bustling street markets. The fried glass noodles are a must-try, offering a perfect balance of flavors and textures, while the Tom Yum soup delights with its spicy and sour zest. The atmosphere is welcoming, with staff that go out of their way to make you feel at home.

Value for Money

Concerns about the eatery being pricey are often unfounded. The menu is diverse, and while fresh seafood may come at a premium, there are plenty of dishes that are both delicious and reasonably priced. It's all about choosing wisely to ensure that the experience doesn't break the bank.

A Return Visit

The combination of delectable food and warm hospitality means that Noy Thai is a place you'll want to visit again. It's not just about the meal; it's about the experience, the culture, and the memories that you'll carry with you long after you've left. Noy Thai is a testament to the fact that good food and great service are always in style.

Best green curry I’ve ever had and I’ve been to Thailand several times. I asked for vegetarian curry and they were able to accommodate me. I said little spice and they made it perfectly. They were several different vegetables in it and it was more than enough. It exceeded my expectations for sure and I will definitely return if I ever return to KL!! The photo of the curry was a small amount of it out into a tiny bowl they gave me on the side.

name: Yong Le Kopitiam
reviews: One of the best street food kopitiams around! Their wantan noodles and dumplings are truly the best in town — a must-try with no regrets. The variety of choices is impressive, making it a perfect spot for food lovers seeking authentic local flavors.”
The foods were exceptionally tasty. The seafood tofu soup is a must try. My first time had this and loving this. The service was great as well. A must visit when you go to bukit bintang.
We decided to have dinner here since it was hard to find malay cuisine. The chicken was tender and delicious. Milo was not too sweet, a lil bit bitter and it was so good. Overall worth to try.

name: Kobe Dining
street: Higashikawasakicho, 1 Chome−6−1 神戸ハーバーランドumie モザイク 2F
reviews:
We were looking for some washoku and came across this old-style diner! We ordered the boiled fish set and the hamburg set which were both delicious and tasted really like authentic Japanese school lunches dishes!!
Good place if you’re bringing young kids because there is a sitting area on tatami.
Foreigner friendly, since you order on a tablet which has translation.

Food here is terrible.  “Kobe beef” did not taste like Kobe beef and it’s mostly fat.  Lettuces in the salad tasted like they will expire tomorrow.  Oden was the worst, especially the ちくわ, I bet it was sitting in the soup for at least 3 days.  The ぼっかけそばめし must of used at least 20 ml oil, all we can taste is oil.  タコの唐揚げwas so rubbery that one piece required almost a minute to chew.

I rate this 2 stars instead of 1 because the rice was decent and the drinks were okay.

Found this place accidentally in the Mosaic mall near the Kobe port. The interior design of this restaurant isn’t very delicate, it’s a bit dark inside, and there isn’t so many customers. The food quantity is fulfilling but taste ordinary. The staff are very nice and helpful. They kept helping me refilling my glass.

Although there are many restaurant choices, I chose this one, because it’s called “神戸食堂” (the cafeteria of Kobe). I didn’t check any public reviews of restaurants nearby. Although this restaurant isn’t a fancy choice, I am still satisfying, and I get to know a new dish.

There are electronic pads on everyone’s table, you browse the menu and order from the pad of your own table. The staff won’t miss your order or mistake your order with others’. Their menu offers a wide range of dish choices as well as side dishes, drinks and desserts.

I order the しらす丼定食 (rice with small white fish and fresh egg set meal), which is something I’ve never seen and had in Japan before.

The rice with small white fish and fresh egg yolk is of very big quantity. The rice is high quality Japanese cooked rice as usual. The small white fish and egg yolk are very fresh.
The side dishes within the set meal are miso soup, small fresh salad, a tofu cube and a small portion cold boodle blended with dried shrimp. The side dishes are very ordinary but also not off-putting.

name: Brickfields colorful backlane
reviews:
Unfortunately it's not worth visiting. I thought we would get some nice aesthetic shots while we were here. But the paint was faded, there was an open sewer and umbrellas aren't there anymore.

Attached is an overfly drone video, that's all you need to see, it's not worth going out of the way for or even stopping by if you're in the area.

Please like this review if I've saved you some time :)
Currently the condition of this road is very bad.  Many people want to come here after seeing the image shown on Google Maps.  But now in the year 2024 someone will be really disappointed here.

I mean... It is colorful... That is absolutely true... Yet it has a pretty depressive touch to it... It might be because I was there right after it stopped raining and the colors were a bit more grey because of that... A rat ran across it too so... Still! Go there to take a Pic :)!
